rows.original: The office of the planetary governor, Big T., is a warm, spacious office with plenty of seats and couches and several bookshelves, looking more like an aristocrat’s study than a government office. The room is dominated by a huge, oaken desk facing the door, a semi-circle of wood alight with monitors, holo-displays, and other readouts, all angled towards a huge, comfy-looking chair.
rows.translation: 行星总督大T的办公室宽敞温暖，摆放着许多座椅、沙发和几座书架，看起来更像贵族的书房，而非政府办公室。正对门口的一张巨大橡木办公桌占据了整个房间的视觉中心，半圆形桌面上亮着显示器、全息屏幕和其他读数装置，全都朝向一张看上去无比舒适的巨椅。
rows.raw: "The office of the planetary governor, Big T., is a warm, spacious office with plenty of seats and couches and several bookshelves, looking more like an aristocrat’s study than a government office. The room is dominated by a huge, oaken desk facing the door, a semi-circle of wood alight with monitors, holo-displays, and other readouts, all angled towards a huge, comfy-looking chair."

rows.original: The towering bull-like governor is sitting at his desk, busily talking and typing, managing the world’s affairs all from his desk.
rows.translation: 那位身形高大、酷似公牛的总督正坐在办公桌后，一边忙着交谈和打字，一边足不出户地处理整个世界的事务。
rows.raw: " The towering bull-like governor is sitting at his desk, busily talking and typing, managing the world’s affairs all from his desk."

rows.original: You pull on the door, but all it does is rattle, locked. The secretary just laughs to herself, making her implausibly large bust wobble. “You’ll need to talk to me if you want to get in there, but why don’t you save us both the time and just leave?” Rude.
rows.translation: 你拉了拉门，但门锁着，只发出一阵晃动声。 秘书暗自发笑，令她大得难以置信的胸脯随之摇晃。“你想进去就得先跟我谈，不过何不替咱俩都省点时间，直接离开呢？” 真没礼貌。
rows.raw: "You pull on the door, but all it does is rattle, locked. The secretary just laughs to herself, making her implausibly large bust wobble. “You’ll need to talk to me if you want to get in there, but why don’t you save us both the time and just leave?” Rude."

rows.original: You step through the door into Governor Tee’s office. The inside is nothing like any government office you’ve seen before, looking more like a hunting lodge’s lobby than the soulless, bleak affairs you’re familiar with from the core worlds. The room’s dominated by a huge oaken desk facing the door, a semi-circle of solid hardwood inlaid with enough holo-displays to light up the room. The screens show flickering glimpses of milk production, food exports, and the comings and goings of ships from all over the planet’s many towns. Hunting trophies line the room, culminating in a massive stuffed creature behind the desk, looking something like a six-legged polar bear with a unicorn’s horn jamming out from its head.
rows.translation: 你穿过房门，进入蒂总督的办公室。里面和你见过的任何政府办公室都截然不同，更像狩猎小屋的大厅，而不是核心世界里那些毫无生气、阴沉乏味的办事机构。房间里最显眼的是一张正对房门的巨型橡木办公桌，半圆形实木桌面嵌满了足以照亮整个房间的全息显示器。屏幕上闪现着牛奶产量、食品出口，以及来自星球各城镇的飞船进出记录。狩猎战利品陈列在房间四周，最后汇聚到桌后的一头巨大标本：它看上去像一只六条腿的北极熊，脑袋上却突兀地伸出一根独角兽般的角。
rows.raw: "You step through the door into Governor Tee’s office. The inside is nothing like any government office you’ve seen before, looking more like a hunting lodge’s lobby than the soulless, bleak affairs you’re familiar with from the core worlds. The room’s dominated by a huge oaken desk facing the door, a semi-circle of solid hardwood inlaid with enough holo-displays to light up the room. The screens show flickering glimpses of milk production, food exports, and the comings and goings of ships from all over the planet’s many towns. Hunting trophies line the room, culminating in a massive stuffed creature behind the desk, looking something like a six-legged polar bear with a unicorn’s horn jamming out from its head."

rows.original: Pacing in front of the desk is a huge, barrel-chested bull man. He’s better dressed than you might have expected, clad in slacks and a white button-up shirt, just low enough to show a forest of dark, curly chest hair over taut muscles. The only Texan thing about him is the wide-brimmed white Stetson hat he’s wearing, pierced by a pair of huge steer horns growing from his brow, and the over-sized six-gun slung low on his hip. For a man of his size, though, it looks like a popgun: New Texas’s governor stands a formidable ten feet in height, at the least, and taller with his horns and cowboy hat added in. He’s a wrecking ball of a man, massive and muscular, all crammed into business casual wear that looks ready to burst if he takes a deep breath.
rows.translation: 办公桌前踱步的是一个胸膛如桶般宽阔的巨型牛人。他穿得比你预想中体面，身着长裤和白色纽扣衬衫，领口开得恰到好处，露出紧绷肌肉上茂密卷曲的黑色胸毛。他身上唯一颇具得州风格的是那顶宽檐白色斯泰森帽，一对巨大的阉牛角从额头长出并刺穿帽身；腰间还低低挂着一把超大号六发左轮。可即便如此，以他的体格来看，那把枪也像支玩具：新德克萨斯的总督至少高达十英尺，算上牛角和牛仔帽还要更高。他像一颗人形破坏球，魁梧而肌肉发达，硬塞在一套仿佛只要深吸一口气就会撑破的商务休闲装里。
rows.raw: "\n\nPacing in front of the desk is a huge, barrel-chested bull man. He’s better dressed than you might have expected, clad in slacks and a white button-up shirt, just low enough to show a forest of dark, curly chest hair over taut muscles. The only Texan thing about him is the wide-brimmed white Stetson hat he’s wearing, pierced by a pair of huge steer horns growing from his brow, and the over-sized six-gun slung low on his hip. For a man of his size, though, it looks like a popgun: New Texas’s governor stands a formidable ten feet in height, at the least, and taller with his horns and cowboy hat added in. He’s a wrecking ball of a man, massive and muscular, all crammed into business casual wear that looks ready to burst if he takes a deep breath."

rows.original: Seeing you walk in, the governor points to a headset buried in one of his bovine ears and says, “Sorry, hoss, visitors a‘comin’. We’ll settle up later. Yeah. Ya’ll take care, now.”
rows.translation: 看到你走进来，总督指了指埋在一只牛耳里的耳机，说道：“抱歉，伙计，有客人来啦。咱们回头再谈。嗯。你们多保重啊。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSeeing you walk in, the governor points to a headset buried in one of his bovine ears and says, “Sorry, hoss, visitors a‘comin’. We’ll settle up later. Yeah. Ya’ll take care, now.”"

rows.original: He clicks off the headset and thrusts his hand out beneath a big, toothy grin. “Well howdy! Welcome to New Texas, partner!”
rows.translation: 他关掉耳机，咧开大嘴露出满口牙齿，伸出手来。“哎呀，你好！欢迎来到新德克萨斯，朋友！”
rows.raw: "He clicks off the headset and thrusts his hand out beneath a big, toothy grin. “Well howdy! Welcome to New Texas, partner!”"

rows.original: Over your shoulder and through the door, the governor shouts, “Zephyr! You didn’t say our guest was a beautiful woman!” “You say that like anything else walks through your damn door!” comes the answer from the lobby. Tee guffaws, waving her off and extends a hand to you.
rows.translation: 总督越过你的肩膀，朝门外喊道：“泽菲尔！你可没说我们的客人是位美人！” “你说得好像还有别的什么人会走进你那扇破门似的！”大厅里传来回答。蒂哈哈大笑，对她挥挥手，接着向你伸出手。
rows.raw: "Over your shoulder and through the door, the governor shouts, “Zephyr! You didn’t say our guest was a beautiful woman!”\n\n“You say that like anything else walks through your damn door!” comes the answer from the lobby. Tee guffaws, waving her off and extends a hand to you."

rows.original: You shake Big T.’s hand and introduce yourself. His grip’s vice-like, crushing down on you as he pumps your arm eagerly. <i>“Outstanding! Welcome to New Texas,
rows.translation: 你握住大T的手并作了自我介绍。他的握力如同老虎钳，热情地上下摇动你的手臂时，手掌也紧紧压住你。<i>“太棒了！欢迎来到新德克萨斯，
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shake Big T.’s hand and introduce yourself. His grip’s vice-like, crushing down on you as he pumps your arm eagerly. <i>“Outstanding! Welcome to New Texas, "

rows.original: Mr.
rows.translation: 先生
rows.raw: "Mr."

rows.original: Ms.
rows.translation: 女士
rows.raw: "Ms."

rows.original: Steele. I’m Governor Benjamin Tiberious Tee. Though most folks ‘round here just call me Big T.”
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔。我是本杰明·提比略·蒂总督。不过这儿的大多数人都叫我大T。”
rows.raw: " Steele. I’m Governor Benjamin Tiberious Tee. Though most folks ‘round here just call me Big T.”"

rows.original: He ushers you into a big, plush seat and plops down behind his desk, kicking his feet up and pulling a huge, blue cigar from a drawer. <i>“Enjoyin’ your stay on New Texas so far,
rows.translation: 他把你领到一张宽大柔软的椅子上，自己则一屁股坐回桌后，翘起双脚，从抽屉里取出一根巨大的蓝色雪茄。<i>“目前在新德克萨斯住得还开心吗，
rows.raw: "\n\nHe ushers you into a big, plush seat and plops down behind his desk, kicking his feet up and pulling a huge, blue cigar from a drawer. <i>“Enjoyin’ your stay on New Texas so far, "

rows.original: Mr.
rows.translation: 先生
rows.raw: "Mr."

rows.original: Ms.
rows.translation: 女士
rows.raw: "Ms."

rows.original: Steele? Lemme know if there’s anything you need -- or if you’ve got questions! Most governor’s have secretaries for that sorta thing, but mine’s a little ornery for it, dontcha think?”
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔？有什么需要——或者有什么问题——尽管告诉我！大多数总督都会让秘书处理这类事，可我那位的脾气可不太适合，你说是不是？”
rows.raw: " Steele? Lemme know if there’s anything you need -- or if you’ve got questions! Most governor’s have secretaries for that sorta thing, but mine’s a little ornery for it, dontcha think?”"

rows.original: “I can hear you!” Zephyr snorts from outside.
rows.translation: “我听得见！”泽菲尔在外面哼了一声。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I can hear you!” Zephyr snorts from outside."

rows.original: “Hrm. Gotta invest in some soundproofing one of these days,” Tee grunts, scratching his beard.
rows.translation: “嗯。改天真得弄点隔音措施，”蒂一边嘟囔，一边挠着胡子。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hrm. Gotta invest in some soundproofing one of these days,” Tee grunts, scratching his beard."

rows.original: Big T.
rows.translation: 大T
rows.raw: "Big T."

rows.original: “Howdy there, Steele. Take a load off,” Governor Tee grins, motioning to the seat across from his desk. He lights up a big, blue-crowned cigar as you settle in. “So, what can I do ya for?”
rows.translation: “你好啊，斯蒂尔。坐下歇歇，”蒂总督咧嘴笑着，示意你坐到办公桌对面的椅子上。你落座时，他点燃一根顶端泛蓝的大雪茄。“那么，我能为你做什么？”
rows.raw: "“Howdy there, Steele. Take a load off,” Governor Tee grins, motioning to the seat across from his desk. He lights up a big, blue-crowned cigar as you settle in. “So, what can I do ya for?”"

rows.original: Big T
rows.translation: 大T
rows.raw: "Big T"

rows.original: Go talk to the Governor
rows.translation: 去和总督谈谈
rows.raw: "Go talk to the Governor"

rows.original: “So, tell me about your planet, Governor Tee,” you prompt. The governor’s all too happy to oblige.
rows.translation: “那么，蒂总督，给我讲讲你的星球吧，”你提示道。总督非常乐意回答。
rows.raw: "“So, tell me about your planet, Governor Tee,” you prompt. The governor’s all too happy to oblige."

rows.original: “Well this here a paradise world if ever there was one,” Big T. says proudly, leaning back in his chair and puffing his cigar. “Beautiful, friendly people. Verdant fields and open sky. Peaceful and happy.”
rows.translation: “要说天堂般的世界，这儿绝对算一个，”大T骄傲地说着，靠向椅背，抽了一口雪茄。“人民美丽又友善，田野青翠，天空辽阔。和平又幸福。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well this here a paradise world if ever there was one,” Big T. says proudly, leaning back in his chair and puffing his cigar. “Beautiful, friendly people. Verdant fields and open sky. Peaceful and happy.”"

rows.original: There’s a long pause after that. Long enough to make you think he’s not going to say any more.
rows.translation: 随后是一阵长久的沉默。久得让你以为他不会再说下去了。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s a long pause after that. Long enough to make you think he’s not going to say any more."

rows.original: “Is that it? Is that your whole sell?” you ask, laughing.
rows.translation: “就这些？这就是你的全部推销词？”你笑着问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Is that it? Is that your whole sell?” you ask, laughing."

rows.original: “Anything else to it?” you finally ask.
rows.translation: “还有别的吗？”你终于问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anything else to it?” you finally ask."

rows.original: Tee guffaws and slaps his knee. “That not enough for you, Steele? What else can ya want from a home, huh? Sure, it ain’t the most exciting place in the galaxy. Just ask Ogram down at Customs. He’s always complaining about not having pirates and kidnappers to shoot. Or at least he does when that Amma of his isn’t keeping him busy. Ha! That’s the real beauty of our little world, isn’t it? There’s always something to distract you from your woes. Never a bad day on New Texas - and if it is, just pop down to the milk barn until it ain’t one!”
rows.translation: 蒂哈哈大笑，拍了拍膝盖。“这还不够吗，斯蒂尔？一个家还能奢求什么，嗯？没错，这儿不是银河系里最刺激的地方。去问问海关的奥格拉姆吧。他总抱怨没有海盗和绑匪给他射杀。至少，他没被那个叫阿玛的姑娘缠住时总这么说。哈！这不正是我们这个小世界真正的美妙之处吗？总有东西能让你忘掉烦恼。新德克萨斯从来没有坏日子——就算真碰上了，去挤奶棚待一会儿，直到心情变好就行！”
rows.raw: "\n\nTee guffaws and slaps his knee. “That not enough for you, Steele? What else can ya want from a home, huh? Sure, it ain’t the most exciting place in the galaxy. Just ask Ogram down at Customs. He’s always complaining about not having pirates and kidnappers to shoot. Or at least he does when that Amma of his isn’t keeping him busy. Ha! That’s the real beauty of our little world, isn’t it? There’s always something to distract you from your woes. Never a bad day on New Texas - and if it is, just pop down to the milk barn until it ain’t one!”"

rows.original: Tee laughs and shakes his head. <i>“Life ain’t all sex and milk, but there’s enough of it on tap to keep anybody happy, thanks to the Treatment. That’s what makes New Texas run,
rows.translation: 蒂笑着摇了摇头。<i>“生活不全是性爱和牛奶，不过多亏了改造疗程，这两样随时都多得足够让任何人开心。新德克萨斯就是靠它运转的，
rows.raw: "\n\nTee laughs and shakes his head. <i>“Life ain’t all sex and milk, but there’s enough of it on tap to keep anybody happy, thanks to the Treatment. That’s what makes New Texas run, "

rows.original: son
rows.translation: 小伙子
rows.raw: "son"

rows.original: girl
rows.translation: 姑娘
rows.raw: "girl"

rows.original: ! Or at least, run as smooth as it does for as long as it has. All the way back to the old colony days up till now!”
rows.translation: ！至少从当年的殖民时代一直到现在，都因此运转得这么顺畅！”
rows.raw: "! Or at least, run as smooth as it does for as long as it has. All the way back to the old colony days up till now!”"

rows.original: “So could you, like, tell me more about what I’m in for, all Treated and stuff?” you ask, fluttering your lashes at the governor.
rows.translation: “那么，你能不能再多讲讲，接受改造疗程之后我究竟会变成什么样？”你扑闪着睫毛问总督。
rows.raw: "“So could you, like, tell me more about what I’m in for, all Treated and stuff?” you ask, fluttering your lashes at the governor."

rows.original: “So, what’d I sign on for with this whole Treatment thing, exactly?”
rows.translation: “那么，这整套改造疗程究竟会让我变成什么样？”
rows.raw: "“So, what’d I sign on for with this whole Treatment thing, exactly?”"

rows.original: “So, tell me more about this Treatment I’ve been hearing about.”
rows.translation: “那么，给我多讲讲我一直听说的这种改造疗程吧。”
rows.raw: "“So, tell me more about this Treatment I’ve been hearing about.”"

rows.original: Big T. takes a long moment to think about that, puffing on his cigar and blowing clouds that smell more like cinammon than poison. “Well, I reckon you could hear plenty from darn near anybody here on New Texas. Shoot, that cute little blonde down in Customs, Amma, can’t wait to gab anybody’s ear off who’ll listen about it. But heck, you’re here and asking, so I guess I can give you the whole spiel, too!”
rows.translation: 大T花了好一会儿思考，抽着雪茄，吐出的烟云闻起来更像肉桂，而非毒物。“这个嘛，我想新德克萨斯几乎随便哪个人都能给你讲上一大堆。真的，海关那个可爱的金发姑娘阿玛巴不得逮住愿意听的人，把这事讲个没完。不过既然你已经来了，还特意问起，那我也能把整套说辞都讲给你听！”
rows.raw: "\n\nBig T. takes a long moment to think about that, puffing on his cigar and blowing clouds that smell more like cinammon than poison. “Well, I reckon you could hear plenty from darn near anybody here on New Texas. Shoot, that cute little blonde down in Customs, Amma, can’t wait to gab anybody’s ear off who’ll listen about it. But heck, you’re here and asking, so I guess I can give you the whole spiel, too!”"

rows.original: He chuckles to himself and leans back in his chair in a way that makes his shirt and pants strain around his massive physique - and draws your eyes to the unmistakable bulge in the governor’s britches. “Treatment’s been around just as long as New Texas has been, just about. Original colonists slow-boated here, way ‘fore the whole Warp Gate shenanigans came around. Just a bunch of people crammed into a ship, a deck of cryo pods, and as much seeds and supplies as they could squeeze in - all blastin’ off into the great unknown. Lucky them, they ended up here on a garden world instead of sucked into a black hole or something! When our ancestors landed, they needed something to kickstart the population. And that’s the Treatment in a nutshell!”
rows.translation: 他自顾自地笑了笑，向后靠进椅子里，衬衫和裤子被他壮硕的身体绷得紧紧的——也让你的目光落在总督裤裆里那道不容错认的鼓包上。“改造疗程差不多和新德克萨斯一样古老。最初的殖民者搭慢船来到这里，那时候跃迁门之类的花样还远没出现。一群人挤在一艘船上，带着一整层的冷冻舱，以及能塞进去的所有种子和补给——就这么朝伟大的未知发射出去。他们运气好，最终抵达了这颗花园世界，没有被黑洞之类的东西吸进去！我们的祖先登陆后，需要某种东西来迅速增加人口。这就是改造疗程的来龙去脉！”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe chuckles to himself and leans back in his chair in a way that makes his shirt and pants strain around his massive physique - and draws your eyes to the unmistakable bulge in the governor’s britches. “Treatment’s been around just as long as New Texas has been, just about. Original colonists slow-boated here, way ‘fore the whole Warp Gate shenanigans came around. Just a bunch of people crammed into a ship, a deck of cryo pods, and as much seeds and supplies as they could squeeze in - all blastin’ off into the great unknown. Lucky them, they ended up here on a garden world instead of sucked into a black hole or something! When our ancestors landed, they needed something to kickstart the population. And that’s the Treatment in a nutshell!”"

rows.original: <i>“Started out as a fertility drug all the colonists took way back when. Weren’t as powerful then, but it let us spread out ‘round the planet in a hurry. Over time, we’ve modified the Treatment to do all sorts of things. Makes everybody better in more ways than just baby making.
rows.translation: <i>“最初，它是当年所有殖民者都会服用的生育药。那时的药效没这么强，却能让我们迅速遍布整颗星球。后来，我们逐渐改良改造疗程，让它产生各种作用。它让每个人在许多方面都变得更好，远不只生孩子。
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Started out as a fertility drug all the colonists took way back when. Weren’t as powerful then, but it let us spread out ‘round the planet in a hurry. Over time, we’ve modified the Treatment to do all sorts of things. Makes everybody better in more ways than just baby making. "

rows.original: Women
rows.translation: 女人
rows.raw: "Women"

rows.original: You women
rows.translation: 你们女人
rows.raw: "You women"

rows.original: get more libidinous, start lactating, put on curves in all the right places to make fellers drool.
rows.translation: 会变得欲望更强、开始泌乳，身体该丰满的地方都长出让男人垂涎的曲线。
rows.raw: " get more libidinous, start lactating, put on curves in all the right places to make fellers drool. "

rows.original: Us guys
rows.translation: 我们男人
rows.raw: "Us guys"

rows.original: Men like me
rows.translation: 像我这样的男人
rows.raw: "Men like me"

rows.original: get bigger, burlier, hornier.”
rows.translation: 会变得更高大、更壮实、也更饥渴。”
rows.raw: " get bigger, burlier, hornier.”"

rows.original: Tee laughs, pointing at the huge horns growing from the sides of his head when he notices where your gaze has wandered.
rows.translation: 蒂笑了起来，察觉到你的目光落在哪里后，便指了指从头颅两侧长出的巨角。
rows.raw: "\n\nTee laughs, pointing at the huge horns growing from the sides of his head when he notices where your gaze has wandered."

rows.original: “At least that’s what usually happens. Backfires sometimes, makes fellas girly and pretty little ladies into big, angry, muscle-bound-”
rows.translation: “至少通常是这样。有时候也会适得其反，把小伙子变得娘里娘气，又把娇小可爱的姑娘变成满身肌肉、脾气暴躁的——”
rows.raw: "\n\n“At least that’s what usually happens. Backfires sometimes, makes fellas girly and pretty little ladies into big, angry, muscle-bound-”"

rows.original: “Sure you wanna finish that sentence, Tee?” Zephyr shouts from the lobby.
rows.translation: “你真想把那句话说完吗，蒂？”泽菲尔从大厅里喊道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sure you wanna finish that sentence, Tee?” Zephyr shouts from the lobby."

rows.original: Tee grumbles something and adjusts his tie. <i>“
rows.translation: 蒂咕哝了几句，整理了一下领带。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nTee grumbles something and adjusts his tie. <i>“"

rows.original: Kinda like with you, little guy.
rows.translation: 有点像你，小家伙。
rows.raw: "Kinda like with you, little guy."

rows.original: Just like, uh, just like you, missy!
rows.translation: 就像，呃，就像你一样，小姐！
rows.raw: "Just like, uh, just like you, missy!"

rows.original: Don’t usually happen, though. You turned out alright!
rows.translation: 不过这种事并不常见。你最后变得还不错！
rows.raw: "Don’t usually happen, though. You turned out alright!"

rows.original: That’s all pretty rare, though, and even then, most folk turn out to like what the Treatment does to ‘em. Ask that blonde boy out by the fields what he thinks of bulls these days! Hah!
rows.translation: 不过那都相当罕见，而且即便发生，大多数人最后也会喜欢改造疗程给自己带来的变化。去问问田边那个金发小伙，他如今对公牛有什么看法！哈！”
rows.raw: "That’s all pretty rare, though, and even then, most folk turn out to like what the Treatment does to ‘em. Ask that blonde boy out by the fields what he thinks of bulls these days! Hah!"

rows.original: ...What?
rows.raw: "\n\n...What?"

rows.original: Tee guffaws at a joke you don’t quite get and taps some ash out from his cigar.
rows.translation: 蒂因一个你没太听懂的笑话哈哈大笑，从雪茄上弹掉一些烟灰。
rows.raw: "\n\nTee guffaws at a joke you don’t quite get and taps some ash out from his cigar."

rows.original: “Anyhoo, long and the short is that the Treatment’s what makes sure New Texas the paradise it is. We’re the biggest tourist spot there is for the galaxy’s elite, and have the highest happiness ratings among the people of any system in the Confederacy! Makes good ol’ New Texas just about as perfect as it gets!”
rows.translation: “总之，长话短说，正是改造疗程让新德克萨斯一直维持着天堂般的模样。我们是整个银河系精英最爱的旅游胜地，而且在联邦各个星系中，我们居民的幸福指数最高！好个新德克萨斯，简直完美得不能再完美了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anyhoo, long and the short is that the Treatment’s what makes sure New Texas the paradise it is. We’re the biggest tourist spot there is for the galaxy’s elite, and have the highest happiness ratings among the people of any system in the Confederacy! Makes good ol’ New Texas just about as perfect as it gets!”"

rows.original: “What was New Texas like, back in the day? You mentioned the Treatment used to be something pretty different.”
rows.translation: “以前的新德克萨斯是什么样？你提过改造疗程过去和现在很不一样。”
rows.raw: "“What was New Texas like, back in the day? You mentioned the Treatment used to be something pretty different.”"

rows.original: “Sure,” Tee laughs, “Every place changes, right? Even New Texas’s grown over the years since my great great etcetera grandpappy landed us all here generations ago. Used to be some native, non-sapient species here, and the place was a little less grassy for starters. Mostly dry, dusty plains, far as the eye could see. Course, we didn’t come with much in the way of fancy terraformin’ machines, no
rows.translation: “当然，”蒂笑道，“每个地方都会变化，对吧？自从我那曾曾曾祖父在好多代以前带着大家登陆之后，就连新德克萨斯也成长了许多。首先，这里以前有些本土的非智慧物种，草也没现在这么多。目之所及，大多都是干燥、尘土飞扬的平原。当然，我们来时没带多少花哨的地球化机器，
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sure,” Tee laughs, “Every place changes, right? Even New Texas’s grown over the years since my great great etcetera grandpappy landed us all here generations ago. Used to be some native, non-sapient species here, and the place was a little less grassy for starters. Mostly dry, dusty plains, far as the eye could see. Course, we didn’t come with much in the way of fancy terraformin’ machines, no "

rows.original: sir
rows.translation: 先生
rows.raw: "sir"

rows.original: ma’am
rows.translation: 女士
rows.raw: "ma’am"

rows.original: . Settled this world the old fashioned way, with guns and grit and a whole lot of hard work.”
rows.translation: 。我们用老办法开拓了这个世界，靠的是枪、胆量，还有一大堆苦活。”
rows.raw: ". Settled this world the old fashioned way, with guns and grit and a whole lot of hard work.”"

rows.original: Tee gets a proud, faraway look as he speaks. “Back when men were men and women were women. ‘Fore all this pre-fab colony nonsense, when you fought and bled for your stake of land! Even with the old Treatment doin’ its thing, it was a long time ‘fore we managed to settle the whole planet. Generations! Folk were living out of the original colony boat for decades, till we cleared out the biggest of the super-varmints. Practically a war, that was, the way my grandpappy told it. Huge bastards with claws and fangs thicker‘n my arm, came raidin’ at night to steal supplies, the bunch of scav-wolves. Even the little ones still around are a pain in the ass. Ask my girl Gianna sometime why she can’t leave the property, she’ll tell you what they still get up to.”
rows.translation: 蒂说话时露出骄傲而悠远的神情。“那时候男人有男人样，女人有女人样。还没有这些预制殖民地的胡闹东西，想要一块地，就得拿命去拼、流血去争！即使有老版改造疗程帮忙，我们也花了很久才开拓完整颗星球。整整几代人！人们在最初那艘殖民船里住了几十年，直到我们清理掉最大的一批超级害兽。照我爷爷的说法，那几乎就是一场战争。那些巨型混蛋长着比我胳膊还粗的爪子和獠牙，夜里会来抢补给，一群拾荒狼。就连如今还活着的小家伙也烦得要命。有空去问问我女儿吉安娜为什么不能离开牧场，她会告诉你那些东西现在还会干些什么。”
rows.raw: "\n\nTee gets a proud, faraway look as he speaks. “Back when men were men and women were women. ‘Fore all this pre-fab colony nonsense, when you fought and bled for your stake of land! Even with the old Treatment doin’ its thing, it was a long time ‘fore we managed to settle the whole planet. Generations! Folk were living out of the original colony boat for decades, till we cleared out the biggest of the super-varmints. Practically a war, that was, the way my grandpappy told it. Huge bastards with claws and fangs thicker‘n my arm, came raidin’ at night to steal supplies, the bunch of scav-wolves. Even the little ones still around are a pain in the ass. Ask my girl Gianna sometime why she can’t leave the property, she’ll tell you what they still get up to.”"

rows.original: “You lived out of the colony ship?” you ask, cocking an eyebrow. Most colony ships back then would have been stripped down for scrap to make houses and other structures.
rows.translation: “你们以前住在殖民船里？”你扬起眉毛问道。当时的大多数殖民船都会被拆成废料，用来建造房屋和其他设施。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You lived out of the colony ship?” you ask, cocking an eyebrow. Most colony ships back then would have been stripped down for scrap to make houses and other structures."

rows.original: “Sure,” Tee shrugs, punching one of the buttons on his holoscreen. An image of a massive, sleek starship flickers to life. “Managed to actually land the damn thing... right ‘round here, actually. Most colony ships just sorta crash, fall onto a good planet then wake the crew up outta cryo. Texas ship did it the other way around, see, and my great great etcetera grandpappy managed to land the big bastard. Perfect touchdown, not a scratch on ‘er. Considerin’ the creepy crawlies living here already, colonists figured it’d be better to stay aboard for the first while, till they could push the varms back a ways.”
rows.translation: “当然，”蒂耸耸肩，按下全息屏幕上的一个按钮。一艘庞大而流线优美的星舰影像闪现出来。“实际上真把这该死的大家伙降落了...就在这附近。大多数殖民船只会找颗合适的星球直接坠下去，然后再把船员从冷冻休眠中唤醒。得克萨斯号却反过来，你懂吧，我那曾曾曾祖父成功让这个大混蛋着陆了。完美降落，船身一点刮痕都没有。考虑到这里已经生活着那些吓人的爬虫，殖民者觉得一开始还是住在船上比较好，等他们把害兽赶远些再说。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sure,” Tee shrugs, punching one of the buttons on his holoscreen. An image of a massive, sleek starship flickers to life. “Managed to actually land the damn thing... right ‘round here, actually. Most colony ships just sorta crash, fall onto a good planet then wake the crew up outta cryo. Texas ship did it the other way around, see, and my great great etcetera grandpappy managed to land the big bastard. Perfect touchdown, not a scratch on ‘er. Considerin’ the creepy crawlies living here already, colonists figured it’d be better to stay aboard for the first while, till they could push the varms back a ways.”"

rows.original: “So what happened to the ship, then?” you ask. You haven’t seen any gigantic colony ships sitting around.
rows.translation: “那后来飞船怎么样了？”你问。你可没看到附近停着任何巨型殖民船。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So what happened to the ship, then?” you ask. You haven’t seen any gigantic colony ships sitting around."

rows.original: Tee laughs, “Great big sinkhole opened up a ways back, swallowed the old girl. Between you and me, the ranch house here’s built right on top of ‘er. Generator’s still powering the whole ranch!”
rows.translation: 蒂笑道：“前些年裂开一个大天坑，把老姑娘吞了。咱俩私下说，这座牧场宅邸就盖在她正上方。她的发电机现在还给整座牧场供电呢！”
rows.raw: "\n\nTee laughs, “Great big sinkhole opened up a ways back, swallowed the old girl. Between you and me, the ranch house here’s built right on top of ‘er. Generator’s still powering the whole ranch!”"

rows.original: “You talk a lot about your ancestors. Original colonists, right?”
rows.translation: “你总提起自己的祖先。他们是最初的殖民者，对吧？”
rows.raw: "“You talk a lot about your ancestors. Original colonists, right?”"

rows.original: “That’s right,” Tee beams proudly. “Can trace my line all the way back to Captain Tiberia Tee, Commanding. First lady captain of a whole colony ship, she was. Husband was the helmsman, landed us here without a scratch on the old girl’s hull.”
rows.translation: “没错，”蒂骄傲地喜形于色。“我的家系能一路追溯到殖民船舰长提比莉娅·蒂。她可是第一位统领整艘殖民船的女舰长。她丈夫是舵手，把我们毫发无损地送到了这里，老姑娘的船壳连道划痕都没留下。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s right,” Tee beams proudly. “Can trace my line all the way back to Captain Tiberia Tee, Commanding. First lady captain of a whole colony ship, she was. Husband was the helmsman, landed us here without a scratch on the old girl’s hull.”"

rows.original: That’s a surprise. The New Texas expedition was led by a woman?
rows.translation: 真让人意外。新德克萨斯远征队是由一名女性领导的？
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s a surprise. The New Texas expedition was led by a woman?"

rows.original: Tee laughs at the question. “Sure, why not? Ain’t nothing a man can do a woman can’t!”
rows.translation: 蒂听到这个问题后笑了起来。“当然，有何不可？男人能做的事，女人一样能做！”
rows.raw: "\n\nTee laughs at the question. “Sure, why not? Ain’t nothing a man can do a woman can’t!”"

rows.original: “Yeah, but, the Treatment...” you say, casting a glance out the governor’s window to the ranch full of busty, air-headed sluts with little more than dick on their minds.
rows.translation: “是啊，可是，改造疗程...”你说着，瞥向总督窗外的牧场，那里满是胸部丰满、头脑空空的荡妇，脑子里除了肉棒几乎什么都没有。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, but, the Treatment...” you say, casting a glance out the governor’s window to the ranch full of busty, air-headed sluts with little more than dick on their minds."

rows.original: It takes a moment for your implication to sink in. When it does, Tee guffaws and slaps his leg. “What, it was Tiberia’s idea to begin with! She’s the one that had us all taking the Treatment from the get-go. Gotta work hard to populate a new planet, she said. Course we don’t need it anymore, but everyone just plain wants to! Her makin’ everyone get Treated is what shaped New Texas into the paradise it is, sure as hell.”
rows.translation: 他过了一会儿才明白你的暗示。反应过来后，蒂哈哈大笑，拍了拍大腿。“什么，那一开始就是提比莉娅的主意！是她从一开始就让我们所有人接受改造疗程。她说，想让一颗新星球住满人口，就得努力干活。现在当然已经不再需要这么做了，可大家就是乐意！正是她让所有人接受改造，才把新德克萨斯塑造成如今的天堂，千真万确。”
rows.raw: "\n\nIt takes a moment for your implication to sink in. When it does, Tee guffaws and slaps his leg. “What, it was Tiberia’s idea to begin with! She’s the one that had us all taking the Treatment from the get-go. Gotta work hard to populate a new planet, she said. Course we don’t need it anymore, but everyone just plain wants to! Her makin’ everyone get Treated is what shaped New Texas into the paradise it is, sure as hell.”"

rows.original: “Anyway,” you say, figuring you can cut him off before another Treatment tirade. “So, the captain’s descendants get to be governor, is that it?”
rows.translation: “总之，”你说道，心想可以在他又开始长篇大论改造疗程前打断他。“所以，船长的后代都能当上总督，就是这样？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anyway,” you say, figuring you can cut him off before another Treatment tirade. “So, the captain’s descendants get to be governor, is that it?”"

rows.original: “Naw, we’ve got elections and all that,” Tee answers, a bit flatly. “Not a dictatorship or a kingdom, no, nothing like that. We’re a right proper democracy, elections every two years. We Tees get elected plenty, but not all the time. Most folk think we’ve done right by ‘em, and are more‘n happy to have more of the same.
rows.translation: “才不是，我们有选举什么的。”T语气有些平淡地回答。“这里不是独裁统治，也不是什么王国，完全不是。我们是货真价实的民主制度，每两年选举一次。我们T家人经常当选，但也不是每次都能选上。大多数人觉得我们待他们不薄，也很乐意继续维持现状。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Naw, we’ve got elections and all that,” Tee answers, a bit flatly. “Not a dictatorship or a kingdom, no, nothing like that. We’re a right proper democracy, elections every two years. We Tees get elected plenty, but not all the time. Most folk think we’ve done right by ‘em, and are more‘n happy to have more of the same."

rows.original: Heck, aren’t you? All nice and Treated - you wouldn’t give that for anything, would ya?
rows.translation: 见鬼，你不也一样吗？接受了舒舒服服的改造，你怎么都不肯放弃，对吧？
rows.raw: " Heck, aren’t you? All nice and Treated - you wouldn’t give that for anything, would ya?"

rows.original: Sounds like the Tees have themselves a mighty nice set-up here....

rows.original: “So, who’s up next to inherit the Tee throne?” you ask, only half joking.
rows.translation: “那么，下一位继承T家王位的是谁？”你半开玩笑地问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, who’s up next to inherit the Tee throne?” you ask, only half joking."

rows.original: If the Governor picks up on the joke, he doesn’t acknowledge it. “Well, I don’t have any proper kids. Well, I probably have loads of ‘em, but none I know about. ‘Who’s your daddy?’ is a pretty hard question to answer ‘round here sometimes! Ha! Only kid I’ve legally got is my girl Gianna. You’ve met her, ain’t ya?”
rows.translation: 总督即便听出了玩笑，也没有理会。“嗯，我没有正式的孩子。好吧，我大概有一大堆，但没有一个是我认识的。在这里，‘你爸是谁？’有时可是个很难回答的问题！哈！我法律上唯一的孩子就是我的姑娘吉安娜。你见过她，对吧？”

Nicest girl I’ve ever met, even if she don’t smell like a woman. Owner got Treated, moved in, but plumb forgot about his girl, just left her to rot on the ship. Damn shame.”
rows.translation: “嗯？啊，对。吉安娜是个仿生人！陪伴型机器人，很贵的型号。她聪明得很，相处起来也舒服得不得了。虽说她没有女人的气味，但还是我见过最好的姑娘。她的主人接受改造、搬来这里，却把自己的姑娘忘得一干二净，直接扔在飞船上等着腐烂。真他妈可惜。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmm? Ah, right. Gianna’s an android! Companion droid, real expensive model. Smart as a whip and damn pleasant to be around. Nicest girl I’ve ever met, even if she don’t smell like a woman. Owner got Treated, moved in, but plumb forgot about his girl, just left her to rot on the ship. Damn shame.”"

The brewery has a dusty road leading to it, like most of New Texas, barred on both sides by grass that surrounds the alcohol producing plant. It isn’t open to the public, but there’s a stockyard filled haphazardly with barrels next to the factory.
rows.translation: 你看见一栋十分古朴的红砖建筑，顶部似乎还立着几根烟囱。门上方挂着一块涂成浅马尼拉色的招牌，上面的红蓝文字写着“贝利酿酒厂”。与新德克萨斯大多数地方一样，一条尘土飞扬的道路通向酿酒厂，两侧都是环绕这座酒类生产厂的草地。这里不对公众开放，但工厂旁边有一座堆货场，里面杂乱地摆满酒桶。
rows.raw: "You see a building: it’s very old-fashioned looking, made of red brick, and has what appear to be chimneys atop it. You’re able to make out a sign painted light manila just above the door, and in red and blue letters you read “Bailey’s Brewery”. The brewery has a dusty road leading to it, like most of New Texas, barred on both sides by grass that surrounds the alcohol producing plant. It isn’t open to the public, but there’s a stockyard filled haphazardly with barrels next to the factory."

rows.original: In your peripheral vision you can make out what appears to be a green-haired cowgirl working in the stockyard of the brewery: she’s hammering down the lids of barrels, and she’s looking your way.
rows.translation: 你用眼角余光看见，一个绿发牛女似乎正在酿酒厂的堆货场工作：她正用锤子敲紧酒桶盖，同时看向你这边。
rows.raw: "\n\nIn your peripheral vision you can make out what appears to be a green-haired cowgirl working in the stockyard of the brewery: she’s hammering down the lids of barrels, and she’s looking your way."

rows.original: Cowgirl
rows.translation: 牛女
rows.raw: "Cowgirl"

rows.original: HugsAlright
rows.raw: "HugsAlright"

rows.original: You turn your gaze towards the curious cowgirl; she’s piqued your interest enough. She notices your change in direction and quickly looks away, returning to whatever it was she was doing before. You swear you hear a faint jingling. You take in her figure for a moment before moving forward; the Treatment certainly did its job: the cowgirl has a womanly hourglass figure with wide hips, and a nice cushy looking bottom. A cow-like tail swings behind her rear hypnotically. As you draw closer it seems she’s aware of your presence; her shoulders begin moving faster as she attempts to finish whatever work she’s doing. You’re definitely hearing a jingling sound now. Stopping in your tracks as you close in on her, you stand behind her for a moment.
rows.translation: 你将目光转向这个好奇的牛女；她已经成功引起你的兴趣。她注意到你改变方向，立刻移开视线，继续先前正在做的事情。你发誓自己听见了微弱的叮当声。你先打量她的身材片刻，随后向前走去；改造疗程显然充分发挥了作用：牛女拥有女性化的沙漏身材，腰胯宽阔，还有一个看起来柔软漂亮的屁股。一条牛尾在后臀后方催眠般摆动。随着你不断靠近，她似乎察觉到了你的存在；她试图完成手头工作，双肩动作开始加快。现在你绝对听见了叮当声。靠近她后，你停下脚步，在她身后站了片刻。
rows.raw: "You turn your gaze towards the curious cowgirl; she’s piqued your interest enough. She notices your change in direction and quickly looks away, returning to whatever it was she was doing before. You swear you hear a faint jingling. You take in her figure for a moment before moving forward; the Treatment certainly did its job: the cowgirl has a womanly hourglass figure with wide hips, and a nice cushy looking bottom. A cow-like tail swings behind her rear hypnotically. As you draw closer it seems she’s aware of your presence; her shoulders begin moving faster as she attempts to finish whatever work she’s doing. You’re definitely hearing a jingling sound now. Stopping in your tracks as you close in on her, you stand behind her for a moment."

rows.original: From what you can see she’s working on a barrel, marked “Bailey’s Bovine Brewery”, and under that: “120 Proof”.
rows.translation: 据你所见，她正在处理一只标有“贝利牛族酿酒厂”的酒桶，下方还写着：“120标准酒精度”。
rows.raw: "\n\nFrom what you can see she’s working on a barrel, marked “Bailey’s Bovine Brewery”, and under that: “120 Proof”."

rows.original: Powerful stuff.
rows.translation: 真够烈的。
rows.raw: "\n\nPowerful stuff."

rows.original: The cowgirl seems to be avoiding contact with you, hastily working and fidgeting, like she’s hoping you’re not there for her.
rows.translation: 牛女似乎在回避与你接触，手忙脚乱地工作着，还坐立不安，仿佛希望你不是来找她的。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe cowgirl seems to be avoiding contact with you, hastily working and fidgeting, like she’s hoping you’re not there for her."

rows.original: “Hey,” you finally call out.
rows.translation: “嘿，”你终于开口喊道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey,” you finally call out."

rows.original: She jumps, setting her behind jiggling enticingly. Again, you hear the jingling.
rows.translation: 她吓得一跳，惹得屁股诱人地晃动起来。你再次听见了叮当声。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe jumps, setting her behind jiggling enticingly. Again, you hear the jingling."

rows.original: She turns around, revealing a pair of F-cups barely contained by her shirt, a large amount of cleavage on display for passersby like yourself to observe. Her eyes are hidden behind her green bangs. Her currently downward-facing cow-like ears part her hair, which ends in two ponytails on either side of her face. Of course, two adorable horns are perched atop her head.
rows.translation: 她转过身来，一对F罩杯乳房被衬衫勉强包裹住，大片乳沟袒露在外，供像你一样的路人欣赏。她的双眼藏在绿色刘海后面。两只此刻向下垂着的牛耳将头发分开，发梢在脸庞两侧扎成两条马尾。当然，她头顶还生着两只可爱的小角。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe turns around, revealing a pair of F-cups barely contained by her shirt, a large amount of cleavage on display for passersby like yourself to observe. Her eyes are hidden behind her green bangs. Her currently downward-facing cow-like ears part her hair, which ends in two ponytails on either side of her face. Of course, two adorable horns are perched atop her head."

rows.original: Then you see a cowbell around her neck, and the source of the jingling becomes clear.
rows.translation: 随后你看见她脖子上挂着一只牛铃，叮当声的来源也就一目了然了。
rows.raw: "\n\nThen you see a cowbell around her neck, and the source of the jingling becomes clear."

rows.original: She brings a finger to point at her face and her other arm behind her back as if to say “Who, me?”
rows.translation: 她伸出一根手指指向自己的脸，另一只手臂则背到身后，仿佛在说“谁，我吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe brings a finger to point at her face and her other arm behind her back as if to say “Who, me?”"

rows.original: You give her a confused look.
rows.translation: 你困惑地看着她。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give her a confused look."

rows.original: “Yeah, you.”
rows.translation: “对，就是你。”
rows.raw: " “Yeah, you.”"

rows.original: “Uh, yeah,” you chuckle, “Who else?”
rows.translation: “呃，对，”你轻笑道，“不然还有谁？”
rows.raw: " “Uh, yeah,” you chuckle, “Who else?”"

rows.original: “Yeah,” you say calmly, a smile on your face, “You.”
rows.translation: “对，”你面带微笑，平静地说道，“就是你。”
rows.raw: " “Yeah,” you say calmly, a smile on your face, “You.”"

rows.original: She blushes hotly and begins to feverishly look around, a distressed expression on her face. With a deep breath she puffs out her chest, and finally seems to calm herself. She looks at you and offers a wave with a shy smile; making her bell jingle and breasts wobble.
rows.translation: 她的脸顿时涨得通红，开始慌乱地环顾四周，神情显得十分窘迫。她深吸一口气，挺起胸膛，终于似乎让自己镇定下来。她看着你，带着腼腆的笑容挥了挥手；这让她的铃铛叮当作响，乳房也跟着晃动。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe blushes hotly and begins to feverishly look around, a distressed expression on her face. With a deep breath she puffs out her chest, and finally seems to calm herself. She looks at you and offers a wave with a shy smile; making her bell jingle and breasts wobble."

rows.original: Her silence is more than a bit strange.
rows.translation: 她的沉默实在有些古怪。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer silence is more than a bit strange."

rows.original: “Can you talk at all?” you question,
rows.translation: “你会说话吗？”你问道，
rows.raw: "\n\n“Can you talk at all?” you question, "

rows.original: crossing your arms with impatience
rows.translation: 不耐烦地抱起双臂
rows.raw: "crossing your arms with impatience"

rows.original: a hint of laughter still hanging in your voice
rows.translation: 语气中仍带着一丝笑意
rows.raw: "a hint of laughter still hanging in your voice"

rows.original: bringing your tone down to something gentler
rows.translation: 把语气放得更加温和
rows.raw: "bringing your tone down to something gentler"

rows.original: A frown forms on the cowgirl’s face as she looks down at her feet and shakes her head, bell jingling. She looks back up at you, clear displeasure written across her face, and her posture shifts, making her look fairly uncomfortable.
rows.translation: 牛女低头看向自己的脚，摇了摇头，铃铛随之叮当作响，脸上也浮现出不悦的神情。她重新抬眼看你，脸上的不快显而易见，姿势也随之一变，显得颇为不自在。
rows.raw: "\n\nA frown forms on the cowgirl’s face as she looks down at her feet and shakes her head, bell jingling. She looks back up at you, clear displeasure written across her face, and her posture shifts, making her look fairly uncomfortable."

rows.original: You feel a bit bad for asking, but at least you know now.
rows.translation: 你有点后悔问这个问题，但至少现在知道答案了。
rows.raw: " You feel a bit bad for asking, but at least you know now."

rows.original: You try to change the subject, “Well, uh, do you have a name?” You suddenly find yourself filled with dread, realizing that she probably can’t answer.
rows.translation: 你试着换个话题，“那么，呃，你有名字吗？”你突然感到一阵忐忑，因为意识到她多半没法回答。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou try to change the subject, “Well, uh, do you have a name?” You suddenly find yourself filled with dread, realizing that she probably can’t answer."

rows.original: To your surprise she nods and leans forward, bringing a hand to up to point at her collar bone. At first you think she’s trying to show you her cleavage, but quickly realize she’s pointing to her bell. You’re barely able to make out something faintly engraved into the cast-iron. You lean in closer to get a better look at what it says, bringing your face mere inches from the valley of her cleavage. You can feel the heat radiating off of her pale boobflesh, making your breath quicken slightly. Pulling yourself from the ever-expansive distraction of her breasts, you look at the bell and see that the engraving reads “Brandy”.
rows.translation: 出乎意料的是，她点了点头，身体前倾，抬手指向自己的锁骨。起初你还以为她是想让你看她的乳沟，但很快便意识到她指的是那只铃铛。你勉强能看见铸铁表面浅浅刻着什么。你凑近了一些，想看清上面写的内容，脸离她的乳沟只有几英寸。你能感受到她苍白乳肉散发出的热量，令你的呼吸略微加快。你把注意力从她那令人沉迷的无边乳海中拉回来，看向铃铛，发现上面刻着“布兰迪”。
rows.raw: "\n\nTo your surprise she nods and leans forward, bringing a hand to up to point at her collar bone. At first you think she’s trying to show you her cleavage, but quickly realize she’s pointing to her bell. You’re barely able to make out something faintly engraved into the cast-iron. You lean in closer to get a better look at what it says, bringing your face mere inches from the valley of her cleavage. You can feel the heat radiating off of her pale boobflesh, making your breath quicken slightly. Pulling yourself from the ever-expansive distraction of her breasts, you look at the bell and see that the engraving reads “Brandy”."

rows.original: “Brandy,” you say aloud, pulling your head back as Brandy straightens herself, her previous somber look replaced by a soft smile. The buxom cowgirl nods in affirmation, happy that you asked. Her posture has grown more relaxed, her hands behind her back. Brandy seems pretty content in the silence.
rows.translation: “布兰迪，”你一边大声念出这个名字，一边抬起头来。布兰迪也直起身子，先前那副阴郁的神情已被柔和的微笑取代。丰满的牛女肯定地点点头，很高兴你问了她的名字。她的姿势变得更加放松，双手背在身后。布兰迪似乎很享受这份寂静。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Brandy,” you say aloud, pulling your head back as Brandy straightens herself, her previous somber look replaced by a soft smile. The buxom cowgirl nods in affirmation, happy that you asked. Her posture has grown more relaxed, her hands behind her back. Brandy seems pretty content in the silence."

rows.original: “I saw you looking at me earlier.”
rows.translation: “我刚才看见你盯着我了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I saw you looking at me earlier.”"

rows.original: A blush quickly returns to the busty bovine’s cheeks, as she looks downwards once more. You can’t help but smile seeing a New Texas girl so shy.
rows.translation: 这位丰满牛女的脸颊迅速再次泛红，又低下头去。看到新德克萨斯女孩如此害羞，你不禁露出微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nA blush quickly returns to the busty bovine’s cheeks, as she looks downwards once more. You can’t help but smile seeing a New Texas girl so shy. "

rows.original: You decide to follow up, “Well did you see anything you like?”
rows.translation: 你决定追问一句，“那么，你看到什么喜欢的东西了吗？”
rows.raw: "You decide to follow up, “Well did you see anything you like?” "

rows.original: You hold your arms out, inviting her to look you over, and she briefly runs her eyes over you as she raises her head back up. Once she’s completed her inspection, Brandy looks you in the eyes and smiles a bit wider than before. She nods, bell jingling as she does so.
rows.translation: 你张开双臂，示意她尽管打量。她重新抬起头，目光飞快地扫过你的全身。审视完毕后，布兰迪直视着你的双眼，笑容比先前更灿烂了些。她点点头，铃铛也随之叮当作响。
rows.raw: "You hold your arms out, inviting her to look you over, and she briefly runs her eyes over you as she raises her head back up. Once she’s completed her inspection, Brandy looks you in the eyes and smiles a bit wider than before. She nods, bell jingling as she does so."

rows.original: You smile contentedly at the cowgirl and introduce yourself as “[pc.name]”. Maybe now that the ice is broken you can get to know each other a bit better.
rows.translation: 你满意地对牛女笑了笑，并自我介绍道“[pc.name]”。或许现在既然已经打破僵局，你们就能更深入地了解彼此了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou smile contentedly at the cowgirl and introduce yourself as “[pc.name]”. Maybe now that the ice is broken you can get to know each other a bit better."

rows.original: Cowgirl
rows.translation: 牛女
rows.raw: "Cowgirl"

rows.original: Investigate the curious bovine.
rows.translation: 调查这个好奇的牛女。
rows.raw: "Investigate the curious bovine."

rows.original: You see a building: it’s very old-fashioned looking, made of red brick, and has what appear to be chimneys atop it. You’re able to make out a sign painted light manila just above the door, and in red and blue letters you read “Bailey’s Brewery”. The brewery has a dusty road leading to it, like most of New Texas, barred on both sides by grass that surrounds the alcohol producing plant. It isn’t open to the public, but there’s a yard filled haphazardly with barrels next to the factory. A hovertruck is parked nearby.
rows.translation: 你看见一栋十分古朴的红砖建筑，顶部似乎还立着几根烟囱。门上方挂着一块涂成浅马尼拉色的招牌，上面的红蓝文字写着“贝利酿酒厂”。与新德克萨斯大多数地方一样，一条尘土飞扬的道路通向酿酒厂，两侧都是环绕这座酒类生产厂的草地。这里不对公众开放，但工厂旁边有一座堆货场，里面杂乱地摆满酒桶。附近还停着一辆悬浮卡车。
rows.raw: "You see a building: it’s very old-fashioned looking, made of red brick, and has what appear to be chimneys atop it. You’re able to make out a sign painted light manila just above the door, and in red and blue letters you read “Bailey’s Brewery”. The brewery has a dusty road leading to it, like most of New Texas, barred on both sides by grass that surrounds the alcohol producing plant. It isn’t open to the public, but there’s a yard filled haphazardly with barrels next to the factory. A hovertruck is parked nearby."

rows.original: The mute cowgirl, Brandy, is working nearby.
rows.translation: 不会说话的牛女布兰迪正在附近工作。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe mute cowgirl, Brandy, is working nearby."

rows.original: Brandy
rows.translation: 布兰迪
rows.raw: "Brandy"

rows.original: HugsAlright
rows.raw: "HugsAlright"

rows.original: The steady jingle of Brandy’s bell gets louder and louder as you approach her, watching the cowgirl toil away at her work, mallet in hand, carefully inspecting each barrel her gaze meets. That is, until, you finally reach the girl, standing right behind her as you wait for her to notice you.
rows.translation: 随着你走近，布兰迪铃铛发出的平稳叮当声越来越响。你看着牛女手握木槌辛勤工作，仔细检查视线所及的每一只酒桶。直到你终于来到她身后，站在那里等她注意到你。
rows.raw: "The steady jingle of Brandy’s bell gets louder and louder as you approach her, watching the cowgirl toil away at her work, mallet in hand, carefully inspecting each barrel her gaze meets. That is, until, you finally reach the girl, standing right behind her as you wait for her to notice you."

rows.original: After some time passes, you decide to take the initiative and tap on Brandy’s shoulder, which makes her gasp silently and jump, and has the added effect of causing all her round, squishy bits to jiggle along with her bell. When the cowgirl turns around to see who it is, her face lights up, turning red with a big grin to match at the sight of your [pc.face].
rows.translation: 过了一会儿，你决定主动出击，拍了拍布兰迪的肩膀。这让她无声地倒吸一口气，猛地跳了起来，附带效果则是令她身上所有圆润柔软的部位与铃铛一起摇晃起来。牛女转身看清来者是谁时，脸上顿时喜形于色；一见到你的[pc.face]，她便满脸通红，咧嘴露出灿烂的笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter some time passes, you decide to take the initiative and tap on Brandy’s shoulder, which makes her gasp silently and jump, and has the added effect of causing all her round, squishy bits to jiggle along with her bell. When the cowgirl turns around to see who it is, her face lights up, turning red with a big grin to match at the sight of your [pc.face]."

rows.original: Almost immediately after she realizes who’s come to visit her, she wraps her arms around your back
rows.translation: 她刚意识到是谁来看她，便立刻伸出双臂搂住你的后背
rows.raw: "\n\nAlmost immediately after she realizes who’s come to visit her, she wraps her arms around your back"

rows.original: , pulling you down into a nice, warm, booby-filled hug
rows.translation: ，把你拉低，投入一个温暖舒适、充满乳香的拥抱中
rows.raw: ", pulling you down into a nice, warm, booby-filled hug"

rows.original: , scooping you up into a nice, warm hug, your face buried in her expansive chest
rows.translation: ，将你抱起来，投入一个温暖舒适的拥抱中，让你的脸埋进她宽广的胸怀
rows.raw: ", scooping you up into a nice, warm hug, your face buried in her expansive chest"

rows.original: as she moos and moos with an ecstatic tone.
rows.translation: ，同时欣喜若狂地哞叫个不停。
rows.raw: " as she moos and moos with an ecstatic tone."

rows.original: You roll your eyes but
rows.translation: 你翻了翻白眼，但还是
rows.raw: "\n\nYou roll your eyes but"

rows.original: You smile and
rows.translation: 你面带微笑，
rows.raw: "\n\nYou smile and"

rows.original: return Brandy’s embrace, leaving her to ride out her wave of excitement until she finally releases you from her grasp, letting you
rows.translation: 回抱住布兰迪，任由她尽情释放这股兴奋，直到她终于松开怀抱，让你
rows.raw: " return Brandy’s embrace, leaving her to ride out her wave of excitement until she finally releases you from her grasp, letting you"

rows.original: loose
rows.translation: 挣脱出来
rows.raw: " loose"

rows.original: fall
rows.translation: 落下来
rows.raw: " fall"

rows.original: from her svelte, girly arms with a big smile still on her face.
rows.translation: 离开她纤细柔美的双臂，而她脸上依然挂着灿烂的笑容。
rows.raw: " from her svelte, girly arms with a big smile still on her face."

rows.original: “Moo, moo!” the blushing cowgirl exclaims, clasping her hands together and eagerly awaiting any word from you.
rows.translation: “哞，哞！”满脸通红的牛女喊道，双手紧握在一起，热切地等待你开口。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Moo, moo!” the blushing cowgirl exclaims, clasping her hands together and eagerly awaiting any word from you."

rows.original: As you approach the quiet cowgirl, you notice one of her ears twitches at the sound of your
rows.translation: 你走向这位安静的牛女时，注意到她的一只耳朵在听见你的
rows.raw: "As you approach the quiet cowgirl, you notice one of her ears twitches at the sound of your"

rows.original: [pc.legs] sliding through gravel and dirt
rows.translation: [pc.legs]滑过砂砾和泥土的声音时动了一下
rows.raw: " [pc.legs] sliding through gravel and dirt"

rows.original: [pc.footOrFeet] stepping against gravel and dust
rows.translation: [pc.footOrFeet]踩在砂砾和尘土上的声音时动了一下
rows.raw: " [pc.footOrFeet] stepping against gravel and dust"

rows.original: , to which she quickly turns around. Her bell jingles and her face brightens with blush and happiness at the sight of your return. Finally closing in on her, Brandy raises a hand to wave at you and gives you an ecstatic, if somewhat quiet, “Moo!”
rows.translation: ，随即迅速转过身来。看见你回来了，她的铃铛叮当作响，脸上洋溢着红晕和喜悦。终于走到她面前时，布兰迪抬手向你挥了挥，兴奋却又略显轻声地“哞！”了一声。
rows.raw: ", to which she quickly turns around. Her bell jingles and her face brightens with blush and happiness at the sight of your return. Finally closing in on her, Brandy raises a hand to wave at you and gives you an ecstatic, if somewhat quiet, “Moo!”"

rows.raw: "Four and a half pounds of sirloin steak might seem insane on other planets, but for the massive, energetic residents of New Texas this is “just” a large steak. Popular with tourists who want the full “New Texas experience.”"

rows.original: B&Gravy
rows.raw: "B&Gravy"

rows.original: You use your fork to cut a piece out of the closer of the two biscuits, making sure to scoop up a piece of sausage from the gravy along with it. The biscuit is still crunchy on the outside, and the soft interior tastes buttery and flaky. It blends perfectly with the crumbled bits of spiced sausage and peppery, creamy gravy. The gravy is still so hot from the kitchen that you fear you may burn your mouth, but the taste is so delicious that you just can’t bring yourself to wait for the meal to cool. You relish every bite, taking a few sips of your sweet tea whenever the pepper begins to overwhelm you. The sugary taste of the drink complements the salty meal perfectly.
rows.translation: 你用叉子从两块饼干中较近的一块切下一角，同时确保从肉汁里舀起一块香肠。饼干外层依然酥脆，柔软内里带着黄油香，层层松酥。它与调味香肠碎和胡椒奶油肉汁完美融合。肉汁刚出厨房，依然滚烫，你担心会烫伤嘴巴，但味道实在太过美妙，根本无法等它冷却。你细细享受每一口，每当胡椒味开始压倒味蕾便啜饮几口甜茶。饮料的甜味与咸香餐点相得益彰。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou use your fork to cut a piece out of the closer of the two biscuits, making sure to scoop up a piece of sausage from the gravy along with it. The biscuit is still crunchy on the outside, and the soft interior tastes buttery and flaky. It blends perfectly with the crumbled bits of spiced sausage and peppery, creamy gravy. The gravy is still so hot from the kitchen that you fear you may burn your mouth, but the taste is so delicious that you just can’t bring yourself to wait for the meal to cool. You relish every bite, taking a few sips of your sweet tea whenever the pepper begins to overwhelm you. The sugary taste of the drink complements the salty meal perfectly."

rows.original: When you start on the second biscuit, it’s a different experience from the first; the gravy has soaked in, leaving you with a more homogenous but unique new taste. The biscuit itself isn’t crunchy, but it is far more moist than the first, and the gravy has begun to thicken as it cools, providing another new texture in your meal. You consume the second half of your meal as quickly as the first, wishing you could have a breakfast like this every day.
rows.translation: 开始吃第二块饼干时，体验与第一块截然不同；肉汁已经渗入其中，带来更加均匀却又独特的新滋味。饼干本身不再酥脆，却比第一块湿润得多，肉汁也在冷却时逐渐变稠，为这顿饭增添另一种口感。你像吃前一半那样迅速消灭后半顿饭，真希望每天都能享受这样的早餐。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you start on the second biscuit, it’s a different experience from the first; the gravy has soaked in, leaving you with a more homogenous but unique new taste. The biscuit itself isn’t crunchy, but it is far more moist than the first, and the gravy has begun to thicken as it cools, providing another new texture in your meal. You consume the second half of your meal as quickly as the first, wishing you could have a breakfast like this every day."

rows.original: Country Ham
rows.raw: "Country Ham"

rows.original: You grab your knife and fork and slice off a piece of the ham, scooping up a bit of the grits and gravy with it. It’s a symphony of flavors: the pan-seared ham is savory, the grits are creamy and slightly sweet, and the red-eye gravy is bitter and salty. Your mouth tingles deliciously from the salty taste of the meal. It’s as salty as something can be without being at all unpleasant, and it only gives you an excuse to drink more of your delicious iced tea.
rows.translation: 你拿起刀叉切下一片火腿，同时舀起一点玉米糊和肉汁。这简直是一首味觉交响曲：煎烤火腿鲜香可口，玉米糊绵密微甜，红眼肉汁则苦咸交织。餐点的咸味令口腔愉快发麻。它咸到了不会令人不适的极限，也正好给你更多理由畅饮美味冰茶。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou grab your knife and fork and slice off a piece of the ham, scooping up a bit of the grits and gravy with it. It’s a symphony of flavors: the pan-seared ham is savory, the grits are creamy and slightly sweet, and the red-eye gravy is bitter and salty. Your mouth tingles deliciously from the salty taste of the meal. It’s as salty as something can be without being at all unpleasant, and it only gives you an excuse to drink more of your delicious iced tea."

rows.original: You take a bite of the delicious cornbread. There’s no corn kernels in it and the texture is unlike most bread you’ve had; rather, it’s made of cornmeal, flour, and buttermilk placed in a cast-iron skillet and baked in an oven. It crumbles in your mouth immediately, the top surface of the cornbread satisfyingly and audibly crunchy, while the interior and bottom is soft and chewy.
rows.translation: 你咬了一口美味的玉米面包。里面没有玉米粒，口感也与吃过的大多数面包不同；它是将玉米粉、面粉与酪乳放入铸铁锅，再送入烤箱制成。面包入口即碎，表面酥脆得令人满足，甚至能听见响声，内部与底部则柔软有嚼劲。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take a bite of the delicious cornbread. There’s no corn kernels in it and the texture is unlike most bread you’ve had; rather, it’s made of cornmeal, flour, and buttermilk placed in a cast-iron skillet and baked in an oven. It crumbles in your mouth immediately, the top surface of the cornbread satisfyingly and audibly crunchy, while the interior and bottom is soft and chewy."

rows.original: You make quick work of the ham before using the cornbread to sop up the red-eye gravy and remaining grits. The salty meal has left your tea pitcher completely empty, but your belly is delightfully full.
rows.translation: 你迅速解决火腿，随后用玉米面包蘸净红眼肉汁和剩余玉米糊。咸香餐点令茶壶彻底见底，但肚子也满足地装得饱饱的。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou make quick work of the ham before using the cornbread to sop up the red-eye gravy and remaining grits. The salty meal has left your tea pitcher completely empty, but your belly is delightfully full."

rows.raw: "CF Steak"

rows.original: The steak is so tender you barely need to use your knife to cut it. The crispy breading on the beef crunches satisfyingly as you slice into the steak. The meat is far more flavorful than a normal steak; it’s rich, juicy, savory, peppery and oh so tender. The contrast between the textures of the crunchy breading, the chewy beef, and the thick and creamy gravy is wonderful, and the spices used in the batter and gravy bring out every flavor to its fullest.
rows.translation: 牛排嫩得几乎无需用刀便能切开。刀刃切入时，牛肉外层酥脆面衣发出令人满足的碎响。肉味比普通牛排丰富得多；浓郁、多汁、鲜香、带着胡椒味，又无比软嫩。酥脆面衣、耐嚼牛肉与浓稠奶油肉汁形成绝妙口感对比，面糊与肉汁使用的香料则将每一种滋味发挥到极致。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe steak is so tender you barely need to use your knife to cut it. The crispy breading on the beef crunches satisfyingly as you slice into the steak. The meat is far more flavorful than a normal steak; it’s rich, juicy, savory, peppery and oh so tender. The contrast between the textures of the crunchy breading, the chewy beef, and the thick and creamy gravy is wonderful, and the spices used in the batter and gravy bring out every flavor to its fullest."

rows.original: The mashed potatoes are no less satisfying. They were mashed without being peeled, leaving bits of peel throughout the dish to vary the texture and add an earthy note to the dish. You can definitely tell milk was added to the potatoes, as well as a generous portion of butter, but aside from a dash of salt and pepper, there isn’t much more to the dish. The mashed potatoes provide a soft and creamy texture to the meal that complements the crunchy and chewy texture of the steak, and the simple taste of the potatoes doesn’t distract from the complicated array of flavors in the steak. It doesn’t take you long to work through the delicious meal, leaving you feeling absolutely stuffed.
rows.translation: 土豆泥同样令人满足。制作时没有去皮，因此菜中散布着薯皮碎片，既改变口感，也增添朴实风味。你能明确尝出土豆中加入了牛奶和大量黄油，但除少许盐和胡椒外再无多少调味。土豆泥为餐点带来柔滑绵密的口感，与牛排酥脆又耐嚼的质地相得益彰，而土豆的简单滋味也不会干扰牛排复杂丰富的风味。没过多久，你便吃完这顿美餐，感觉肚子撑得满满当当。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe mashed potatoes are no less satisfying. They were mashed without being peeled, leaving bits of peel throughout the dish to vary the texture and add an earthy note to the dish. You can definitely tell milk was added to the potatoes, as well as a generous portion of butter, but aside from a dash of salt and pepper, there isn’t much more to the dish. The mashed potatoes provide a soft and creamy texture to the meal that complements the crunchy and chewy texture of the steak, and the simple taste of the potatoes doesn’t distract from the complicated array of flavors in the steak. It doesn’t take you long to work through the delicious meal, leaving you feeling absolutely stuffed."

rows.original: You lean back in your chair for a few minutes, simply enjoying the feeling of a good meal. Your waitress comes by and collects your dishes, thanking you for your patronage in her New Texas drawl and giving you a generous eyeful of cleavage as she leans down to clear the table. When you feel ready again you gather yourself and leave the table, happy to have enjoyed some authentic New Texas cuisine.
rows.translation: 你靠在椅背上休息几分钟，单纯享受一顿美餐后的满足。女服务员过来收走餐具，用新德克萨斯口音感谢你的惠顾，俯身清理桌面时还慷慨地让你饱览乳沟。感觉恢复精神后，你收拾妥当离开餐桌，很高兴自己享用了一顿正宗新德克萨斯菜肴。

rows.original: Looking along the bar, where you’d normally see an empty seat next to Sally, you instead see New Texas’ own minty-haired, mute cowgirl: Brandy. The quiet queenie is carrying out as much of a conversation as she can with Sally, blushing and giggling silently every once in awhile. Like her rum-titted friend (girlfriend?), Brandy appears to be completely naked.
rows.translation: 沿吧台望去，莎莉旁边平时空着的座位上，此刻坐着新德克萨斯自家那位薄荷绿头发、不会说话的牛女：布兰迪。安静的小女王正尽可能与莎莉交谈，偶尔面红耳赤地无声咯咯笑着。和她那对朗姆酒乳房的朋友（女朋友？）一样，布兰迪似乎一丝不挂。
rows.raw: "\n\nLooking along the bar, where you’d normally see an empty seat next to Sally, you instead see New Texas’ own minty-haired, mute cowgirl: Brandy. The quiet queenie is carrying out as much of a conversation as she can with Sally, blushing and giggling silently every once in awhile. Like her rum-titted friend (girlfriend?), Brandy appears to be completely naked."

rows.original: Sally and Brandy are sitting together at bar again, both of them completely nude. The darker-skinned cowgirl points you out to her girlfriend, and they both wave happily at you.
rows.translation: 莎莉和布兰迪又一起坐在吧台边，两人都全身赤裸。肤色较深的牛女向女朋友指出你的存在，随后两人都开心地向你挥手。
rows.raw: "\n\nSally and Brandy are sitting together at bar again, both of them completely nude. The darker-skinned cowgirl points you out to her girlfriend, and they both wave happily at you."

rows.original: Seeing Brandy out naked in public like this piques your curiosity, and leads you to [pc.walk] over to the couple of cow gals. They seem pretty engrossed in each other’s company, with Sally leaning in close to her minty-haired friend and talking to her, leading to some giggling, happy moos from the cowgirl. The pair doesn’t seem to notice you until you’re close, with the darker of the two girls turning your way, a gentle smile appearing on her face when she sees who’s come to visit.
rows.translation: 看见布兰迪这样赤身裸体地出现在公众场合，勾起了你的好奇，令你[pc.walk]向这对牛女。她们似乎完全沉浸在彼此的陪伴中，莎莉凑近薄荷色头发的朋友说话，引来牛女几声咯咯轻笑和愉快哞叫。直到你走近，两人才似乎注意到你；其中肤色较深的女孩转向这边，看清来访者后脸上浮现温柔笑容。
rows.raw: "Seeing Brandy out naked in public like this piques your curiosity, and leads you to [pc.walk] over to the couple of cow gals. They seem pretty engrossed in each other’s company, with Sally leaning in close to her minty-haired friend and talking to her, leading to some giggling, happy moos from the cowgirl. The pair doesn’t seem to notice you until you’re close, with the darker of the two girls turning your way, a gentle smile appearing on her face when she sees who’s come to visit."

rows.original: “Well hey there, [pc.name],” she coos with her usual, sultry voice.
rows.translation: “嘿，你来啦，[pc.name]，”她用一贯性感的嗓音柔声说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well hey there, [pc.name],” she coos with her usual, sultry voice."

rows.original: Brandy jumps slightly when she hears Sally say your name, and slowly turns her barstool to face you as you take a seat next to her. When she sees that it is indeed you, she blushes hard and tries to cover herself by shifting her body around, giving you a nervous smile as she does. Her rum-titted friend notices her embarrassed reaction and smiles all the wider.
rows.translation: 布兰迪听见莎莉念出你的名字，微微一跳；你在她身旁坐下时，她慢慢转动吧台凳面向你。确认来人确实是你后，她顿时满脸通红，扭动身体试图遮掩自己，同时向你露出紧张笑容。她那有着朗姆酒乳房的朋友注意到这番窘迫反应，笑得更加灿烂。
rows.raw: "\n\nBrandy jumps slightly when she hears Sally say your name, and slowly turns her barstool to face you as you take a seat next to her. When she sees that it is indeed you, she blushes hard and tries to cover herself by shifting her body around, giving you a nervous smile as she does. Her rum-titted friend notices her embarrassed reaction and smiles all the wider."

rows.original: She looks back to you for a moment and winks before turning to Brandy again. “Sweety,” she says, draping her arms around the nervous cowgirl’s shoulders, “Do you know [pc.name] here?”
rows.translation: 她回头看你一眼，眨了眨眼，随后再次转向布兰迪。“亲爱的，”她一边说，一边将双臂搭在紧张牛女的肩上，“你认识这里的[pc.name]吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe looks back to you for a moment and winks before turning to Brandy again. “Sweety,” she says, draping her arms around the nervous cowgirl’s shoulders, “Do you know [pc.name] here?”"

rows.original: You thank the android for his warning before taking a deep breath and slamming back the shot. A burning sensation immediately fills your throat and spreads to your chest as you gulp the shot down, just as you’d expect from whiskey. You close your eyes from the feeling, shaking your head to distract yourself. When you open your eyes again though, you feel dizzy. Euphoria is clouding your senses; you have to prop yourself on the bar momentarily to keep from losing your balance, but you don’t even care. You feel ready to take on the whole world right now. James removes your shot glass while you’re still reeling, grinning at your stupor as he tells you “I’d recommend waiting a while before drinking anything else.”
rows.translation: 你感谢仿生人的提醒，随后深吸一口气，将杯中酒一口闷下。烈焰般的感觉立刻灌满喉咙，并随着你吞下酒液蔓延到胸口，正如威士忌应有的表现。你受刺激闭上眼睛，摇摇头转移注意。可再次睁眼时，你已感到头晕目眩。欣快感蒙蔽了你的感官；你不得不暂时撑住吧台才没有失去平衡，却根本毫不在意。此刻你感觉自己足以挑战整个世界。你仍在踉跄，詹姆斯便收走了子弹杯，对你这副醉态咧嘴一笑，并说道：“我建议你过一阵子再喝别的。”

rows.original: “Well, I’m a Reaper Armaments bodyguard android. People prefer VIs for most combat roles since a VI is about as effective and far cheaper, but the truly wealthy and the truly friendless spring for AIs such as myself; if you can buy a real friend who literally can’t betray your trust, what reason do you have not to? Erm, not that my owner is truly friendless of course!” James blushes when he realizes what he just implied. “If anything I meant it as a compliment to her. See, my type of android is very expensive to make, and demand is limited enough that we aren’t mass produced. Each of us is custom-built to the specifications of the customer. Certain elements of my design,” the android strikes a bodybuilder’s pose that threatens to destroy his clothes as he says this, “meant that I was three times the price of most of my siblings. I guess I’m lucky my owner has a good eye for men.” James stops flexing his synthetic muscles before any of the seams in his clothes burst.
rows.translation: “嗯，我是死神军械的保镖仿生人。大多数战斗岗位都偏爱虚拟智能，因为虚拟智能效果相当，价格却便宜得多；但真正富有或真正没有朋友的人，还是会舍得花钱买我这样的人工智能。既然你可以买到一个真正的朋友，而且他绝不可能背叛你的信任，又有什么理由不买呢？呃，当然不是说我的主人真的没有朋友！”詹姆斯意识到自己方才暗示了什么，脸上一红。“真要说起来，我其实是在夸奖她。你瞧，我这种仿生人的制造成本极高，需求又少得无法量产。我们每一个都是依照客户要求定制的。我的某些设计元素，”说到这里，仿生人摆出健美姿势，衣服几乎要被撑裂，“让我的价格达到了大多数同类的三倍。我想，主人很有识男人的眼光，我也算幸运。”詹姆斯在衣服的接缝崩裂前停止展示人造肌肉。

rows.original: “In terms of my personal history, I served my owner, who is also the owner of this fine establishment by the way, as a bodyguard for 14 years. When she retired to New Texas eight years ago, she brought me along. She’s very generous to those who serve her well; she offered me my freedom when she retired, but I turned her down. She’s a very kind woman, and I’m not made to self-actualize anyway.”

rows.original: James laughs good-naturedly at your question. “Most folks, at least those who haven’t taken the Treatment, are always searching for their purpose in life. Lucky me then being built with a crystal-clear purpose: to guard my mistress and do what she tells me. Even luckier for me that she’s rich enough to afford anti-agathic therapy and is content to lead a very danger-free life. It means she’ll be around pretty much forever.” He finishes his last statement with a contented sigh and a slightly glazed-over look; if you didn’t know any better you’d think he was a lovestruck teenager!

rows.translation: 外貌

rows.original: The hunk standing before you can be summarized with the simple title of “The Beefcake Next Door”, a mixture of playful happy-go-lucky cheer combined with slabs of muscle adorned on his body. His pair of horns are fully grown, possibly around eight inches long, the ivory tusks sticking up on either side of his short, messy brown hair. His hair brings out his sea blue eyes. A light stubble adorns his well defined jawline. He looks as if he hasn’t a care in the world, always carrying a relaxed, happy-to-be-there smile.
rows.translation: 站在你面前的猛男可以用一个简单的称号概括：“邻家肌肉男”。他既有顽皮随和的开朗气质，身上又堆满大块肌肉。那对角已经完全长成，大约有八英寸长，象牙色的角从凌乱的棕色短发两侧向上伸出。棕发衬得那双海蓝色眼睛更加醒目，轮廓分明的下颌覆着一层浅浅胡茬。他看起来无忧无虑，总带着放松而乐在其中的笑容。
rows.raw: "The hunk standing before you can be summarized with the simple title of “The Beefcake Next Door”, a mixture of playful happy-go-lucky cheer combined with slabs of muscle adorned on his body. His pair of horns are fully grown, possibly around eight inches long, the ivory tusks sticking up on either side of his short, messy brown hair. His hair brings out his sea blue eyes. A light stubble adorns his well defined jawline. He looks as if he hasn’t a care in the world, always carrying a relaxed, happy-to-be-there smile."

rows.original: His torso is hugged tight by the undershirt he’s wearing. The outline of his pectorals and abs are clearly visible through the white cloth, and you can see hints of chest hair peaking out from under his shirt. The male bull seems to work out constantly, as his body and arms are perfectly defined. There is a decent amount of hair on his arms as well. Not enough to pass for fur, but more akin to an unshaven lumberjack.
rows.translation: 他身上的汗衫紧紧包裹着躯干。白色布料下清晰可见胸肌和腹肌的轮廓，领口处还露出一缕缕胸毛。这头雄性公牛似乎一直在锻炼，身体和双臂的线条堪称完美。手臂上也长着不少毛，虽不至于称作皮毛，却很像一个没刮体毛的伐木工。
rows.raw: "\n\nHis torso is hugged tight by the undershirt he’s wearing. The outline of his pectorals and abs are clearly visible through the white cloth, and you can see hints of chest hair peaking out from under his shirt. The male bull seems to work out constantly, as his body and arms are perfectly defined. There is a decent amount of hair on his arms as well. Not enough to pass for fur, but more akin to an unshaven lumberjack."

rows.original: On Busky’s lower body are two legs that are just as hairy and muscular, ending in regular old human feet. And between those legs, constrained in a brown leather jockstrap, are a quartet of grapefruit sized balls supporting a hefty 20 inch horsecock that is spotted brown at the base, and pink up towards the flare.
rows.translation: 巴斯基的下半身是一双同样多毛而肌肉发达的腿，末端则是普通的人类双脚。两腿之间，一条棕色皮革护裆束缚着四颗葡萄柚般大小的睾丸，它们托着一根粗硕的二十英寸马鸡巴，根部布有棕色斑点，越接近龟头冠便越发粉红。
rows.raw: "\n\nOn Busky’s lower body are two legs that are just as hairy and muscular, ending in regular old human feet. And between those legs, constrained in a brown leather jockstrap, are a quartet of grapefruit sized balls supporting a hefty 20 inch horsecock that is spotted brown at the base, and pink up towards the flare."

rows.original: Busky has one tight ass, placed exactly where it belongs. Resting above his ass is a standard bovine tail, with a tuft of brown fur at the end.
rows.translation: 巴斯基有一只紧实的屁股，端端正正长在该在的位置。屁股上方是一条标准牛尾，末端带着一簇棕毛。
rows.raw: "\n\nBusky has one tight ass, placed exactly where it belongs. Resting above his ass is a standard bovine tail, with a tuft of brown fur at the end."

rows.translation: 外貌
rows.raw: "Appearance"
