rows.translation: 听到回答，他笑得更加灿烂。“哦，那你肯定会喜欢这个。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHis smile grows even wider at your answer. “Oh, you’re gonna love this one then.”"

rows.original: Did you hear about the restaurant on the asteroid? Great food, no atmosphere.
rows.translation: 听说过小行星上的餐厅吗？食物很棒，就是没有大气层。
rows.raw: "Did you hear about the restaurant on the asteroid? Great food, no atmosphere."

rows.original: What do you call a fake noodle? An impasta.
rows.translation: 冒牌面条叫什么？假意面。
rows.raw: "What do you call a fake noodle? An impasta."

rows.original: How many apples grow on a tree? All of them.
rows.translation: 一棵树上会长出多少苹果？所有苹果。
rows.raw: "How many apples grow on a tree? All of them."

rows.original: Want to hear a joke about paper? Never mind, it’s tearable.
rows.translation: 想听一个关于纸的笑话吗？还是算了，它太容易撕了。
rows.raw: "Want to hear a joke about paper? Never mind, it’s tearable."

rows.original: I just watched a program about beavers. It was the best dam program I’ve ever seen.
rows.translation: 我刚看了一个讲海狸的节目。那是我看过最棒的筑坝节目。
rows.raw: "I just watched a program about beavers. It was the best dam program I’ve ever seen."

rows.original: Why did the coffee file a police report? It got mugged.
rows.translation: 咖啡为什么去报警？因为它被“杯劫”了。
rows.raw: "Why did the coffee file a police report? It got mugged."

rows.original: How does a penguin build its house? Igloos it together.
rows.translation: 企鹅怎么盖房子？用冰屋把它粘起来。
rows.raw: "How does a penguin build its house? Igloos it together."

rows.original: I once worked as a can crusher, but I had to quit. It was soda-pressing.
rows.translation: 我以前做过易拉罐压扁工，但只好辞职。那工作实在汽水压抑。
rows.raw: "I once worked as a can crusher, but I had to quit. It was soda-pressing."

rows.original: What do you call somebody with no body and no nose? Nobody knows!
rows.translation: 没有身体也没有鼻子的人叫什么？无人知晓！
rows.raw: "What do you call somebody with no body and no nose? Nobody knows!"

rows.original: I’m not addicted to brake fluid. I can stop anytime!
rows.translation: 我没有对刹车油上瘾。我随时都能停下来！
rows.raw: "I’m not addicted to brake fluid. I can stop anytime!"

rows.original: Why did the scarecrow win an award? Because he was outstanding in his field.
rows.translation: 稻草人为什么获奖？因为它在自己的田野里表现突出。
rows.raw: "Why did the scarecrow win an award? Because he was outstanding in his field."

rows.original: Why don’t skeletons ever go trick or treating? Because they have no body to go with.
rows.translation: 骷髅为什么从不出去不给糖就捣蛋？因为没有人陪它。
rows.raw: "Why don’t skeletons ever go trick or treating? Because they have no body to go with."

rows.original: What did the buffalo say to his son when he left for college? Bison!
rows.translation: 水牛在儿子离家上大学时说了什么？拜，儿子！
rows.raw: "What did the buffalo say to his son when he left for college? Bison!"

rows.original: What do you call an elephant that doesn’t matter? An irrelephant.
rows.translation: 无关紧要的大象叫什么？无关紧象。
rows.raw: "What do you call an elephant that doesn’t matter? An irrelephant."

rows.original: Want to hear a joke about construction? Never mind, I’m still working on it.
rows.translation: 想听一个关于建筑的笑话吗？还是算了，我还在施工。
rows.raw: "Want to hear a joke about construction? Never mind, I’m still working on it."

rows.original: I bought a pair of shoes from a drug dealer once. I don’t know what she laced them with, but I was tripping all day.
rows.translation: 我曾经从毒贩那里买过一双鞋。我不知道她在鞋带里掺了什么，反正我绊了一整天。
rows.raw: "I bought a pair of shoes from a drug dealer once. I don’t know what she laced them with, but I was tripping all day."

rows.original: Why couldn’t the bicycle stand up by itself? It was two tired.
rows.translation: 自行车为什么没法自己站起来？因为它有两个轮胎。
rows.raw: "Why couldn’t the bicycle stand up by itself? It was two tired."

rows.original: What did the grape do when he got stepped on? He let out a little wine.
rows.translation: 葡萄被踩时做了什么？它发出了一点葡萄酒般的哀鸣。
rows.raw: "What did the grape do when he got stepped on? He let out a little wine."

rows.original: I wouldn’t buy anything with velcro. It’s a total rip-off.
rows.translation: 我不会买任何带魔术贴的东西。那完全是在撕钱。
rows.raw: "I wouldn’t buy anything with velcro. It’s a total rip-off."

rows.original: The shovel was a ground-breaking invention.
rows.translation: 铲子是一项开天辟地的发明。
rows.raw: "The shovel was a ground-breaking invention."

rows.original: Did you hear about the Terran who invented the knock knock joke? He won the no-bell prize.
rows.translation: 听说过发明“咚咚敲门”笑话的地球人吗？他赢得了“没门”奖。
rows.raw: "Did you hear about the Terran who invented the knock knock joke? He won the no-bell prize."

rows.original: What did the police molecule say to the suspect molecule? I’ve got my ion you!
rows.translation: 警察分子对嫌疑分子说了什么？我的离子盯上你了！
rows.raw: "What did the police molecule say to the suspect molecule? I’ve got my ion you!"

rows.original: Never trust atoms. They make up everything.
rows.translation: 永远别相信原子。万物都是它们编造的。
rows.raw: "Never trust atoms. They make up everything."

rows.original: A recent survey found that 5/4 of people admit that they’re bad with fractions.
rows.translation: 最近一项调查发现，5/4的人承认自己不擅长分数。
rows.raw: "A recent survey found that 5/4 of people admit that they’re bad with fractions."

rows.original: Two goldfish are in a tank. One says to the other, “do you know how to drive this thing?”
rows.translation: 两条金鱼待在一辆坦克里。一条对另一条说：“你知道这东西怎么开吗？”
rows.raw: "Two goldfish are in a tank. One says to the other, “do you know how to drive this thing?”"

rows.original: I once went to a wedding between two satellite dishes. The ceremony was nothing special, but the reception was incredible!
rows.translation: 我曾参加两面卫星天线的婚礼。仪式平平无奇，但接收效果棒极了！
rows.raw: "I once went to a wedding between two satellite dishes. The ceremony was nothing special, but the reception was incredible!"

rows.original: What do you call a fat psychic? A four-chin teller.
rows.translation: 肥胖的灵媒叫什么？四下巴预言家。
rows.raw: "What do you call a fat psychic? A four-chin teller."

rows.original: I would avoid the sushi they serve around here. It’s a little fishy.
rows.translation: 我会避开这里供应的寿司。它闻起来有点可疑。
rows.raw: "I would avoid the sushi they serve around here. It’s a little fishy."

rows.original: What do you call a pony with a sore throat? A little horse.
rows.translation: 嗓子疼的小马叫什么？一匹声音嘶哑的小马。
rows.raw: "What do you call a pony with a sore throat? A little horse."

rows.original: The rotation of New Texas really makes my day.
rows.translation: 新德克萨斯的自转真的成就了我的一天。
rows.raw: "The rotation of New Texas really makes my day."

rows.original: I thought about going on an all-almond diet. But that’s just nuts.
rows.translation: 我考虑过只吃杏仁的饮食法。但那实在太疯狂了。
rows.raw: "I thought about going on an all-almond diet. But that’s just nuts."

rows.original: What’s brown and sticky? A stick.
rows.translation: 什么东西又棕又黏？一根棍子。
rows.raw: "What’s brown and sticky? A stick."

rows.original: I’ve decided I hate elevators. I’m going to start taking steps to avoid them.
rows.translation: 我决定自己讨厌电梯。以后要一步步避开它们。
rows.raw: "I’ve decided I hate elevators. I’m going to start taking steps to avoid them."

rows.original: Why do you never see elephants hiding in trees? Because they’re so good at it.
rows.translation: 为什么从来看不见大象躲在树上？因为它们太擅长了。
rows.raw: "Why do you never see elephants hiding in trees? Because they’re so good at it."

rows.original: Did you hear about the kidnapping at school? It’s fine, he woke up.
rows.translation: 听说学校里发生的儿童绑架案了吗？没事，他睡醒了。
rows.raw: "Did you hear about the kidnapping at school? It’s fine, he woke up."

rows.original: A furniture store keeps calling me. All I wanted was one night stand.
rows.translation: 一家家具店一直给我打电话。我只想要一个床头柜而已。
rows.raw: "A furniture store keeps calling me. All I wanted was one night stand."

rows.original: I used to work in a shoe recycling center. It was sole destroying.
rows.translation: 我以前在鞋类回收中心工作。那工作摧毁鞋底，也摧毁灵魂。
rows.raw: "I used to work in a shoe recycling center. It was sole destroying."

rows.original: What’s the loneliest kind of cheese? Provolone.
rows.translation: 最孤独的奶酪是哪一种？普罗卧龙奶酪。
rows.raw: "What’s the loneliest kind of cheese? Provolone."

rows.original: I don’t play soccer because I enjoy the sport. I’m just doing it for kicks.
rows.translation: 我踢足球不是因为喜欢这项运动。我只是想踢几脚。
rows.raw: "I don’t play soccer because I enjoy the sport. I’m just doing it for kicks."

rows.original: People don’t like having to bend over to get their drinks. We really need to raise the bar.
rows.translation: 大家不喜欢弯腰拿饮料。我们真得把酒吧抬高点。
rows.raw: "People don’t like having to bend over to get their drinks. We really need to raise the bar."

rows.original: I once tried this tropical fruit diet, but I didn’t last long on it. It was enough to make a mango crazy!
rows.translation: 我曾试过热带水果饮食，但坚持不了多久。那足以让芒果把人逼疯！
rows.raw: "I once tried this tropical fruit diet, but I didn’t last long on it. It was enough to make a mango crazy!"

rows.original: I knew I shouldn’t have eaten the seafood platter. Now I’m feeling a little eel.
rows.translation: 我早知道不该吃那盘海鲜。现在感觉有点鳗不舒服。
rows.raw: "I knew I shouldn’t have eaten the seafood platter. Now I’m feeling a little eel."

rows.original: I’d like to thank all the sidewalks out there for keeping me off the streets.
rows.translation: 我要感谢外面的每一条人行道，是它们让我没有流落街头。
rows.raw: "I’d like to thank all the sidewalks out there for keeping me off the streets."

rows.original: I used to really hate facial hair, but then it really grew on me.
rows.translation: 我以前真的讨厌面部毛发，但后来它慢慢长在我身上，也长进我心里。
rows.raw: "I used to really hate facial hair, but then it really grew on me."

rows.original: I really hate jokes about sausage. They’re the wurst!
rows.translation: 我真的讨厌香肠笑话。它们是最糟的！
rows.raw: "I really hate jokes about sausage. They’re the wurst!"

rows.original: This wedding I went to a few years ago was so beautiful. Even the cake was in tiers!
rows.translation: 几年前参加的那场婚礼太美了。就连蛋糕也感动得层层落泪！
rows.raw: "This wedding I went to a few years ago was so beautiful. Even the cake was in tiers!"

rows.original: What lies at the bottom of the ocean and twitches? A nervous wreck.
rows.translation: 什么东西躺在海底抽搐？一艘紧张的沉船。
rows.raw: "What lies at the bottom of the ocean and twitches? A nervous wreck."

rows.original: Have you heard of that new band 1023 MB? Yeah, I’m not surprised. They haven’t quite got a gig yet.
rows.translation: 听说过那个叫1023 MB的新乐队吗？没听过也不奇怪。他们还没凑够一个G的演出。
rows.raw: "Have you heard of that new band 1023 MB? Yeah, I’m not surprised. They haven’t quite got a gig yet."

rows.original: Do you know why crabs never donate to charity? They’re just shellfish.
rows.translation: 知道螃蟹为什么从不向慈善机构捐款吗？因为它们太自私了。
rows.raw: "Do you know why crabs never donate to charity? They’re just shellfish."

rows.original: Why can’t you have a hand that’s more than 11 inches long? Because then it would be a foot.
rows.translation: 为什么手不可能超过11英寸长？因为再长就成一英尺了。
rows.raw: "Why can’t you have a hand that’s more than 11 inches long? Because then it would be a foot."

rows.original: !ERROR WITH RANDOM VALUE :(!
rows.translation: !ERROR WITH RANDOM VALUE :(!
rows.raw: "!ERROR WITH RANDOM VALUE :(!"

rows.original: You put your face in your hands and groan at the DILF’s truly corny joke. He laughs uproariously as much at your reaction as at his own joke. You quickly change the subject before Ciaran can inflict more of his terrible humor on you.
rows.translation: 面对熟爹这个老掉牙到极点的笑话，你双手掩面呻吟起来。他放声大笑，既是在笑自己的笑话，也是在笑你的反应。你赶紧换了话题，免得基兰继续用糟糕幽默折磨你。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou put your face in your hands and groan at the DILF’s truly corny joke. He laughs uproariously as much at your reaction as at his own joke. You quickly change the subject before Ciaran can inflict more of his terrible humor on you."

rows.original: Dad Jokes
rows.translation: 老爸笑话
rows.raw: "Dad Jokes"

rows.original: Dad Jokes
rows.translation: 老爸笑话
rows.raw: "Dad Jokes"

rows.original: You just talked about this.
rows.translation: 你刚聊过这个话题。
rows.raw: "You just talked about this."

rows.original: Dad Jokes
rows.translation: 老爸笑话
rows.raw: "Dad Jokes"

rows.original: You might not think it to look at him, but Ciaran likes lame humor. Sometimes he even tells jokes unsolicited...
rows.translation: 别看基兰的样子不太像，他其实喜欢冷笑话。有时甚至会不请自来地讲几个...
rows.raw: "You might not think it to look at him, but Ciaran likes lame humor. Sometimes he even tells jokes unsolicited..."

rows.original: His Scars
rows.translation: 他的伤疤
rows.raw: "His Scars"

rows.original: Night Trap
rows.raw: "Night Trap"

rows.original: Knowing that Ciaran takes some measure of pride in his myriad scars, you ask him to tell you again about how he acquired them.
rows.translation: 你知道基兰颇为自己身上的无数伤疤自豪，于是请他再讲讲这些伤疤的来历。
rows.raw: "Knowing that Ciaran takes some measure of pride in his myriad scars, you ask him to tell you again about how he acquired them."

rows.original: You’re not sure if it’s a sensitive topic for Ciaran, so you broach the subject of how he acquired his myriad scars as tactfully as you can.
rows.translation: 你不确定这对基兰是不是敏感话题，于是尽可能委婉地提起他那无数伤疤的由来。
rows.raw: "You’re not sure if it’s a sensitive topic for Ciaran, so you broach the subject of how he acquired his myriad scars as tactfully as you can."

rows.original: Initially you’re worried you’ve offended the older man, as he fixes you with a stern gaze.
rows.translation: 一开始你担心冒犯了这个年长男人，因为他严厉地盯着你。
rows.raw: "\n\nInitially you’re worried you’ve offended the older man, as he fixes you with a stern gaze. "

rows.original: “You wanna know how I got these scars? My father, was... a drinker... and a fiend.”
rows.translation: “你想知道这些伤疤怎么来的？我父亲，是个...酒鬼...还是个恶棍。”
rows.raw: "“You wanna know how I got these scars? My father, was... a drinker... and a fiend.” "

rows.original: Just when you start to feel uncomfortable though, he breaks out laughing. “I’m just fucking with you, kid. Really gets your imagination running when I act all dodgy about my scars, right?”
rows.translation: 就在你开始感到不自在时，他突然大笑起来。“逗你玩的，孩子。我故意对伤疤遮遮掩掩时，很能激发你的想象，对吧？”
rows.raw: "Just when you start to feel uncomfortable though, he breaks out laughing. “I’m just fucking with you, kid. Really gets your imagination running when I act all dodgy about my scars, right?” "

rows.original: You breathe a sigh of relief before conceding that yes, you were worried after asking him.
rows.translation: 你松了一口气，随后承认，问出口以后确实有些担心。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou breathe a sigh of relief before conceding that yes, you were worried after asking him."

rows.original: Ciaran chuckles mirthfully at your response, obviously pleased with himself. He stifles his laughter when he notices you aren’t laughing though, giving you a more serious answer this time. “Alright, alright, I’m sorry. I’m actually a bit proud of my scars, but they still weren’t fun to earn. Cut me a bit of slack if I try to get some enjoyment out of them after the fact.” He shrugs contritely and grins.
rows.translation: 基兰听见你的回答，开心地轻笑，显然颇为得意。不过发现你没有笑后，他压下笑声，这次给出了更认真的回答。“好吧，好吧，抱歉。其实我有点为这些伤疤自豪，但得到它们的过程一点也不好受。既然事情都过去了，我想从中找点乐子，你就宽容一点吧。”他歉疚地耸肩，咧嘴一笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nCiaran chuckles mirthfully at your response, obviously pleased with himself. He stifles his laughter when he notices you aren’t laughing though, giving you a more serious answer this time. “Alright, alright, I’m sorry. I’m actually a bit proud of my scars, but they still weren’t fun to earn. Cut me a bit of slack if I try to get some enjoyment out of them after the fact.” He shrugs contritely and grins."

rows.original: Satisfied with his apology, you ask Ciaran how he received so many scars when modern medicine often prevents them in the first place.
rows.translation: 你接受了他的道歉，随后问基兰，现代医学往往能从一开始就避免留疤，他怎么会留下这么多。
rows.raw: "\n\nSatisfied with his apology, you ask Ciaran how he received so many scars when modern medicine often prevents them in the first place."

rows.original: He wags a furred finger at you while smiling roguishly. “See, you’ve sort of answered your own question there. Modern medicine might prevent most scarring, but when I received most of these injuries all I had access to was what could be provided in the field. Basically, just first aid stuff.” As he speaks, Ciaran begins undressing from the waist up, quickly exposing his sculpted musculature and the many exotic scars covering his bare flesh. “I served more than a decade in the reconnaissance marines, and I volunteered for all the most dangerous postings and assignments. That usually meant that I was either deep in the wilderness or behind enemy lines, two places where you can’t exactly set up a field hospital. Then there were instances where I either wouldn’t or couldn’t be extracted for what would be considered proper treatment. I always figured that if I could march and hold a gun, I was ready for duty. It didn’t matter to me if I had been shot, burned, or bitten.” Ciaran punctuates his last three words by first gesturing to an old bullet wound on his stomach, then turning around to show a plasma burn on his left scapula, and finally a very faded bite mark on his right side. The poses that the hellhound adopts to show off his old wounds have the very enjoyable side effect of displaying his chiseled physique in different states of flexion.
rows.translation: 他坏笑着朝你摇晃一根毛茸茸的手指。“你看，这算是自己回答了问题。现代医学确实能避免大多数伤疤，可我受这些伤时，能得到的只有战场上提供的医疗。基本就是急救用品。”说话时，基兰开始脱掉上半身衣物，很快便露出雕塑般的肌肉，以及覆盖裸露肉体的许多奇特伤疤。“我在侦察陆战队服役了十多年，而且所有最危险的驻地和任务，我都会志愿参加。通常这意味着我要么深入荒野，要么身处敌后，这两个地方都不可能搭建野战医院。还有些时候，我不愿意或者无法撤离去接受所谓的正规治疗。我一直觉得，只要还能行军、还能拿枪，就能继续执行任务。中枪、烧伤还是被咬，对我都没有区别。”基兰说出最后三个词时，先指向腹部一处旧枪伤，接着转身展示左肩胛骨上的等离子灼伤，最后又指向右侧一处已经很淡的咬痕。地狱犬为展示旧伤摆出的姿势还有个十分赏心悦目的副作用：让他轮流绷紧身体不同部位，展现那身雕刻般的体格。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe wags a furred finger at you while smiling roguishly. “See, you’ve sort of answered your own question there. Modern medicine might prevent most scarring, but when I received most of these injuries all I had access to was what could be provided in the field. Basically, just first aid stuff.” As he speaks, Ciaran begins undressing from the waist up, quickly exposing his sculpted musculature and the many exotic scars covering his bare flesh. “I served more than a decade in the reconnaissance marines, and I volunteered for all the most dangerous postings and assignments. That usually meant that I was either deep in the wilderness or behind enemy lines, two places where you can’t exactly set up a field hospital. Then there were instances where I either wouldn’t or couldn’t be extracted for what would be considered proper treatment. I always figured that if I could march and hold a gun, I was ready for duty. It didn’t matter to me if I had been shot, burned, or bitten.” Ciaran punctuates his last three words by first gesturing to an old bullet wound on his stomach, then turning around to show a plasma burn on his left scapula, and finally a very faded bite mark on his right side. The poses that the hellhound adopts to show off his old wounds have the very enjoyable side effect of displaying his chiseled physique in different states of flexion. "

rows.original: You have a hard time focusing on a bunch of old scar tissue when there’s so much hunky muscle on display. Is he just doing this as an excuse to flex? Not that you care either way. You fan your flushed face with your hand, trying to pay attention to the ausar DILF’s story.
rows.translation: 当眼前展示着这么多壮汉肌肉时，你很难把注意力放在一堆陈旧疤痕组织上。他是不是只想找借口秀肌肉？不过无论如何你都不介意。你用手扇着泛红的脸，努力把注意力放回奥萨尔熟爹的故事。
rows.raw: "You have a hard time focusing on a bunch of old scar tissue when there’s so much hunky muscle on display. Is he just doing this as an excuse to flex? Not that you care either way. You fan your flushed face with your hand, trying to pay attention to the ausar DILF’s story. "

rows.original: He begins dressing himself once more
rows.translation: 他开始重新穿上衣服
rows.raw: "He begins dressing himself once more"

rows.original: , much to your chagrin,
rows.translation: ，令你大失所望，
rows.raw: ", much to your chagrin,"

rows.original: before taking a seat again.
rows.translation: 然后重新坐下。
rows.raw: " before taking a seat again."

rows.original: Well that at least explains why Ciaran’s injuries scarred over. Your next question is how he received so many wounds in the first place. Even given the dangerous places he says he served, he should have had personal shields that would at least mitigate serious injury
rows.translation: 好吧，这至少解释了基兰的伤为什么会结疤。下一个问题是，他最初怎么会受这么多伤。就算他服役的地方确实危险，也应该有个人护盾，至少能减轻严重伤害
rows.raw: "\n\nWell that at least explains why Ciaran’s injuries scarred over. Your next question is how he received so many wounds in the first place. Even given the dangerous places he says he served, he should have had personal shields that would at least mitigate serious injury"

rows.original: , especially given that ausar shields are the best available
rows.translation: ，尤其奥萨尔护盾还是市面上最好的
rows.raw: ", especially given that ausar shields are the best available"

rows.original: The expression Ciaran makes when he hears your question is something in between boastful and abashed. He takes a moment to chew over his answer, searching for just the right way to express himself. Finally though, Ciaran responds, “Well it’s true that ausar shields are top of the line. That’s sort of how I got into so much trouble though. See, I was really, and I mean really reckless when I was younger. I would do the craziest things and take the dumbest risks you can imagine, always relying on my shields to keep me alive. In hindsight it was damn foolish of me, but it’s how I clawed my way up from enlisted to officer. Reckless and stupid are highly desired traits in a soldier, and volunteering for things nobody else wanted got me noticed by the brass. Even when I was a first lieutenant, I still went into the field as often as possible. Sending other people into danger when I was sitting in a bunker somewhere just never sat right with me. I always preferred leading from the front. But that’s how I ended up with the injury that finally made me accept a medical discharge.”
rows.translation: 基兰听见问题后，脸上露出一种既自夸又窘迫的表情。他花了片刻斟酌答案，寻找恰当的表达方式。最后，基兰说道：“嗯，奥萨尔护盾确实是一流水准。可我会惹上那么多麻烦，某种程度上也正因为如此。你看，我年轻时真的——我是说真的——非常鲁莽。你能想象的疯狂事和愚蠢风险，我都敢做，总是仗着护盾保命。回头看，那真是蠢透了，可我也正是靠这样从士兵一路爬到军官。鲁莽和愚蠢都是士兵身上备受青睐的品质，而自愿接下别人都不想碰的任务，让高层注意到了我。就算当上中尉，我还是尽可能常去前线。自己坐在某处掩体里，却派别人去冒险，这种事我始终无法接受。我更喜欢冲在最前面指挥。不过也正因为这样，我才受了那次伤，最后不得不接受医疗退役。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe expression Ciaran makes when he hears your question is something in between boastful and abashed. He takes a moment to chew over his answer, searching for just the right way to express himself. Finally though, Ciaran responds, “Well it’s true that ausar shields are top of the line. That’s sort of how I got into so much trouble though. See, I was really, and I mean really reckless when I was younger. I would do the craziest things and take the dumbest risks you can imagine, always relying on my shields to keep me alive. In hindsight it was damn foolish of me, but it’s how I clawed my way up from enlisted to officer. Reckless and stupid are highly desired traits in a soldier, and volunteering for things nobody else wanted got me noticed by the brass. Even when I was a first lieutenant, I still went into the field as often as possible. Sending other people into danger when I was sitting in a bunker somewhere just never sat right with me. I always preferred leading from the front. But that’s how I ended up with the injury that finally made me accept a medical discharge.”"

rows.original: Ciaran taps the grievous scar on his neck that he normally conceals with his bandanna. <i>“This is the closest I ever came to dying. I was leading a squad on this little asshole of a planet, Noxia VI. It’s a death world, barely charted thanks to the acid storms that destroy most probes. We were there to assault a slaver base
rows.translation: 基兰轻敲平时藏在头巾下面、颈部那道可怕的伤疤。<i>“这是我最接近死亡的一次。当时我带领一支小队，在一颗叫诺克西亚六号的小混蛋星球上。那是个死亡世界，酸雨风暴会摧毁大多数探测器，所以几乎没有完成测绘。我们去那里袭击一座奴隶贩子基地
rows.raw: "\n\nCiaran taps the grievous scar on his neck that he normally conceals with his bandanna. <i>“This is the closest I ever came to dying. I was leading a squad on this little asshole of a planet, Noxia VI. It’s a death world, barely charted thanks to the acid storms that destroy most probes. We were there to assault a slaver base"

rows.original: , something you know is a very personal issue to me,
rows.translation: ，你知道，这对我而言是非常私人的问题，
rows.raw: ", something you know is a very personal issue to me,"

rows.original: and rescue any of the captives we could. We moved on foot to try to take the slavers by surprise, and during the march, I got pounced by a Noxian acid beast. Horrible creature. All of their bodily fluids are acidic, and their drool is the most corrosive of all. It tore through my shields in seconds and took a bite out of my neck. The acid burn it left is all that kept me from bleeding out. The rest of the squad lit that fucker up as soon as they saw it, but they still barely got to me in time. I had to be extracted, and I left service shortly thereafter.” Ciaran ties his bandanna around his neck as he finishes his story.
rows.translation: 并尽可能营救俘虏。为了出其不意，我们徒步前进，行军途中，我被一头诺克西亚酸兽扑倒。可怕的生物。它们所有体液都有酸性，口水腐蚀性最强。它几秒内便穿透我的护盾，一口咬掉了我颈部的肉。留下的酸灼伤反倒阻止我失血过多。小队其他人一看见便朝那个混蛋火力全开，可仍差点没能及时救下我。我不得不撤离，不久后也离开了部队。”讲完故事时，基兰把头巾系回颈部。
rows.raw: " and rescue any of the captives we could. We moved on foot to try to take the slavers by surprise, and during the march, I got pounced by a Noxian acid beast. Horrible creature. All of their bodily fluids are acidic, and their drool is the most corrosive of all. It tore through my shields in seconds and took a bite out of my neck. The acid burn it left is all that kept me from bleeding out. The rest of the squad lit that fucker up as soon as they saw it, but they still barely got to me in time. I had to be extracted, and I left service shortly thereafter.” Ciaran ties his bandanna around his neck as he finishes his story."

rows.original: You give Ciaran a sympathetic look, patting his huge, furred hand comfortingly. Although he didn’t seem particularly bothered by telling you his story, he still appreciates the gesture, as his tail wags slightly at your touch. You ask him if he has ever considered having his scars removed.
rows.translation: 你同情地看着基兰，安慰地拍了拍他毛茸茸的大手。尽管讲述时似乎并没有特别难受，他仍然很感激这个动作；你触碰时，他的尾巴轻轻摇了摇。你问他有没有考虑过祛除伤疤。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give Ciaran a sympathetic look, patting his huge, furred hand comfortingly. Although he didn’t seem particularly bothered by telling you his story, he still appreciates the gesture, as his tail wags slightly at your touch. You ask him if he has ever considered having his scars removed."

rows.original: The ausar shakes his head before gesturing to his limbs. <i>“No, I feel like it would be a waste of money that I’d rather just save. You can’t see them under all the fur, but I’ve got some scars on my arms and legs too. The fur was actually white in those places, but I got a nice color restoration mod several years ago as a gift
rows.translation: 奥萨尔摇摇头，随后指向四肢。<i>“没有，我觉得那样浪费钱，还不如存下来。毛发下面看不见，但我胳膊和腿上也有几道伤疤。那些地方的毛其实变白了，不过几年前，有人送了我一个很不错的颜色修复模组
rows.raw: "\n\nThe ausar shakes his head before gesturing to his limbs. <i>“No, I feel like it would be a waste of money that I’d rather just save. You can’t see them under all the fur, but I’ve got some scars on my arms and legs too. The fur was actually white in those places, but I got a nice color restoration mod several years ago as a gift"

rows.original: from my daughter. Little Celina said she hated the way it made me look like an old man
rows.translation: ，是我女儿送的。小塞莉娜说她讨厌那些白毛让我看起来像个老头
rows.raw: " from my daughter. Little Celina said she hated the way it made me look like an old man"

rows.original: . I’ve already started to grey again, but that color mod, the Treatment, and a mod for my eyes are the only mods I’ve ever indulged myself with. I just couldn’t pass up something that let me see in the dark now that I’m a game warden. It was something I always wanted, but my new job let me get a tax write off for it.
rows.translation: 。现在我已经又开始变灰，不过那个颜色模组、改造疗程，还有眼睛模组，是我唯一放纵自己装过的东西。当上狩猎监督员后，我实在无法拒绝一个能让我在黑暗里看清东西的模组。这一直是我想要的，而新工作又让我能用它抵税。
rows.raw: ". I’ve already started to grey again, but that color mod, the Treatment, and a mod for my eyes are the only mods I’ve ever indulged myself with. I just couldn’t pass up something that let me see in the dark now that I’m a game warden. It was something I always wanted, but my new job let me get a tax write off for it. "

rows.original: kaithrit
rows.raw: "kaithrit"

rows.original: I was always jealous of you kaithrit and your better night vision, so I just had to jump on the chance to share in that.
rows.translation: 我一直嫉妒你们凯斯利特拥有更好的夜视能力，所以一有机会分享这种能力，我就非装不可。
rows.raw: "I was always jealous of you kaithrit and your better night vision, so I just had to jump on the chance to share in that. "

rows.original: Even before that though, the Treatment changed my eye color from gold to what you see now.”
rows.translation: 不过早在那之前，改造疗程就已经把我的眼睛从金色变成你现在看到的样子。”
rows.raw: "Even before that though, the Treatment changed my eye color from gold to what you see now.”"

rows.original: You thank Ciaran for explaining his scars to you.
rows.translation: 你感谢基兰向你解释这些伤疤。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou thank Ciaran for explaining his scars to you."

rows.original: He flashes his usual cocky grin as he responds, “Anytime kid, anytime. Not every day you see scars like these anymore, so I’m always happy to show them off.”
rows.translation: 他露出平时那副自信笑容，回答道：“随时都可以，孩子，随时都可以。如今可不是每天都能看到这种伤疤，所以我一直很乐意展示。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe flashes his usual cocky grin as he responds, “Anytime kid, anytime. Not every day you see scars like these anymore, so I’m always happy to show them off.”"

rows.original: His Scars
rows.translation: 他的伤疤
rows.raw: "His Scars"

rows.original: His Scars
rows.translation: 他的伤疤
rows.raw: "His Scars"

rows.original: You just talked about this.
rows.translation: 你刚聊过这个话题。
rows.raw: "You just talked about this."

rows.original: His Scars
rows.translation: 他的伤疤
rows.raw: "His Scars"

rows.original: You noticed some pretty wicked scars on Ciaran earlier. See if he’s got any stories about how he got them.
rows.translation: 你早些时候注意到基兰身上有几道很吓人的伤疤。看看他是否愿意讲讲这些伤是怎么来的。
rows.raw: "You noticed some pretty wicked scars on Ciaran earlier. See if he’s got any stories about how he got them."

rows.original: Locked
rows.translation: 锁定
rows.raw: "Locked"

rows.original: Locked
rows.translation: 锁定
rows.raw: "Locked"

rows.original: You don’t even know to ask him about this. Try getting to know him more first.
rows.translation: 你甚至不知道该怎么问。先多了解他一些吧。
rows.raw: "You don’t even know to ask him about this. Try getting to know him more first."

rows.original: Head Scritches
rows.translation: 挠挠脑袋
rows.raw: "Head Scritches"

rows.original: Night Trap
rows.raw: "Night Trap"

rows.original: Figuring Ciaran can’t be treated like a proper puppy too often, you decide to spoil him a bit with some petting. Mischievously, you walk over to the hellhound’s seat, careful not to give away your scheme too early.
rows.translation: 你觉得基兰应该很少有机会被当成真正的小狗，于是决定好好抚摸他，宠他一次。你顽皮地走向地狱犬的座位，小心不让他过早察觉计划。
rows.raw: "Figuring Ciaran can’t be treated like a proper puppy too often, you decide to spoil him a bit with some petting. Mischievously, you walk over to the hellhound’s seat, careful not to give away your scheme too early. "

rows.original: He casts you a suspicious glance. “What are you doing? Are you up to something?” His ears flick before swiveling towards you like big, furry radar dishes. Those targets are just too tempting to resist.
rows.translation: 他怀疑地瞥了你一眼。“你在做什么？又在打什么主意？”他的耳朵抽动一下，随后像两面毛茸茸的大型雷达盘般转向你。这些目标实在太诱人，让人无法抗拒。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe casts you a suspicious glance. “What are you doing? Are you up to something?” His ears flick before swiveling towards you like big, furry radar dishes. Those targets are just too tempting to resist."

rows.original: You put on a face like butter wouldn’t melt in your mouth and innocently explain to the older ausar as you step behind his chair that you’d simply like to take a closer look at his old-fashioned hat.
rows.translation: 你摆出一副无比无辜的表情，走到椅子后面，同时天真地向这个年长奥萨尔解释，自己只是想近距离看看他那顶老式帽子。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou put on a face like butter wouldn’t melt in your mouth and innocently explain to the older ausar as you step behind his chair that you’d simply like to take a closer look at his old-fashioned hat."

rows.original: He scoffs at your explanation. “Yeah, you and every other tourist in this joint. Hell, if you want it so bad kid, how about you wear it for a bit? Maybe the tourists will think you’re the outlaw for once.” With that he reaches up to doff his hat before passing it to you.
rows.translation: 他听完解释后嗤之以鼻。“是啊，你和这里每个游客都一样。见鬼，孩子，既然这么想要，不如你戴一会儿？也许游客这次会把你当成亡命徒。”说完，他伸手摘下帽子，递给你。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe scoffs at your explanation. “Yeah, you and every other tourist in this joint. Hell, if you want it so bad kid, how about you wear it for a bit? Maybe the tourists will think you’re the outlaw for once.” With that he reaches up to doff his hat before passing it to you. "

rows.original: It’s a little snug on your head, but that’s not what matters.
rows.translation: 戴在你头上有点紧，不过这并不重要。
rows.raw: "It’s a little snug on your head, but that’s not what matters. "

rows.original: It’s an almost perfect fit for you
rows.translation: 它几乎完全适合你
rows.raw: "It’s an almost perfect fit for you"

[

rows.original: and it even has holes for your ears to fit through,
rows.translation: ，上面甚至还有让耳朵穿过的洞，
rows.raw: " and it even has holes for your ears to fit through,"

rows.original: but that’s not what matters.
rows.translation: 但那并不重要。
rows.raw: " but that’s not what matters. "

rows.original: His hat’s just too big for your smaller head, slipping down over your eyes and blocking your vision, forcing you to wear it at a tilted angle. That’s not what matters though.
rows.translation: 他的帽子对你较小的脑袋而言实在太大，滑下来遮住双眼，挡住视线，逼得你只能歪着戴。不过这并不重要。
rows.raw: "His hat’s just too big for your smaller head, slipping down over your eyes and blocking your vision, forcing you to wear it at a tilted angle. That’s not what matters though. "

rows.original: His hat is comically large on you, making you look like a child wearing their father’s hat and forcing you to tilt it back at an extreme angle to hang off your brow, but that’s not what matters.
rows.translation: 他的帽子戴在你头上大得滑稽，让你像个偷戴父亲帽子的孩子，不得不把它以极端角度向后倾斜，勉强挂在眉头，不过这并不重要。
rows.raw: "His hat is comically large on you, making you look like a child wearing their father’s hat and forcing you to tilt it back at an extreme angle to hang off your brow, but that’s not what matters. "

rows.original: What matters is that the ausar has unwittingly cooperated with your plan.
rows.translation: 重要的是，奥萨尔在毫无察觉的情况下配合了你的计划。
rows.raw: "What matters is that the ausar has unwittingly cooperated with your plan. "

rows.original: Confident after his previous reaction that he won’t be too upset about a repeat performance, you gently tug his hat right off of his head.
rows.translation: 他上次的反应给了你信心，让你觉得再来一次应该不会让他太生气，于是轻轻把帽子从他头上摘了下来。
rows.raw: "\n\nConfident after his previous reaction that he won’t be too upset about a repeat performance, you gently tug his hat right off of his head."

rows.original: “Hey, what the hell?” Ciaran tries to reach for his hat, but you simply place it on your own head as you rest a hand comfortingly on his shoulder to prevent him standing up to retrieve his headwear as you explain your actions. You tell him you just think he could use a little more tender affection in his life.
rows.translation: “嘿，搞什么鬼？”基兰伸手去拿帽子，可你只是把它戴到自己头上，同时把一只手安慰地按在他肩上，不让他站起来夺回帽子，并解释自己的举动。你告诉他，只是觉得他的生活里应该多一点温柔关爱。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, what the hell?” Ciaran tries to reach for his hat, but you simply place it on your own head as you rest a hand comfortingly on his shoulder to prevent him standing up to retrieve his headwear as you explain your actions. You tell him you just think he could use a little more tender affection in his life."

rows.original: He grumbles a bit, but he doesn’t try to stop you. “Geez, if you’re so hung up on this I guess I won’t stop you. Just give me a little warning next time, kid.”
rows.translation: 他抱怨了几声，却没有试着阻止你。“天哪，既然你这么执着，那我就不拦了。下次先给我一点警告，孩子。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe grumbles a bit, but he doesn’t try to stop you. “Geez, if you’re so hung up on this I guess I won’t stop you. Just give me a little warning next time, kid.”"

rows.original: You take a moment to stare at Ciaran’s head and formulate your plan of attack. You can see that he has the usual two anubis-like ears of most ausar poking up through the thick black hair of his head, though the fur of his ears is thicker than is typical of most ausar, and his left ear has been notched by a past injury. Far less typical though are the massive horns poking out of his skull and up through his hair. You’re pretty sure you heard somewhere that bovines enjoy having the base of their horns scratched. You’ll just have to hope that’s true of hellhounds as well.
rows.translation: 你花了片刻盯着基兰的脑袋，制定进攻计划。你看见他浓密黑发中伸出一对大多数奥萨尔都有的、类似阿努比斯的耳朵，不过耳朵上的毛比一般奥萨尔更厚，左耳还因过去受伤缺了一块。更加不寻常的，是从头骨伸出、穿过头发的巨大长角。你好像在哪里听说过，牛科动物喜欢别人抓挠角根。只能希望地狱犬也一样。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take a moment to stare at Ciaran’s head and formulate your plan of attack. You can see that he has the usual two anubis-like ears of most ausar poking up through the thick black hair of his head, though the fur of his ears is thicker than is typical of most ausar, and his left ear has been notched by a past injury. Far less typical though are the massive horns poking out of his skull and up through his hair. You’re pretty sure you heard somewhere that bovines enjoy having the base of their horns scratched. You’ll just have to hope that’s true of hellhounds as well."

rows.original: Setting your strategy in motion, you move your fingers to Ciaran’s canid ears, alternating between scratching at the bases and gliding your nails up the lengths of those aural attachments. You don’t seem to elicit any reaction yet, but you’re confident that will change with time. The fur of his ears is ridiculously soft and far finer than the hair on his head. It’s a joy just to run your fingertips over the lustrous strands, so you begin lightly pinching the edges of his ears with your fingers to feel both inside and out. Whenever you linger for too long on one spot, the respective ear flicks reflexively.
rows.translation: 你开始实施策略，把手指移向基兰的犬耳，轮流抓挠耳根，再用指甲沿这些听觉器官一路向上滑动。暂时似乎没有引起任何反应，不过你相信这会随时间改变。他耳朵上的毛柔软得不可思议，比头发细腻得多。仅仅让指尖滑过那些光亮毛丝就令人愉悦，于是你开始用手指轻轻捏住耳缘，同时感受内外两侧。每当你在同一点停留太久，对应耳朵便会反射性抽动。
rows.raw: "\n\nSetting your strategy in motion, you move your fingers to Ciaran’s canid ears, alternating between scratching at the bases and gliding your nails up the lengths of those aural attachments. You don’t seem to elicit any reaction yet, but you’re confident that will change with time. The fur of his ears is ridiculously soft and far finer than the hair on his head. It’s a joy just to run your fingertips over the lustrous strands, so you begin lightly pinching the edges of his ears with your fingers to feel both inside and out. Whenever you linger for too long on one spot, the respective ear flicks reflexively."

rows.original: Your DILFy puppy growls a complaint at you the third time this happens. <i>“Hey, those are more sensitive than they look. You’re really just itching me when you do that.
rows.translation: 第三次发生这种事时，你的熟爹小狗低吼着抱怨。<i>“嘿，它们比看起来敏感。你那么做只会让我发痒。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour DILFy puppy growls a complaint at you the third time this happens. <i>“Hey, those are more sensitive than they look. You’re really just itching me when you do that. "

joinAfter.expression:
pc.isAusar()
                                        ? "How do you not know this when your ears are the same?"
                                        : ""

rows.original: How do you not know this when your ears are the same?
rows.translation: 你的耳朵明明一样，怎么会不知道？”
rows.raw: "How do you not know this when your ears are the same?"

rows.original: You apologize to Ciaran, assuring him that you know what you’re doing. To prove your words you increase the intensity of your scratching, compressing his ears and massaging them between your fingers and his skull, truly putting force behind the strokes of your digits. It’s barely audible, but you think you hear a stifled groan of pleasure. The older ausar is trying his level best to hide how much he’s enjoying being treated like a little puppy, but his struggles only spur you on to spoil him even more. You begin to alternate between scratching those furry aural organs and scratching at his scalp. The response is immediate: Ciaran’s tail starts wagging, thumping into his chair at the apex of each swing. You place your mouth right next to his ear and whisper a very important question to him. “Who’s a good boy?” It’s barely audible, but you know he heard it.
rows.translation: 你向基兰道歉，保证自己知道在做什么。为了证明这番话，你加重抓挠力度，把他的耳朵压在手指与头骨之间按摩，指尖每一下都真正用上力量。声音微不可闻，但你觉得自己听见了一声被压抑的愉悦呻吟。这个年长奥萨尔竭尽全力掩饰自己有多享受被当成小狗宠爱，可他的挣扎只让你更想宠他。你开始交替抓挠这些毛茸茸的听觉器官和他的头皮。效果立竿见影：基兰的尾巴开始摇摆，每次摆到顶点都会砰砰敲打椅子。你把嘴凑到他耳边，低声问了一个非常重要的问题。“谁是好孩子？”声音几乎听不见，但你知道他听到了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou apologize to Ciaran, assuring him that you know what you’re doing. To prove your words you increase the intensity of your scratching, compressing his ears and massaging them between your fingers and his skull, truly putting force behind the strokes of your digits. It’s barely audible, but you think you hear a stifled groan of pleasure. The older ausar is trying his level best to hide how much he’s enjoying being treated like a little puppy, but his struggles only spur you on to spoil him even more. You begin to alternate between scratching those furry aural organs and scratching at his scalp. The response is immediate: Ciaran’s tail starts wagging, thumping into his chair at the apex of each swing. You place your mouth right next to his ear and whisper a very important question to him. “Who’s a good boy?” It’s barely audible, but you know he heard it."

rows.original: The ausar grunts and tries to respond evenly, “Shut up, kid!” but he stutters a little from the pleasure of your ministrations. Grinning, you decide it’s time to enact the last masterstroke of your strategy. Adding in another stop on the circuit your hands have been following around Ciaran’s head, you worm your fingertips through your puppy’s hair to the base of his horns and begin scratching around their circumference. The hellhound instantly lets out a groan of pleasure, and his tail doubles the speed of its wagging. He’s actually panting now, his tongue drooping slightly out of the side of his mouth. You repeat your earlier question, loud enough for those around you to hear this time. “Are you a good puppy? Tell me who’s a good little boy.”
rows.translation: 奥萨尔哼了一声，试图平稳回答：“闭嘴，孩子！”可你的抚弄带来的快感让他有些结巴。你咧嘴一笑，决定实施策略的最后一步。你的双手本来沿基兰脑袋循环游走，现在又增加了一个停靠点：手指钻过小狗的头发，来到角根，沿着周围开始抓挠。地狱犬立刻发出愉悦呻吟，尾巴摇摆速度翻了一倍。他现在甚至开始喘气，舌头从嘴角微微垂下。你重复之前的问题，这次声音大得足以让周围人听见。“你是乖狗狗吗？告诉我谁是乖孩子。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe ausar grunts and tries to respond evenly, “Shut up, kid!” but he stutters a little from the pleasure of your ministrations. Grinning, you decide it’s time to enact the last masterstroke of your strategy. Adding in another stop on the circuit your hands have been following around Ciaran’s head, you worm your fingertips through your puppy’s hair to the base of his horns and begin scratching around their circumference. The hellhound instantly lets out a groan of pleasure, and his tail doubles the speed of its wagging. He’s actually panting now, his tongue drooping slightly out of the side of his mouth. You repeat your earlier question, loud enough for those around you to hear this time. “Are you a good puppy? Tell me who’s a good little boy.”"

rows.original: Ciaran closes his eyes in pleasure and hoarsely mutters, “Me.”
rows.translation: 基兰享受地闭上眼，声音沙哑地嘟囔：“我。”
rows.raw: "\n\nCiaran closes his eyes in pleasure and hoarsely mutters, “Me.”"

rows.original: You slow down your scratching and rubbing and insist he say it louder before repeating yourself a third time.
rows.translation: 你放慢抓挠和揉搓，坚持要他大声说出来，随后第三次重复问题。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou slow down your scratching and rubbing and insist he say it louder before repeating yourself a third time."

rows.original: With a groan of equal parts frustration, embarrassment, and enjoyment, the helpless DILF responds loudly “I’m a good boy! I’m such a good puppy! Please pet me more!” He rubs his head into your hands, desperate for more stimulation on his animalistic anatomy.
rows.translation: 无助的熟爹发出一声混合了沮丧、尴尬和享受的呻吟，大声回答：“我是好孩子！我是最乖的小狗！请再多摸摸我！”他用脑袋磨蹭你的手，渴望动物特征得到更多刺激。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith a groan of equal parts frustration, embarrassment, and enjoyment, the helpless DILF responds loudly “I’m a good boy! I’m such a good puppy! Please pet me more!” He rubs his head into your hands, desperate for more stimulation on his animalistic anatomy."

rows.original: You laugh cheekily and tell him he’s right, that surely such a good puppy deserves more petting. You redouble your earlier efforts, and the tall ausar adonis melts underneath you. He’s putty in your hands at this point. You’re pretty sure you could make him bark for you if you wanted. You decide to go easy on him for now though, instead spoiling the middle-aged puppy for over a quarter of an hour, occasionally telling him that he’s a good boy or that he’s strong or handsome. You heap him with praise and affection, appreciating the happy sounds he makes or the murmurs of agreement you sometimes receive. When your fingers grow sore from lavishing care for so long, you pat Ciaran on the head a few times with a final “Good boy.”
rows.translation: 你顽皮地大笑，告诉他没错，这么乖的小狗当然值得更多抚摸。你加倍重复之前的动作，高大的奥萨尔美男子在你手下融化了。此刻他完全任你摆布。只要愿意，你很确定甚至能让他为你吠叫。不过你决定暂时放他一马，转而宠爱这只中年小狗超过十五分钟，偶尔称赞他是好孩子、强壮又英俊。你把赞美与关爱倾注在他身上，欣赏他发出的快乐声音，以及偶尔得到的赞同低语。长时间宠爱让手指酸痛后，你最后说了句“好孩子。”，又拍了几下基兰的脑袋。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou laugh cheekily and tell him he’s right, that surely such a good puppy deserves more petting. You redouble your earlier efforts, and the tall ausar adonis melts underneath you. He’s putty in your hands at this point. You’re pretty sure you could make him bark for you if you wanted. You decide to go easy on him for now though, instead spoiling the middle-aged puppy for over a quarter of an hour, occasionally telling him that he’s a good boy or that he’s strong or handsome. You heap him with praise and affection, appreciating the happy sounds he makes or the murmurs of agreement you sometimes receive. When your fingers grow sore from lavishing care for so long, you pat Ciaran on the head a few times with a final “Good boy.”"

rows.original: Your puppy sits there dumbly for several seconds after you stop petting him, a dopey smile on his face and his eyes still closed. When he opens them again he’s still blushing, but he turns to look at you with a more serious face. “I enjoyed that a lot kid, but you’re really pushing your luck. Don’t call me a puppy again when you aren’t doing that unless you want some serious pain.” The stern warning is undercut by his still rapidly wagging tail, but he does give you an idea. You know now how to make Ciaran want to punish you. Maybe you could do something with this information?
rows.translation: 你停止抚摸后，小狗呆呆地坐了几秒，脸上挂着傻笑，双眼仍然闭着。再次睁眼时，他依旧脸红，却转过头用更严肃的表情看你。“我很享受，孩子，但你真是在挑战自己的运气。除非你想承受真正的痛苦，否则以后不做这些事时，别再叫我小狗。”他仍在飞快摇摆的尾巴削弱了这份严厉警告，却也给了你一个主意。现在你知道怎样让基兰想惩罚你了。也许能利用这条信息做点什么？
rows.raw: "\n\nYour puppy sits there dumbly for several seconds after you stop petting him, a dopey smile on his face and his eyes still closed. When he opens them again he’s still blushing, but he turns to look at you with a more serious face. “I enjoyed that a lot kid, but you’re really pushing your luck. Don’t call me a puppy again when you aren’t doing that unless you want some serious pain.” The stern warning is undercut by his still rapidly wagging tail, but he does give you an idea. You know now how to make Ciaran want to punish you. Maybe you could do something with this information?"

rows.original: While you’re still considering this, Ciaran takes his hat back from you and pats you on the head. He grins at you for a moment and wags his tail before donning his headwear again and moseying over to the bar, leaving you happy to have made another so happy.
rows.translation: 你还在思考时，基兰从你手里拿回帽子，拍了拍你的头。他冲你咧嘴笑了一会儿，摇摇尾巴，随后重新戴好帽子，悠闲地走向吧台。能让另一个人如此开心，你也很高兴。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhile you’re still considering this, Ciaran takes his hat back from you and pats you on the head. He grins at you for a moment and wags his tail before donning his headwear again and moseying over to the bar, leaving you happy to have made another so happy."

rows.original: While you’re still considering this, the DILF stands up and turns bodily to face you before taking his hat back from you and using it to cover the warm kiss he plants on your [pc.lips] from prying eyes. It only lasts a few seconds, but the kiss is tender and affectionate, almost as if Ciaran were trying to return as quickly as possible all of the pampering you’ve given him in the last fifteen minutes. You swoon, and he breaks the kiss with a smile in place of his usual cocky smirk before placing his cowboy hat on his head snugly over his horns again. He winks at you before moseying over to the bar, leaving you happy to have made another so happy.
rows.translation: 你还在思考时，熟爹站起身，整个身体转向你，从你手中取回帽子，又用帽子挡住窥探的目光，把一个温暖的吻落在[pc.lips]上。亲吻只持续几秒，却温柔而充满爱意，仿佛基兰想尽快回报你在过去十五分钟给他的全部宠爱。你心神荡漾，而他结束亲吻时，脸上不再是平常自信的坏笑，而是一抹温柔笑容。他把牛仔帽重新戴在头上，紧贴双角，随后冲你眨眨眼，悠闲地走向吧台。能让另一个人如此开心，你也很高兴。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhile you’re still considering this, the DILF stands up and turns bodily to face you before taking his hat back from you and using it to cover the warm kiss he plants on your [pc.lips] from prying eyes. It only lasts a few seconds, but the kiss is tender and affectionate, almost as if Ciaran were trying to return as quickly as possible all of the pampering you’ve given him in the last fifteen minutes. You swoon, and he breaks the kiss with a smile in place of his usual cocky smirk before placing his cowboy hat on his head snugly over his horns again. He winks at you before moseying over to the bar, leaving you happy to have made another so happy."

rows.translation: 继续

rows.raw: "Head Scritches"

rows.original: You’re sure that under that rugged, ferocious exterior lies a sweet pooch that likes getting his ears scratched.
rows.translation: 你很确定，那副粗犷凶猛的外表下面，藏着一只喜欢被挠耳朵的可爱狗狗。
rows.raw: "You’re sure that under that rugged, ferocious exterior lies a sweet pooch that likes getting his ears scratched."

rows.translation: 他的过去
rows.raw: "His Past"

rows.original: Night Trap
rows.raw: "Night Trap"

rows.original: You ask Ciaran if he’s from New Texas; given his lack of an accent he must surely be from elsewhere?
rows.translation: 你问基兰是不是来自新德克萨斯；他没有当地口音，肯定来自别处吧？
rows.raw: "You ask Ciaran if he’s from New Texas; given his lack of an accent he must surely be from elsewhere?"

rows.original: It’s almost too quick to be sure, but you think you see him frown at this question. By the time you notice the change however, he’s all smiles again. <i>“Where to begin?
rows.translation: 变化快得让人无法确定，但你觉得自己看见他因这个问题皱了皱眉。然而等你察觉时，他又恢复满面笑容。<i>“从哪里开始呢？
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s almost too quick to be sure, but you think you see him frown at this question. By the time you notice the change however, he’s all smiles again. <i>“Where to begin? "

rows.original: Between the time when the oceans drank Atlantis and the rise of the sons of Aryas, there was an age undreamed of. And unto this, Ciaran, destined to wear the jeweled crown of Ausarilonia upon a troubled brow.
rows.translation: 在海洋吞没亚特兰蒂斯之后、阿里亚斯之子崛起之前，曾有一个无人梦见的时代。而后，基兰降临于世，注定将奥萨里洛尼亚的珠宝王冠戴在忧郁的额头上。
rows.raw: "Between the time when the oceans drank Atlantis and the rise of the sons of Aryas, there was an age undreamed of. And unto this, Ciaran, destined to wear the jeweled crown of Ausarilonia upon a troubled brow. "

rows.original: I was one of the first children born on a newly-colonized world on the frontier. It was pretty much on the fringe of civilized space at the time, and even now I promise you’ve never heard of the place. It’s an agricultural world very like New Texas, only a good deal hotter. We dealt with a lot of raids from pirates and slavers over the years.” He pauses briefly, adopting a more serious tone. “I actually lost my mother and siblings to slavers when I was fairly young.”
rows.translation: 我是边疆上一颗新殖民星球最早出生的孩子之一。当时那里几乎处于文明空间边缘，就算现在，我也敢保证你从没听说过那个地方。那是一颗农业星球，很像新德克萨斯，只是炎热得多。多年来，我们经常遭受海盗和奴隶贩子袭击。”他短暂停顿，语气变得更加严肃。“其实我还很小时，母亲和兄弟姐妹就被奴隶贩子掳走了。”
rows.raw: "I was one of the first children born on a newly-colonized world on the frontier. It was pretty much on the fringe of civilized space at the time, and even now I promise you’ve never heard of the place. It’s an agricultural world very like New Texas, only a good deal hotter. We dealt with a lot of raids from pirates and slavers over the years.” He pauses briefly, adopting a more serious tone. “I actually lost my mother and siblings to slavers when I was fairly young.”"

rows.original: You’re shocked to hear him tell you something so personal when you haven’t even asked him directly. It must show plainly on your face, because Ciaran cuts you off when you try to speak.
rows.translation: 你很震惊，明明没有直接询问，他却告诉你这么私人的事。这份惊讶肯定明明白白写在脸上，因为你刚想开口，基兰便打断了你。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re shocked to hear him tell you something so personal when you haven’t even asked him directly. It must show plainly on your face, because Ciaran cuts you off when you try to speak."

rows.original: “Don’t worry about it. I came to terms with it decades ago. Which brings me nicely to the next part of my story: joining my planet’s self-defense force. See, I was damned determined to make sure nobody else went through what I did, so as soon as I came of age I joined the planetary defense force, the marines specifically. After I finished my first tour of duty two years later I had a little angel that I named after my mother, Celina. She’s beautiful, just like my mother before her. Actually, I’ve got some pictures of my little Celina right here.” He pulls a codex out of his comparatively massive pocket and moves to the seat next to your own, opening a few files on the device’s screen before presenting it to you. The album in front of you is filled with thousands of pictures and videos of a beautiful girl with long, lavender hair. Her round-pupiled gold eyes, lavender-furred limbs, sharp claws, and two long and incredibly fluffy tails clearly mark her as a kaithrit-ausar hybrid.
rows.translation: “不用担心。几十年前我就接受了这件事。这也正好引出故事的下一部分：加入星球自卫军。你看，我下定决心，绝不让别人遭遇我的经历，所以一成年便加入了行星防卫军，具体来说是陆战队。两年后完成第一次服役时，我有了一个小天使，并以母亲的名字为她取名塞莉娜。她很美，就像我母亲一样。其实我这里就有几张小塞莉娜的照片。”他从相对而言巨大的口袋里取出一台CODEX终端，挪到你旁边的座位，在设备屏幕上打开几个文件，随后递给你。眼前相册里有数千张照片和视频，主角是个留着薰衣草色长发的美丽姑娘。圆形瞳孔的金色双眼、覆盖薰衣草色毛发的四肢、锋利爪子，以及两条又长又蓬松的尾巴，清楚表明她是凯斯利特与奥萨尔混血。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t worry about it. I came to terms with it decades ago. Which brings me nicely to the next part of my story: joining my planet’s self-defense force. See, I was damned determined to make sure nobody else went through what I did, so as soon as I came of age I joined the planetary defense force, the marines specifically. After I finished my first tour of duty two years later I had a little angel that I named after my mother, Celina. She’s beautiful, just like my mother before her. Actually, I’ve got some pictures of my little Celina right here.” He pulls a codex out of his comparatively massive pocket and moves to the seat next to your own, opening a few files on the device’s screen before presenting it to you. The album in front of you is filled with thousands of pictures and videos of a beautiful girl with long, lavender hair. Her round-pupiled gold eyes, lavender-furred limbs, sharp claws, and two long and incredibly fluffy tails clearly mark her as a kaithrit-ausar hybrid."

rows.original: Ciaran’s normally hyper-sexual attitude has completely disappeared, replaced with simple paternal pride and affection for his daughter as he shows you images, videos, and holo-clips of Celina. In just a few minutes the enthusiastic ausar takes you through his daughter’s life from infancy all the way to her recent college graduation. Strangely, only a small handful of the images after the first dozen or so contain Ciaran, and most bizarrely of all is that none show Celina with anyone who could be mistaken for her mother. In most pictures or videos where you would expect to see the young girl’s parents, you instead see an increasingly elderly kaithrit couple, and in some photos you even see
rows.translation: 基兰平时无比旺盛的性欲姿态完全消失，取而代之的只是身为父亲对女儿的骄傲与关爱。他向你展示塞莉娜的图像、视频和全息片段。短短几分钟里，热情的奥萨尔便带你看遍女儿从婴儿期直到最近大学毕业的人生。奇怪的是，最初十来张之后的图像只有极少数出现基兰；最怪异的是，没有一张照片中出现任何可能被认作塞莉娜母亲的人。大多数你本以为会看见女孩父母的照片或视频里，出现的却是一对日益年迈的凯斯利特夫妇；有些照片里，你甚至看见了
rows.raw: "\n\nCiaran’s normally hyper-sexual attitude has completely disappeared, replaced with simple paternal pride and affection for his daughter as he shows you images, videos, and holo-clips of Celina. In just a few minutes the enthusiastic ausar takes you through his daughter’s life from infancy all the way to her recent college graduation. Strangely, only a small handful of the images after the first dozen or so contain Ciaran, and most bizarrely of all is that none show Celina with anyone who could be mistaken for her mother. In most pictures or videos where you would expect to see the young girl’s parents, you instead see an increasingly elderly kaithrit couple, and in some photos you even see "

rows.original: Mrs. Reasner and her husband Traven
rows.translation: 里斯纳夫人和她的丈夫特拉文
rows.raw: "Mrs. Reasner and her husband Traven "

rows.original: an older, maternal Terran woman with brown hair and a ruggedly handsome, white-haired half-ausar man
rows.translation: 一位棕发、上了年纪且充满母性气质的地球女人，和一位白发、粗犷英俊的半奥萨人男子
rows.raw: "an older, maternal Terran woman with brown hair and a ruggedly handsome, white-haired half-ausar man "

rows.original: with Celina. Ciaran is also absent from many of the photos, and only in the recent graduation shot is he Treated. Eventually Ciaran pockets his codex and continues telling his story, cutting off any chance you may have had to ask further questions.
rows.translation: 与塞莉娜的合影。许多照片里也没有基兰，只有最近那张毕业照中的他接受过改造。最后，基兰收起个人终端，继续讲述自己的故事，彻底截断了你可能想进一步追问的机会。
rows.raw: "with Celina. Ciaran is also absent from many of the photos, and only in the recent graduation shot is he Treated. Eventually Ciaran pockets his codex and continues telling his story, cutting off any chance you may have had to ask further questions."

rows.original: “I re-enlisted when Celina was two. My father had just passed away of natural causes, and I came under even more stress shortly after that. I enlisted this time with the Royal Ausaril Reconnaissance Marines, for the better pay and family benefits. I served with enough distinction to actually work my way up to commissioned officer. You’re talking to First Lieutenant Eildean right now.” The older man adopts a mock military pose and a falsely serious expression for a moment before chuckling and relaxing again.
rows.translation: “塞莉娜两岁时，我再次入伍。那时我父亲刚刚自然去世，没多久，我又承受了更大的压力。这一次，为了更高的薪水和家庭福利，我加入了奥萨里洛尼亚皇家侦察陆战队。我服役期间表现出色，甚至一路升成了军官。现在站在你面前的，可是艾尔丁中尉。”这位年长男子摆出一个滑稽的军姿，故作严肃了片刻，随后轻笑着放松下来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I re-enlisted when Celina was two. My father had just passed away of natural causes, and I came under even more stress shortly after that. I enlisted this time with the Royal Ausaril Reconnaissance Marines, for the better pay and family benefits. I served with enough distinction to actually work my way up to commissioned officer. You’re talking to First Lieutenant Eildean right now.” The older man adopts a mock military pose and a falsely serious expression for a moment before chuckling and relaxing again."

rows.original: “I ended up spending most of my service time in the wilderness, and I absolutely loved it. Sure, it was often a horrifying death world we got sent, but I was getting a chance to see the galaxy, break up slaver rings, and kill pirates, all while getting paid. But a few near-death experiences made me think I might be in the wrong line of work. After the third time I had my guts shoved back into me, I was given a medical discharge. I decided a slightly safer job would be more my speed, so I signed on with a ship called the S.S. Inexorable.”
rows.translation: “我服役的大部分时间都在荒野中度过，而且我非常喜欢。没错，我们经常被派到骇人的死亡世界，但我既能借机游历银河、捣毁奴隶贩卖团伙、杀掉海盗，还有钱可拿。不过，几次死里逃生让我开始怀疑自己是不是入错了行。第三次有人把我的肠子塞回肚子后，我拿到了医疗退役证明。我觉得稍微安全一点的工作可能更适合我，于是登上了一艘名叫不屈号的飞船。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I ended up spending most of my service time in the wilderness, and I absolutely loved it. Sure, it was often a horrifying death world we got sent, but I was getting a chance to see the galaxy, break up slaver rings, and kill pirates, all while getting paid. But a few near-death experiences made me think I might be in the wrong line of work. After the third time I had my guts shoved back into me, I was given a medical discharge. I decided a slightly safer job would be more my speed, so I signed on with a ship called the S.S. Inexorable.” "

rows.original: You’re surprised to hear a ship you actually know of. You tell Ciaran that you have met the captain of the S.S. Inexorable. The hellhound looks incredibly wistful when he hears that. In his usual evasive manner though, he continues on without an explanation of his reaction.
rows.translation: 听到一艘自己居然知道的飞船，你颇感惊讶。你告诉基兰，自己见过不屈号的船长。地狱犬听后显得无比怀念。不过，他仍像往常一样闪烁其词，没解释自己的反应便继续说了下去。
rows.raw: "You’re surprised to hear a ship you actually know of. You tell Ciaran that you have met the captain of the S.S. Inexorable. The hellhound looks incredibly wistful when he hears that. In his usual evasive manner though, he continues on without an explanation of his reaction."

rows.original: “Those years on the Inexorable were some of the best of my life. I was in a pretty bad place emotionally when I signed on. The captain and her husband really helped me get my shit together; being part of their crew is less like being an employee and more like being a member of their family. They even had me move Celina onto the ship with me, and treated her like she was their own daughter. And apparently they thought I was good at my job. Hell, if I had stayed another few years I would’ve been a department head.”
rows.translation: “在不屈号上的那几年，是我一生中最美好的时光之一。登船时，我的情绪状态糟透了。船长和她丈夫确实帮我重新振作起来；成为他们的船员，与其说是受雇于人，不如说是成了他们家的一员。他们甚至让我把塞莉娜接到船上一起生活，还像对待亲生女儿一样照顾她。显然，他们也觉得我的工作做得不错。见鬼，要是再多待几年，我都能当上部门主管了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Those years on the Inexorable were some of the best of my life. I was in a pretty bad place emotionally when I signed on. The captain and her husband really helped me get my shit together; being part of their crew is less like being an employee and more like being a member of their family. They even had me move Celina onto the ship with me, and treated her like she was their own daughter. And apparently they thought I was good at my job. Hell, if I had stayed another few years I would’ve been a department head.”"

rows.original: “If?” you ask. If his time on the Inexorable was as good for him as he said, why did he leave?
rows.translation: “要是？”你问道。如果他在不屈号上的时光真像他说的那样美好，他为什么还要离开？
rows.raw: "\n\n“If?” you ask. If his time on the Inexorable was as good for him as he said, why did he leave?"

rows.original: Ciaran sighs deeply at your question, taking a moment to consider his words. “That’s really a story for another time. All I’ll say is that even though I was working through my old problems, I started developing some new ones, and the only solution to them was to part ways. I left amicably; hell, I played host to the captain’s husband, Traven, just last year when he visited New Texas. It was just time for me to go my own way for once. By this point I had a pretty impressive resume, so I was able to use all that training and experience to become a fairly high-class bodyguard in the core worlds. I spent years moving from contract to contract, taking on the jobs nobody else was stupid enough to in hopes of finding something lucrative that would last more than a few months. Ironically, it was when I was between jobs that I ended up getting my big break.”
rows.translation: 听到你的问题，基兰深深叹了口气，斟酌片刻才开口。“那真得留到改天再讲。我只能说，虽然我渐渐摆脱了过去的问题，却又开始遇到一些新问题，而唯一的解决办法就是分道扬镳。我是友好离开的；见鬼，就在去年，船长的丈夫特拉文来新德克萨斯时，我还招待过他。只是我终于该走自己的路了。那时我的履历已经相当亮眼，凭着那些训练和经验，我在核心世界当上了一名颇为高端的保镖。几年间，我不断更换雇佣合同，专门接下那些别人没蠢到肯接的活，希望能找到一份利润丰厚、又能干上几个月以上的工作。讽刺的是，真正让我迎来重大转机的，反倒是两份工作之间的空档期。”
rows.raw: "\n\nCiaran sighs deeply at your question, taking a moment to consider his words. “That’s really a story for another time. All I’ll say is that even though I was working through my old problems, I started developing some new ones, and the only solution to them was to part ways. I left amicably; hell, I played host to the captain’s husband, Traven, just last year when he visited New Texas. It was just time for me to go my own way for once. By this point I had a pretty impressive resume, so I was able to use all that training and experience to become a fairly high-class bodyguard in the core worlds. I spent years moving from contract to contract, taking on the jobs nobody else was stupid enough to in hopes of finding something lucrative that would last more than a few months. Ironically, it was when I was between jobs that I ended up getting my big break.”"

rows.original: You crook an eyebrow at that and admit you’re curious just what he means.
rows.translation: 你闻言扬起一边眉毛，承认自己很好奇他究竟是什么意思。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou crook an eyebrow at that and admit you’re curious just what he means."

rows.original: His cocky grin returns as he responds more than a little smugly. “Well you know the governor of this planet, Governor Tee?”
rows.translation: 他那自信的笑容又回来了，回答时还颇为得意。“你知道这颗星球的总督T总吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nHis cocky grin returns as he responds more than a little smugly. “Well you know the governor of this planet, Governor Tee?”"

rows.original: It’s your turn to be smug when you answer
rows.translation: 这次轮到你得意了，你回答说
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s your turn to be smug when you answer "

rows.original: yes, you do know Big T and were invited to New Texas by him personally.
rows.translation: 是的，你确实认识大T，还是他亲自邀请你来新德克萨斯的。
rows.raw: "yes, you do know Big T and were invited to New Texas by him personally. "

rows.original: that though you were invited to New Texas by Big T, you haven’t managed to meet him yet.
rows.translation: 虽然大T邀请你来到了新德克萨斯，但你还没能见到他。
rows.raw: "that though you were invited to New Texas by Big T, you haven’t managed to meet him yet."

rows.original: Ciaran gives an impressed-sounding whistle, but his next statement makes it seem a bit sarcastic. “Well, not all of us are important enough to get an invitation from the planetary governor. In my case I was just walking down a lonely street one evening when I bumped into a huge human with bull horns and a tail. Keep in mind I was still barely over six feet at the time, so I bounce off this towering human and fall on my tail. rows.raw: "\n\nWell, clearly even if Ellie doesn’t really know the details, she thinks you’re something special. You suppose that’s all that really matters."

rows.original: “Thanks, Ellie,” you say, kissing the top of her head. She hums happily and you continue on to her little shop, hopping off before you enter.
rows.translation: “谢谢，艾莉，”你说道，亲吻她的头顶。她幸福地哼了一声。你们继续前往她的小店，并在进门前从她背上跳下。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thanks, Ellie,” you say, kissing the top of her head. She hums happily and you continue on to her little shop, hopping off before you enter."

rows.original: When the two of you get into the store and she gets back behind the counter, everything seems relatively normal. Big bulls and doe-eyed cowgirls are milling around the store talking and flirting, pheromones are in the air, and Ellie is behind the counter checking you out. You give her a wink and put an arm down on the counter, relaxing.
rows.translation: 你们走进商店，等她回到柜台后，一切看起来都比较正常。高大的公牛和眼神温顺的牛女郎在店里闲逛、交谈、调情，空气中弥漫着信息素，而艾莉则站在柜台后打量你。你朝她眨眨眼，把一条手臂搭在柜台上，放松下来。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen the two of you get into the store and she gets back behind the counter, everything seems relatively normal. Big bulls and doe-eyed cowgirls are milling around the store talking and flirting, pheromones are in the air, and Ellie is behind the counter checking you out. You give her a wink and put an arm down on the counter, relaxing."

rows.original: “So,” Ellie says, twirling a finger through her hair. “You gonna leave me all by my little lonesome, darling?”
rows.translation: “那么，”艾莉用手指卷着头发说道。“你要把弱小的我孤零零留在这里吗，亲爱的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So,” Ellie says, twirling a finger through her hair. “You gonna leave me all by my little lonesome, darling?”"

rows.original: “I’m sure you’ll find some way to entertain yourself,” you say with a grin. “Besides, you know I’m not gonna leave you alone.”
rows.translation: “我相信你会找到办法自娱自乐，”你笑着说道。“再说，你知道我不会把你一个人留下。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m sure you’ll find some way to entertain yourself,” you say with a grin. “Besides, you know I’m not gonna leave you alone.”"

rows.original: Ellie smiles, leaning forward slightly and accidentally showing off the edges of her areolae. <i>“Just don’t be too surprised if I’m not here all the time. I’m gonna be taking trips to the Nursery every so often just to check on things, ‘kay?
rows.translation: 艾莉微笑着稍稍前倾，无意间露出乳晕边缘。<i>“如果我不是一直待在这里，别太惊讶。我会隔一段时间去育儿室看看情况，好吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nEllie smiles, leaning forward slightly and accidentally showing off the edges of her areolae. <i>“Just don’t be too surprised if I’m not here all the time. I’m gonna be taking trips to the Nursery every so often just to check on things, ‘kay?"

rows.original: And maybe play around with the puppies.
rows.translation: 也许还能陪幼崽们玩一会儿。
rows.raw: " And maybe play around with the puppies."

rows.original: “Hey, fine by me,” you say, spreading your arms. “We can visit it together too if you like.”
rows.translation: “嘿，我没意见，”你张开双臂说道。“如果愿意，我们也可以一起去。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, fine by me,” you say, spreading your arms. “We can visit it together too if you like.”"

rows.original: “Sounds fun,” she says, giggling. “Like a little outer-space picnic.”
rows.translation: “听起来很有趣，”她咯咯笑着说道。“就像一次小小的外太空野餐。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sounds fun,” she says, giggling. “Like a little outer-space picnic.”"

rows.original: When you finish chatting, Ellie leans over for you to give her a kiss and gives you a happy wave. You jokingly tip your imaginary space-cowboy hat to her as you exit, setting her giggling. Breathing in the fresh air of the New Texan outdoors, you ponder your options.
rows.translation: 聊天结束后，艾莉俯身让你亲吻，又开心地挥手道别。离开时，你开玩笑地向她抬了抬想象中的太空牛仔帽，逗得她咯咯发笑。你呼吸着新德克萨斯户外的新鲜空气，思考接下来的选择。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you finish chatting, Ellie leans over for you to give her a kiss and gives you a happy wave. You jokingly tip your imaginary space-cowboy hat to her as you exit, setting her giggling. Breathing in the fresh air of the New Texan outdoors, you ponder your options."

rows.original: Back on the merchant floor, you glance back up at the building you came out of. Truth be told, you feel a little lonely already. But she’ll still be there when you return, and so will the kids. You made a vow for them, too. Turning away, you set your mind back on business.
rows.translation: 回到商业层，你抬头看了一眼刚刚离开的建筑。说实话，你已经感到有些孤单。不过等你回来时，她仍会在那里，孩子们也一样。你也曾向他们许下誓言。你转过身，把心思重新放回正事。
rows.raw: "Back on the merchant floor, you glance back up at the building you came out of. Truth be told, you feel a little lonely already. But she’ll still be there when you return, and so will the kids. You made a vow for them, too. Turning away, you set your mind back on business."

rows.translation: 继续

rows.original: Wsan
rows.raw: "Wsan"

rows.original: The next day, you’re making preparations to leave, having talked with Ellie. She’s decided to stay here just for a little while, to take care of the kids and make sure they’re doing okay. They’ll be taken care of by the staff, you know that for sure, but it makes you glad to see just how much she cares. Not a minute goes by that she isn’t using her boisterous energy to fuss over them, keeping them entertained.
rows.translation: 第二天，和艾莉谈过之后，你开始为离开做准备。她决定暂时留在这里照顾孩子，确保她们一切安好。你很清楚工作人员会照料她们，但看到艾莉如此在意孩子，还是令你十分欣慰。她一刻也闲不下来，把旺盛的精力全用在孩子们身上，逗她们开心。
rows.raw: "The next day, you’re making preparations to leave, having talked with Ellie. She’s decided to stay here just for a little while, to take care of the kids and make sure they’re doing okay. They’ll be taken care of by the staff, you know that for sure, but it makes you glad to see just how much she cares. Not a minute goes by that she isn’t using her boisterous energy to fuss over them, keeping them entertained. "

rows.original: Your other kids aren’t exempt from the Ellie experience, either, treated as just one of the pack.
rows.translation: 其他孩子也无法免于‘艾莉式体验’，全都被当作这群幼崽中的一员。
rows.raw: "Your other kids aren’t exempt from the Ellie experience, either, treated as just one of the pack."

rows.original: When it’s time to go, you call out to Ellie and she puts
rows.translation: 到了该离开的时候，你招呼艾莉，她把
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen it’s time to go, you call out to Ellie and she puts "

rows.original: down, who watches the two of you with curiosity, her heterochromic eyes wide. You give her a reassuring smile before turning to Ellie.
rows.translation: 放下。她睁大异色双眼，好奇地看着你们。你安慰地朝她笑笑，随后转向艾莉。
rows.raw: " down, who watches the two of you with curiosity, her heterochromic eyes wide. You give her a reassuring smile before turning to Ellie."

rows.original: “I should get back out there.”
rows.translation: “我该回去了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I should get back out there.”"

rows.original: “I know,” Ellie nods, looking at you with a smile. “You’ll be back, right?”
rows.translation: “我知道，”艾莉点点头，微笑着看向你。“你会回来的，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I know,” Ellie nods, looking at you with a smile. “You’ll be back, right?”"

rows.original: “I will. I love you, okay? I’ll visit as often as I can.”
rows.translation: “我会的。我爱你，好吗？我会尽可能常来看你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I will. I love you, okay? I’ll visit as often as I can.”"

rows.original: “Oh,” she says, a hitch in her voice as she turns away. “Sorry, hearing you say that just- there’s something in my eye...”
rows.translation: “哦，”她声音一哽，转过身去。“抱歉，听见你这么说，只是眼睛里进了东西...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh,” she says, a hitch in her voice as she turns away. “Sorry, hearing you say that just- there’s something in my eye...”"

rows.original: “Ellie,” you say softly, and she turns back to look at you. Her beautiful blue eyes are welling with tears, and you give her a gentle smile. “I won’t desert you. The kids are a lifelong commitment, and it’s a path we’ll walk together. The two of us. That’s what I mean when I say I love you, Ellie.”
rows.translation: “艾莉，”你轻声唤她，她转过身来看着你。那双美丽的蓝眼睛里涌起泪水，你温柔地朝她微笑。“我不会抛弃你。孩子是一生的责任，而这条路我们会一起走下去。就我们两个人。这就是我说爱你时的意思，艾莉。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ellie,” you say softly, and she turns back to look at you. Her beautiful blue eyes are welling with tears, and you give her a gentle smile. “I won’t desert you. The kids are a lifelong commitment, and it’s a path we’ll walk together. The two of us. That’s what I mean when I say I love you, Ellie.”"

rows.original: Her jaw quivers momentarily before she throws herself into your chest, weeping silently. You smile and embrace her, running your hands through her hair to comfort her. For all the love she gets on New Texas, it’s a bit different coming from the father of her children, and always will be. You look down to see the kids clustered around your feet, looking up at you accusingly.
rows.translation: 她的下巴颤抖了一下，随即扑进你怀里，无声地哭泣。你微笑着抱住她，手指穿过她的头发，安慰着她。尽管她在新德克萨斯得到了许多爱，来自孩子父亲的爱终究有所不同，而且永远都会如此。你低头看去，发现孩子们聚在你脚边，带着责怪的神情仰望着你。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer jaw quivers momentarily before she throws herself into your chest, weeping silently. You smile and embrace her, running your hands through her hair to comfort her. For all the love she gets on New Texas, it’s a bit different coming from the father of her children, and always will be. You look down to see the kids clustered around your feet, looking up at you accusingly."

rows.original: “I didn’t make her cry,” you protest, trying to explain, drawing a giggle from Ellie.
rows.translation: “我没有把她弄哭，”你抗议着试图解释，逗得艾莉咯咯发笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I didn’t make her cry,” you protest, trying to explain, drawing a giggle from Ellie."

rows.original: She unearths her head from your chest and smiles down at the kids through drying tears. “I’m fine, your father just made me a very happy girl is all. Sometimes we cry when we’re happy too!”
rows.translation: 她把脑袋从你胸前抬起，透过逐渐干涸的泪水，低头朝孩子们微笑。“我没事，只是你们的父亲让我变成了非常幸福的姑娘。我们开心时有时也会哭！”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe unearths her head from your chest and smiles down at the kids through drying tears. “I’m fine, your father just made me a very happy girl is all. Sometimes we cry when we’re happy too!”"

rows.original: You crouch down and swiftly scoop the kids into a hug, planting a kiss on each of their foreheads and smiling. “Daddy has to leave now. Can you be good for mommy?”
rows.translation: 你蹲下身，迅速把孩子们搂进怀里，微笑着逐一亲吻他们的额头。“爸爸现在必须离开。你们能乖乖听妈妈的话吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou crouch down and swiftly scoop the kids into a hug, planting a kiss on each of their foreheads and smiling. “Daddy has to leave now. Can you be good for mommy?”"

rows.original: They nod one by one, and you tighten your grip before letting them go. They scamper back to the play area, woes already forgotten, leaving you with Ellie.
rows.translation: 他们逐一点头。你收紧怀抱，才把他们放开。他们飞奔回游乐区，早已忘记忧愁，留下你和艾莉。
rows.raw: "\n\nThey nod one by one, and you tighten your grip before letting them go. They scamper back to the play area, woes already forgotten, leaving you with Ellie."

rows.original: “Okay,” you say, getting back up. “I’m off.”
rows.translation: “好吧，”你起身说道。“我走了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Okay,” you say, getting back up. “I’m off.”"

rows.original: “Bye, [pc.name],” Ellie murmurs, planting a soft kiss on your cheek. “I’ll see you soon. Be safe out there.”
rows.translation: “再见，[pc.name]，”艾莉低声说道，轻柔地亲吻你的脸颊。“很快再见。在外面注意安全。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Bye, [pc.name],” Ellie murmurs, planting a soft kiss on your cheek. “I’ll see you soon. Be safe out there.”"

rows.original: You muss her hair a bit and lean in as she pulls back, kissing her on the lips before you leave. She smiles at your back until you disappear from view, turning a corner towards the elevators.
rows.translation: 她退开时，你揉乱她的头发，俯身亲吻她的嘴唇，随后离开。她朝你的背影微笑，直到你转过通往电梯的拐角，消失在视野中。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou muss her hair a bit and lean in as she pulls back, kissing her on the lips before you leave. She smiles at your back until you disappear from view, turning a corner towards the elevators."

rows.original: Alone for the first time in a while, you sigh and turn your mind back to-
rows.translation: 许久以来第一次独处，你叹了口气，把思绪重新转回到
rows.raw: "\n\nAlone for the first time in a while, you sigh and turn your mind back to-"

rows.original: “Oh, [pc.name]! Wait!” you hear from behind you, and turn as the elevator dings, the doors opening.
rows.translation: “哦，[pc.name]！等等！”身后传来呼喊。电梯叮的一声打开门时，你转过身。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, [pc.name]! Wait!” you hear from behind you, and turn as the elevator dings, the doors opening."

rows.original: “Ellie?” you ask, as she skitters to a stop at the other end of the corridor.
rows.translation: “艾莉？”你问道。她在走廊另一端匆忙停下。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ellie?” you ask, as she skitters to a stop at the other end of the corridor."

rows.original: “I forgot to tell you,” she says, hand clenched beneath her bosom as she fixes you with a gentle smile you will never forget. “I love you too.”
rows.translation: “我忘了告诉你，”她说道，一手攥在胸脯下方，以你永生难忘的温柔笑容注视着你。“我也爱你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I forgot to tell you,” she says, hand clenched beneath her bosom as she fixes you with a gentle smile you will never forget. “I love you too.”"

rows.original: “I know,” you call back with a smile. “I’ll see you soon, Ellie.”
rows.translation: “我知道，”你微笑着回喊。“很快再见，艾莉。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I know,” you call back with a smile. “I’ll see you soon, Ellie.”"

rows.original: Ellie watches the elevator doors close and carry her love away, back to
rows.translation: 艾莉看着电梯门合拢，将她的爱人带走，返回
rows.raw: "\n\nEllie watches the elevator doors close and carry her love away, back to "

rows.translation: 他的
rows.raw: "his"
