rows.translation: 她
rows.raw: "her"

rows.original: adventure and the smile that was on her face fades slightly, but remains in place. Yes, it will be lonely without [pc.name] around. But they’ll be back, she knows in her heart. [pc.name] never lies. She turns back to the nursery and walks into the play area, finding the kids littered about in various lazy positions.
rows.translation: 开始冒险，脸上的笑容稍微黯淡，却依然没有消失。没错，[pc.name]不在身边时会很孤单。但她知道，对方一定会回来。[pc.name]从不说谎。她转身回到育儿室，走进游乐区，看见孩子们懒洋洋地散落在各处。
rows.raw: " adventure and the smile that was on her face fades slightly, but remains in place. Yes, it will be lonely without [pc.name] around. But they’ll be back, she knows in her heart. [pc.name] never lies. She turns back to the nursery and walks into the play area, finding the kids littered about in various lazy positions."

rows.original: “Who wants to play?” she coos.
rows.translation: “谁想玩呀？”她柔声问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Who wants to play?” she coos."

rows.original: A chorus of squees rings out, and her children surround her as she giggles.
rows.translation: 一阵兴奋的尖叫响起，孩子们围到她身边，逗得她咯咯直笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nA chorus of squees rings out, and her children surround her as she giggles."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Wsan
rows.raw: "Wsan"

rows.original: You emerge flushed and still breathing hard from the private quarters a few hours later, having indulged Ellie’s celebration request thoroughly enough to leave her almost comatose in post-orgasmic bliss. She might be missing the pheromones, but she’s still the sexiest - and horniest - woman you know. And the mother of your kids, whom you note are still sleeping. You take some time to just watch their little chests rise and fall, soft breaths syncing up like they really are joined at the hip, and your mind drifts as your eyes glaze over.
rows.translation: 几小时后，你面色潮红、呼吸依旧急促地走出私人房间。你彻底满足了艾莉庆祝一番的要求，让她沉浸在高潮后的极乐中，几乎昏睡过去。她或许闻不到信息素，却依然是你认识的最性感、也最饥渴的女人。她还是你孩子们的母亲；你注意到孩子依旧睡得香甜。你花了些时间静静看着她们小小的胸膛起伏，轻柔的呼吸同步得仿佛真的形影不离；你的目光逐渐放空，思绪也随之飘远。
rows.raw: "You emerge flushed and still breathing hard from the private quarters a few hours later, having indulged Ellie’s celebration request thoroughly enough to leave her almost comatose in post-orgasmic bliss. She might be missing the pheromones, but she’s still the sexiest - and horniest - woman you know. And the mother of your kids, whom you note are still sleeping. You take some time to just watch their little chests rise and fall, soft breaths syncing up like they really are joined at the hip, and your mind drifts as your eyes glaze over."

rows.original: The reality of having intelligent children is... well, difficult. They’ll be well taken care of, no doubt of that. But how often can you be there for them? How many of their special moments are you going to miss, flying through space to lay claim to an inheritance? Well, at least they were born able to speak. You didn’t miss that. You can only hope your journey is a matter of weeks or months, rather than years or... decades.
rows.translation: 养育拥有智慧的孩子，现实是...嗯，很困难。她们毫无疑问会得到妥善照料。可你能有多少时间陪在她们身边？为了取得遗产而在太空中奔波时，你又会错过多少属于她们的特殊时刻？好吧，至少她们生来就会说话。你没有错过这一点。你只能希望自己的旅程只需持续数周或数月，而不是数年，甚至...数十年。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe reality of having intelligent children is... well, difficult. They’ll be well taken care of, no doubt of that. But how often can you be there for them? How many of their special moments are you going to miss, flying through space to lay claim to an inheritance? Well, at least they were born able to speak. You didn’t miss that. You can only hope your journey is a matter of weeks or months, rather than years or... decades."

rows.original: You shake your head. No point thinking about this - what’s done is done, and besides, your father wouldn’t do that to you. This was intended to be an adventure of self-discovery, courtesy of dad, not a mythical trial. He knew you could do it. And you will. Watching your kids, you silently clench a fist and vow to be there for them, the way your dad made time for you even as a CEO. It’s the right thing to do.

rows.translation: “我知道，我已经尽快赶来了，”你抱住她说道。“我们去看看他们，好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I know, I got here as fast as I could,” you say, giving her a hug. “Let’s go see them, okay?”"

rows.original: The cover on the incubation chamber slides back and the tray protrudes outward, revealing the large eggs as they begin to shake. You find yourself holding your breath with Ellie as cracks begin to appear on their surface, little tapping noises and squeaks coming from within. You briefly consider helping them out of their eggs, but a look at Ellie’s expression stops you. Her eyes are hopeful, but her jaw is set; they should break out of them on their own.
rows.translation: 孵化舱的盖子向后滑开，托盘伸了出来，露出其中开始摇晃的大蛋。蛋壳表面开始出现裂纹，里面传来轻微的敲击声和吱吱叫声，你和艾莉一起屏住了呼吸。你一度想帮它们破壳，但看到艾莉的表情便停下了。她眼含希望，却紧咬着牙关；它们应该靠自己破壳而出。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe cover on the incubation chamber slides back and the tray protrudes outward, revealing the large eggs as they begin to shake. You find yourself holding your breath with Ellie as cracks begin to appear on their surface, little tapping noises and squeaks coming from within. You briefly consider helping them out of their eggs, but a look at Ellie’s expression stops you. Her eyes are hopeful, but her jaw is set; they should break out of them on their own."

rows.original: Gianna’s lip quivers, and she appears on the verge of crying. The pained look in her eyes flickers and dies, replaced by a depressing sort of acceptance. “Fine.... I just... I’ve been alone so long and every here-” She glances back your way and wilts. “Never mind. Was there something else you would like me to do?”

rows.original: The short version is that he left - ditched me and his ship after getting treated.” Her lower lip quivers. “I’m a companion damnit! Being alone is like torture and starvation mixed together into a depressing stew for us.” She sighs. “After a week of suffering, I realized I couldn’t take it anymore and stepped off the ship.”
rows.translation: 简单来说，他离开了——接受改造疗程后抛下了我和他的飞船。”她的下唇微微颤抖。“我是个伴侣机器人，该死！对我们来说，孤独就像把酷刑和饥饿混在一起，熬成一锅令人绝望的浓汤。”她叹了口气。“痛苦了一个星期后，我意识到自己再也受不了了，于是走下了飞船。”
rows.raw: " The short version is that he left - ditched me and his ship after getting treated.” Her lower lip quivers. “I’m a companion damnit! Being alone is like torture and starvation mixed together into a depressing stew for us.” She sighs. “After a week of suffering, I realized I couldn’t take it anymore and stepped off the ship.”"

rows.original: You cock your head, listening intently. “Then?”
rows.translation: 你歪着脑袋，认真倾听。“然后呢？”

rows.original: “Then I hit customs and....” Gianna blushes.

rows.original: The android actually seems to be embarrassed. “It was the fastest I’ve ever gone from an introduction into fucking. I was so desperate to please that I all but begged them to let me give them massages. Ogram just rolled his eyes and whipped it out. Amma just crammed a nipple in my mouth and let me drink until I looked pregnant.” She giggles and rolls her eyes. “Can you imagine me? An android? Pregnant?”
rows.translation: 这个机器人竟然显得有些尴尬。“那是我从自我介绍到上床最快的一次。我太渴望取悦她们了，几乎是央求她们让我按摩。奥格拉姆只是翻了个白眼，把肉棒掏了出来。阿玛则直接把一颗乳头塞进我嘴里，让我喝到看起来像怀孕了一样。”她咯咯笑着翻了个白眼。“你能想象吗？我，一个机器人？怀孕？”

rows.original: You wanted me to start at the beginning,” the companionable vixen explains. “I’m not sure if customs here really cares about citizenship or anything, because they let me go after that. I waddled out into the planet, and that’s when I met Big T.” She pauses for dramatic effect. “Or rather, when he met me. I wasn’t looking where I was going and walked right in front of his truck. You have no idea how bad pain is for someone with a sense of touch multiple times more sensitive than a terran’s.”
rows.translation: 你想让我从头说起，”这只亲切友善的雌狐解释道。“我不确定这里的海关是否真正在意公民身份之类的东西，因为之后她们就放我走了。我蹒跚着走进星球腹地，就是那时遇到了大T。”她故意停顿，制造戏剧效果。“或者更准确地说，是他撞见了我。我没看路，径直走到他的卡车前面。你根本不知道，对于触觉比泰伦人敏锐数倍的人来说，疼痛有多可怕。”

rows.raw: "\n\nYour eyebrows raise in shock. “The guy ran you over?”"

rows.original: Smiling broadly, Gianna vigorously nods. “Uh huh!”
rows.translation: 吉安娜灿烂地笑着，用力点头。“嗯哼！”
rows.raw: "\n\nSmiling broadly, Gianna vigorously nods. “Uh huh!”"

rows.original: “And that doesn’t bother you?”
rows.translation: “而你一点都不介意？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And that doesn’t bother you?”"

rows.original: “Not really. Sure, the impact damaged some of my internals and knocked me flat, but it isn’t like he didn’t have a high-dollar hovertruck. You know, the kind with distributed force projectors strong enough to let it fly a few hundred feet in the air.” She gestures with her hands to create a fair approximation of a flying truck - or brick. One of the two. “Anyway, I got pushed a few inches into the mud and left with a half-dozen system shorts and synthskin breaches.”
rows.translation: “也不完全是。撞击确实损坏了我的一些内部零件，把我撞倒在地，但他的悬浮卡车毕竟价格不菲。你知道，就是那种装有分布式力场投射器、足以让车飞到几百英尺高空的型号。”她用双手比划出一辆飞行卡车——或者说飞砖——的大致形状，二者总有一个。“总之，我被压进泥里几英寸，留下六处左右的系统短路和合成皮肤破损。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not really. Sure, the impact damaged some of my internals and knocked me flat, but it isn’t like he didn’t have a high-dollar hovertruck. One of the two. “Anyway, I got pushed a few inches into the mud and left with a half-dozen system shorts and synthskin breaches.”"

rows.original: You’re not sure you’d be quite as chipper about it if it was you in her shoes.
rows.translation: 你不确定换作自己经历同样的事，还能不能像她这么开心。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re not sure you’d be quite as chipper about it if it was you in her shoes."

rows.original: Gianna closes her eyes to focus, and a number of red lines appear across her body. The wistful look never leaves her face. “These were the biggest injuries.” Drawing her finger across the simulated wounds, she pivots to show you the full severity. “So there I am, confused, wracked with agony so bad I can’t move, and half-buried in the dirt.” The pigment of her skin slowly fades back to normal while she talks. “...And Big T, the big softy, is in such a hurry to help me that he trips coming out of his truck and faceplants into the muck next to me. You should’ve seen it! I would’ve laughed if I wasn’t too busy fighting to turn down my sensory resolution.”
rows.translation: 吉安娜闭上双眼集中精神，身体各处浮现出许多红线。她脸上始终带着怀念的神色。“这些是最严重的伤口。”她用手指沿模拟伤口划过，转过身体让你看清全部伤势。“所以当时的我又迷茫又痛苦，剧痛让我动弹不得，半个身子还埋在泥里。”说话间，她皮肤的色素缓缓恢复正常。“...而大T这个大好人，急着来救我，结果下车时绊了一跤，一头栽进我旁边的泥里。你真该看看！要不是我忙着调低感官分辨率，肯定会笑出来。”

You should’ve seen it! I would’ve laughed if I wasn’t too busy fighting to turn down my sensory resolution.”"

rows.original: You chuckle appreciatively at the mental image.
rows.translation: 想到那幅画面，你忍俊不禁。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou chuckle appreciatively at the mental image."

rows.original: “Well, he pulled himself right up, didn’t even mind the mud, and grabbed me out of the dirt, holding me in his arms in a way I’d never been held before. He was so big, and he was just... gently cradling me.” Her eyes flicker dimly as she loses herself to the memory. “My vocalizer was shot and I was leaking a half-dozen caustic fluids onto his truck’s leather, but he didn’t care. He just kept apologizing and promising to take care of me. I’m not sure where he was going when he hit me, but he flew for two hours looking for a place that could help me.”
rows.translation: “他马上爬了起来，完全不在意泥巴，把我从泥里抱出来，用一种我从未体验过的方式抱在怀中。他那么高大，却只是...温柔地把我搂着。”她沉浸在回忆中，眼中的光芒微微暗淡。“我的发声器坏了，还有六种左右的腐蚀性液体漏到他卡车的皮革上，可他毫不在意。他只是不停道歉，保证会照顾好我。我不知道撞到我之前他要去哪里，但为了寻找能救我的地方，他飞了两个小时。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, he pulled himself right up, didn’t even mind the mud, and grabbed me out of the dirt, holding me in his arms in a way I’d never been held before. He was so big, and he was just... gently cradling me.” Her eyes flicker dimly as she loses herself to the memory. “My vocalizer was shot and I was leaking a half-dozen caustic fluids onto his truck’s leather, but he didn’t care. He just kept apologizing and promising to take care of me. I’m not sure where he was going when he hit me, but he flew for two hours looking for a place that could help me.”"

rows.original: “He seems like a good guy.”
rows.translation: “他看起来是个好人。”

rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask, “Does that mean that somewhere out there you have an organic sister, so to speak?”"

rows.original: Gianna’s resulting smile is warm, genuine. You get the impression that she enjoyed the familial comparisons more than she’s letting on. “I guess you could say that, if they’re still alive. I don’t know how old my original scan was. It could’ve been in storage for decades. I do know that it was a terran originally. That’s listed in my technical specs. There are optional A.I.s that can be equipped in a Generation Six, but mine is the most popular, owing largely to the many races finding terrans emotionally compatible.”
rows.translation: 吉安娜随即露出温暖而真诚的微笑。你感觉她其实很喜欢这种家族式的比较，只是没有表现出来。“如果他们还活着，我想也可以这么说。我不知道原始扫描对象当时多大年纪。那份扫描或许已经储存了几十年。不过我知道，原型最初是泰伦人；技术规格里写着这一点。第六代机体可以选装不同的人工智能，而我的型号最受欢迎，主要因为许多种族都觉得泰伦人在情感上很容易相处。”
rows.raw: "\n\nGianna’s resulting smile is warm, genuine. You get the impression that she enjoyed the familial comparisons more than she’s letting on. “I guess you could say that, if they’re still alive. I don’t know how old my original scan was. It could’ve been in storage for decades. I do know that it was a terran originally. That’s listed in my technical specs. There are optional A.I.s that can be equipped in a Generation Six, but mine is the most popular, owing largely to the many races finding terrans emotionally compatible.”"

rows.original: Pausing briefly, she shifts the discussion back, “But the point I was trying to make is that G-class intelligences are by nature similar to organics in a great many ways. Our thought processes are intertwined, interdependent, and entirely unoptimized. We make mistakes in judgement, get emotional, and otherwise act like the race we’re grown from. We’re ideal for any platform that needs to interact with organics on a regular basis. After all, what’s easier to relate to than intelligence that thinks and talks the same way?”
rows.translation: 她短暂停顿，又把话题拉了回来：“但我想表达的重点是，G级智能在许多方面天生就和有机生命相似。我们的思维过程彼此交织、相互依存，而且完全没有经过优化。我们会判断失误，会情绪化，也会以创造我们的种族那样的方式行事。任何需要经常与有机生命互动的平台，我们都是理想选择。毕竟，还有什么比一个以相同方式思考和说话的智能更容易让人产生共鸣呢？”
rows.raw: "\n\nPausing briefly, she shifts the discussion back, “But the point I was trying to make is that G-class intelligences are by nature similar to organics in a great many ways. Our thought processes are intertwined, interdependent, and entirely unoptimized. We make mistakes in judgement, get emotional, and otherwise act like the race we’re grown from. We’re ideal for any platform that needs to interact with organics on a regular basis. After all, what’s easier to relate to than intelligence that thinks and talks the same way?”"

rows.original: “And we still have all the advantages of being housed in computers. We can change bodies easily enough. rows.original: “Growing A.I.s is expensive. Biological drives need to be mapped to mechanical impulses in a way that helps us to serve our purpose without driving us insane. I’m not privy to the exact processes involved, but I’m told it has to be done for each intelligence off the line individually. Even with the same brainscan, tiny anomalies surface that require hand tuning,” Gianna explains. “Then it’s off to an incubating supercomputer with enough power to put us through simulated years of schooling and social development. In the real world, it only takes a month. Imagine graduating with your educational proficiency card only to discover that only four weeks had passed.”
rows.translation: “培育人工智能的成本很高。必须把生物性的驱动力映射成机械冲动，让我们既能履行用途，又不至于发疯。我无权了解其中的确切流程，但听说生产线上的每一个智能都必须单独接受这种处理。即使采用同一份脑部扫描，也会出现需要手工调校的微小异常，”吉安娜解释道。“接下来，我们会被送进一台算力足以模拟多年学校教育和社会发展的孵化超级计算机。现实世界里，这只需一个月。想象一下，你拿着教育水平证书毕业，却发现现实中只过去了四个星期。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Growing A.I.s is expensive. Biological drives need to be mapped to mechanical impulses in a way that helps us to serve our purpose without driving us insane. I’m not privy to the exact processes involved, but I’m told it has to be done for each intelligence off the line individually. Even with the same brainscan, tiny anomalies surface that require hand tuning,” Gianna explains. “Then it’s off to an incubating supercomputer with enough power to put us through simulated years of schooling and social development. In the real world, it only takes a month. Imagine graduating with your educational proficiency card only to discover that only four weeks had passed.”"

rows.raw: "\n\n“It was quite the trip, but without it, I wouldn’t have gotten to grow into the woman I am today.”"

rows.translation: 哦？你疑惑地看了她一眼。
rows.raw: "\n\nOh? You pass her a questioning look."

rows.original: “Yeah. I’m wired so that biological needs are replaced with a desire to please others, but my programming is necessarily dynamic and adaptive,” Gianna says, oddly serious. “New Texas has been great for keeping me completely satiated. For a time, that was enough, but now... now I find myself wanting more. I have the time to consider what my true purpose is, not just the one I was designed for. Could I do more than merely keep someone company? Can I truly love? Can others love me?”
rows.translation: “对。我的线路设定会用取悦他人的欲望来取代生理需求，但我的程序必然是动态而且具有适应性的，”吉安娜异常严肃地说道。“新德克萨斯一直能让我得到彻底满足。一度而言，那就足够了，可现在...现在我发现自己想要更多。我有时间思考自己真正的使命，而不只是被设计出来时赋予的用途。我能做的不只是陪伴某个人吗？我真的能够去爱吗？别人能够爱我吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah. I’m wired so that biological needs are replaced with a desire to please others, but my programming is necessarily dynamic and adaptive,” Gianna says, oddly serious. “New Texas has been great for keeping me completely satiated. For a time, that was enough, but now... now I find myself wanting more. I have the time to consider what my true purpose is, not just the one I was designed for. Could I do more than merely keep someone company? Can I truly love? Can others love me?”"

rows.original: She nervously fiddles with her ponytail. “My experiences are analogous to Maslow’s hierarchy of needs in a way. With my baser needs met, I’m free to tackle more important, higher concepts. I just hope that I can fulfill them, too.”
rows.translation: 她紧张地摆弄着马尾。“从某种角度说，我的经历很像马斯洛需求层次理论。基础需求得到满足之后，我就可以自由追求更重要、更高层次的概念。我只希望自己也能满足那些需求。”

rows.original: The android literally glows - eyes, body, et al. “You think so?” Her voice has slipped into a higher-pitched, girlier register. She almost sounds like one of the natives. “I could get protein synthesizers installed in my mammaries, and like, convert food into milk just like these cows. I could become a ship captain!” She’s going faster and faster now. “Ohhh, I could take over the dairy here and manage the place, maybe even keep the girls from eating so much of the slop they serve over at the grill. All those milkshakes aren’t good for their bodies!”

rows.original: “Well, for one, you’re programmed to be a companion. Doing anything else is bound to leave you feeling uncomfortable, and for another, you’re an android. You have no citizenship that the U.G.C. would recognize, and no associated rights. Someone could abduct you, and without a master to file a police report, they’d get away with it. Face it, this is as far as you’re going to go. The best that can happen is that you get to stay here in a paradise like this or come along with someone who truly appreciates what you are good at. And you’re very good at pleasing,” you explain, closing with a complement to soften the blow.
rows.translation: “首先，你被编程成了一名伴侣。做其他事情势必会让你感到不适；其次，你是机器人。银河联合邦联不会承认你拥有公民身份，你也没有相应的权利。有人可以绑架你，而如果没有主人去报警，他们就能逍遥法外。面对现实吧，你最多只能走到这里。最好的结果，就是留在这样的天堂，或者跟随一个真正欣赏你所长的人。况且你很擅长取悦别人，”你解释道，最后用一句赞美缓和这番话造成的打击。

Face it, this is as far as you’re going to go. The best that can happen is that you get to stay here in a paradise like this or come along with someone who truly appreciates what you are good at. And you’re very good at pleasing,” you explain, closing with a complement to soften the blow."

rows.original: “Of course, that all serves to make me a better companion, I guess. rows.original: “Arg... fucking... dirty trickster, you!” She shouts, visibly agitated.
rows.translation: “呃...该死的...你这卑鄙的骗子！”她明显恼火地喊道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Arg... fucking... dirty trickster, you!” She shouts, visibly agitated."

rows.original: You win!
rows.translation: 你赢了！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou win!"

rows.original: You try to angle your head properly but... it’s harder to... lift... “Ack!”
rows.translation: 你试着调整脑袋的角度，但...越来越难...抬起来了...“啊！”
rows.raw: " You try to angle your head properly but... it’s harder to... lift... “Ack!”"

rows.original: You cry out as you feel a sharp pain your spine. Instantly, Mirrin lets go of you and you fall onto the floor with your knees and hands buffering you.
rows.translation: 脊椎传来一阵剧痛，令你失声叫喊。米琳立即放开你，你跪趴着跌到地上，用膝盖和双手撑住身体。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou cry out as you feel a sharp pain your spine. Instantly, Mirrin lets go of you and you fall onto the floor with your knees and hands buffering you."

rows.original: You lose!

rows.translation: 你抢先出手。
rows.raw: "You take the initiative."

rows.original: Going the offensive, you aim for her weak points first: ribs, knees and her centre of gravity. You strike fast rather than hard, although she’s quicker than her size would suggest. You miss most attacks, some are blocked and only a few appear to have a visible effect on her.
rows.translation: 你转入进攻，首先瞄准她的弱点：肋骨、膝盖和重心。你的攻击求快而不求重，尽管她的敏捷程度远超体型给人的印象。你大多数攻击都落空，一些被格挡，只有少数似乎对她造成了明显影响。
rows.raw: "\n\nGoing the offensive, you aim for her weak points first: ribs, knees and her centre of gravity. You strike fast rather than hard, although she’s quicker than her size would suggest. You miss most attacks, some are blocked and only a few appear to have a visible effect on her."

rows.original: However, a counterattack from your side throws you off guard and she pounces!
rows.translation: 然而，她的一记反击令你猝不及防，她随即扑了上来！
rows.raw: "\n\nHowever, a counterattack from your side throws you off guard and she pounces!"

rows.original: Locking you into a bear grip, she squeezes your body like a vice. “Gotcha, Steeley-boo,” she mocks, her face a few inches away from your own.
rows.translation: 她用熊抱锁住你，像虎钳一样挤压你的身体。“抓到你了，斯蒂尔宝贝，”她嘲弄道，脸离你只有几英寸。
rows.raw: "\n\nLocking you into a bear grip, she squeezes your body like a vice. “Gotcha, Steeley-boo,” she mocks, her face a few inches away from your own."

rows.original: You have to think quickly! So you go for... the ribs!
rows.translation: 你必须赶快想办法！于是你决定攻击...肋骨！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou have to think quickly! So you go for... the ribs!"

rows.original: Having figured out where her diaphragm is, you get both of your fists to simultaneously smack on the skin where it lines up! Mirrin instantly lets go, her arms and legs seizing up as she’s winded by the blow. You manage to fall on your feet but the qilin crumples over onto her knees.
rows.translation: 判断出她横膈膜的位置后，你双拳同时猛击与其对应的皮肤！米琳的手脚因这一击岔了气而顿时僵住，立刻放开了你。你设法双脚落地，而麒麟则瘫跪下来。

Mirrin instantly lets go, her arms and legs seizing up as she’s winded by the blow. You manage to fall on your feet but the qilin crumples over onto her knees."

rows.original: “Hmm... I’ve got something buuut... tell me if is too much,” she says, clasping your hands in her own.

rows.raw: "“Hmm... I’ve got something buuut... tell me if is too much,” she says, clasping your hands in her own."

rows.translation: 既然答应陪她玩，你便转身面向窗户。外面的光线扰乱了窗中倒影，所以你看不清她拿出了什么...片刻后，她发出含混的嗒嗒声从你身后靠近。“看看吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHaving agreed to play along with her games, you turn to face the window. The reflection in it is messed with by the light outside so you can’t quite tell what she’s getting out... after a few moments, her muffled clop clops approach from behind you. “Have a look.”"

rows.original: You turn apprehensively. She’s holding some bundles of black bindings and straps, although it’s obvious what they’re going to be for. The she-dragon holds up wrist bindings, ankle bindings, and elbow-locks, looking back and forth to see how to adjust them. Unsure of what to do, you pipe up.
rows.translation: 你忐忑地转过身。她手里拿着几捆黑色束带和绑带，不过它们的用途显而易见。雌龙举起腕部束带、脚踝束带和肘部锁带，来回打量该如何调整。你不知道该怎么办，便开口问道。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou turn apprehensively. She’s holding some bundles of black bindings and straps, although it’s obvious what they’re going to be for. The she-dragon holds up wrist bindings, ankle bindings, and elbow-locks, looking back and forth to see how to adjust them. Unsure of what to do, you pipe up."

rows.original: “Uh, so... where’s what going?” You enquire, feigning your foreknowledge of such things.
rows.translation: “呃，所以...什么该绑在哪里？”你问道，装作自己事先并不了解这种东西。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Uh, so... where’s what going?” You enquire, feigning your foreknowledge of such things."

rows.original: “Jeez, as if you needed more ways to pin me down,” you joke sarcastically.
rows.translation: “天啊，好像你还嫌压制我的办法不够多似的，”你讽刺地开玩笑道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Jeez, as if you needed more ways to pin me down,” you joke sarcastically."

rows.original: “So what, couldn’t use your fists to hold me down?” You mock, folding your arms.
rows.translation: “怎么，光靠拳头压不住我吗？”你抱起双臂嘲弄道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So what, couldn’t use your fists to hold me down?” You mock, folding your arms."

rows.original: “Dooon’t worry yourself, Steele. Just put your hands out,” she instructs, walking behind you. Wishing to see where this goes, you comply. She pulls your hands round to your back, holding them at the wrists. You feel the tough fabric tighten around them both and within seconds, you find them severely restricted in movement. A similar feeling surrounds your elbows and with a quick pull, they too pull together. The bindings don’t feel so tight but the actual pose itself is awkward, almost uncomfortable. You find yourself bending over forwards to compensate.
rows.translation: “别——担心啦，斯蒂尔。把双手伸出来就好，”她一边指示，一边走到你身后。你想看看接下来会怎样，便照做了。她把你的双手拉到背后，握住手腕。你感觉坚韧的布料同时在两只手腕上收紧，几秒钟内，双手的活动便受到严重限制。类似的感觉包围了你的双肘，随着她猛地一拉，它们也并拢在一起。束带本身感觉不算太紧，但这个姿势实在别扭，几乎令人不适。你发现自己不得不向前弯腰来补偿。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Dooon’t worry yourself, Steele. Just put your hands out,” she instructs, walking behind you. Wishing to see where this goes, you comply. She pulls your hands round to your back, holding them at the wrists. You feel the tough fabric tighten around them both and within seconds, you find them severely restricted in movement. A similar feeling surrounds your elbows and with a quick pull, they too pull together. The bindings don’t feel so tight but the actual pose itself is awkward, almost uncomfortable. You find yourself bending over forwards to compensate."

rows.original: “Good, good,” approves Mirrin, a hard emphasis on every D

rows.raw: ". You can feel her hands round your ankles, more bindings keeping your joints together. She stands up and faces you, placing a hand on your cheek. She says nothing but her resultant grin tells all."

rows.translation: “当然！一天里的大多数时间我都提供免费课程；如果你愿意，现在就可以开始。我叫米琳，”她热情地回答，将注意力转向身旁的配重。她的口音和举止有些奇怪：听起来像泰伦人，却又无法确定具体来自哪里。

rows.original: She points to a rather large poster on the other side of the room. It depicts a highly muscled and completely nude figure baring their exposed chest, oiled abs and two soft, dangling horsecocks with a text blurb for some fitness product.
rows.translation: 她指向房间另一侧一张相当巨大的海报。上面画着一个肌肉发达、全身赤裸的人物，袒露胸膛、露出涂油的腹肌，两根柔软的马屌垂在下面，旁边还有某种健身产品的宣传文字。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe points to a rather large poster on the other side of the room. It depicts a highly muscled and completely nude figure baring their exposed chest, oiled abs and two soft, dangling horsecocks with a text blurb for some fitness product."

rows.original: It takes you a second but the clay-red skin gives it away. You’re surprised her face is mostly cut off by the print itself. You also note some... questionable stains that dot the image, especially on that set of divine tits.
rows.translation: 你花了一秒才从陶土红的皮肤认出她。令你惊讶的是，她的脸大部分被印刷画面裁掉了。你还注意到图像上散布着一些...可疑的污渍，尤其集中在那对神圣的乳房上。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt takes you a second but the clay-red skin gives it away. You’re surprised her face is mostly cut off by the print itself. You also note some... questionable stains that dot the image, especially on that set of divine tits."

rows.original: You feel a quick, heavily calloused hand on your [pc.hip]: a hand that gently turns you to fully face the direction of the poster. She’s standing right next to you with a ‘told you so’ sort of face. “And the name is Mirrin, for reference. Now you know,” she quips, turning away just as quickly to fiddle with some weights. “Sure you wouldn’t like to uuh, train?” She seems to pause a lot, gesturing with a twirling finger when she needs to say a certain word.
rows.translation: 你感觉一只布满厚茧的手迅速搭上[pc.hip]，轻轻将你转向海报的正面。她就站在你旁边，脸上一副“早就告诉过你”的表情。“顺便说一句，她叫米琳。现在你知道了。”她打趣道，随即迅速转过身去摆弄几件举重器材。“真不想来，呃，训练一下吗？”她说话似乎经常停顿，每当需要说某个特定词语时，还会用手指绕圈示意。

rows.original: Mirrin just shrugs back, gesturing to some mats a few meters away. “Need to see how you measure up,” she flatly replies. As she walks over to said mats, you notice that her strides are quite powerful for a biped, her hooves clop clopping lightly against the hard floor. You wonder: how she could even manage the more reasonably proportioned running machines with those things?
rows.translation: 米琳只是耸耸肩，指向几米外的几张垫子。“得看看你有多少本事，”她平淡地回答。她朝那些垫子走去时，你注意到她作为一名双足生物，步伐格外有力，蹄子在坚硬地面上轻轻发出嗒嗒声。你不禁纳闷：她用这双蹄子怎么能操作那些比例更加正常的跑步机？
rows.raw: "\n\nMirrin just shrugs back, gesturing to some mats a few meters away. “Need to see how you measure up,” she flatly replies. As she walks over to said mats, you notice that her strides are quite powerful for a biped, her hooves clop clopping lightly against the hard floor. You wonder: how she could even manage the more reasonably proportioned running machines with those things?"

rows.original: Once you’re in position - straightened up, facing towards the mirror - she stands at your side. “Okay, so this is training. You’re here to learn. The grinding, hard stuff will come naturally when your technique is approved,” she explains. You wonder if she’s being euphemistic. “Alright, do a T-pose for me.”
rows.translation: 你站好位置，挺直身体，面朝镜子，她则站在你身旁。“好，这就是训练。你来这里是为了学习。等你的技术获得认可，辛苦又磨人的部分自然会到来，”她解释道。你怀疑她是不是话里有话。“好了，给我摆个T字姿势。”
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce you’re in position - straightened up, facing towards the mirror - she stands at your side. “Okay, so this is training. You’re here to learn. The grinding, hard stuff will come naturally when your technique is approved,” she explains. You wonder if she’s being euphemistic. “Alright, do a T-pose for me.”"

rows.original: You press your feet together and outstretch your arms to a 90 degree angle each way.
rows.translation: 你双脚并拢，双臂分别向两侧伸展至九十度。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou press your feet together and outstretch your arms to a 90 degree angle each way."

rows.original: You’re very confident in your rigid posture, [pc.legs] bent ever so slightly forward. You don’t even need to look! Easy stuff.
rows.translation: 你对自己僵直的姿势非常自信，[pc.legs]稍稍向前弯曲。你甚至都不需要看！小菜一碟。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re very confident in your rigid posture, [pc.legs] bent ever so slightly forward. You don’t even need to look! Easy stuff."

rows.original: You assume the position, checking your limbs for deviance in form and technique. Looks pretty ok to you!
rows.translation: 你摆好姿势，检查四肢在姿态与技巧上有没有偏差。你觉得看起来很不错！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou assume the position, checking your limbs for deviance in form and technique. Looks pretty ok to you!"

rows.original: You’re holding it well but you’re not sure if you’re perfectly straight.
rows.translation: 你保持得很好，但不确定身体是否完全笔直。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re holding it well but you’re not sure if you’re perfectly straight."

rows.original: Even so, there’s a certain confidence and swiftness to your movements, something that get’s a “hmm” out of Mirrin.
rows.translation: 即便如此，你的动作仍透着一股自信与迅捷，惹得米琳发出一声“嗯”。
rows.raw: " Even so, there’s a certain confidence and swiftness to your movements, something that get’s a “hmm” out of Mirrin."

rows.original: She gives you a looking over.
rows.translation: 她将你上下打量一番。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gives you a looking over. "

rows.original: “Hm, pretty shipshape, Steele. You’ll do well,” she says with a hint of admiration.
rows.translation: “嗯，挺利落的，斯蒂尔。你会做得很好，”她略带赞赏地说道。
rows.raw: "“Hm, pretty shipshape, Steele. You’ll do well,” she says with a hint of admiration."

rows.original: “Hmmm, not so bad, Steele. I think we can make this work,” she appraises.
rows.translation: “嗯——，还不错，斯蒂尔。我觉得这能行，”她评价道。
rows.raw: "“Hmmm, not so bad, Steele. I think we can make this work,” she appraises."

rows.original: She taps the side of her mouth. “Mm... well, I started off worse,” she flatly states.
rows.translation: 她轻点嘴角。“嗯...好吧，我刚开始时还更糟，”她平淡地说道。
rows.raw: "She taps the side of her mouth. “Mm... well, I started off worse,” she flatly states."

rows.original: She also gives your [pc.belly] a rough patting. “We’re cutting down on this,” she says with a smirk. A flush runs through your cheeks.
rows.translation: 她还粗鲁地拍了拍你的[pc.belly]。“我们得把这里减下去，”她坏笑着说道。你的脸颊一阵发热。
rows.raw: " She also gives your [pc.belly] a rough patting. “We’re cutting down on this,” she says with a smirk. A flush runs through your cheeks."

rows.original: “Right, stretches.”
rows.translation: “好了，拉伸。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Right, stretches.”"

rows.original: She stands on the mat next to you. “Copy me as best you can,” she commands. She swiftly goes through several recognizable stretching motions and exercises, calling out the timing of each one. You mimic them
rows.translation: 她站在你旁边的垫子上。“尽量照着我做，”她命令道。她迅速完成数种容易辨认的拉伸动作与练习，并喊出每一个动作的节拍。你模仿着她，
rows.raw: "\n\nShe stands on the mat next to you. “Copy me as best you can,” she commands. She swiftly goes through several recognizable stretching motions and exercises, calling out the timing of each one. You mimic them "

rows.original: in perfect sync with your draconic instructor.
rows.translation: 与龙族教练完全同步。
rows.raw: "in perfect sync with your draconic instructor."

rows.original: relatively cleanly.
rows.translation: 动作还算干净利落。
rows.raw: "relatively cleanly."

rows.original: with a fair bit of sluggishness.
rows.translation: 显得相当迟缓。
rows.raw: "with a fair bit of sluggishness."

rows.original: You explore at least fifteen different patterns, from triceps to hamstrings and everything in between.
rows.translation: 你尝试了至少十五种不同动作，从肱三头肌到腘绳肌，身体各处无一遗漏。
rows.raw: " You explore at least fifteen different patterns, from triceps to hamstrings and everything in between. "

rows.original: These movements seem like second nature to you!
rows.translation: 这些动作对你来说仿佛已经成为本能！
rows.raw: "These movements seem like second nature to you! "

rows.original: Mirrin signals for a quick breather. By the end of it, your body is
rows.translation: 米琳示意短暂休息。结束时，你的身体
rows.raw: "Mirrin signals for a quick breather. By the end of it, your body is "

rows.original: feeling a consistent, energised warmness.
rows.translation: 持续感到一股充满活力的暖意。
rows.raw: "feeling a consistent, energised warmness."

rows.original: comfortably loose and innervated.
rows.translation: 舒适地放松下来，神经也活跃起来。
rows.raw: "comfortably loose and innervated."

rows.original: a little bit thrown about but happily warmed up.
rows.translation: 虽然有点被折腾得够呛，却也愉快地热好了身。
rows.raw: "a little bit thrown about but happily warmed up."

rows.original: “Right, show me your press-ups,” she says with a breathy sniff. You nod, laying front first with your palms on the ground, your [pc.chest] pressed under your weight. She’s standing over you with folded arms.
rows.translation: “好了，给我看看你的俯卧撑，”她喘息着吸了吸鼻子。你点点头，正面朝下趴好，双掌撑地，[pc.chest]被体重压在下方。她抱着双臂站在你上方。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Right, show me your press-ups,” she says with a breathy sniff. You nod, laying front first with your palms on the ground, your [pc.chest] pressed under your weight. She’s standing over you with folded arms."

rows.original: “As many as you can - go!”
rows.translation: “能做多少就做多少，开始！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“As many as you can - go!”"

rows.original: You power through your first thirty with relative ease, not too fast or too slow. The more you do, the more spurned on you become to do more. You’re going so low that your [pc.chest] and [pc.belly] seem to bounce you back up again. Mirrin’s calling out every tenth press but you’re too focused to care. Soon though, you’re feeling the shakes and the burn
rows.translation: 最初三十个俯卧撑你完成得相当轻松，不快也不慢。做得越多，你就越受鼓舞，想要继续增加数量。你压得如此之低，仿佛[pc.chest]和[pc.belly]会把你弹回去。米琳每逢第十个就会报数，但你太过专注，根本无暇在意。不过很快，你便感到身体发抖，而且肌肉灼痛
rows.raw: "\n\nYou power through your first thirty with relative ease, not too fast or too slow. The more you do, the more spurned on you become to do more. You’re going so low that your [pc.chest] and [pc.belly] seem to bounce you back up again. Mirrin’s calling out every tenth press but you’re too focused to care. Soon though, you’re feeling the shakes and the burn"

rows.original: and also something to do with the fat cats on Wall Street goes in and out of your mind
rows.translation: ，脑中还闪过一些与华尔街肥猫有关的东西
rows.raw: " and also something to do with the fat cats on Wall Street goes in and out of your mind"

rows.original: . You push yourself up with a final bit of drive and say “Done” a bit breathlessly.
rows.translation: 。你用最后一点冲劲撑起身体，略微喘息地说道：“做完了。”
rows.raw: ". You push yourself up with a final bit of drive and say “Done” a bit breathlessly."

rows.original: You’re still up for more! Blessed be these Steele genes.
rows.translation: 你还能继续！赞美斯蒂尔家的基因。
rows.raw: " You’re still up for more! Blessed be these Steele genes."

rows.original: You power through your first twenty with relative ease, fresh off the previous warmup. The more you do, the easier it becomes. Mirrin’s calling out every tenth press, something you note. Soon though, you’re feeling the shakes. You finish one last press, retract your legs in and slowly rise. “Done, I think,” you breathlessly say.
rows.translation: 刚完成热身，你相当轻松地做完最初二十个俯卧撑。做得越多，反而变得越轻松。米琳每逢第十个就会报数，你也留意到了这一点。但很快，你开始浑身发抖。你完成最后一次俯卧撑，收回双腿，缓缓起身。“我想，做完了，”你上气不接下气地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou power through your first twenty with relative ease, fresh off the previous warmup. The more you do, the easier it becomes. Mirrin’s calling out every tenth press, something you note. Soon though, you’re feeling the shakes. You finish one last press, retract your legs in and slowly rise. “Done, I think,” you breathlessly say."

rows.original: But you’re still up for more! Blessed be these Steele genes.
rows.translation: 但你还能继续！赞美斯蒂尔家的基因。
rows.raw: " But you’re still up for more! Blessed be these Steele genes."

rows.original: You power through your first set of ten relatively easily, if a little slowly. The more you do, the better you feel. Mirrin’s calling out every tenth press, although you’re already mouthing the number of each one anyway. A bit sooner than you thought, you’re feeling the shakes. You finish one last press, slumping on your front for a few seconds then slowly rise to stand up. “Duh... done,” you breathlessly say.
rows.translation: 最初一组十个俯卧撑你做得相当轻松，只是有些缓慢。做得越多，你的感觉就越好。米琳每逢第十个就会报数，尽管你自己也早已默念着每个数字。身体开始发抖的时间比你想象得更早。你完成最后一次俯卧撑，正面朝下瘫了几秒，随后缓缓站起来。“做...做完了，”你上气不接下气地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou power through your first set of ten relatively easily, if a little slowly. The more you do, the better you feel. Mirrin’s calling out every tenth press, although you’re already mouthing the number of each one anyway. A bit sooner than you thought, you’re feeling the shakes. You finish one last press, slumping on your front for a few seconds then slowly rise to stand up. “Duh... done,” you breathlessly say."

rows.original: But you’re feeling a second wind! Blessed be these Steele genes.
rows.translation: 但你感到第二股劲头涌了上来！赞美斯蒂尔家的基因。
rows.raw: " But you’re feeling a second wind! Blessed be these Steele genes."

rows.original: You follow her lead all the way, absent minded of the time. It just seems to breeze by! After going through press-ups, crunches, basic squats and some final stretches, an hour has disappeared.
rows.translation: 你一路跟随她的引导，完全没留意时间。时间就这样飞逝！做完俯卧撑、卷腹、基础深蹲和最后的拉伸后，一个小时已经消失不见。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou follow her lead all the way, absent minded of the time. It just seems to breeze by! After going through press-ups, crunches, basic squats and some final stretches, an hour has disappeared."

rows.original: “Okay, that’s enough for this session,” says the sweat-sheened dragon. “I think I’ve got a good idea of what to do with you next. Come by later, Steele.”
rows.translation: “好了，这次训练就到这里，”浑身泛着汗光的雌龙说道。“我想我已经知道下次该怎么训练你了。晚些时候再来，斯蒂尔。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Okay, that’s enough for this session,” says the sweat-sheened dragon. “I think I’ve got a good idea of what to do with you next. Come by later, Steele.”"

rows.original: She gives you a hefty pat on the shoulder. You
rows.translation: 她重重拍了拍你的肩膀。你
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gives you a hefty pat on the shoulder. You "

rows.original: smile and wave,
rows.translation: 微笑着挥手，

rows.raw: "\n\nHer beaming grin is all the confirmation you need."

rows.original: The both of you sit in front of the window for several hours, lightly hugging, kissing, belly patting: simple, effortless things. There’s not so much talking as there is murmuring, the weirdly sedate mood and atmosphere feeling disconnected from the world around you.
rows.translation: 你们在窗前坐了几个小时，轻柔地拥抱、亲吻、拍打肚子：都是些简单而毫不费力的事情。与其说在交谈，不如说是在喃喃低语，异常平静的情绪与氛围仿佛脱离了周围世界。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe both of you sit in front of the window for several hours, lightly hugging, kissing, belly patting: simple, effortless things. There’s not so much talking as there is murmuring, the weirdly sedate mood and atmosphere feeling disconnected from the world around you."

rows.original: You don’t think about that, of course, only about keeping warm with your qilin lover.
rows.translation: 当然，你没有思考那些，只想着与麒麟爱侣相互取暖。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou don’t think about that, of course, only about keeping warm with your qilin lover."

rows.original: Then there’s a groan from your gut.
rows.translation: 接着你的腹中传来一声咕噜。
rows.raw: "\n\nThen there’s a groan from your gut. "

rows.original: Is that your womb or... nope, stomach!
rows.translation: 是子宫，还是...不，是胃！
rows.raw: "Is that your womb or... nope, stomach!"

rows.original: Just pancakes seems like a year ago: you’re hungry!
rows.translation: 仿佛吃煎饼已经是一年前的事：你饿了！
rows.raw: "Just pancakes seems like a year ago: you’re hungry!"

rows.original: Hearing this, Mirrin reaches for something on a table behind the couch. She pulls over a dataslate, tapping on it very quickly.
rows.translation: 米琳听见后，伸手去拿沙发后方桌上的某样东西。她拉过一块数据板，在上面迅速轻点。
rows.raw: "\n\nHearing this, Mirrin reaches for something on a table behind the couch. She pulls over a dataslate, tapping on it very quickly."

rows.original: “Ey, ey, Brescoe. Not dozing, eh?” she calls out, the sounds of a heavy-lunged male coming through.
rows.translation: “嘿，嘿，布雷斯科。没在打瞌睡吧？”她呼喊道，对面传来一名肺活量十足的男性声音。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ey, ey, Brescoe. Not dozing, eh?” she calls out, the sounds of a heavy-lunged male coming through."

rows.original: “Uh, yeah, hey. All good in there? Need something?” says a casual Brescoe, an audible sniff coming after his question.
rows.translation: “呃，对，嘿。里面一切都好吗？需要什么？”布雷斯科随意地说道，问题之后还传来清晰的吸鼻声。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Uh, yeah, hey. All good in there? Need something?” says a casual Brescoe, an audible sniff coming after his question."

rows.original: “Me and my friend are hungry as fuck, just go get some take out for us, eh? And some for you, we’ll make a thing of it. I’ll pay you back and shit, kay?”
rows.translation: “我和朋友饿得要命，去帮我们弄点外卖，嗯？也给你买一份，我们一起吃。我会把钱还给你什么的，行吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n “Me and my friend are hungry as fuck, just go get some take out for us, eh? And some for you, we’ll make a thing of it. I’ll pay you back and shit, kay?”"

rows.original: “Fine I guess, be about a half hour, aight?”
rows.translation: “我想行吧，大概半小时，成吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fine I guess, be about a half hour, aight?”"

rows.original: “Sweeeeet, no booze though. Although you can, just not for us. Ah um, yeah, whatever, don’t forget side salad, yah?”
rows.translation: “太——棒了，不过别买酒。虽然你可以喝，只是别给我们。啊呃，对，随便啦，别忘了配菜沙拉，行吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sweeeeet, no booze though. Although you can, just not for us. Ah um, yeah, whatever, don’t forget side salad, yah?”"

rows.original: With that, she ends the voice channel and chucks the dataslate to the end of the couch.
rows.translation: 说完，她结束语音频道，把数据板扔到沙发尾端。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith that, she ends the voice channel and chucks the dataslate to the end of the couch."

rows.original: Food comes in short order, only about twenty minutes or so. Brescoe barely says a word outside of mundane ‘security stuff’, talking about house maintenance and the occasional fan who wanted an autograph hanging around a little bit longer than usual. Still, the three of you have a delicious chow down on the BBQ spread, the overly juicy and sauce drizzled meats filling that need very nicely and then some.
rows.translation: 食物很快便送来了，只用了大约二十分钟。除了平凡的“安保事务”，布雷斯科几乎一言不发，只谈到房屋维护，以及偶尔有想要签名的粉丝逗留时间比平常稍久。不过，你们三人还是美美吃了一顿烧烤盛宴；过分多汁、淋满酱汁的肉类充分满足了那股需求，而且远远不止。
rows.raw: "\n\nFood comes in short order, only about twenty minutes or so. Brescoe barely says a word outside of mundane ‘security stuff’, talking about house maintenance and the occasional fan who wanted an autograph hanging around a little bit longer than usual. Still, the three of you have a delicious chow down on the BBQ spread, the overly juicy and sauce drizzled meats filling that need very nicely and then some."

rows.original: Hasn’t actually made a dent in that belly bump you already have, though...
rows.translation: 不过，它其实没让你原本就有的腹部隆起消下去半点...
rows.raw: "\n\nHasn’t actually made a dent in that belly bump you already have, though..."

rows.original: Of course, Mirrin takes the lion’s share again, her fingers and cheeks dotted with bits of sauce. You try to keep up with a napkin, feeling the urge to nag her about it. Might be those burgeoning,
rows.translation: 当然，米琳再次拿走了最大份，手指与脸颊上点缀着少许酱汁。你拿餐巾努力跟上她的速度，感觉自己很想为此唠叨她。也许是那些正在滋长的
rows.raw: "\n\nOf course, Mirrin takes the lion’s share again, her fingers and cheeks dotted with bits of sauce. You try to keep up with a napkin, feeling the urge to nag her about it. Might be those burgeoning,"

rows.original: paternal
rows.translation: 父性
rows.raw: " paternal"

rows.original: parental
rows.translation: 家长
rows.raw: " parental"

rows.original: maternal
rows.translation: 母性
rows.raw: " maternal"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: You hadn’t even realized how much time had been spent here. The whole thing’s been a blur of sex, food and heavy sleeping. You check the Codex to have a look since checking in with Belker: 34 hours...?!
rows.translation: 你甚至没意识到在这里度过了多少时间。整件事已经化作一团由性爱、食物和沉睡构成的模糊记忆。你查看法典，看看自从找贝尔克检查后过去了多久：三十四小时...？！
rows.raw: "You hadn’t even realized how much time had been spent here. The whole thing’s been a blur of sex, food and heavy sleeping. You check the Codex to have a look since checking in with Belker: 34 hours...?!"

rows.original: You nudge the reclining qilin as she recovers from her food coma, showing her the time gap.
rows.translation: 米琳正斜躺着从食物昏迷中恢复，你轻推她一下，向她展示时间差。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nudge the reclining qilin as she recovers from her food coma, showing her the time gap."

rows.original: “Hm, how bout that... ehh, well, I did say a day. I’d get it if you wanted to get back to your business saving the world or... whatever it is you do these days. I keep hearing crazy shit. Have to start prepping to relocate anyway,” she says slowly, a mild note of exhaustion in her voice. Well, she has been taking care of her baby
rows.translation: “嗯，瞧瞧这个...呃，好吧，我确实说过一天。要是你想回去继续拯救世界的事业，或者...随便你最近在做什么，我也能理解。我不断听到些疯狂消息。反正也得开始准备搬家了，”她慢吞吞地说道，声音中带着轻微疲惫。嗯，她毕竟整天都在照顾自己的宝宝
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hm, how bout that... ehh, well, I did say a day. I’d get it if you wanted to get back to your business saving the world or... whatever it is you do these days. I keep hearing crazy shit. Have to start prepping to relocate anyway,” she says slowly, a mild note of exhaustion in her voice. Well, she has been taking care of her baby"

rows.original: daddy
rows.translation: 爸爸
rows.raw: " daddy"

rows.original: momma... poppa... breeder
rows.translation: 妈妈...爸爸...育种者
rows.raw: " momma... poppa... breeder"

rows.original: momma
rows.translation: 妈妈
rows.raw: " momma"

rows.original: all day!
rows.raw: " all day!"

rows.original: You imagine that she’ll be a good parent, if maybe a little loose with the rules.
rows.translation: 你想象她会成为一名好家长，尽管规矩也许会有些宽松。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou imagine that she’ll be a good parent, if maybe a little loose with the rules."

rows.original: “That’s ok, tell me when you’re set up and I’ll visit,” you say back,
rows.translation: “没关系，等你安顿好后告诉我，我会来探望，”你回答道，同时
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s ok, tell me when you’re set up and I’ll visit,” you say back, "

rows.original: wrapping your arm around her waist.
rows.translation: 用手臂环住她的腰。
rows.raw: "wrapping your arm around her waist."

rows.original: wrapping your arm around her shoulder.
rows.translation: 用手臂环住她的肩膀。
rows.raw: "wrapping your arm around her shoulder."

rows.original: “Aight, I’ll send a mail. Also, do I get access to the nursery?” she asks, eyes darting around is if she’s trying to remember loads of things at once.
rows.translation: “好，我会发邮件。另外，我能进入育儿室吗？”她问道，眼睛四处转动，仿佛试图同时记起许多事情。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Aight, I’ll send a mail. Also, do I get access to the nursery?” she asks, eyes darting around is if she’s trying to remember loads of things at once."

rows.original: You nod, quickly sending an automated alert to the Nursery’s system with Mirrin’s details attached.
rows.translation: 你点点头，迅速向育儿室系统发送一条自动通知，并附上米琳的资料。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod, quickly sending an automated alert to the Nursery’s system with Mirrin’s details attached."

rows.original: “Nice, well... how about a little goodbye, huh?” she half-whispers, drawing your mouth towards her. Her semi-closed, smouldering eyes meet your gaze and you feel a pang of adrenaline as they do. Ooh...
rows.translation: “很好，那么...来点小小的告别怎么样，嗯？”她半声低语，把你的嘴拉向她。她半闭而灼热的双眼与你对视，你随之感到一阵肾上腺素冲动。噢噢...
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nice, well... how about a little goodbye, huh?” she half-whispers, drawing your mouth towards her. Her semi-closed, smouldering eyes meet your gaze and you feel a pang of adrenaline as they do. Ooh..."

rows.original: Taking the initiative, you push your [pc.lipsChaste] to her mouth, catching her off guard. In a turn of play, you make merry with her long, dragon’s tongue, licking, pressing and pushing at it with all your mouth-muscles might.
rows.translation: 你抢先把[pc.lipsChaste]贴上她的嘴，令她猝不及防。游戏的形势随之逆转，你尽情戏弄她修长的龙舌，用全部口腔肌肉的力量舔舐、挤压并推动它。
rows.raw: "\n\nTaking the initiative, you push your [pc.lipsChaste] to her mouth, catching her off guard. In a turn of play, you make merry with her long, dragon’s tongue, licking, pressing and pushing at it with all your mouth-muscles might."

rows.original: You break it just as quickly, leaving the qilin breathless and stunned.
rows.translation: 你同样迅速地结束亲吻，留下麒麟喘不过气、目瞪口呆。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou break it just as quickly, leaving the qilin breathless and stunned."

rows.original: “Oo, uh... fuck. That’s very much a goodbye,” she chuckles, a slightly dopey smirk on her face.
rows.translation: “噢，呃...操。这还真是个告别，”她轻笑道，脸上挂着略显迷糊的坏笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oo, uh... fuck. That’s very much a goodbye,” she chuckles, a slightly dopey smirk on her face."

rows.original: With some final pats to
rows.translation: 最后拍了拍
rows.raw: "\n\nWith some final pats to"

rows.original: Mirrin’s new belly bulge
rows.translation: 米琳新出现的腹部隆起
rows.raw: " Mirrin’s new belly bulge"

rows.original: each others belly bulges
rows.translation: 彼此的腹部隆起
rows.raw: " each others belly bulges"

rows.original: your new belly bulge
rows.translation: 你新出现的腹部隆起
rows.raw: " your new belly bulge"

rows.original: , you give each other a reluctant goodbye.
rows.translation: 后，你们依依不舍地互相道别。
rows.raw: ", you give each other a reluctant goodbye."

rows.original: Gathering your equipment together, you leave Mirrin’s ranch with a new passenger on the way...
rows.translation: 你收拾好装备，离开米琳的牧场，新的乘客正在途中...
rows.raw: "\n\nGathering your equipment together, you leave Mirrin’s ranch with a new passenger on the way..."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: instincts coming to... even if it’s only been a day.
rows.translation: 本能开始萌发...尽管才过了一天。
rows.raw: " instincts coming to... even if it’s only been a day."

rows.original: Once you’re all done, you both press gang Brescoe into cleaning up, much to his vague annoyance. “Damn lovebirds, treatin’ me like some glorified maid, bleh...”
rows.translation: 一切结束后，你们两个强迫布雷斯科负责清理，令他有些恼火。“该死的恩爱鸟，把我当成什么高级女仆，呸...”
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce you’re all done, you both press gang Brescoe into cleaning up, much to his vague annoyance. “Damn lovebirds, treatin’ me like some glorified maid, bleh...”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: needs!
rows.translation: 需求！
rows.raw: " needs!"

rows.original: “Got me thinking, you know. I don’t think the next... however many months should be wasted here on this nothingness of a planet. I thought about it after we uh... blew our tops, heh. I’m thinking Tavros. Why? Well... I know that you’ve got that there Nursery that ol’ papi Steele set up. How I uhhh, how I know, well... secret,” she begins, her voice somewhat sedate but happy all the same.
rows.translation: “这让我想到一件事。接下来...不管几个月，我都不该继续浪费在这颗一无所有的星球上。我们呃...爽翻天后，我想了想，嘿。我在考虑塔弗罗斯。为什么？嗯...我知道你那里有老斯蒂尔爸爸建的育儿室。我呃，我怎么知道的，嗯...秘密，”她开始说道，声音有些平静，却依旧开心。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Got me thinking, you know. I don’t think the next... however many months should be wasted here on this nothingness of a planet. I thought about it after we uh... blew our tops, heh. I’m thinking Tavros. Why? Well... I know that you’ve got that there Nursery that ol’ papi Steele set up. How I uhhh, how I know, well... secret,” she begins, her voice somewhat sedate but happy all the same."

rows.original: <i>“Easier access to contracts, pick of any apartment, I can see the
rows.translation: <i>“更容易接到合约，可以随意挑公寓，我每天都能见到
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Easier access to contracts, pick of any apartment, I can see the "

rows.original: kid
rows.translation: 子
rows.raw: "kid"

rows.original: kids
rows.translation: 子们
rows.raw: "kids"

rows.original: every day. It’s uh... it’s perfect for me. And you, I think. You’ve got this massive obligation and the best years ahead.
rows.translation: 。这呃...这对我来说很完美。我觉得对你也一样。你肩负着这个重大责任，而最美好的岁月还在前方。
rows.raw: " every day. It’s uh... it’s perfect for me. And you, I think. You’ve got this massive obligation and the best years ahead."

rows.original: I’m not old but I’ve been full pelt all day, every day for like... fokk, 25 years? A few years off, raise some babies, indulge some, you know. What do you think?”
rows.translation: 我还没老，但像这样每天全速不停地过了...法克，二十五年？休息几年，养几个孩子，享受一下，你懂的。觉得怎么样？”
rows.raw: "\n\nI’m not old but I’ve been full pelt all day, every day for like... fokk, 25 years? A few years off, raise some babies, indulge some, you know. What do you think?”"

rows.original: You can see it working out: she’s been happier since you came into her life but a new change of scenery could improve her mental state. Money would never be an issue either. You say sure, no reason not to.
rows.translation: 你能看见这个计划可行：自从你进入她的生活后，她一直更快乐，而换个新环境或许还能改善精神状态。钱也永远不会成为问题。你说当然，没有理由拒绝。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can see it working out: she’s been happier since you came into her life but a new change of scenery could improve her mental state. Money would never be an issue either. You say sure, no reason not to."

rows.original: <i>“Mm, settled then. I can get rid of this place in a week, set up on Tavros the next. Probably take Brescoe with me too, he’s very handy. Won’t need to fly all the way to this ass end to see the
rows.translation: <i>“嗯，那就定了。我能在一周内处理掉这里，下一周在塔弗罗斯安顿下来。大概也会带布雷斯科一起走，他非常能干。以后不用一路飞到这个鸟不拉屎的地方来看
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Mm, settled then. I can get rid of this place in a week, set up on Tavros the next. Probably take Brescoe with me too, he’s very handy. Won’t need to fly all the way to this ass end to see the "

rows.original: kid
rows.translation: 子
rows.raw: "kid"

rows.original: kids
rows.translation: 子们
rows.raw: "kids"

rows.original: or...me...” she continues, trailing off somewhat to the end.
rows.translation: ，或者...我...”她继续说道，到最后声音逐渐减弱。
rows.raw: " or...me...” she continues, trailing off somewhat to the end."

rows.original: “Mmmhmm, anyway, uh what was I going to say... yeah, um, I, mmm...”
rows.translation: “嗯哼，不管怎样，呃，我刚才想说什么...对，嗯，我，嗯...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mmmhmm, anyway, uh what was I going to say... yeah, um, I, mmm...”"

rows.original: She seems to have trouble with her next words, as if they were perhaps too daring or impolite.
rows.translation: 她似乎很难说出接下来的话，仿佛它们过于大胆或不礼貌。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe seems to have trouble with her next words, as if they were perhaps too daring or impolite."

rows.original: <i>“I was wondering if you’d be willing to stay here until tomorrow. With me, of course. I, uh... just want this whole thing to go smoothly, make sure this baby thing really works.
rows.translation: <i>“我在想，你愿不愿意留在这里直到明天。当然，是陪着我。我，呃...只是希望整件事顺利进行，确保生孩子这件事真的有效。
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“I was wondering if you’d be willing to stay here until tomorrow. With me, of course. I, uh... just want this whole thing to go smoothly, make sure this baby thing really works."

rows.original: I’ve been feeling odd all morning, very low, very... anxious.
rows.translation: 我整个早晨都感觉很奇怪，非常低落，非常...焦虑。
rows.raw: " I’ve been feeling odd all morning, very low, very... anxious."

rows.original: And I just want to make sure you’re safe, you know? Yeah, yeah, you’re a galactic adventurer with scars and shit but this is so serious for me.
rows.translation: 而且我只想确保你安全，明白吗？对，对，你是个身上有疤什么的银河冒险家，但这对我太重要了。
rows.raw: " And I just want to make sure you’re safe, you know? Yeah, yeah, you’re a galactic adventurer with scars and shit but this is so serious for me."

rows.original: So would you?” she asks, her absent gaze trailing off to some corner of the room. Her expression forms a hesitant, anxious frown.
rows.translation: 所以你愿意吗？”她问道，失神的目光飘向房间某个角落。她脸上浮现迟疑而焦虑的皱眉。
rows.raw: " So would you?” she asks, her absent gaze trailing off to some corner of the room. Her expression forms a hesitant, anxious frown."

rows.original: “Sure, what’s a day?” you say, seeing the unrest in her body language. Immediately, she exhales in relief, her eyes turning to you.
rows.translation: “当然，一天算什么？”你看出她肢体语言中的不安，说道。她立即如释重负地呼气，将目光转向你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sure, what’s a day?” you say, seeing the unrest in her body language. Immediately, she exhales in relief, her eyes turning to you."

rows.original: She mouths ‘thank you’, stroking your cheek with the back of her hand.
rows.translation: 她无声说出“谢谢”，用手背抚摸你的脸颊。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe mouths ‘thank you’, stroking your cheek with the back of her hand."

rows.original: “Please, please, please... do not forget your pancakes,” she chuckles. “Sit tight, we got more to talk about in a bit.”
rows.translation: “求你了，求你了，求你了...别忘了你的煎饼，”她轻笑。“安心坐着，我们过会儿还有更多事情要谈。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Please, please, please... do not forget your pancakes,” she chuckles. “Sit tight, we got more to talk about in a bit.”"

rows.original: She leaves you to your food, wandering off to some other part of the house with her hooves clip clopping against the wooden floor.
rows.translation: 她把你留给食物，自己走向房屋另一部分，蹄子嗒嗒敲击木地板。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe leaves you to your food, wandering off to some other part of the house with her hooves clip clopping against the wooden floor."

rows.original: You wonder what more there is to discuss but eh, that can come later.
rows.translation: 你想知道还有什么可谈，不过嗯，那可以以后再说。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wonder what more there is to discuss but eh, that can come later."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You lay your hand on her protruding abs, caressing the substantial under-bulge that you bred her with.
rows.translation: 你把手放在她突出的腹肌上，爱抚由你的播种造成的巨大下方隆起。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou lay your hand on her protruding abs, caressing the substantial under-bulge that you bred her with."
