rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: “Hey there, can we do some training?” You say from behind the hulking dragon.
rows.translation: “嘿，我们能一起训练吗？”你在这条魁梧巨龙身后说道。
rows.raw: "“Hey there, can we do some training?” You say from behind the hulking dragon."

rows.original: “Yup, lemme finish up here.”
rows.translation: “行，等我做完这组。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yup, lemme finish up here.”"

rows.original: “Well, I’m not sure how you’ll measure but we can go easy.”
rows.translation: “嗯，我不确定你能做到什么程度，不过我们可以从轻量开始。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, I’m not sure how you’ll measure but we can go easy.”"

rows.original: She unloads her barbell onto the nearby rack. It’s amazing how it seems to always grow in size every time you see her use it and now it’s probably at around 450 kilos...
rows.translation: 她把杠铃卸到旁边的架子上。奇怪的是，每次看到她使用它，它似乎都会变得更大；现在大概已经有450公斤了...
rows.raw: "\n\nShe unloads her barbell onto the nearby rack. It’s amazing how it seems to always grow in size every time you see her use it and now it’s probably at around 450 kilos..."

rows.original: “Just some ground rules: You focus on me and only me. What I say goes, if you falter, I’ll help but that’s not likely to happen,” she explains.
rows.translation: “先定几条基本规矩：你只准专注于我，而且只能是我。我说什么就是什么；如果你撑不住，我会帮你，不过这种事大概不会发生，”她解释道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Just some ground rules: You focus on me and only me. What I say goes, if you falter, I’ll help but that’s not likely to happen,” she explains."

rows.original: It might be hard to focus with all these hefty, heaving bulls and cows smelling so good all the time...
rows.translation: 周围这些壮硕、胸膛起伏的公牛和奶牛始终散发着如此诱人的气味，想专心恐怕并不容易...
rows.raw: " It might be hard to focus with all these hefty, heaving bulls and cows smelling so good all the time..."

rows.original: “Right now... I want to see you squat,” she finishes, more forwardly than you expected.
rows.translation: “现在...我要看你做深蹲，”她说完，态度比你预想的更加直接。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Right now... I want to see you squat,” she finishes, more forwardly than you expected."

rows.original: “I-if you’re sure...” you say, a little cautious at the prospect.
rows.translation: “如、如果你确定的话...”你说道，对这件事多少有些谨慎。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I-if you’re sure...” you say, a little cautious at the prospect."

rows.original: “Just had to ask, big girl,” you say with a wink. She briefly raises an eyebrow.
rows.translation: “就是问问嘛，大姑娘，”你眨眼说道。她短暂地挑起眉毛。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Just had to ask, big girl,” you say with a wink. She briefly raises an eyebrow."

rows.original: “Better be fair with me...” you tepidly say.
rows.translation: “可要对我公平点...”你迟疑地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Better be fair with me...” you tepidly say."

rows.original: “Mmmhm, don’t worry. I’ll be with you every step of the way,” she assures you.
rows.translation: “嗯哼，别担心。我会一步不离地陪着你，”她保证道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mmmhm, don’t worry. I’ll be with you every step of the way,” she assures you."

rows.original: “Guess it makes a change from you checking me out,” she sasses you. Shit, that means she saw you peeping.
rows.translation: “也算换换口味，平时可都是你在打量我，”她挖苦道。糟糕，这意味着她发现你偷看了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Guess it makes a change from you checking me out,” she sasses you. Shit, that means she saw you peeping."

rows.original: “Ah, don’t be such a panzer,” she jokes, lazily waving her hand at your statement. You’re fairly sure she meant to say pansy.
rows.translation: “啊，别这么装甲车啦，”她开着玩笑，懒洋洋地朝你挥手。你很确定她想说的是“胆小鬼”。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, don’t be such a panzer,” she jokes, lazily waving her hand at your statement. You’re fairly sure she meant to say pansy."

rows.original: Instead of adjusting the manual weights on the rack, she picks up a curiously shaped metal bar. It’s roughly the same size but has a thicker middle section with a tiny control panel on it and dull metal spheres on both ends. “Right, stand in front of the mirror, Steele,” she directs, hefting the bar a foot above her horn-crowned head.
rows.translation: 她没有调整架子上的手动配重，而是拿起一根形状奇特的金属杆。它的长度大致相同，不过中段更粗，上面有一块微型控制面板，两端则各有一个暗淡的金属球。“好了，站到镜子前，斯蒂尔，”她一边指示，一边把杆子举到自己戴着角冠的脑袋上方一英尺处。
rows.raw: "\n\nInstead of adjusting the manual weights on the rack, she picks up a curiously shaped metal bar. It’s roughly the same size but has a thicker middle section with a tiny control panel on it and dull metal spheres on both ends. “Right, stand in front of the mirror, Steele,” she directs, hefting the bar a foot above her horn-crowned head."

rows.original: Standing perfectly opposite to the mirror, you straighten your [pc.legs] in preparation. Mirrin artfully hefts the strange bar onto your shoulders and you instinctively grab the handles. It feels cold but comfortable enough against your [pc.skinFurScales]. “Think I got it,” you say.
rows.translation: 你正对镜子站好，伸直[pc.legs]做好准备。米琳娴熟地把那根奇怪的杆子架到你肩上，你本能地握住把手。它贴着你的[pc.skinFurScales]，触感冰凉，却还算舒适。“我觉得我拿稳了，”你说道。
rows.raw: "\n\nStanding perfectly opposite to the mirror, you straighten your [pc.legs] in preparation. Mirrin artfully hefts the strange bar onto your shoulders and you instinctively grab the handles. It feels cold but comfortable enough against your [pc.skinFurScales]. “Think I got it,” you say."

rows.original: “Nooope, I haven’t set the weight yet,” she counteracts. “This calculates uhhh, your potential load based on your body strength. I’ve set it to 50 percent of what you theoretically can do so shouldn’t be too harsh.”
rows.translation: “不——，我还没设定重量呢，”她反驳道。“这东西会根据你的身体力量计算，呃，你可能承受的负重。我把它设成了你理论极限的50%，所以应该不会太苛刻。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nooope, I haven’t set the weight yet,” she counteracts. “This calculates uhhh, your potential load based on your body strength. I’ve set it to 50 percent of what you theoretically can do so shouldn’t be too harsh.”"

rows.original: She’s using her thumb to key in the buttons while holding the bar along with you. There’s a bit of apprehension in the air...
rows.translation: 她一边和你共同托着杆子，一边用拇指在按钮上输入。空气中弥漫着一丝不安...
rows.raw: "\n\nShe’s using her thumb to key in the buttons while holding the bar along with you. There’s a bit of apprehension in the air..."

rows.original: Suddenly, you feel it!
rows.translation: 突然，你感觉到了！
rows.raw: "\n\nSuddenly, you feel it!"

rows.original: An immense pressure on your frame makes you tense briefly. You take a few seconds to adjust. It’s heavy as hell but you have an inkling that it’s manageable. Unexpectedly, she puts her large and rough, heat-radiating hands around your waist.
rows.translation: 一股巨大的压力落在你的身体上，让你短暂绷紧。你花了几秒钟适应。它重得要命，但你隐约觉得自己能够应付。出乎意料的是，她那粗糙宽大的、散发着热量的双手环住了你的腰。
rows.raw: "\n\nAn immense pressure on your frame makes you tense briefly. You take a few seconds to adjust. It’s heavy as hell but you have an inkling that it’s manageable. Unexpectedly, she puts her large and rough, heat-radiating hands around your waist. "

rows.original: Your doughy midsection prevents her clawtips meeting in the middle... but she’s definitely trying, squeezing your flub something fierce. Said clawtips dig in to your [pc.skinFurScales] quite firmly.
rows.translation: 你松软的腰腹使她的爪尖无法在正中相触...但她显然很努力，狠狠挤压着你的赘肉。那些爪尖相当用力地陷进你的[pc.skinFurScales]。
rows.raw: "Your doughy midsection prevents her clawtips meeting in the middle... but she’s definitely trying, squeezing your flub something fierce. Said clawtips dig in to your [pc.skinFurScales] quite firmly."

rows.original: Your midsection tightens as her claws try to meet in the middle. The claws themselves pull a little sharply on your [pc.skinFurScales] but not painfully so.
rows.translation: 她的爪子试图在正中相触，令你的腰腹绷紧。爪尖微微刮扯着你的[pc.skinFurScales]，有点尖锐，却并不疼痛。
rows.raw: "Your midsection tightens as her claws try to meet in the middle. The claws themselves pull a little sharply on your [pc.skinFurScales] but not painfully so."

rows.original: Your thinner frame feels almost immaterial as her fingers wrap tightly enough for her claws to meet. The tips grip into your [pc.skinFurScales] but not enough to hurt or do damage.
rows.translation: 她的手指紧紧环绕，以至于爪尖能够相触；你较为纤细的身躯在其中几乎没有实感。尖端扣进你的[pc.skinFurScales]，但还不至于造成疼痛或伤害。
rows.raw: "Your thinner frame feels almost immaterial as her fingers wrap tightly enough for her claws to meet. The tips grip into your [pc.skinFurScales] but not enough to hurt or do damage."

rows.original: “We go together, kay?”
rows.translation: “我们一起下去，好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We go together, kay?”"

rows.original: With a lead-in from your trainer, you slowly bend down. Your [pc.knees] feel stiff but steady. As you descend, Mirrin’s powerful thumbs presses into different places on your back, encouraging you to push out certain parts of your body. Particularly, your [pc.ass] feels a little strain as it perks itself out under all this weight, not to mention the way her movements makes your [pc.chest] push a little bit more forward. If it gives the gym regulars a show...
rows.translation: 在教练的引导下，你慢慢屈身下蹲。你的[pc.knees]感觉僵硬却很稳固。随着身体下沉，米琳强有力的拇指按压着你背部的不同位置，鼓励你挺出身体的某些部位。尤其是你的[pc.ass]，它在如此沉重的负荷下向外翘起，感到些许拉扯；更不用说她的动作还让你的[pc.chest]更加向前挺出。要是能让健身房的常客一饱眼福...
rows.raw: "\n\nWith a lead-in from your trainer, you slowly bend down. Your [pc.knees] feel stiff but steady. As you descend, Mirrin’s powerful thumbs presses into different places on your back, encouraging you to push out certain parts of your body. Particularly, your [pc.ass] feels a little strain as it perks itself out under all this weight, not to mention the way her movements makes your [pc.chest] push a little bit more forward. If it gives the gym regulars a show..."

rows.original: you bite your lip at the thought.
rows.translation: 想到这里，你咬住嘴唇。
rows.raw: " you bite your lip at the thought."

rows.original: you’re a little tentative at the thought.
rows.translation: 想到这里，你有些迟疑。
rows.raw: " you’re a little tentative at the thought."

rows.original: You feel your [pc.butt] hit the backs of your ankles. Success! Sort of?! At this point, Mirrin lets go, standing up behind you. “Now, complete the movement,” she encourages.
rows.translation: 你感觉自己的[pc.butt]碰到了脚踝后侧。成功了！算是吧？！这时米琳松开手，在你身后站直。“现在，把动作做完，”她鼓励道。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou feel your [pc.butt] hit the backs of your ankles. Success! Sort of?! At this point, Mirrin lets go, standing up behind you. “Now, complete the movement,” she encourages. "

rows.original: It’s a bit tough at first but you’re able to push yourself up steadily back to a standing position.
rows.translation: 一开始有点吃力，不过你还是稳稳地撑起身体，重新恢复站姿。
rows.raw: "It’s a bit tough at first but you’re able to push yourself up steadily back to a standing position."

rows.original: It’s a strain to push yourself up again but after the initial, troublesome uphill thrust, you reach the standing position.
rows.translation: 重新撑起身体十分费力，不过熬过最初那段艰难的向上发力后，你终于恢复了站姿。
rows.raw: "It’s a strain to push yourself up again but after the initial, troublesome uphill thrust, you reach the standing position."

rows.original: You find it quite difficult to complete the motion at first. You feel that your body lacks a certain strength in some areas. Nevertheless, your struggling eventually lets you to finish at the correct position.
rows.translation: 一开始，你发现完成动作相当困难。你感觉自己的身体在某些部位缺乏足够的力量。尽管如此，经过一番挣扎，你最终还是以正确姿势完成了动作。
rows.raw: "You find it quite difficult to complete the motion at first. You feel that your body lacks a certain strength in some areas. Nevertheless, your struggling eventually lets you to finish at the correct position."

rows.original: This feels quite natural, now that you think about it.
rows.translation: 现在想来，这种感觉相当自然。
rows.raw: " This feels quite natural, now that you think about it."

rows.original: Despite all that, you’re sure that your [pc.ass] is going to appreciate your efforts...
rows.translation: 尽管如此，你确信自己的[pc.ass]会感谢你的努力...
rows.raw: "\n\nDespite all that, you’re sure that your [pc.ass] is going to appreciate your efforts..."

rows.original: Flaring her nose a bit, Mirrin saunters around you with a particularly piercing gaze. You watch her movements with your peripheral vision and all you see is a set of unblinking red eyes staring you down. “Eight more,” she commands. “This thing has a rep counter so I’ll know if you skip, Steele. Now I’ll be back in a bit.”
rows.translation: 米琳微微张开鼻翼，带着格外锐利的目光绕着你缓步走动。你用余光观察她的动作，看到的只有一双一眨不眨、死死盯着你的红眼睛。“再做八次，”她命令道。“这东西有次数计数器，所以你要是偷懒，我会知道的，斯蒂尔。现在我先离开一会儿。”
rows.raw: "\n\nFlaring her nose a bit, Mirrin saunters around you with a particularly piercing gaze. You watch her movements with your peripheral vision and all you see is a set of unblinking red eyes staring you down. “Eight more,” she commands. “This thing has a rep counter so I’ll know if you skip, Steele. Now I’ll be back in a bit.”"

rows.original: She strides off towards the changing rooms for something... but you have more pressing things to handle. You plow on through with your reps
rows.translation: 她大步朝更衣室走去，似乎要拿什么东西...但你还有更迫切的事情要应付。你继续完成剩下的次数，
rows.raw: "\n\nShe strides off towards the changing rooms for something... but you have more pressing things to handle. You plow on through with your reps "

rows.original: with some ease, although you could swear that the damn bar was getting heavier each time.
rows.translation: 过程还算轻松，不过你发誓那根该死的杆子每次都在变得更重。
rows.raw: "with some ease, although you could swear that the damn bar was getting heavier each time."

rows.original: smoothly but not without strain, the last three being exceptionally slower than usual.
rows.translation: 动作流畅却并不轻松，最后三次比平时慢了许多。
rows.raw: "smoothly but not without strain, the last three being exceptionally slower than usual."

rows.original: at a slow pace, focusing on the technique over anything else.
rows.translation: 速度缓慢，把注意力放在技巧而非其他事情上。
rows.raw: "at a slow pace, focusing on the technique over anything else."

rows.original: You spot Mirrin in the mirror’s reflection although she’s... wearing something else. It appears to be a particularly low-cut mint green jacket, like a Terran style hooded top. The label covering the chest in white text says ‘F O X F I T’. She seems to be sporting matching knee-length leggings, which are a white color with a singular mint stripe down each leg. Modelling stuff?
rows.translation: 你从镜中的倒影看到米琳，只是她...换了身衣服。那似乎是一件领口极低的薄荷绿色夹克，类似泰伦风格的连帽上衣。胸口处的标签用白字写着“F O X F I T”。她似乎还穿着配套的及膝打底裤，底色为白色，每条裤腿上各有一道薄荷色条纹。这是在当模特？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou spot Mirrin in the mirror’s reflection although she’s... wearing something else. It appears to be a particularly low-cut mint green jacket, like a Terran style hooded top. The label covering the chest in white text says ‘F O X F I T’. She seems to be sporting matching knee-length leggings, which are a white color with a singular mint stripe down each leg. Modelling stuff?"

rows.original: She says “smiiile,” as she approaches from behind, holding up some sort of small dataslate in her hand. Angling it to catch the both of you, you hear a distinct tk-tzzch sound, like an old style camera. It all happens so fast that you don’t even change expression. You haven’t even taken the bar off of your back.
rows.translation: 她从后方走近，手里举着某种小型数据板，说道：“笑——一个。”她调整角度，将你们两人都纳入画面；你听见清晰的咔嚓声，就像老式相机一样。一切发生得太快，你甚至来不及改变表情。你连背上的杆子都还没卸下来。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe says “smiiile,” as she approaches from behind, holding up some sort of small dataslate in her hand. Angling it to catch the both of you, you hear a distinct tk-tzzch sound, like an old style camera. It all happens so fast that you don’t even change expression. You haven’t even taken the bar off of your back."

rows.original: “Have a look.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Have a look.”"

rows.original: She pretty much forces the slate into your face and you see a highly stylized and filtered picture of you, cowed by the weights on your back and Mirrin looking exceptionally photogenic... even though only half of her face is in the shot. You just about have enough time to read a sentence.
rows.translation: 她几乎把数据板硬塞到你面前；你看到一张经过高度美化和滤镜处理的照片：你被背上的重量压得畏缩，而米琳则显得格外上镜...尽管画面里只有她的半张脸。你勉强有时间读完一句话。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe pretty much forces the slate into your face and you see a highly stylized and filtered picture of you, cowed by the weights on your back and Mirrin looking exceptionally photogenic... even though only half of her face is in the shot. You just about have enough time to read a sentence."

rows.original: “Working on a new one, could be a keeper x.x.x Special thanks to FoxFit for these awesome garbs!”
rows.translation: “正在练新动作，或许值得保留x.x.x 特别感谢FoxFit提供这些超棒的衣服！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Working on a new one, could be a keeper x.x.x Special thanks to FoxFit for these awesome garbs!”"

rows.original: Aside the name drop, you’re not quite sure what to make of it all. During this time, the refreshed Mirrin is fidgeting with the panel on the bar weight. “Hmm, good work, Steele,” she says, betraying a hint of approval. “Now do five more sets of eight.”
rows.translation: 除了这次品牌宣传，你不太明白这一切究竟是怎么回事。与此同时，恢复精神的米琳正摆弄着负重杆上的面板。“嗯，干得不错，斯蒂尔，”她说道，流露出一丝赞许。“现在再做五组，每组八次。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAside the name drop, you’re not quite sure what to make of it all. During this time, the refreshed Mirrin is fidgeting with the panel on the bar weight. “Hmm, good work, Steele,” she says, betraying a hint of approval. “Now do five more sets of eight.”"

rows.original: Nice, a challenge!
rows.translation: 很好，是个挑战！
rows.raw: "Nice, a challenge!"

rows.original: Groan.
rows.translation: 呻吟。
rows.raw: "Groan."

rows.original: Once you’ve pretty much exhausted your strength, the bar near-instantly becomes light again. It’s enough that you can lift it over your head despite your very tired out arm muscles. “I’d say that calls for food,” she says.
rows.translation: 当你的力气几乎耗尽时，杆子转眼间又变轻了。尽管手臂肌肉已经疲惫不堪，你仍能把它举过头顶。“我觉得该吃点东西了，”她说道。
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce you’ve pretty much exhausted your strength, the bar near-instantly becomes light again. It’s enough that you can lift it over your head despite your very tired out arm muscles. “I’d say that calls for food,” she says."

rows.original: Aw, food sounds so good right now...
rows.translation: 啊，食物现在听起来太诱人了...
rows.raw: "\n\nAw, food sounds so good right now..."

rows.original: even if she might point out your extra dough later.
rows.translation: 哪怕她之后可能会指出你多长的那点软肉。
rows.raw: " even if she might point out your extra dough later."

rows.original: “On me, how about it?” she adds.
rows.translation: “我请客，怎么样？”她又说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“On me, how about it?” she adds."

rows.original: physique
rows.raw: "physique"

rows.original: reflexes
rows.raw: "reflexes"

rows.original: willpower
rows.raw: "willpower"

rows.original: MIRRIN_TRAINED
rows.raw: "MIRRIN_TRAINED"

rows.original: Food!
rows.translation: 食物！
rows.raw: "Food!"

rows.original: “Hey there, can we do some training?” you say from behind the hulking dragon.
rows.translation: “嘿，我们能一起训练吗？”你在这条魁梧巨龙身后说道。
rows.raw: "“Hey there, can we do some training?” you say from behind the hulking dragon."

rows.original: “Back for more? I got some good stuff planned,” says Mirrin.
rows.translation: “还想再来？我安排了些好东西，”米琳说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Back for more? I got some good stuff planned,” says Mirrin."

rows.original: In a true reflection of what she does, she’s wearing a skintight leotard. Its color scheme is somewhat garish - covered in black, yellow and pink - but it appears to be incredibly well fitted, almost unnaturally so. Her intrusive, distracting bulge leaves even less to the imagination than before... you just about manage to tear your [pc.eyes] away from it.
rows.translation: 她身穿一件紧身连体衣，倒是如实反映了她的工作。它的配色有些花哨——遍布黑、黄、粉三色——但似乎极其合身，甚至合身得不太自然。她那突兀而惹眼的鼓包比从前更加毫无遮掩...你费了好大劲才把[pc.eyes]从上面移开。
rows.raw: "\n\nIn a true reflection of what she does, she’s wearing a skintight leotard. Its color scheme is somewhat garish - covered in black, yellow and pink - but it appears to be incredibly well fitted, almost unnaturally so. Her intrusive, distracting bulge leaves even less to the imagination than before... you just about manage to tear your [pc.eyes] away from it."

rows.original: “Can’t wait! I’ve gotten pretty strong from all this,” you chirp.
rows.translation: “等不及了！这些训练让我变得相当强壮，”你欢快地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Can’t wait! I’ve gotten pretty strong from all this,” you chirp."

rows.original: “Mm, I betcha have,” says the distracted trainer. She is - quite unapologetically - checking out your [pc.butt], an eyebrow raised.
rows.translation: “嗯，我敢说确实如此，”心不在焉的教练说道。她毫不掩饰地打量着你的[pc.butt]，还挑起一边眉毛。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mm, I betcha have,” says the distracted trainer. She is - quite unapologetically - checking out your [pc.butt], an eyebrow raised."

rows.original: “Uhh, what are we doing today, then?” You ask, to which she slowly brings her gaze to your eye level.
rows.translation: “呃，那我们今天练什么？”你问道；她这才慢慢把视线抬到与你双眼平齐的位置。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Uhh, what are we doing today, then?” You ask, to which she slowly brings her gaze to your eye level."

rows.original: “Niiice outfit,” you say, a vague hint of sarcasm coming through.
rows.translation: “衣服真——不错，”你说道，话中透着一丝隐约的讽刺。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Niiice outfit,” you say, a vague hint of sarcasm coming through."

rows.original: “Niiice ass,” she says rather flatly, checking your [pc.butt] out unapologetically.
rows.translation: “屁股真——不错，”她语气相当平淡，毫不避讳地打量着你的[pc.butt]。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Niiice ass,” she says rather flatly, checking your [pc.butt] out unapologetically."

rows.original: “Heyy-” you start but she interrupts.
rows.translation: “嘿——”你刚开口，她便打断了你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Heyy-” you start but she interrupts."

rows.original: “Mess with the dragon, you get the horns,” she grins, red eyes staring right into yours.
rows.translation: “招惹巨龙，就得挨角顶，”她咧嘴笑道，红眼睛直直盯进你的双眼。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mess with the dragon, you get the horns,” she grins, red eyes staring right into yours."

rows.original: “I expect it to be more challenging,” you say dismissively, arms folded. Mirrin appears to be slightly distracted, checking out your [pc.butt] without a care.
rows.translation: “我还以为会更有挑战性呢，”你抱着双臂，不屑地说道。米琳似乎有些心不在焉，正毫不在意地打量你的[pc.butt]。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I expect it to be more challenging,” you say dismissively, arms folded. Mirrin appears to be slightly distracted, checking out your [pc.butt] without a care."

rows.original: “I’m talking to you, Mirrin,” you add. She slowly turns her gaze from below you to directly at you, a rather displeased expression on her face. She raises an eyebrow.
rows.translation: “我在跟你说话，米琳，”你补充道。她缓缓把视线从你的下身移到你脸上，表情相当不悦。她挑起眉毛。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m talking to you, Mirrin,” you add. She slowly turns her gaze from below you to directly at you, a rather displeased expression on her face. She raises an eyebrow."

rows.original: “And...?” she flatly states. It seems to be tit for tat with her.
rows.translation: “所以...？”她平淡地说道。看来她这是在以牙还牙。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And...?” she flatly states. It seems to be tit for tat with her."

rows.original: “Anyway...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anyway...”"

rows.original: “We’re doing something necessary today,” she continues in a business-like tone.
rows.translation: “今天我们要做一项必要的训练，”她用公事公办的口吻继续说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“We’re doing something necessary today,” she continues in a business-like tone."

rows.original: “Cardio.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Cardio.”"

rows.original: Fuck yes.
rows.translation: 太他妈棒了。
rows.raw: "\n\nFuck yes."

rows.original: Fuck.
rows.translation: 操。
rows.raw: "\n\nFuck."

rows.original: She briskly paces over to the rowing machines and you follow suit. The gym is a little emptier today than normal but still the few gym goers around disperse when she walks up to the machines. They really want to avoid her for some reason...
rows.translation: 她快步走向划船机，你也跟了上去。今天健身房比平时稍微空一些，但当她走近器械时，周围仅有的几名健身者还是四散避开。不知为何，他们真的很想躲着她...
rows.raw: "\n\nShe briskly paces over to the rowing machines and you follow suit. The gym is a little emptier today than normal but still the few gym goers around disperse when she walks up to the machines. They really want to avoid her for some reason..."

rows.original: You set yourself up on one of the machines, placing your [pc.ass] on the sliding seat and comfortably setting your [pc.legs] to the omni-fitting foot latches. You curl forward and pull up the handle on the machine. It’s a surprisingly tough pull: the machine appears to be adjusting to your body strength. There’s a monitor right in front of you that confirms what you assumed.
rows.translation: 你在其中一台器械上就位，把[pc.ass]放到滑动座椅上，再将[pc.legs]舒适地固定进全适配脚扣。你向前蜷身，拉起机器的手柄。拉动起来出奇地费力：机器似乎正在根据你的身体力量进行调节。正前方的显示器证实了你的猜测。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou set yourself up on one of the machines, placing your [pc.ass] on the sliding seat and comfortably setting your [pc.legs] to the omni-fitting foot latches. You curl forward and pull up the handle on the machine. It’s a surprisingly tough pull: the machine appears to be adjusting to your body strength. There’s a monitor right in front of you that confirms what you assumed."

rows.original: “15 kilometers. All in your own time,” she says, thrusting her posture forward slightly. Well, at least there’s a good view of some boobs...
rows.translation: “15公里。按你自己的节奏来，”她说道，身体微微前倾。好吧，至少能欣赏到一番乳景...
rows.raw: "\n\n“15 kilometers. All in your own time,” she says, thrusting her posture forward slightly. Well, at least there’s a good view of some boobs..."

rows.original: You begin.
rows.translation: 你开始了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou begin."

rows.original: It’s not quite as hard as you thought but very quickly you’re respiring and perspiring all over the place.
rows.translation: 这并没有你想象中那么困难，但你很快便呼吸急促、浑身冒汗。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s not quite as hard as you thought but very quickly you’re respiring and perspiring all over the place. "

rows.original: You work the proper technique to the finest detail, your limbs and body working in tandem with mechanical consistency.
rows.translation: 你把正确技巧的每个细节都做到极致，四肢和身体协调运转，稳定得如同机械。
rows.raw: "You work the proper technique to the finest detail, your limbs and body working in tandem with mechanical consistency."

rows.original: You’re familiar with the proper technique, although you feel yourself slipping a bit in some places. Still, you’re certain it’s consistent enough.
rows.translation: 你熟悉正确的技巧，尽管有些地方感觉稍微走样了。即便如此，你确信自己的动作足够稳定。
rows.raw: "You’re familiar with the proper technique, although you feel yourself slipping a bit in some places. Still, you’re certain it’s consistent enough."

rows.original: It’s quite a bit of effort but you find a rhythm. You start to feel yourself straining early on.
rows.translation: 这相当费力，不过你找到了节奏。刚开始不久，你便感到身体逐渐吃力。
rows.raw: "It’s quite a bit of effort but you find a rhythm. You start to feel yourself straining early on."

rows.original: Throughout all this, Mirrin appears to be ignoring you. She’s now leaning her hip on the machine in a relaxed way, a look of disinterest on her face as she fiddles with the dataslate in her hand. Every so often, you see her stroke, touch and scratch the material covering her tightly packed chest. It bounces and springs with every prod she makes. Such a tease...
rows.translation: 在此期间，米琳似乎完全无视了你。她正放松地用臀部倚着机器，一脸兴味索然地摆弄手中的数据板。你不时看到她抚摸、触碰并搔抓紧裹着胸部的布料。每戳一下，那对乳房都会弹跳起伏。真会勾人...
rows.raw: "\n\nThroughout all this, Mirrin appears to be ignoring you. She’s now leaning her hip on the machine in a relaxed way, a look of disinterest on her face as she fiddles with the dataslate in her hand. Every so often, you see her stroke, touch and scratch the material covering her tightly packed chest. It bounces and springs with every prod she makes. Such a tease..."

rows.original: After a bit of time, a double beep from the rowing machine signals you that you’ve reached 15k. “Oop, finished,” says your alerted trainer. She gives the monitor a quick once-over, ‘umming’ and ‘ahhing’ to herself.
rows.translation: 过了一会儿，划船机发出两声提示音，告诉你已经完成了15公里。“哦，做完了，”被惊动的教练说道。她迅速扫了一眼显示器，自顾自地“嗯嗯”“啊啊”起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a bit of time, a double beep from the rowing machine signals you that you’ve reached 15k. “Oop, finished,” says your alerted trainer. She gives the monitor a quick once-over, ‘umming’ and ‘ahhing’ to herself."

rows.original: Your limbs are like jelly after the rowing but the afterglow is warming your tired senses all around your body. You slovenly slide your [pc.legs] from the all-fitting foot rests to sit up properly. “Huh... how’d I do?”
rows.translation: 划完以后，你的四肢软得像果冻，但运动后的余韵温暖着全身疲惫的感官。你懒散地把[pc.legs]从全适配脚踏中抽出，坐直身体。“呼...我表现得怎么样？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYour limbs are like jelly after the rowing but the afterglow is warming your tired senses all around your body. You slovenly slide your [pc.legs] from the all-fitting foot rests to sit up properly. “Huh... how’d I do?”"

rows.original: You almost feel ready to go again!
rows.translation: 你甚至感觉自己已经准备好再来一遍了！
rows.raw: " You almost feel ready to go again!"

rows.original: “Enough,” she says with a grin. “Let’s get some grub. Could murder some junk food right now.”
rows.translation: “够了，”她咧嘴说道。“去弄点吃的吧。我现在真想狠狠干掉一堆垃圾食品。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Enough,” she says with a grin. “Let’s get some grub. Could murder some junk food right now.”"

rows.original: reflexes
rows.raw: "reflexes"

rows.original: willpower
rows.raw: "willpower"

rows.original: MIRRIN_TRAINED
rows.raw: "MIRRIN_TRAINED"

rows.original: Food!
rows.translation: 食物！
rows.raw: "Food!"

rows.original: “Hey Mirrin, can we do some training?”
rows.translation: “嘿，米琳，我们能一起训练吗？”
rows.raw: "“Hey Mirrin, can we do some training?”"

rows.original: “Of course, Steele. I just need to go change a sec,” she says in a chipper manner. She’s even got something of a genuine smile on her face. What could it be for...
rows.translation: “当然，斯蒂尔。我只需要去换一下衣服，”她兴高采烈地说道。她脸上甚至带着几分真诚的笑容。究竟是为了什么...
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course, Steele. I just need to go change a sec,” she says in a chipper manner. She’s even got something of a genuine smile on her face. What could it be for..."

rows.original: You spot that the gym floor is a little more crowded than usual. Did Quenton organize something...?
rows.translation: 你注意到健身房里比平时稍微拥挤。昆顿组织了什么活动吗...？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou spot that the gym floor is a little more crowded than usual. Did Quenton organize something...?"

rows.original: Mirrin returns and immediately most of the heads in the room turn to her. She’s not looking at them but her face is prideful all the same. She’s wearing a thin latex bikini, almost completely transparent. You don’t even need your imagination anymore! Although, a second look suggests the bikini bottoms might not be too adept at holding back the monsters beneath...
rows.translation: 米琳回来后，房间里的大多数人立刻都把头转向了她。她没有看他们，脸上却依旧满是自豪。她穿着一套薄薄的乳胶比基尼，几乎完全透明。你甚至再也不需要发挥想象了！不过再看一眼，比基尼下装似乎不太擅长压住藏在下面的怪物...
rows.raw: "\n\nMirrin returns and immediately most of the heads in the room turn to her. She’s not looking at them but her face is prideful all the same. She’s wearing a thin latex bikini, almost completely transparent. You don’t even need your imagination anymore! Although, a second look suggests the bikini bottoms might not be too adept at holding back the monsters beneath..."

rows.original: It’s only just dawned on you that you’ve been staring her up and down at point blank range for almost a minute. The she-dragon casually clears her throat.
rows.translation: 你才刚刚意识到，自己已经近距离上上下下盯着她看了将近一分钟。雌龙若无其事地清了清嗓子。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s only just dawned on you that you’ve been staring her up and down at point blank range for almost a minute. The she-dragon casually clears her throat."

rows.original: “Eyes up here, Steele,” she says with a knowing smirk.
rows.translation: “眼睛看这里，斯蒂尔，”她露出心知肚明的坏笑说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Eyes up here, Steele,” she says with a knowing smirk. "

rows.original: Your [pc.eyes] meet her at eye level,
rows.translation: 你的[pc.eyes]在同一高度与她对视，
rows.raw: "Your [pc.eyes] meet her at eye level, "

rows.original: Your [pc.eyes] meet hers from below,
rows.translation: 你的[pc.eyes]从下方与她对视，
rows.raw: "Your [pc.eyes] meet hers from below, "

rows.original: a wash of embarrassment filling your [pc.face]. She leans in just a bit closer, almost uncomfortably so.
rows.translation: 羞窘的热浪涌上你的[pc.face]。她又凑近了一点，近得几乎让人不适。
rows.raw: "a wash of embarrassment filling your [pc.face]. She leans in just a bit closer, almost uncomfortably so."

rows.original: “Benchpress, go,” she lazily commands, pointing you to it’s general direction.
rows.translation: “卧推，去吧，”她懒洋洋地命令道，朝大致方向指了指。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Benchpress, go,” she lazily commands, pointing you to it’s general direction."

rows.original: You walk briskly over to an empty bench, Mirrin’s heavy clop clops just behind you. Eager to
rows.translation: 你快步走向一张空长凳，米琳沉重的哒哒蹄声紧随其后。急于
rows.raw: "\n\nYou walk briskly over to an empty bench, Mirrin’s heavy clop clops just behind you. Eager to "

rows.original: please,
rows.translation: 讨她欢心，
rows.raw: "please,"

rows.original: eye her on the side,
rows.translation: 从侧面偷看她，
rows.raw: "eye her on the side,"

rows.original: get this forced guilt trip over with,
rows.translation: 结束这场强迫式的内疚之旅，
rows.raw: "get this forced guilt trip over with,"

rows.original: you lay down on your back. Your draconid trainer places the strange spheroid barbell from before on the stands behind your head. “Same settings as before. One set of 8 reps, go.”
rows.translation: 你仰面躺下。龙裔教练把之前那根奇怪的球状杠铃放到你头后的支架上。“设置和之前一样。八次一组，开始。”
rows.raw: " you lay down on your back. Your draconid trainer places the strange spheroid barbell from before on the stands behind your head. “Same settings as before. One set of 8 reps, go.”"

rows.original: Lifting the thing off of its hooks is simple if a bit slow at first.
rows.translation: 把它从挂钩上抬起并不难，只是一开始稍微有些慢。
rows.raw: "\n\nLifting the thing off of its hooks is simple if a bit slow at first. "

rows.original: You make sure your arms are angled to a perfect 90 degrees, the load spread evenly across your palms. After a couple of reps, the rhythm you make does the work for you.
rows.translation: 你确保双臂弯成完美的90度，重量均匀分布在手掌上。做了几次后，形成的节奏开始替你完成动作。
rows.raw: "You make sure your arms are angled to a perfect 90 degrees, the load spread evenly across your palms. After a couple of reps, the rhythm you make does the work for you."

rows.original: You’ve got your arms angled accurately although the load is a little tough to deal with. After four reps, you feel a surge of will to complete them properly.
rows.translation: 你的手臂角度很准确，不过负重有点难以应付。做完四次后，一股意志涌上心头，促使你正确地完成剩余动作。
rows.raw: "You’ve got your arms angled accurately although the load is a little tough to deal with. After four reps, you feel a surge of will to complete them properly."

rows.original: It turns out to be tougher than you thought but not impossible. You work through the set slowly, making sure your technique is the focus.
rows.translation: 事实证明它比你想象中更困难，但并非不可能。你缓慢完成整组，把注意力集中在技巧上。
rows.raw: "It turns out to be tougher than you thought but not impossible. You work through the set slowly, making sure your technique is the focus."

rows.original: When the beep sounds, you place the bar in its resting position with a hefty exhale.
rows.translation: 提示音响起时，你重重呼出一口气，把杆子放回静止位置。
rows.raw: " When the beep sounds, you place the bar in its resting position with a hefty exhale."

rows.original: Easy! Let’s do more!
rows.translation: 轻而易举！再来点！
rows.raw: " Easy! Let’s do more!"

rows.original: “Hmm, take a breather,” says Mirrin, tapping away at the control panel on the barbell. Relaxing your chest muscles, you idly glance around you. Immediately, you see that Mirrin’s impressive bulge is barely inches away from your [pc.face]. Holy shit, is it huge. Maybe not the biggest you’ve seen but there’s two of those meaty horsedicks curled away, a rounded and smooth coconut-sized semen sphere on each side. The pressure they must be under, wrapped inside that thin layer of latex...
rows.translation: “嗯，喘口气吧，”米琳一边说，一边敲击杠铃上的控制面板。你放松胸肌，漫不经心地环顾四周。随即便发现，米琳惊人的鼓包离你的[pc.face]只有几英寸。我的天，真是巨大。也许不是你见过最大的，但里面可是卷着两根肉感十足的马屌，两侧各有一颗椰子大小、圆润光滑的精液球。裹在那层薄薄的乳胶中，它们承受的压力一定难以想象...
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmm, take a breather,” says Mirrin, tapping away at the control panel on the barbell. Relaxing your chest muscles, you idly glance around you. Immediately, you see that Mirrin’s impressive bulge is barely inches away from your [pc.face]. Holy shit, is it huge. Maybe not the biggest you’ve seen but there’s two of those meaty horsedicks curled away, a rounded and smooth coconut-sized semen sphere on each side. The pressure they must be under, wrapped inside that thin layer of latex..."

rows.original: “Back to work, Steele,” she chimes, breaking you out of that trance. She appears to wander away somewhere and goes out of your periphery. “I’m just over here,” she says, resting a hand on your [pc.legs] for a few seconds. Hotdamn, are those things rough on your [pc.skinFurScales].
rows.translation: “继续干活，斯蒂尔，”她欢快地说道，把你从恍惚中唤醒。她似乎走到某处，离开了你的余光范围。“我就在这边，”她说着，把一只手放在你的[pc.legs]上停了几秒。老天，那双手贴着你的[pc.skinFurScales]可真够粗糙的。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Back to work, Steele,” she chimes, breaking you out of that trance. She appears to wander away somewhere and goes out of your periphery. “I’m just over here,” she says, resting a hand on your [pc.legs] for a few seconds. Hotdamn, are those things rough on your [pc.skinFurScales]."

rows.original: Getting back into your sets, you find it a little easier than before. You’re pretty warmed up after all! That must be it...
rows.translation: 重新开始训练后，你发现动作比之前容易了一些。毕竟你已经充分热身了！一定是这样...
rows.raw: "\n\nGetting back into your sets, you find it a little easier than before. You’re pretty warmed up after all! That must be it..."

rows.original: The rest of the session seems like a breeze since that moment, Mirrin’s occasional words of encouragement spurring you on. She intervenes to give you a bit of direction, her rough, radiating clawed hands guiding you here and there with angles and posture. Sometimes, she brushes over your [pc.groin] ever so lightly and there’s a delightful internal twinge from the mere contact.
rows.translation: 从那以后，余下的训练似乎轻松得像微风，米琳偶尔的鼓励让你不断前进。她会插手给你一些指导，用粗糙而温热的带爪双手调整你的角度和姿势。有时，她会极其轻柔地擦过你的[pc.groin]，仅仅是这点接触就令你体内泛起愉悦的抽动。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe rest of the session seems like a breeze since that moment, Mirrin’s occasional words of encouragement spurring you on. She intervenes to give you a bit of direction, her rough, radiating clawed hands guiding you here and there with angles and posture. Sometimes, she brushes over your [pc.groin] ever so lightly and there’s a delightful internal twinge from the mere contact."

rows.original: Without warning, someway through your sets, a something lands abruptly on your face. Immediately, you clamber to set your barbell properly, just about managing to do so from intuition.
rows.translation: 在你做到某组动作的途中，毫无预警地，有个什么东西突然落在了你的脸上。你立刻手忙脚乱地把杠铃放稳，勉强凭直觉成功完成。
rows.raw: "\n\nWithout warning, someway through your sets, a something lands abruptly on your face. Immediately, you clamber to set your barbell properly, just about managing to do so from intuition."

rows.original: What in the hell is...? Oh.
rows.translation: 这他妈是什么...?哦。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat in the hell is...? Oh."

rows.original: Mirrin is standing just above your head but... her bikini bottoms have ripped themselves off!
rows.translation: 米琳正站在你脑袋上方，但...她的比基尼下装自己崩掉了！
rows.raw: "\n\nMirrin is standing just above your head but... her bikini bottoms have ripped themselves off!"

rows.original: It’s all quite overwhelming. You get a strong waft of warm plastic and a subtle but complex musk, something like burning coals, cinnamon and... hmmm.
rows.translation: 这一切令人应接不暇。温暖塑料的浓烈气味和一股微妙而复杂的麝香扑面而来，仿佛燃烧的煤炭、肉桂，还有...嗯。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s all quite overwhelming. You get a strong waft of warm plastic and a subtle but complex musk, something like burning coals, cinnamon and... hmmm."

rows.original: It’s more than enough to drive your other senses insane, a reactionary heat rising in your [pc.crotch]. On top of that, you’re feeling the ache in your nipples as they harden up. But she’s not even Treated!
rows.translation: 这足以令你的其他感官陷入疯狂，[pc.crotch]也条件反射般涌起热意。不仅如此，乳头逐渐变硬时，你还感觉那里隐隐作痛。可她甚至都没接受过改造疗程！
rows.raw: " It’s more than enough to drive your other senses insane, a reactionary heat rising in your [pc.crotch]. On top of that, you’re feeling the ache in your nipples as they harden up. But she’s not even Treated!"

rows.original: “Huh... wardrobe failure,” says the apathetic dragon. She does quickly grab the ripped plastic from your face but she’s still standing right over you... along with two unfurled horsecocks, just inches from your [pc.lips].
rows.translation: “唔...衣服出故障了，”这条冷淡的龙说道。她确实迅速从你脸上拿走了破裂的塑料，但依然站在你正上方...两根完全伸展的马屌也离你的[pc.lips]只有几英寸。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Huh... wardrobe failure,” says the apathetic dragon. She does quickly grab the ripped plastic from your face but she’s still standing right over you... along with two unfurled horsecocks, just inches from your [pc.lips]."

rows.original: The temptation to slide your [pc.tongue] all over these monsters is difficult to resist. You could almost give in if she wasn’t giving you such a deathly stare!
rows.translation: 想用[pc.tongue]舔遍这两头怪物的诱惑实在难以抵抗。要不是她正用杀人般的目光盯着你，你几乎就要屈服了！
rows.raw: " The temptation to slide your [pc.tongue] all over these monsters is difficult to resist. You could almost give in if she wasn’t giving you such a deathly stare!"

rows.original: “Well don’t stop lifting, keep going,” she calls out, staring you right in the eyes from above.
rows.translation: “喂，别停下来，继续举，”她喊道，从上方直视着你的双眼。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well don’t stop lifting, keep going,” she calls out, staring you right in the eyes from above. "

rows.original: With a little bit of hesitation and a big distraction dangling around your face, you plow on through with your last set. You swear you can see right into her urethra the entire time...
rows.translation: 尽管有些犹豫，脸旁还晃荡着一个巨大的干扰物，你依然坚持完成了最后一组。你发誓整个过程中都能直接看进她的尿道...
rows.raw: "\n\nWith a little bit of hesitation and a big distraction dangling around your face, you plow on through with your last set. You swear you can see right into her urethra the entire time..."

rows.original: With one final, blessed beep, you haul the hateful barbell onto its handles. Mirrin walks around to your side and only then do you exhale fully, trying to come down from your energetic high. All this time, the gym goers appear to have gravitated ever so slightly towards you and Mirrin... True to the spirit of New Texas, there’s enough catcalling, wolf whistling and genital jostling to drown out a sports crowd.
rows.translation: 随着最后一声令人如获大赦的提示音响起，你把可恨的杠铃拖回挂架。米琳走到你身旁，直到这时你才彻底呼出一口气，努力从亢奋状态中平静下来。在此期间，健身房里的人似乎一直在一点点朝你和米琳聚拢...不愧是新德克萨斯，起哄、口哨和生殖器晃动的声势足以盖过一整群体育观众。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith one final, blessed beep, you haul the hateful barbell onto its handles. Mirrin walks around to your side and only then do you exhale fully, trying to come down from your energetic high. All this time, the gym goers appear to have gravitated ever so slightly towards you and Mirrin... True to the spirit of New Texas, there’s enough catcalling, wolf whistling and genital jostling to drown out a sports crowd."

rows.original: “Ugh... give me a few minutes,” Mirrin says in response. She clops off to the changing rooms, ignoring the crowd around her. You yourself slowly sit up, stretching out your [pc.arms] and [pc.legs]. There’s still a vague hint of musk floating around your [pc.face].
rows.translation: “呃...等我几分钟，”米琳回应道。她哒哒地走向更衣室，无视周围的人群。你也慢慢坐起身，伸展[pc.arms]和[pc.legs]。[pc.face]周围依然飘荡着一丝若有若无的麝香。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ugh... give me a few minutes,” Mirrin says in response. She clops off to the changing rooms, ignoring the crowd around her. You yourself slowly sit up, stretching out your [pc.arms] and [pc.legs]. There’s still a vague hint of musk floating around your [pc.face]."

rows.original: It’s enough to keep you flushed and horny for a good while. So much smoky dragon flavor...
rows.translation: 这足以让你面红耳赤、欲火中烧好一阵子。好浓郁的烟熏龙味...
rows.raw: " It’s enough to keep you flushed and horny for a good while. So much smoky dragon flavor..."

rows.original: Almost as quickly as she left, Mirrin is back and covered up. She’s changed to a rather unremarkable white bikini top with white short shorts. However, she doesn’t seem to have quite got her full package to fit properly... they’re still inside her shorts but almost wrap round her hips, forming two snakelike bulges.
rows.translation: 几乎才刚离开，米琳就已经穿戴整齐地回来了。她换上了一件平平无奇的白色比基尼上衣和白色短裤。不过，她似乎没能完全把那整套家伙好好塞进去...它们依然藏在短裤里，却几乎绕到了她的髋部，形成两道蛇状鼓包。
rows.raw: "\n\nAlmost as quickly as she left, Mirrin is back and covered up. She’s changed to a rather unremarkable white bikini top with white short shorts. However, she doesn’t seem to have quite got her full package to fit properly... they’re still inside her shorts but almost wrap round her hips, forming two snakelike bulges."

rows.original: “I could do with some grill, what do you say to food, Steele?”
rows.translation: “我想吃点烤肉，你觉得来点吃的怎么样，斯蒂尔？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I could do with some grill, what do you say to food, Steele?”"

rows.original: physique
rows.raw: "physique"

rows.raw: "MIRRIN_TRAINED"

rows.original: Food!
rows.translation: 食物！
rows.raw: "Food!"

rows.original: After the last session’s... incident, you’re not really that phased to go for another one. “Got time for some training today, Mirrin?” You start.
rows.translation: 经历了上次训练的...意外后，你其实并不太介意再来一场。“今天有时间训练吗，米琳？”你开口道。
rows.raw: "After the last session’s... incident, you’re not really that phased to go for another one. “Got time for some training today, Mirrin?” You start."

rows.original: The jacked
rows.translation: 那名肌肉发达的
rows.raw: "\n\nThe jacked "

rows.original: qilin
rows.translation: 麒麟
rows.raw: "qilin"

rows.original: dragon-morph
rows.translation: 龙族变体
rows.raw: "dragon-morph"

rows.original: perks up at hearing your voice, hurriedly finishing her rep. “Eyyy, [pc.name]. Something awesome that I’ve been saving for some time,” she greets, not exactly with a smile but friendlier than usual. She hands you a small plastic bottle of something orange and oily.
rows.translation: 听见你的声音便精神一振，匆匆做完这次动作。“嘿——，[pc.name]。我藏了好一阵子的超棒东西，”她招呼道，虽然没有露出笑容，但比平时友善多了。她递给你一个小塑料瓶，里面装着某种橙色油状物。
rows.raw: " perks up at hearing your voice, hurriedly finishing her rep. “Eyyy, [pc.name]. Something awesome that I’ve been saving for some time,” she greets, not exactly with a smile but friendlier than usual. She hands you a small plastic bottle of something orange and oily."

rows.original: You ask her what it is. As she hands it to you, you feel its weight. It’s surprisingly dense, almost like handling mercury. Opening it up, the odour is rather lacking but it smells vaguely warm.
rows.translation: 你问她这是什么。她递过来时，你感受到了它的重量。密度出奇地高，拿在手里几乎像水银。打开瓶子，里面没什么明显气味，只隐约散发出一种温热的感觉。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her what it is. As she hands it to you, you feel its weight. It’s surprisingly dense, almost like handling mercury. Opening it up, the odour is rather lacking but it smells vaguely warm."

rows.original: “It’s a kind of uuuuh, muscle stimulant,” she replies. “It’s not like steroids, more like uhh, energy and stamina that you just rub on yourself instead of eat. This isn’t the awesome thing, just part of it. Follow me.”
rows.translation: “这是一种，呃——，肌肉刺激剂，”她回答。“它不像类固醇，更像是，呃，能量和耐力，只需要抹在身上，不用吃下去。这还不是那个超棒的东西，只是其中一环。跟我来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s a kind of uuuuh, muscle stimulant,” she replies. “It’s not like steroids, more like uhh, energy and stamina that you just rub on yourself instead of eat. This isn’t the awesome thing, just part of it. Follow me.”"

rows.original: She walks with a bit of spunk, heading towards the gym’s front desk. There, she waves over Quenton - who appears to just be scratching his dick - and has a few quiet words and nods out of earshot. Intriguing.
rows.translation: 她步伐颇有活力，朝健身房前台走去。在那里，她向昆顿招手——他似乎只是在挠自己的屌——随后两人在你听不见的地方低声交谈、频频点头。真有意思。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe walks with a bit of spunk, heading towards the gym’s front desk. There, she waves over Quenton - who appears to just be scratching his dick - and has a few quiet words and nods out of earshot. Intriguing."

rows.original: She turns to you, beckoning you with a finger. Her and Quenton slip behind the front desk into an inconspicuous back room. WELP, you came for training after all, it seems best to follow her. Although, you never know if you’ll end up with a horsedick in your face again...
rows.translation: 她转向你，用一根手指示意你过去。她和昆顿溜到前台后面一个不起眼的后室里。好吧，你毕竟是来训练的，最好还是跟上去。不过，谁也不知道最后会不会又有一根马屌出现在你脸前...
rows.raw: "\n\nShe turns to you, beckoning you with a finger. Her and Quenton slip behind the front desk into an inconspicuous back room. WELP, you came for training after all, it seems best to follow her. Although, you never know if you’ll end up with a horsedick in your face again..."

rows.original: What you see when you enter is altogether different. It’s a rather blank, dimly lit white room with only a few skylights for illumination. Mirrin and the bull are standing by a large, complex looking bit of machinery. As you get closer, Quenton abruptly turns to leave.
rows.translation: 进入房间后，你看到的却完全是另一回事。这是一间相当空旷、光线昏暗的白色房间，只有几扇天窗提供照明。米琳和那头公牛站在一台外观庞大复杂的机器旁。你靠近时，昆顿突然转身离开。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat you see when you enter is altogether different. It’s a rather blank, dimly lit white room with only a few skylights for illumination. Mirrin and the bull are standing by a large, complex looking bit of machinery. As you get closer, Quenton abruptly turns to leave."

rows.original: “Hey good lookin’, ‘sgonna be a fun day,” he says, a knowing wink and a smile beaming from his chiseled face.
rows.translation: “嘿，美人儿，今天可有得乐了，”他说道，棱角分明的脸上绽放出会意的眨眼和灿烂笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey good lookin’, ‘sgonna be a fun day,” he says, a knowing wink and a smile beaming from his chiseled face."

rows.original: At least it’s not horsedicks, you say to yourself. Then again, is that ever a bad thing?
rows.translation: 至少不是马屌，你对自己说道。不过话又说回来，那真算坏事吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nAt least it’s not horsedicks, you say to yourself. Then again, is that ever a bad thing?"

rows.original: Mirrin’s got her fingers all over some sort of control panel, one that looks quite alien. The entire machine could be summed up as such, too: It’s about four metres tall and three metres wide with two big saucers - one on the floor, one in the air - holding some sort of massive, white metal cylinder in a gravitational field. It’s surface is exceedingly smooth but every so often, it appears to ‘ripple’ like a thick liquid.
rows.translation: 米琳的手指正摆弄着某种看起来极具异星风格的控制面板。其实整台机器都可以如此概括：它约四米高、三米宽，有两个巨大的碟盘——一个在地板上，一个悬在空中——借助引力场托住某个巨大的白色金属圆柱体。它的表面极其光滑，但时不时会像黏稠液体般泛起“涟漪”。
rows.raw: "\n\nMirrin’s got her fingers all over some sort of control panel, one that looks quite alien. The entire machine could be summed up as such, too: It’s about four metres tall and three metres wide with two big saucers - one on the floor, one in the air - holding some sort of massive, white metal cylinder in a gravitational field. It’s surface is exceedingly smooth but every so often, it appears to ‘ripple’ like a thick liquid."

rows.original: “Uh, Mirrin... what in the tits is this thing?”
rows.translation: “呃，米琳...这到底是个什么鬼东西？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Uh, Mirrin... what in the tits is this thing?”"

rows.original: You stand by her side,
rows.translation: 你站在她身旁，
rows.raw: "\n\nYou stand by her side, "

rows.raw: "looking to her"

rows.original: looking up at her
rows.translation: 仰头望着她
rows.raw: "looking up at her"

rows.original: for an answer.
rows.translation: 等待答案。

rows.original: “It’s uuuh, sort of a present,” she says with a small sniff and twirl of the finger. “Not that it’s mine to go give. But somehow Quenton got his hands on this... marvel of bodybuilding magnificence and we,” she pauses, pointing to you and then herself.
rows.translation: “它算是，呃，一份礼物，”她轻轻吸了吸鼻子，手指画了个圈说道。“虽然它并不是我的东西，不能由我送人。但昆顿不知怎么搞到了这个...健美奇迹，而我们，”她停顿下来，先指向你，再指向自己。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s uuuh, sort of a present,” she says with a small sniff and twirl of the finger. “Not that it’s mine to go give. But somehow Quenton got his hands on this... marvel of bodybuilding magnificence and we,” she pauses, pointing to you and then herself."

rows.original: “We get to use it.”
rows.translation: “我们可以使用它。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We get to use it.”"

rows.translation: 你问她这东西到底是什么，

rows.translation: 一脸困惑。

rows.original: with indignant disbelief.
rows.translation: 带着愤慨的怀疑。
rows.raw: "with indignant disbelief."

rows.original: “Kind of everything... I guess?” states the unconvincing she-dragon. “So like, you stand on the pads there and you push down with your legs but push up with your arms. Full body workout, fits to your shape, fits to your strength and it goes up to weights of seven Terran tons.”
rows.translation: “大概...什么都能练？”这条不太有说服力的雌龙说道。“就是，你站到那边的踏板上，用双腿向下蹬，同时用双臂向上推。全身训练，适配你的体型、适配你的力量，最高负重可达七泰伦吨。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Kind of everything... I guess?” states the unconvincing she-dragon. “So like, you stand on the pads there and you push down with your legs but push up with your arms. Full body workout, fits to your shape, fits to your strength and it goes up to weights of seven Terran tons.”"

rows.original: What. The. Balls.
rows.translation: 这。什。么。鬼。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat. The. Balls."

rows.original: “So, you. Steele. Heir to Steele Tech and general galactic busybody with moi, Mirrin Arkosduttir, galactic model and freaky dragon thing, get to test this badass... whatever it is,” she exclaims, having a smile so wide that this is the happiest you’ve seen her.
rows.translation: “所以，你，斯蒂尔，斯蒂尔科技的继承人兼银河系头号好事之徒，要和本人——米琳·阿科斯杜蒂尔，银河模特兼怪异龙形生物——一起测试这个牛逼的...管它是什么东西，”她兴奋地喊道，笑容灿烂得前所未见。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, you. Steele. Heir to Steele Tech and general galactic busybody with moi, Mirrin Arkosduttir, galactic model and freaky dragon thing, get to test this badass... whatever it is,” she exclaims, having a smile so wide that this is the happiest you’ve seen her."

rows.original: Interested in the prospect, you clamber onto the all-purpose foot pads that hover a foot in the air. They’re not actually attached to anything - at all - and yet they feel very stable. With caution, you put your hands onto two handles that float close to your shoulders. You end up in a squatting position. At that moment, you feel an invisible pressure round your [pc.hips] and midriff.
rows.translation: 你对此颇感兴趣，于是爬上悬在空中一英尺高的多功能脚踏。它们完全没有连接任何东西，却感觉非常稳固。你小心地把手放到两根漂浮在肩膀附近的把手上，最后摆成深蹲姿势。就在这时，你感到一股无形压力环绕着[pc.hips]和腰腹。
rows.raw: "\n\nInterested in the prospect, you clamber onto the all-purpose foot pads that hover a foot in the air. They’re not actually attached to anything - at all - and yet they feel very stable. With caution, you put your hands onto two handles that float close to your shoulders. You end up in a squatting position. At that moment, you feel an invisible pressure round your [pc.hips] and midriff."

rows.original: “Don’t worry about that, it’s just a failsafe sort of thing,” calls out Mirrin.
rows.translation: “别担心，那只是某种故障保险装置，”米琳喊道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t worry about that, it’s just a failsafe sort of thing,” calls out Mirrin."

rows.original: “Mirrin, I trust you but... is this really safe?” You call back, a little bit alarmed.
rows.translation: “米琳，我信任你，可是...这真的安全吗？”你略显惊慌地高声问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mirrin, I trust you but... is this really safe?” You call back, a little bit alarmed."

rows.original: She smiles back at you. “I’d never try to hurt you, Steele. Too many lawsuits!”
rows.translation: 她回头朝你微笑。“我绝不会故意伤害你，斯蒂尔。官司太多了！”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe smiles back at you. “I’d never try to hurt you, Steele. Too many lawsuits!”"

rows.original: “I swear, if this starts ripping my clothes off, I’m strapping you in this damn thing forever,” you call back, half joking, half serious.
rows.translation: “我发誓，要是这玩意开始撕我的衣服，我就把你永远绑在这该死的东西里，”你喊道，半开玩笑，半是认真。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I swear, if this starts ripping my clothes off, I’m strapping you in this damn thing forever,” you call back, half joking, half serious."

rows.original: She just laughs. “You’ll be fiiiiine, you’re a Steele. You’re hard as rocks,” she reassures you. Ooo, it wouldn’t be good if she started confusing rocks with metals now...
rows.translation: 她只是笑了起来。“你会没——事的，你可是斯蒂尔。硬得像石头一样，”她安慰道。哦——，她要是开始把石头和金属混为一谈，那可就不好了...
rows.raw: "\n\nShe just laughs. “You’ll be fiiiiine, you’re a Steele. You’re hard as rocks,” she reassures you. Ooo, it wouldn’t be good if she started confusing rocks with metals now..."

rows.original: “If I get sucked into some unknown portal to hell, I’m coming back from the dead and fucking killing you,” you shout back, wide-eyed and paranoid.
rows.translation: “要是我被吸进某个未知的地狱传送门，我就算死了也会爬回来，然后他妈的宰了你，”你睁大眼睛、疑神疑鬼地喊道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“If I get sucked into some unknown portal to hell, I’m coming back from the dead and fucking killing you,” you shout back, wide-eyed and paranoid."

rows.original: She just waves it away. “Such a joker, Steele. This is a great experience!” She exclaims, sounding like a peppy therapist on a caffeine drip.
rows.translation: 她只是挥手带过。“真会开玩笑，斯蒂尔。这可是一次绝佳体验！”她兴奋地喊道，听起来像个挂着咖啡因点滴的活力治疗师。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe just waves it away. “Such a joker, Steele. This is a great experience!” She exclaims, sounding like a peppy therapist on a caffeine drip."

rows.original: She’s got the bottle of orange oil in her hands. She wanders over to you, squirting a bit on her left palm. “Now just relax,” she says with a toothy grin, pulling back parts of your [pc.gear] and rubbing the oil over your biceps, [pc.belly], [pc.hips] and [pc.legs]. She seems to be having more fun with that than she lets on... her rough hands feel a helluva lot smoother.
rows.translation: 她手里拿着那瓶橙色油液，走到你身旁，在左手掌挤了一点。“现在放松就好，”她露齿笑道，一边拉开[pc.gear]的部分位置，一边把油涂到你的肱二头肌、[pc.belly]、[pc.hips]和[pc.legs]上。她似乎比表现出来的更加乐在其中...她粗糙的双手感觉顺滑多了。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe’s got the bottle of orange oil in her hands. She wanders over to you, squirting a bit on her left palm. “Now just relax,” she says with a toothy grin, pulling back parts of your [pc.gear] and rubbing the oil over your biceps, [pc.belly], [pc.hips] and [pc.legs]. She seems to be having more fun with that than she lets on... her rough hands feel a helluva lot smoother."

rows.original: She finishes, her face barely a few inches from your own [pc.face].
rows.translation: 她涂完了，脸离你的[pc.face]仅有几英寸。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe finishes, her face barely a few inches from your own [pc.face]."

rows.original: “Ready? Gimme 8 reps.”
rows.translation: “准备好了吗？做八次。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ready? Gimme 8 reps.”"

rows.original: You nod. She steps back, admiring her work. You begin to push up with the handles and push down with the pads. It’s a bit disconcerting at first but after a few lifts and bends, you find it easy to get into. Still, the sensation of being held in place while your arms and lower half push in opposite directions is new.
rows.translation: 你点点头。她后退一步，欣赏着自己的成果。你开始用把手向上推，同时用踏板向下蹬。起初有些令人不安，但经过几次抬举和屈伸后，你很快便得心应手。不过，身体被固定在原地、双臂和下半身同时朝相反方向发力的感觉仍然十分新奇。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod. She steps back, admiring her work. You begin to push up with the handles and push down with the pads. It’s a bit disconcerting at first but after a few lifts and bends, you find it easy to get into. Still, the sensation of being held in place while your arms and lower half push in opposite directions is new."

rows.original: You find an internal balance pretty quickly, however. It makes you want to try all the more! But...
rows.translation: 不过，你很快就在体内找到了平衡。这让你更加跃跃欲试！可是...
rows.raw: " You find an internal balance pretty quickly, however. It makes you want to try all the more! But..."

rows.original: This thing is hard. Aside from your neck, the intense rush, burn and strain on your musculature both syncs your limbs together. It does, however, wear them out faster than you expected.
rows.translation: 这东西真难。除了脖子之外，肌肉承受的猛烈冲击、灼烧和拉扯让你的四肢协调起来。不过，它也让四肢比预想中更快疲惫。
rows.raw: "\n\nThis thing is hard. Aside from your neck, the intense rush, burn and strain on your musculature both syncs your limbs together. It does, however, wear them out faster than you expected."

rows.original: Without the mechanical feedback you’re used to, you adjust to the more floaty sensation of the pads. Combined with your balanced body, your first set of reps go by smoothly, if slowly.
rows.translation: 没有了习惯的机械反馈，你逐渐适应踏板更为飘浮的感觉。再加上身体平衡良好，你顺利完成了第一组动作，只是速度较慢。
rows.raw: "\n\nWithout the mechanical feedback you’re used to, you adjust to the more floaty sensation of the pads. Combined with your balanced body, your first set of reps go by smoothly, if slowly."

rows.original: Without the mechanical feedback you’re used to, you have to try hard to adjust to the floating sensation of the pads. Your body handles it well and your reps go down steadily but slowly.
rows.translation: 没有了习惯的机械反馈，你必须努力适应踏板的飘浮感。身体应付得不错，动作稳定而缓慢地逐个完成。
rows.raw: "\n\nWithout the mechanical feedback you’re used to, you have to try hard to adjust to the floating sensation of the pads. Your body handles it well and your reps go down steadily but slowly."

rows.original: Without the mechanical feedback you’re used to, the sensation is a little wobbly. You find yourself coping with the pads but your body feels a little out of whack. You perform your reps slowly, focusing on technique.
rows.translation: 没有了习惯的机械反馈，感觉有些摇晃。你勉强应付着踏板，身体却有些失调。你缓慢完成每次动作，把注意力放在技巧上。
rows.raw: "\n\nWithout the mechanical feedback you’re used to, the sensation is a little wobbly. You find yourself coping with the pads but your body feels a little out of whack. You perform your reps slowly, focusing on technique."

rows.original: The sensation of the oil is intense. It fills your [pc.skinFurScales] with natural heat and momentum, providing you with the energy you need to keep going. Mirrin’s glancing you over. Her fiery red eyes seem to glow in the dim light of the room.
rows.translation: 油液带来的感觉十分强烈。它让你的[pc.skinFurScales]充满自然的热量和动力，提供了继续坚持所需的能量。米琳正打量着你，她火红的双眼似乎在昏暗房间中闪闪发光。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe sensation of the oil is intense. It fills your [pc.skinFurScales] with natural heat and momentum, providing you with the energy you need to keep going. Mirrin’s glancing you over. Her fiery red eyes seem to glow in the dim light of the room."

rows.original: Once you’ve finished your first set, she just holds up her hand with her fingers spread out and you know she means five more sets...
rows.translation: 第一组完成后，她只是举起手、张开五指，你知道她的意思是再做五组...
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce you’ve finished your first set, she just holds up her hand with her fingers spread out and you know she means five more sets..."

rows.original: Here we go!
rows.translation: 来吧！
rows.raw: " Here we go!"

rows.original: Having a breather between each set, Mirrin re-applies some of the oil to bits of your body.
rows.translation: 每组之间喘息时，米琳都会在你身体的部分位置重新涂上一些油液。
rows.raw: "\n\nHaving a breather between each set, Mirrin re-applies some of the oil to bits of your body."

rows.original: She spends a little extra time touching up your [pc.belly], particularly your visible, tensing abs...
rows.translation: 她花了更多时间涂抹你的[pc.belly]，尤其是那绷紧而清晰可见的腹肌...
rows.raw: " She spends a little extra time touching up your [pc.belly], particularly your visible, tensing abs..."

rows.original: She spends a little extra time on your [pc.hips] and [pc.belly]. You feel her claws pulling slightly on your flesh and you’re fairly certain she’s watching out for some sort of jiggling...
rows.translation: 她花了更多时间涂抹你的[pc.hips]和[pc.belly]。你感觉她的爪子微微拉扯着你的肉，而且很确定她是在观察有没有哪里晃动...
rows.raw: " She spends a little extra time on your [pc.hips] and [pc.belly]. You feel her claws pulling slightly on your flesh and you’re fairly certain she’s watching out for some sort of jiggling..."

rows.original: The oil is absorbed pretty quickly into your skin so every bit reapplied feels like a fresh, new sensation. Judging by how you’re still able to keep going, it’s doing it’s job.
rows.translation: 油液很快便被皮肤吸收，因此每次补涂都像是一种崭新的感觉。看你依然能够坚持下去，它显然发挥了作用。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe oil is absorbed pretty quickly into your skin so every bit reapplied feels like a fresh, new sensation. Judging by how you’re still able to keep going, it’s doing it’s job."

rows.original: Suddenly, Mirrin calls “Stop!” and you snap out of your rhythm. You ask if there’s something wrong.
rows.translation: 突然，米琳喊道：“停！”你猛然脱离节奏，询问是不是出了什么问题。
rows.raw: "\n\nSuddenly, Mirrin calls “Stop!” and you snap out of your rhythm. You ask if there’s something wrong."

rows.original: “Ey, no, no... I just want a go,” she says, somewhat envious of the sweat you’ve worked up. “You did good but fuck, I can’t miss this.”
rows.translation: “哎，没有，没有...我只是也想试试，”她说道，似乎有些羡慕你练出的满身汗水。“你做得不错，可是操，我不能错过这个。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ey, no, no... I just want a go,” she says, somewhat envious of the sweat you’ve worked up. “You did good but fuck, I can’t miss this.”"

rows.original: You let go of the handles above you and the hard grip round your middle disappears. Instinctively, you move your body forward but your limbs feel like jelly!
rows.translation: 你松开上方的把手，腰间牢固的束缚也随之消失。你本能地向前移动身体，可四肢却软得像果冻！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou let go of the handles above you and the hard grip round your middle disappears. Instinctively, you move your body forward but your limbs feel like jelly!"

rows.original: You slip.
rows.translation: 你滑倒了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou slip."

rows.original: And Mirrin lurches forward to catch you.
rows.translation: 米琳猛地向前扑来接住你。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd Mirrin lurches forward to catch you."

rows.original: “Gotcha, gotcha!”
rows.translation: “接住了，接住了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Gotcha, gotcha!”"

rows.original: You regain your sense of self, finding yourself clasped tightly against her with her face a few inches from yours. It’s those eyes... your chest flutters. You both lock into each others gaze for a few seconds.
rows.translation: 你恢复神志，发现自己被她紧紧搂在怀里，她的脸离你只有几英寸。是那双眼睛...你的胸口怦然一动。你们彼此凝视了几秒钟。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou regain your sense of self, finding yourself clasped tightly against her with her face a few inches from yours. It’s those eyes... your chest flutters. You both lock into each others gaze for a few seconds."

rows.original: “You okay, [pc.name]?” asks the velvety voiced she-dragon.
rows.translation: “你没事吧，[pc.name]？”嗓音柔滑的雌龙问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You okay, [pc.name]?” asks the velvety voiced she-dragon."

rows.original: “Uhh... yeah,” you nod slowly, unable to break eye contact.
rows.translation: “呃...没事，”你缓缓点头，无法移开视线。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Uhh... yeah,” you nod slowly, unable to break eye contact."

rows.original: “Uhm... maybe,” you say with a quiver, placing a hand on her arm.
rows.translation: “嗯...也许吧，”你声音发颤地说道，把一只手放到她的手臂上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Uhm... maybe,” you say with a quiver, placing a hand on her arm."

rows.original: “Just about” you say in a subdued voice, blinking a bit.
rows.translation: “还撑得住。”你眨了眨眼，低声说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Just about” you say in a subdued voice, blinking a bit."

rows.original: “Good,” she says softly, a hard emphasis on the D.
rows.translation: “那就好，”她柔声说道，最后一个音咬得格外用力。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Good,” she says softly, a hard emphasis on the D."

rows.original: Much like this game in general, huehuehuehuehuehuehue.
rows.translation: 和这款游戏总体上一样，嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。
rows.raw: " Much like this game in general, huehuehuehuehuehuehue."

rows.original: She lowers you down in a gentle fashion, enough that you can find your footing on your own. You thank her in turn. Then, she has a fiddle on the control panel. The white cylinder in the gravity field seems to bend and squash into a slightly rounder shape. An alert pops up.
rows.translation: 她温柔地把你放低，让你能够自行站稳。你也向她道谢。接着，她摆弄起控制面板。引力场中的白色圆柱似乎弯曲压缩，变成了稍圆的形状。一条警报弹了出来。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe lowers you down in a gentle fashion, enough that you can find your footing on your own. You thank her in turn. Then, she has a fiddle on the control panel. The white cylinder in the gravity field seems to bend and squash into a slightly rounder shape. An alert pops up."

rows.original: “Warning, loads in excess of 1 Terran Tonne require added supervision.”
rows.translation: “警告：负重超过1泰伦吨时，需要额外监督。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Warning, loads in excess of 1 Terran Tonne require added supervision.”"

rows.original: “Ignore it,” says a confident Mirrin, stepping onto the hovering pads with her hooves. You get a glimpse of the control panel: It reads 1372.3kg.
rows.translation: “别管它，”自信的米琳说道，用蹄子踏上悬浮踏板。你瞥见控制面板，上面显示着1372.3公斤。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ignore it,” says a confident Mirrin, stepping onto the hovering pads with her hooves. You get a glimpse of the control panel: It reads 1372.3kg."

rows.original: Fuck.
rows.raw: "\n\nFuck."

rows.original: She’s already oiled up, it seems. Her black top and shorts are slightly damp from it. She inhales deeply then begins her first push.
rows.translation: 看来她已经涂好油了。黑色上衣和短裤被油液微微浸湿。她深吸一口气，开始第一次推举。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe’s already oiled up, it seems. Her black top and shorts are slightly damp from it. She inhales deeply then begins her first push."

rows.original: It takes her 20 seconds to extend her limbs out fully. Through your tired out vision, her muscles seem to bulge to twice the size! She holds the pose for one second... two seconds... three... four... five...
rows.translation: 她花了20秒才完全伸展四肢。在你疲惫的视野中，她的肌肉仿佛膨胀到了两倍！她保持姿势一秒...两秒...三...四...五...
rows.raw: "\n\nIt takes her 20 seconds to extend her limbs out fully. Through your tired out vision, her muscles seem to bulge to twice the size! She holds the pose for one second... two seconds... three... four... five..."

rows.original: Scrcchh!
rows.translation: 嘶啦！
rows.raw: "\n\nScrcchh!"

rows.original: You see her black top burst forward from her chest! Instantly, she lets go of the bars and covers her E-cups. Apparently the failsafe stops everything from crushing people caught in it...
rows.translation: 你看到她的黑色上衣被胸脯猛然撑破！她立刻松开横杆，遮住自己的E罩杯。显然，故障保险会阻止机器压碎困在其中的人...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou see her black top burst forward from her chest! Instantly, she lets go of the bars and covers her E-cups. Apparently the failsafe stops everything from crushing people caught in it..."

rows.original: “Shit!” she shouts.
rows.translation: “操！”她喊道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Shit!” she shouts."

rows.original: This seems familiar...
rows.translation: 这一幕似曾相识...
rows.raw: "\n\nThis seems familiar..."

rows.original: She steps off the pads, ventilating quite heavily. A sheen of sweat sticks to her now mostly bare body.
rows.translation: 她走下踏板，剧烈喘息。汗水的光泽附着在她如今几乎赤裸的身体上。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe steps off the pads, ventilating quite heavily. A sheen of sweat sticks to her now mostly bare body."

rows.original: Goddamn, her smoky scent is stronger than ever... there’s that tell-tale twinge in your [pc.groin].
rows.translation: 该死，她那烟熏般的气味比以往更浓了...[pc.groin]中传来那熟悉的抽动。
rows.raw: " Goddamn, her smoky scent is stronger than ever... there’s that tell-tale twinge in your [pc.groin]."

rows.original: “I am a fucking disaster zone,” she says, somewhat vexed. You keep your eyes away from her chest, even though the temptation is real. She relaxes, putting her hands on her hips.
rows.translation: “我他妈就是一片灾区，”她有些恼火地说道。尽管诱惑真切无比，你仍努力不去看她的胸部。她放松下来，双手叉腰。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I am a fucking disaster zone,” she says, somewhat vexed. You keep your eyes away from her chest, even though the temptation is real. She relaxes, putting her hands on her hips."

rows.original: “Still, how’d it look, Steele?”
rows.translation: “不过，我刚才看起来怎么样，斯蒂尔？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Still, how’d it look, Steele?”"

rows.original: “Very, uhm... very impressive,” you say, desperately trying to keep your eyes on her face.
rows.translation: “非常，嗯...非常厉害，”你说道，拼命让视线停留在她脸上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Very, uhm... very impressive,” you say, desperately trying to keep your eyes on her face."

rows.original: “Breast I’ve seen you do, I mean... best I’ve seen you do,” you say, a little flustered.
rows.translation: “这是我见过你做得最乳...我是说，最好的一次，”你有些慌乱地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Breast I’ve seen you do, I mean... best I’ve seen you do,” you say, a little flustered."

rows.original: “Your form was a little off,” you say, your voice cracking a little on the last syllable. It’s also hard to hide the blush you’ve gained.
rows.translation: “你的姿势有点偏了，”你说道，声音在最后一个音节上微微破裂。脸上的红晕也很难掩饰。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Your form was a little off,” you say, your voice cracking a little on the last syllable. It’s also hard to hide the blush you’ve gained."

rows.original: Mirrin breaks into a laugh. “You can look, you know,” she grins, jiggling her chest a little. “I’m gonna re-dress, then uh... let’s get grub, [pc.name].”
rows.translation: 米琳大笑起来。“你可以看的，知道吗？”她咧嘴说道，微微晃了晃胸部。“我要去重新穿衣服，然后，呃...去吃点东西吧，[pc.name]。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMirrin breaks into a laugh. “You can look, you know,” she grins, jiggling her chest a little. “I’m gonna re-dress, then uh... let’s get grub, [pc.name].”"

rows.original: Hell yeah, tits and steak.
rows.translation: 太棒了，奶子和牛排。
rows.raw: "\n\nHell yeah, tits and steak."

rows.original: physique
rows.raw: "physique"

rows.original: willpower
rows.raw: "willpower"

rows.original: MIRRIN_TRAINED
rows.raw: "MIRRIN_TRAINED"

rows.original: Food!
rows.translation: 食物！
rows.raw: "Food!"

rows.original: “Heeey Mirrin, can we do some training?” You ask your dragon trainer.
rows.translation: “嘿——，米琳，我们能一起训练吗？”你询问自己的龙族教练。
rows.raw: "“Heeey Mirrin, can we do some training?” You ask your dragon trainer."

rows.original: “Always, Steele,” she replies, eyeing your body all over. “Let’s get you doing the whole works, yes?”
rows.translation: “随时奉陪，斯蒂尔，”她回答，上下打量着你的身体。“让你把全套项目都练一遍，怎么样？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Always, Steele,” she replies, eyeing your body all over. “Let’s get you doing the whole works, yes?”"

rows.original: She sets her own weights down and points to the stretching mats. Getting into that familiar stance, you attempt to synchronize with your draconic trainer down to the detail with success. She adapts her speeds and positions for workouts that are comfortable for your bodyshape, spending extra time on working your thighs and glutes...
rows.translation: 她放下自己的负重，指向拉伸垫。你摆出熟悉的姿势，尝试在每个细节上与龙族教练同步，并成功做到了。她调整速度和姿势，选择适合你体型的训练动作，并花了更多时间锻炼你的大腿和臀肌...
rows.raw: "\n\nShe sets her own weights down and points to the stretching mats. Getting into that familiar stance, you attempt to synchronize with your draconic trainer down to the detail with success. She adapts her speeds and positions for workouts that are comfortable for your bodyshape, spending extra time on working your thighs and glutes..."

rows.original: Then to weights: various types of squats, presses and deadlifts that work both of your upper bodies and midsections. Mirrin gives you extra support when tackling the last few sets, getting a little bit frisky with her hands and fingers on your sweating body. It’s quickly passed off as thorough posture inspection.
rows.translation: 接着是负重训练：各种深蹲、推举和硬拉，锻炼你们的上半身与腰腹。进行最后几组时，米琳给予额外支撑，双手和手指在你汗湿的身体上变得有些轻佻。她很快便将其解释为细致的姿势检查。
rows.raw: "\n\nThen to weights: various types of squats, presses and deadlifts that work both of your upper bodies and midsections. Mirrin gives you extra support when tackling the last few sets, getting a little bit frisky with her hands and fingers on your sweating body. It’s quickly passed off as thorough posture inspection."

rows.original: Finally, some general cardio and more stretches: A few laps, a few kilometres on the treadmill, with Mirrin’s voice and direction guiding you all the way.
rows.translation: 最后是一些常规有氧和更多拉伸：跑上几圈，再在跑步机上跑几公里，米琳的声音和指导一路伴随着你。
rows.raw: "\n\nFinally, some general cardio and more stretches: A few laps, a few kilometres on the treadmill, with Mirrin’s voice and direction guiding you all the way."

rows.original: You’re pretty tired out after a few hours of this repeated cycle. You’ve definitely worked up a proper sweat as well!
rows.translation: 如此循环几小时后，你已经相当疲惫，而且绝对出了一身透汗！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re pretty tired out after a few hours of this repeated cycle. You’ve definitely worked up a proper sweat as well!"

rows.original: physique
rows.raw: "physique"

rows.original: willpower
rows.raw: "willpower"

rows.original: MIRRIN_TRAINED
rows.raw: "MIRRIN_TRAINED"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: “Nice, niiiice! You’re improving every session, Steele. Hey, maybe a few more years of that, some illegal gene mods and maybe a uhhh, miracle and you might be as good as me, eh?” jokes Mirrin, giving you a hearty pat on the back. It’s almost enough to knock you over
rows.translation: “不错，真——不错！你每次训练都在进步，斯蒂尔。嘿，也许再练几年，加上一些非法基因改造，还有，呃，来点奇迹，你说不定就能和我一样厉害了，嗯？”米琳开玩笑道，用力拍了拍你的背。这一下几乎把你拍倒
rows.raw: "“Nice, niiiice! You’re improving every session, Steele. Hey, maybe a few more years of that, some illegal gene mods and maybe a uhhh, miracle and you might be as good as me, eh?” jokes Mirrin, giving you a hearty pat on the back. It’s almost enough to knock you over"

rows.original: but you withstand it convincingly enough!
rows.translation: ，不过你颇有说服力地扛住了！
rows.raw: " but you withstand it convincingly enough!"

rows.original: You give your pulsing biceps a squeeze and an appraisal, Mirrin looking them over behind you. A thumbs up is your reward for all the hard work.
rows.translation: 你挤了挤跳动的肱二头肌，仔细审视起来，米琳也在身后打量着它们。她竖起的大拇指便是对你全部努力的回报。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give your pulsing biceps a squeeze and an appraisal, Mirrin looking them over behind you. A thumbs up is your reward for all the hard work."

rows.original: “Anyway, know what I fancy?” she asks in a neutral tone.
rows.translation: “总之，知道我现在想要什么吗？”她语气平淡地问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anyway, know what I fancy?” she asks in a neutral tone."

rows.original: “What?”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What?”"

rows.original: <i>“Oh you know, food!
rows.translation: <i>“哦，你知道的，食物！
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Oh you know, food!"

rows.original: Orrr... maybe a piece of you, if you’ll let me,
rows.translation: 又——或者...如果你愿意，也许尝一口你，
rows.raw: " Orrr... maybe a piece of you, if you’ll let me,"

rows.original: ” she purrs with a hungry need in her eyes.
rows.translation: ”她低声咕哝，眼中充满饥渴的欲望。
rows.raw: "” she purrs with a hungry need in her eyes."

rows.original: Chow Time!
rows.translation: 开饭了！
rows.raw: "Chow Time!"

rows.original: Chow Time!
rows.translation: 开饭了！
rows.raw: "Chow Time!"

rows.original: GET FOOD, WOO.
rows.translation: 去弄吃的，芜——！
rows.raw: "GET FOOD, WOO."

rows.original: Her Place
rows.translation: 她家
rows.raw: "Her Place"

rows.original: Her Place
rows.translation: 她家
rows.raw: "Her Place"

rows.original: You definitely haven’t gotten the okay for this.
rows.translation: 你显然还没有得到这么做的许可。
rows.raw: "You definitely haven’t gotten the okay for this."

rows.original: Her Place
rows.translation: 她家
rows.raw: "Her Place"

rows.original: Her Place
rows.translation: 她家
rows.raw: "Her Place"

rows.original: Maybe talk to her about last time, give her some confidence.
rows.translation: 也许该和她谈谈上次的事，给她一点信心。
rows.raw: "Maybe talk to her about last time, give her some confidence."

rows.original: Her Place
rows.translation: 她家
rows.raw: "Her Place"

rows.original: Her Place
rows.translation: 她家
rows.raw: "Her Place"

rows.original: Into the dragon’s lair...
rows.translation: 深入龙穴...
rows.raw: "Into the dragon’s lair..."

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: You decline, feeling that you’ve got what you’ve wanted for now. She smiles, says “No worries,” and gets back to her routine. You leave the room with the amazing afterglow from working out.
rows.translation: 你拒绝了，觉得现在已经得到了想要的东西。她微笑着说“没关系，”然后继续自己的训练。你带着运动后的美妙余韵离开房间。
rows.raw: "You decline, feeling that you’ve got what you’ve wanted for now. She smiles, says “No worries,” and gets back to her routine. You leave the room with the amazing afterglow from working out."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: NYE.NEWTEXAS.528
rows.raw: "NYE.NEWTEXAS.528"

rows.original: You both head over to the Barbecue Pit, Mirrin in the lead. The walk is thankfully slow, enough for you to work out the excess energy and acid built up in your [pc.legs]. New Texas is balmy today, a little on the subdued side.
rows.translation: 你们一同前往烧烤坑，米琳走在前面。所幸步伐缓慢，足以让你缓解[pc.legs]中积累的多余能量和乳酸。今天的新德克萨斯气候宜人，气氛略显平静。
rows.raw: "You both head over to the Barbecue Pit, Mirrin in the lead. The walk is thankfully slow, enough for you to work out the excess energy and acid built up in your [pc.legs]. New Texas is balmy today, a little on the subdued side."

rows.original: Entering the grill proper,
rows.translation: 进入烧烤店后，
rows.raw: "\n\nEntering the grill proper, "

rows.original: the chef
rows.translation: 厨师
rows.raw: "the chef"

rows.original: Herman
rows.translation: 赫尔曼
rows.raw: "Herman"

rows.original: gives you both a wave. Mirrin waves back while you’re scouting for seats.
