It’s a surprisingly quiet day in the eatery: Aside the sound of sizzling meat, there’s only a few voices around the slightly smoky room. “I got this,” Mirrin says, walking to the BBQ pit with a slight spring in her step. Her hooves make a certain clack on the tiled floor. She holds two fingers up to Herman. He gives her a smiling nod and holds up eight of his own.
rows.translation: 向你们挥手致意。米琳挥手回应，而你则寻找座位。餐厅今天出奇地安静：除了肉在烤架上的滋滋声，略带烟雾的房间里只有寥寥几道说话声。“我来搞定，”米琳说道，脚步轻快地走向烧烤坑。她的蹄子踩在瓷砖地面上，发出独特的嗒声。她向赫尔曼举起两根手指，对方微笑点头，并竖起自己的八根手指。
rows.raw: " gives you both a wave. Mirrin waves back while you’re scouting for seats. It’s a surprisingly quiet day in the eatery: Aside the sound of sizzling meat, there’s only a few voices around the slightly smoky room. “I got this,” Mirrin says, walking to the BBQ pit with a slight spring in her step. Her hooves make a certain clack on the tiled floor. She holds two fingers up to Herman. He gives her a smiling nod and holds up eight of his own."

rows.original: You’re seated in a fairly accommodating booth. Probably for the best, given how large the clientele tend to be. Like your dad used to say: ‘Everything’s appropriately sized in New Texas’.
rows.translation: 你们坐进一处相当宽敞的卡座。鉴于这里的顾客通常体型庞大，这大概是最好的安排。就像你父亲过去常说的：“新德克萨斯的一切尺寸都恰到好处。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re seated in a fairly accommodating booth. Probably for the best, given how large the clientele tend to be. Like your dad used to say: ‘Everything’s appropriately sized in New Texas’."

rows.original: Mirrin saunters over with two beer bottles. She plops one down on your side and slides into the other seat. “Not too long, Steele. You’re gonna love this,” she winks.
rows.translation: 米琳拿着两瓶啤酒缓步走来。她把一瓶放到你这边，然后滑进对面的座位。“不会等太久的，斯蒂尔。你会喜欢这个，”她眨眼说道。
rows.raw: "\n\nMirrin saunters over with two beer bottles. She plops one down on your side and slides into the other seat. “Not too long, Steele. You’re gonna love this,” she winks."

rows.original: Now’s a good a time as any to ask her about your performance.
rows.translation: 现在正是询问她如何评价你表现的好时机。
rows.raw: "\n\nNow’s a good a time as any to ask her about your performance."

rows.original: “Solid, I’d say. Not quite professional level but you know your stuff,” she says calmly, neutral in her tone. “I think we’ll do well, at least.”
rows.translation: “我会说，很扎实。还没到专业水平，但你知道该怎么做，”她平静地说道，语气中性。“至少我觉得我们会配合得不错。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Solid, I’d say. Not quite professional level but you know your stuff,” she says calmly, neutral in her tone. “I think we’ll do well, at least.”"

rows.original: “Better than I expected, actually. You’ve got good control, I think we could make this work,” she says with a positive inflection, although her face remains neutral.
rows.translation: “说实话，比我预想中更好。你的控制力不错，我觉得这事能成，”她用肯定的语调说道，脸上却依然毫无波澜。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Better than I expected, actually. You’ve got good control, I think we could make this work,” she says with a positive inflection, although her face remains neutral."

rows.original: “Hmm, don’t think you did badly, but there’s a ways to go,” she says bluntly. “S’alright though, is what you’re here for, yes?”
rows.translation: “嗯，我不觉得你表现很差，不过还有很长的路要走，”她直率地说道。“但没关系，你来这里不就是为了这个，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmm, don’t think you did badly, but there’s a ways to go,” she says bluntly. “S’alright though, is what you’re here for, yes?”"

rows.original: You’re a little relieved by her appraisal.
rows.translation: 她的评价让你稍微松了口气。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re a little relieved by her appraisal."

rows.original: “I like your attitude about it too, it’s not just your words but your drive,” she posits, rubbing her nose.
rows.translation: “我也喜欢你对这件事的态度，不只是嘴上说说，还有你的动力，”她一边揉鼻子一边说道。
rows.raw: " “I like your attitude about it too, it’s not just your words but your drive,” she posits, rubbing her nose."

rows.original: “That extra puff isn’t uhhh, doing much good for you though,” she adds, pinching a bit of your shoulder fat. You’re not sure if you’re comfortable with that...
rows.translation: “不过多出来的这点软肉，呃，对你可没什么好处，”她补充道，捏了捏你肩上的脂肪。你不确定自己是否喜欢这样...
rows.raw: " “That extra puff isn’t uhhh, doing much good for you though,” she adds, pinching a bit of your shoulder fat. You’re not sure if you’re comfortable with that..."

rows.original: A ding chimes somewhere and Mirrin reflexively gets up and wanders over to the counter. She comes back with four different, huge, punnets of food balanced in her hands and arms. Placing them down, you see that ho-lee shit, it’s the works: Steak, ribs, fries, salad, all with their own side sauces.
rows.translation: 某处响起一声提示音，米琳下意识地站起身，走向柜台。她回来时，双手和手臂上稳稳托着四个不同的巨型食物盒。放下后你才看清，我——的——天，真是应有尽有：牛排、肋排、薯条、沙拉，每样还都配有各自的蘸酱。
rows.raw: "\n\nA ding chimes somewhere and Mirrin reflexively gets up and wanders over to the counter. She comes back with four different, huge, punnets of food balanced in her hands and arms. Placing them down, you see that ho-lee shit, it’s the works: Steak, ribs, fries, salad, all with their own side sauces."

rows.original: Time to chow down! You both dive into different dishes. Your [pc.lipsChaste] are already wrapping round some sauce slathered ribs, the flame-blasted meat just falling into your mouth. There’s definitely enough to go around for two but you’re watching Mirrin and she’s... really going at it. The sides of her mouth have at least three different sauces dotted around already, and she’s got a chunk of steak resting in between her claws.
rows.translation: 该大吃一顿了！你们同时扑向不同的菜肴。你的[pc.lipsChaste]已经裹住涂满酱汁的肋排，火焰炙烤的肉几乎自行滑入口中。食物肯定够两个人吃，但你看着米琳，她却...吃得实在凶猛。她嘴角已经沾上至少三种不同的酱汁，爪子之间还夹着一大块牛排。
rows.raw: "\n\nTime to chow down! You both dive into different dishes. Your [pc.lipsChaste] are already wrapping round some sauce slathered ribs, the flame-blasted meat just falling into your mouth. There’s definitely enough to go around for two but you’re watching Mirrin and she’s... really going at it. The sides of her mouth have at least three different sauces dotted around already, and she’s got a chunk of steak resting in between her claws."

rows.original: “Fuckin’ greatest place in the world,” she says in between mouthfuls.
rows.translation: “这他妈是全世界最棒的地方，”她在进食的间隙说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fuckin’ greatest place in the world,” she says in between mouthfuls. "

rows.original: You beam back at her, sensing a secret shared love:
rows.translation: 你朝她灿烂一笑，感受到彼此暗藏的共同爱好：
rows.raw: "You beam back at her, sensing a secret shared love: "

rows.original: You encourage her with a few ribs, realizing the shared secret you have:
rows.translation: 你用几根肋排为她助兴，意识到你们共同的秘密：
rows.raw: "You encourage her with a few ribs, realizing the shared secret you have: "

rows.original: You eyeroll at her enthusiasm but realize you’re enjoying the same thing:
rows.translation: 你对她的热情翻了个白眼，却发现自己也在享受同一件事：
rows.raw: "You eyeroll at her enthusiasm but realize you’re enjoying the same thing: "

rows.original: stuffing juicy meat into your mouth.
rows.translation: 把多汁的肉塞进嘴里。
rows.raw: "stuffing juicy meat into your mouth."

rows.original: There doesn’t seem to be much room to talk: It takes a straight twenty minutes for you to both clear out the food, although Mirrin definitely took the lion’s share. Your body’s going to be angry at you sooner rather than later... and Mirrin’s just out for the count. Slovenly hunched over, it seems she’s had more than she can handle. You wonder if she’s hiding something from you...
rows.translation: 似乎没什么机会说话：你们足足花了二十分钟才把食物清空，不过米琳显然吃掉了大头。你的身体迟早会为此向你抗议...而米琳已经彻底不省人事。她懒散地弓身趴着，看来吃得超过了承受极限。你怀疑她是不是有什么事瞒着你...
rows.raw: "\n\nThere doesn’t seem to be much room to talk: It takes a straight twenty minutes for you to both clear out the food, although Mirrin definitely took the lion’s share. Your body’s going to be angry at you sooner rather than later... and Mirrin’s just out for the count. Slovenly hunched over, it seems she’s had more than she can handle. You wonder if she’s hiding something from you..."

rows.original: “Can’t... fuckin’... ertu að djóka, I’m... so bad,” she says, staring at the empty punnets. She slowly dunks her head on the table, her normally immaculate hair looking frazzled. You almost get grazed by her horns...
rows.translation: “真...他妈...的，你在开玩笑吗，我...太糟糕了，”她盯着空食盒说道。她缓缓把脑袋砸到桌上，平日一丝不乱的头发也显得凌乱。她的角差点擦到你...
rows.raw: "\n\n“Can’t... fuckin’... ertu að djóka, I’m... so bad,” she says, staring at the empty punnets. She slowly dunks her head on the table, her normally immaculate hair looking frazzled. You almost get grazed by her horns..."

rows.original: Thinking that she’d probably be better off to take a breather before trying to move, you say your goodbyes. She’s laughing to herself but gives you a lazy wave anyway. Back to the ship!
rows.translation: 你觉得她最好先喘口气再尝试移动，于是向她告别。她独自笑个不停，但还是懒洋洋地朝你挥手。回飞船吧！
rows.raw: "\n\nThinking that she’d probably be better off to take a breather before trying to move, you say your goodbyes. She’s laughing to herself but gives you a lazy wave anyway. Back to the ship!"

rows.original: You both make your way over to the grill, a little on the slow side. There aren’t many words said but there’s a few jokes to be made about some shy bull-boys gossiping about Mirrin.
rows.translation: 你们一同缓慢走向烧烤店。一路没说几句话，不过倒是拿几个正在议论米琳的害羞牛族男孩开了些玩笑。
rows.raw: "You both make your way over to the grill, a little on the slow side. There aren’t many words said but there’s a few jokes to be made about some shy bull-boys gossiping about Mirrin."

rows.original: When you enter, it’s at a busy time. The line is quite long and there even appears to be temporary servers dishing out meals. Still, Mirrin just walks up to the counter, gives the same sign to Herman as last time and comes back with two beers.
rows.translation: 进去时正值忙碌时段。队伍相当长，甚至似乎还有临时服务员在分发餐点。不过米琳径直走到柜台，对赫尔曼做出和上次一样的手势，随后带着两瓶啤酒回来。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you enter, it’s at a busy time. The line is quite long and there even appears to be temporary servers dishing out meals. Still, Mirrin just walks up to the counter, gives the same sign to Herman as last time and comes back with two beers."

rows.original: You find a similar spot to last time, tucked away from most of the crowd. When she slides into her seat, you ask her about how she’s able to get preferred service.
rows.translation: 你们找到一个和上次相似的位置，远离大部分人群。她滑进座位后，你询问她为什么能享受优先服务。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou find a similar spot to last time, tucked away from most of the crowd. When she slides into her seat, you ask her about how she’s able to get preferred service."

rows.original: “Oh, uhh... Herman’s a very big fan. Very willing to help a girl out...” she says, giving you a wink. “Same with Quenton actually. You know, as far as low-level business deals go, New Texas has been... accommodating.”
rows.translation: “哦，呃...赫尔曼是个非常狂热的粉丝，很愿意帮姑娘一点忙...”她眨眼说道。“其实昆顿也一样。你知道，就小规模商业交易而言，新德克萨斯一直...很通融。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, uhh... Herman’s a very big fan. Very willing to help a girl out...” she says, giving you a wink. “Same with Quenton actually. You know, as far as low-level business deals go, New Texas has been... accommodating.”"

rows.original: The implication sounds sordid in the least.
rows.translation: 这番暗示听起来至少十分淫秽。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe implication sounds sordid in the least."

rows.original: “Oh that reminds me, remember this?” She asks, showing you the photo of you two from last time. It seems to have gone through even more stylizing, enough that you’re not even sure if that’s the real you in the picture. “Watch.”
rows.translation: “哦，这倒提醒我了，还记得这个吗？”她问道，向你展示上次拍的双人照片。它似乎经过了更多美化，以至于你甚至不确定照片里的是不是真正的自己。“看着。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh that reminds me, remember this?” She asks, showing you the photo of you two from last time. It seems to have gone through even more stylizing, enough that you’re not even sure if that’s the real you in the picture. “Watch.”"

rows.original: She taps on a few buttons, then puts it down. “Promise, just watch,” she says, a knowing grin on her face.
rows.translation: 她点了几个按钮，然后把它放下。“相信我，看着就好，”她说道，脸上露出心照不宣的笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe taps on a few buttons, then puts it down. “Promise, just watch,” she says, a knowing grin on her face."

rows.original: What sounds like a chorus of various different alerts fills the restaurant. The bulls - and a lot of the cows - pull out various handheld devices and open them up. Being a friendly bunch, they’re all showing each other with saucy grins and whistles.
rows.translation: 各种各样的提示音仿佛合唱般充满餐厅。公牛们——以及许多奶牛——纷纷拿出各式手持设备并将其打开。他们都是群友善的家伙，正带着下流的坏笑和口哨声互相展示。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat sounds like a chorus of various different alerts fills the restaurant. The bulls - and a lot of the cows - pull out various handheld devices and open them up. Being a friendly bunch, they’re all showing each other with saucy grins and whistles."

rows.original: “Uhm, what did I just see?” You begin, not quite making the connection.
rows.translation: “呃，我刚才看到了什么？”你开口道，仍没弄明白其中的联系。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Uhm, what did I just see?” You begin, not quite making the connection."

rows.original: “Hiding in plain sight,” she replies, sniffing at the end of it.
rows.translation: “藏在最显眼的地方，”她回答，末了还吸了吸鼻子。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hiding in plain sight,” she replies, sniffing at the end of it."

rows.original: “So what, you’re a hacker too?” You say with a laugh.
rows.translation: “所以呢，你还是个黑客？”你笑着说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So what, you’re a hacker too?” You say with a laugh."

rows.original: She giggles, more feminine than her usual laugh. “No, nooo. But it’s interesting, right?”
rows.translation: 她咯咯笑起来，比平常的笑声更有女人味。“不，不——是。不过这很有意思，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe giggles, more feminine than her usual laugh. “No, nooo. But it’s interesting, right?”"

rows.original: “Hm, surprised they even have extranet here,” you say, trying not to sound impressed.
rows.translation: “嗯，没想到这里居然还有星际网，”你说道，努力不让自己显得钦佩。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hm, surprised they even have extranet here,” you say, trying not to sound impressed."

rows.original: “Oh Steele, so pious,” she chides, then laughs.
rows.translation: “哦，斯蒂尔，真是道貌岸然，”她揶揄了一句，随后笑起来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh Steele, so pious,” she chides, then laughs."

rows.original: “So... everyone’s a little odd around me. At least here, on New Texas. Other planets, ooh, waah, big celebrity, crowd, crowd, crowd,” she begins explaining in her own special way. “But uh... for whatever reasons, very few here want to talk to me. And yet... they all have my social media alerts. I just know that they’re gonna get home or have five minutes in the toilet and just blow their loads over all this,” she says, pointing up and down her frame.
rows.translation: “所以...我身边的每个人都有点奇怪。至少在新德克萨斯是这样。换成其他星球，哦，哇，大明星，人群、人群、还是人群，”她用自己独特的方式解释起来。“可呃...不知为什么，这里几乎没人愿意跟我说话。然而...他们全都开着我的社交媒体提醒。我就是知道，他们回家以后，或者在厕所里待上五分钟，就会对着这一切狠狠干到射出来，”她说着，上下指了指自己的身体。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So... everyone’s a little odd around me. At least here, on New Texas. Other planets, ooh, waah, big celebrity, crowd, crowd, crowd,” she begins explaining in her own special way. “But uh... for whatever reasons, very few here want to talk to me. And yet... they all have my social media alerts. I just know that they’re gonna get home or have five minutes in the toilet and just blow their loads over all this,” she says, pointing up and down her frame."

rows.original: How curious, you posit. There’s not much more that can be said in time as the food arrives.
rows.translation: 真奇怪，你如此评价道。食物随即送到，也没有时间再多说什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nHow curious, you posit. There’s not much more that can be said in time as the food arrives."

rows.original: “Aw, all this beef,” says a woozy Mirrin. It’s mostly the same as the last meal you had with her but the fries appear to be covered in some sort of cheese and gravy. You deal out a generous portion for yourself and tuck in.
rows.translation: “啊，这么多牛肉，”晕乎乎的米琳说道。大体和你上次与她吃的那顿相同，只是薯条上似乎盖了某种奶酪和肉汁。你给自己分了满满一份，开始大吃。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Aw, all this beef,” says a woozy Mirrin. It’s mostly the same as the last meal you had with her but the fries appear to be covered in some sort of cheese and gravy. You deal out a generous portion for yourself and tuck in."

rows.original: Mirrin seems to be eating slower than last time. You ask her about the sudden change.
rows.translation: 米琳似乎吃得比上次慢。你询问她为何突然改变。
rows.raw: "\n\nMirrin seems to be eating slower than last time. You ask her about the sudden change."

rows.original: She stops mid-steak. “Ey, so... obviously being this uhhh, jacked, you need pure physical matter to build yourself with. Buuut... I was also a compulsive eater when I was younger. Eh, I’m good at maintaining myself but I can just... eat and eat, until it comes back to bite me,” she says, a little embarrassed. She even puts down her fingerful of diced steak.
rows.translation: 她吃牛排吃到一半停了下来。“哎，所以...很明显，要维持这么，呃，壮硕的身体，就需要真正的物质来构建自己。但——是...我小时候也有强迫性进食的问题。呃，我很擅长维持身材，可我就是会...不停地吃啊吃，直到自食其果，”她有些尴尬地说道，甚至放下了指间那块切好的牛排。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe stops mid-steak. “Ey, so... obviously being this uhhh, jacked, you need pure physical matter to build yourself with. Buuut... I was also a compulsive eater when I was younger. Eh, I’m good at maintaining myself but I can just... eat and eat, until it comes back to bite me,” she says, a little embarrassed. She even puts down her fingerful of diced steak."

rows.original: “Gah, what kind of personal trainer gorges in front of her client, eh? Enough for me,” she concedes, downing a big glug of beer.
rows.translation: “呃，哪有私人教练在客户面前胡吃海塞的，嗯？我吃够了，”她认输道，一口灌下大杯啤酒。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Gah, what kind of personal trainer gorges in front of her client, eh? Enough for me,” she concedes, downing a big glug of beer."

rows.original: “I guess we’re both getting something out of this, right?” You say to her, taking a swig with her.
rows.translation: “我猜我们都能从中得到些好处，对吧？”你对她说道，和她一起喝了一口。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I guess we’re both getting something out of this, right?” You say to her, taking a swig with her."

rows.original: She eyes you for a second then raises her bottle. “Hmm... good point, Steele. Cheers!”
rows.translation: 她看了你一秒，然后举起酒瓶。“嗯...说得好，斯蒂尔。干杯！”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe eyes you for a second then raises her bottle. “Hmm... good point, Steele. Cheers!”"

rows.original: “That’s right, you gotta be my role model, you slob,” you joke, raising your bottle to her.
rows.translation: “没错，你得当我的榜样，你这懒鬼，”你开玩笑道，朝她举起酒瓶。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s right, you gotta be my role model, you slob,” you joke, raising your bottle to her."

rows.original: “One of these days, Steele,” she sighs, clinking her bottle with yours.
rows.translation: “总有一天，斯蒂尔，”她叹气道，用酒瓶与你碰杯。
rows.raw: "\n\n“One of these days, Steele,” she sighs, clinking her bottle with yours."

rows.original: “Maybe you’ve got more to learn than I do,” you say, throwing back a swig of beer.
rows.translation: “也许你要学的比我更多，”你说道，仰头喝了一口啤酒。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Maybe you’ve got more to learn than I do,” you say, throwing back a swig of beer."

rows.original: “Jeez, you’re such a... kúkalabbi,” she smiles, waving your statement away.
rows.translation: “天啊，你真是个... 小臭蛋，”她笑着摆手驳回你的话。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Jeez, you’re such a... kúkalabbi,” she smiles, waving your statement away."

rows.original: You finish off your fill of food in a short while, the weight of all that deliciously grilled meat slowing your body and mind right down. Mirrin’s finished too, just idly fiddling around with her dataslate while sipping on a last bit of beer.
rows.translation: 你很快吃完了自己的份量，那些烤得无比美味的肉沉甸甸地压着胃，让你的身心都慢了下来。米琳也吃完了，只是一边啜饮最后一点啤酒，一边漫不经心地摆弄数据板。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou finish off your fill of food in a short while, the weight of all that deliciously grilled meat slowing your body and mind right down. Mirrin’s finished too, just idly fiddling around with her dataslate while sipping on a last bit of beer."

rows.original: After a day of emptying and then filling yourself again like the confusing person you are, you decide it’s time to return to the ship. You wave goodbye to your trainer. “See ya, Steele,” she says back, vaguely gesturing a wave with her hand.
rows.translation: 像你这样一个让人摸不着头脑的家伙，经历了一整天先掏空自己、再把自己填满之后，你决定该返回飞船了。你向教练挥手告别。“回见，斯蒂尔，”她回应道，含糊地抬手挥了挥。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a day of emptying and then filling yourself again like the confusing person you are, you decide it’s time to return to the ship. You wave goodbye to your trainer. “See ya, Steele,” she says back, vaguely gesturing a wave with her hand."

rows.original: Although it’s all gone by, you both joke about the exploding bikini while you amble down to the Barbecue Pit. It’s made Mirrin more open and less aloof, you surmise, especially by the way she’s laughing at every joke - lame or otherwise - that you put forward.
rows.translation: 虽然事情已经过去，你们缓步前往烧烤坑时仍拿那件爆裂的比基尼开着玩笑。你猜这让米琳变得更加坦率、不再那么冷漠；尤其是你抛出的每个笑话——无论好坏——她都会大笑。
rows.raw: "Although it’s all gone by, you both joke about the exploding bikini while you amble down to the Barbecue Pit. It’s made Mirrin more open and less aloof, you surmise, especially by the way she’s laughing at every joke - lame or otherwise - that you put forward."

rows.original: She’s particularly enthralled about the time you got confused for the main character from a time-revered Terran porn novel.
rows.translation: 她尤其迷恋你被误认成一部经久不衰的泰伦色情小说主角的那次经历。
rows.raw: " She’s particularly enthralled about the time you got confused for the main character from a time-revered Terran porn novel."

rows.original: The eatery seems to be chugging along regularly today, even though there appears to be several trysts floating around the back of the room. Mirrin makes her usual gesture, Herman signaling back with a gesture you’ve never seen him do before. Hmm...
rows.translation: 餐厅今天似乎照常忙碌，尽管房间后方好像正上演着好几场幽会。米琳做出惯常的手势，赫尔曼却用一个你从没见过的动作回应。嗯...
rows.raw: "\n\nThe eatery seems to be chugging along regularly today, even though there appears to be several trysts floating around the back of the room. Mirrin makes her usual gesture, Herman signaling back with a gesture you’ve never seen him do before. Hmm..."

rows.original: Finding a more open table closer to the serving counter, you immediately feel compelled to talk about today’s...happenings.
rows.translation: 你们在离上菜柜台较近的地方找到一张更开阔的桌子，你立刻感到不得不谈谈今天的...那些事。
rows.raw: "\n\nFinding a more open table closer to the serving counter, you immediately feel compelled to talk about today’s...happenings."

rows.original: “Jeez, I don’t mind the whole clothes thing it’s just... feeling all those bull’s eyes staring at us. Like holy shit, not everyone just gets their rocks off of as soon as they get their clothes off, you know?” She starts, keeping a grin on her face.
rows.translation: “天啊，我倒不介意衣服那件事，只是...那些公牛全都盯着我们看。老天，又不是每个人一脱掉衣服就会立刻性奋到射出来，懂吗？”她开口道，脸上仍带着笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Jeez, I don’t mind the whole clothes thing it’s just... feeling all those bull’s eyes staring at us. Like holy shit, not everyone just gets their rocks off of as soon as they get their clothes off, you know?” She starts, keeping a grin on her face."

rows.original: “Hmm, explains why there were loads of them though... see that bikini was a new model, very expensive, very exclusive. I was lucky to land that contract. Obviously, suppliers fucked up, doesn’t fit me at all. At least I got something to show the fans though.”
rows.translation: “嗯，不过这倒解释了为什么有那么多人...你看，那套比基尼是新款，非常昂贵，也极其独家。我能拿到那份合约算是走运。显然供应商搞砸了，它根本不合身。不过至少我有东西可以展示给粉丝。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmm, explains why there were loads of them though... see that bikini was a new model, very expensive, very exclusive. I was lucky to land that contract. Obviously, suppliers fucked up, doesn’t fit me at all. At least I got something to show the fans though.”"

rows.original: She shows you a picture of that pose where her meatsticks dangled very close to your mouth.
rows.translation: 她给你看了一张那个姿势的照片，当时她的两根肉棒垂在离你嘴巴极近的地方。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe shows you a picture of that pose where her meatsticks dangled very close to your mouth."

rows.original: You pull a very embarrassed, flushed red face, crossing your arms close to your [pc.chest]. “Jeez, I can’t believe you kept that...” you timidly respond.
rows.translation: 你露出极其窘迫、涨得通红的表情，双臂紧紧交叉在[pc.chest]前。“天啊，真不敢相信你还留着那张...”你怯生生地回应。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou pull a very embarrassed, flushed red face, crossing your arms close to your [pc.chest]. “Jeez, I can’t believe you kept that...” you timidly respond."

rows.original: She girlishly giggles - a rare thing for her - eyeing you while she rests her head on her palm. “You’re adorable like that,” she teases.
rows.translation: 她像个女孩般咯咯笑起来——这对她十分罕见——一边把头枕在掌心，一边看着你。“你这样真可爱，”她戏弄道。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe girlishly giggles - a rare thing for her - eyeing you while she rests her head on her palm. “You’re adorable like that,” she teases."

rows.original: “And send,” she says out loud, tapping on her dataslate.
rows.translation: “发送，”她大声说道，轻点数据板。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And send,” she says out loud, tapping on her dataslate."

rows.original: “Oh my FUCK...” you blurt out with exasperation, proceeding to bury your head in your arms on the table.
rows.translation: “我操...”你气急败坏地脱口而出，接着把头埋进桌上的双臂里。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh my FUCK...” you blurt out with exasperation, proceeding to bury your head in your arms on the table."

rows.original: Mirrin lets out a big belly laugh. “Baha! Your fokking face! So precious!”
rows.translation: 米琳开怀大笑。“哈哈！瞧你那张该死的脸！太可爱了！”
rows.raw: "\n\nMirrin lets out a big belly laugh. “Baha! Your fokking face! So precious!”"

rows.original: “And send,” she says out loud, tapping on her dataslate. Great.
rows.translation: “发送，”她大声说道，轻点数据板。真棒。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And send,” she says out loud, tapping on her dataslate. Great."

rows.original: “Oh you are not putting that online,” you angrily say back, pointing right at her.
rows.translation: “你不准把那东西放到网上，”你愤怒地回应，直指着她。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh you are not putting that online,” you angrily say back, pointing right at her."

rows.original: “Already trendiiiing,” she chimes melodiously, shaking the device in her hand. You slouch back with your head in your hands. “Aw, you’re so cute like that, Steele...” she teases.
rows.translation: “已经在上热——搜了，”她旋律般欢快地说道，摇晃着手中设备。你双手抱头，瘫坐回去。“啊，你这样真可爱，斯蒂尔...”她戏弄道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Already trendiiiing,” she chimes melodiously, shaking the device in her hand. You slouch back with your head in your hands. “Aw, you’re so cute like that, Steele...” she teases."

rows.original: There’s a ding and a cow-server comes by with food. She gives you both a wink, presenting just two big punnets of food: More cheesy gravy fries but also what looks like huge slab of pulled pork smothered in a dark glaze.
rows.translation: 一声提示音响起，一名奶牛服务员端着食物走来。她朝你们眨眨眼，只摆上两个大食物盒：除了更多奶酪肉汁薯条，还有一大块浇满深色酱汁的手撕猪肉。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s a ding and a cow-server comes by with food. She gives you both a wink, presenting just two big punnets of food: More cheesy gravy fries but also what looks like huge slab of pulled pork smothered in a dark glaze."

rows.original: “Eat up, babes,” she winks to you both, then trots off with a wiggle of her hips.
rows.translation: “快吃吧，宝贝们，”她向你们眨眨眼，随后扭着臀部小跑离开。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Eat up, babes,” she winks to you both, then trots off with a wiggle of her hips."

rows.original: Mirrin is sitting there slack jawed. “Hoooo... ly shit. I just... dibs!” she calls out, stabbing it in the side with a disposable fork.
rows.translation: 米琳张口结舌地坐在那里。“我——的...天。我要...先吃！”她喊道，用一次性叉子扎进肉块侧面。
rows.raw: "\n\nMirrin is sitting there slack jawed. “Hoooo... ly shit. I just... dibs!” she calls out, stabbing it in the side with a disposable fork."

rows.original: So much for last session’s restraint...
rows.translation: 上次训练时的克制就这么没了...
rows.raw: "\n\nSo much for last session’s restraint..."

rows.original: You jump into the substantially overstacked meal, the smoky sauce glaze is particularly friendly to your nose.
rows.translation: 你扑向堆得过分丰盛的大餐，烟熏酱汁的香气尤其讨鼻子喜欢。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou jump into the substantially overstacked meal, the smoky sauce glaze is particularly friendly to your nose."

rows.original: Something about it reminds you of the indescribably rich musk of your dragon trainer. Ooo, if only you could get that close again...
rows.translation: 它不知为何让你想起龙族教练那难以形容的浓郁麝香。哦，要是还能再次那么靠近她就好了...
rows.raw: " Something about it reminds you of the indescribably rich musk of your dragon trainer. Ooo, if only you could get that close again..."

rows.original: Aside the sounds of enthusiastic noshing, you don’t say much to each other: This slab of juicy, thick meat just feels so good in your mouth!
rows.translation: 除了热情大嚼的声音，你们几乎没有交谈：这块厚实多汁的肉在嘴里的感觉实在太棒了！
rows.raw: "\n\nAside the sounds of enthusiastic noshing, you don’t say much to each other: This slab of juicy, thick meat just feels so good in your mouth!"

rows.original: Mirrin finishes a mouthful. “Just gonna grab another uhhh, beer, [pc.name],” she says, twirling a finger.
rows.translation: 米琳咽下一口食物。“我去再拿一瓶，呃，啤酒，[pc.name]，”她转着手指说道。
rows.raw: "\n\nMirrin finishes a mouthful. “Just gonna grab another uhhh, beer, [pc.name],” she says, twirling a finger."

rows.original: She gets her brewski quickly enough but a group of three shirtless bulls suddenly stand in her way. Huh... you cautiously get up to get a better look.
rows.translation: 她很快拿到了啤酒，但三名赤裸上身的公牛突然挡住去路。咦...你谨慎地站起身，想看得更清楚。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gets her brewski quickly enough but a group of three shirtless bulls suddenly stand in her way. Huh... you cautiously get up to get a better look."

rows.original: “Heeeey, darlin’,” you hear the biggest of the three say, a heavily bearded and bald alpha bull who’s only a few inches taller than Mirrin. He’s pretty much a beef mountain by the looks of things, a small pair of shorts being his only bit of clothing.
rows.translation: “嘿——，亲爱的，”你听见三人中块头最大的家伙说道。那是一头胡须浓密的秃头公牛，比米琳只高几英寸。他看起来几乎就是一座肉山，全身唯一的衣物是一条小短裤。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Heeeey, darlin’,” you hear the biggest of the three say, a heavily bearded and bald alpha bull who’s only a few inches taller than Mirrin. He’s pretty much a beef mountain by the looks of things, a small pair of shorts being his only bit of clothing."

rows.original: “Me an’ the boys saw that there picture of you an’ yer friend over there,” he says, eyeing you from behind Mirrin.
rows.translation: “我和兄弟们看到你跟那边朋友的照片了，”他说着，越过米琳打量你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Me an’ the boys saw that there picture of you an’ yer friend over there,” he says, eyeing you from behind Mirrin."

rows.original: <i>“We got ta thinkin’: bet a she-bull like you ain’t had a proper ride! I’m sure ya friend has done you right afore but
rows.translation: <i>“我们寻思着：像你这样的母牛肯定没被好好骑过！我相信你那朋友以前也把你伺候得不错，可
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“We got ta thinkin’: bet a she-bull like you ain’t had a proper ride! I’m sure ya friend has done you right afore but "

rows.original: he
rows.translation: 他
rows.raw: "he"

rows.original: she
rows.translation: 她
rows.raw: "she"

rows.original: can’t give you what we got: Pure Texas beef™, URNGH!” he boasts, posing with his chiseled guns.
rows.translation: 给不了我们拥有的东西：纯正德克萨斯牛肉™，呃嗯！”他吹嘘着，摆出姿势展示轮廓分明的臂肌。
rows.raw: " can’t give you what we got: Pure Texas beef™, URNGH!” he boasts, posing with his chiseled guns."

rows.original: He’s a proper bull alright and you’d be pulling down those useless shorts there and then if you could, just go get a taste...
rows.translation: 他确实是头货真价实的公牛；要是可以，你真想当场扯下那条没用的短裤，好好尝上一口...
rows.raw: " He’s a proper bull alright and you’d be pulling down those useless shorts there and then if you could, just go get a taste..."

rows.original: “Yeah, that’sa spirit, Doug!” says a random voice behind him.
rows.translation: “没错，就是这股劲，道格！”他身后某个声音说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, that’sa spirit, Doug!” says a random voice behind him."

rows.original: Mirrin just stands there, leaning on a forward thrusted hoof. Her look is one of sheer incredulity. She places her bottle back on the counter.
rows.translation: 米琳只是站在那里，身体靠在一只向前伸出的蹄子上，脸上满是难以置信。她把酒瓶放回柜台。
rows.raw: "\n\nMirrin just stands there, leaning on a forward thrusted hoof. Her look is one of sheer incredulity. She places her bottle back on the counter."

rows.original: “Uh, whatsaname... Doug? Listen to me, Doug,” she begins, a feigned note of friendliness in her voice. She slaps a particularly quick hand onto the bull’s bulging shoulder. He’s still smiling.
rows.translation: “呃，你叫什么来着...道格？听我说，道格，”她开口道，声音中带着假装出来的友善。她以极快的速度把一只手拍到公牛隆起的肩膀上。他依然笑着。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Uh, whatsaname... Doug? Listen to me, Doug,” she begins, a feigned note of friendliness in her voice. She slaps a particularly quick hand onto the bull’s bulging shoulder. He’s still smiling."

rows.original: “Here’s the thing...”
rows.translation: “事情是这样的...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Here’s the thing...”"

rows.original: You see her slowly squeeze, claws dug into his muscle.
rows.translation: 你看到她缓缓收紧手掌，利爪陷进他的肌肉。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou see her slowly squeeze, claws dug into his muscle."

rows.original: “Sure, that sort of thing could work on any respectable cow...”
rows.translation: “当然，这种招数对任何像样的奶牛都可能奏效...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sure, that sort of thing could work on any respectable cow...”"

rows.original: Very visibly, his arm seems to tense and spasm. His face is contorted in pain and the speechless bull is gradually sinking to the floor.
rows.translation: 他的手臂明显绷紧并开始抽搐。脸因痛苦而扭曲；说不出话的公牛逐渐跪向地面。
rows.raw: "\n\nVery visibly, his arm seems to tense and spasm. His face is contorted in pain and the speechless bull is gradually sinking to the floor."

rows.original: “But you certainly” - did she just growl? “are not on my level. Take your friends...”
rows.translation: “但你绝对”——她刚才低吼了吗？“配不上我的层次。带上你的朋友...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But you certainly” - did she just growl? “are not on my level. Take your friends...”"

rows.original: He’s on his knee, desperately clutching at her unmoving, locked fingers.
rows.translation: 他单膝跪地，拼命抓着她纹丝不动、牢牢扣紧的手指。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe’s on his knee, desperately clutching at her unmoving, locked fingers."

rows.original: “And fuck right off.”
rows.translation: “然后赶紧滚蛋。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And fuck right off.”"

rows.original: She lets go and instantly, the defeated bull staggers back with him and his cohorts backing out of the restaurant. Wow.
rows.translation: 她一松手，战败的公牛立刻踉跄后退，与同伴们一同退出餐厅。哇哦。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe lets go and instantly, the defeated bull staggers back with him and his cohorts backing out of the restaurant. Wow."

rows.original: The room has mostly turned quiet but Herman calls out “Nothin’ ta see, folks! Come getcha grub!”
rows.translation: 房间里大多安静下来，但赫尔曼高喊道：“没啥好看的，各位！快来拿吃的！”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe room has mostly turned quiet but Herman calls out “Nothin’ ta see, folks! Come getcha grub!”"

rows.original: Normalcy ensues.
rows.translation: 一切恢复正常。
rows.raw: "\n\nNormalcy ensues."

rows.original: Grabbing her beer, she swaggers back over to you with a look of pride. She slides into her seat like nothing happened. You follow her.
rows.translation: 她拿起啤酒，满脸骄傲地大摇大摆走回你身旁，仿佛什么都没发生般滑进座位。你也跟了过去。
rows.raw: "\n\nGrabbing her beer, she swaggers back over to you with a look of pride. She slides into her seat like nothing happened. You follow her."

rows.original: “So...” she says, hand on beer.
rows.translation: “所以...”她一手按着啤酒说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So...” she says, hand on beer."

rows.original: “Are... you alright? Is he alright?” You inquire, a little anxious.
rows.translation: “你...没事吧？他没事吧？”你有些焦虑地问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Are... you alright? Is he alright?” You inquire, a little anxious."

rows.original: She looks at you with somewhat tired eyes. “Mmm, don’t worry about me. Or him, actually. It’s fine, [pc.name],” she says with a weak grin.
rows.translation: 她用略显疲惫的眼神看着你。“嗯，别担心我。其实也不用担心他。没事的，[pc.name]，”她勉强笑道。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe looks at you with somewhat tired eyes. “Mmm, don’t worry about me. Or him, actually. It’s fine, [pc.name],” she says with a weak grin."

rows.original: “Jeez... you could crush a brick with those hands,” you say with a hint of awe.
rows.translation: “天啊...你那双手能捏碎砖头，”你带着一丝敬畏说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Jeez... you could crush a brick with those hands,” you say with a hint of awe."

rows.original: “Not could; can,” she says with a wink. “He’ll be fine though, just something he’ll feel for a few days.”
rows.translation: “不是‘能’，是‘确实能’，”她眨眼说道。“不过他不会有事，只是接下来几天会一直有感觉。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not could; can,” she says with a wink. “He’ll be fine though, just something he’ll feel for a few days.”"

rows.original: “Are you insane? You could’ve ripped his damned arm off,” you say, mixing concern with disbelief.
rows.translation: “你疯了吗？你差点把他那条该死的胳膊扯下来，”你既担忧又难以置信地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Are you insane? You could’ve ripped his damned arm off,” you say, mixing concern with disbelief."

rows.original: “Literally asking for it,” she says, downing her beer. “Or not literally. Whichever.”
rows.translation: “他真的是自找的，”她灌下啤酒。“或者不算字面意义上的自找。随便吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Literally asking for it,” she says, downing her beer. “Or not literally. Whichever.”"

rows.original: She flares her nose and inhales deeply. “Guy deserved it though. Don’t go mixing horny and dumbass, else that happens. Thankfully, New Texas is mostly just horny,” she opines with a smirk. “Hmm, although... sometimes those uhhh, amazon types are just begging for a fist. Especially that Zephyr nutjob or whatever her name is.”
rows.translation: 她张开鼻翼，深深吸气。“不过那家伙活该。别把饥渴和愚蠢混在一起，否则就是这种下场。幸好新德克萨斯的人大多只是饥渴，”她坏笑着评价道。“嗯，不过...有时那些，呃，亚马逊类型的家伙就是欠拳头。尤其是那个叫泽菲尔还是别的什么的疯子。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe flares her nose and inhales deeply. “Guy deserved it though. Don’t go mixing horny and dumbass, else that happens. Thankfully, New Texas is mostly just horny,” she opines with a smirk. “Hmm, although... sometimes those uhhh, amazon types are just begging for a fist. Especially that Zephyr nutjob or whatever her name is.”"

rows.original: You’re not sure on what version of ‘fist’ she means.
rows.translation: 你不确定她说的是哪一种“拳头”。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re not sure on what version of ‘fist’ she means."

rows.original: Slurp “You know, I turned down her arm wrestle thing and she got super pissy. Eh, fuck it though,” she finishes, leaving her empty bottle on the table.
rows.translation: 吸溜“你知道吗，我拒绝了她掰手腕那回事，她就变得超级恼火。呃，不过管她呢，”她说完，把空瓶留在桌上。
rows.raw: "\n\nSlurp “You know, I turned down her arm wrestle thing and she got super pissy. Eh, fuck it though,” she finishes, leaving her empty bottle on the table."

rows.original: “Sorry you had to see that, Steele. All good?”
rows.translation: “抱歉让你看到这些，斯蒂尔。没事吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sorry you had to see that, Steele. All good?”"

rows.original: You nod, although you might have to talk more about it later. You say your goodbyes and leave for the ship.
rows.translation: 你点点头，不过之后或许还得多谈谈此事。你向她告别，动身返回飞船。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod, although you might have to talk more about it later. You say your goodbyes and leave for the ship."

rows.original: Your fun with the weird weights machine has left the both of you tired. Mirrin is back in her casual white bikini and shorts combo, her hoofsteps noticeably slow and a little unbalanced. Guess she’s not completely immortal...
rows.translation: 在那台奇怪的负重机器上玩过之后，你们都已疲惫不堪。米琳换回了日常的白色比基尼和短裤，蹄步明显缓慢而有些不稳。看来她并非完全不死...
rows.raw: "Your fun with the weird weights machine has left the both of you tired. Mirrin is back in her casual white bikini and shorts combo, her hoofsteps noticeably slow and a little unbalanced. Guess she’s not completely immortal..."

rows.original: The grill seems surprisingly quiet again, although some sort of music plays in the background. It sounds like old Terran country... hey, at least it’s thematic.
rows.translation: 烧烤店再次出奇地安静，不过背景里播放着某种音乐。听起来像古老的泰伦乡村乐...嘿，至少很应景。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe grill seems surprisingly quiet again, although some sort of music plays in the background. It sounds like old Terran country... hey, at least it’s thematic."

rows.original: You’re not feeling so hot after the gravity machine of the gods or whatever it was messed with your sense of bodily awareness. Something easy on the stomach today, you suggest to Mirrin. She nods, idly rubbing her biceps.
rows.translation: 那台诸神引力机，或者管它叫什么，扰乱了你的身体感知，让你感觉不太舒服。你建议米琳今天吃点清淡易消化的东西。她点点头，漫不经心地揉着肱二头肌。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re not feeling so hot after the gravity machine of the gods or whatever it was messed with your sense of bodily awareness. Something easy on the stomach today, you suggest to Mirrin. She nods, idly rubbing her biceps."

rows.original: You find a familiar spot to sit in, the usual exchange between Mirrin and Herman going off without incident this time. Your [pc.belly] feels quite strained from today so you slouch a bit.
rows.translation: 你找到一个熟悉的位置坐下；这次米琳和赫尔曼之间惯常的交流顺利完成。今天的训练让你的[pc.belly]颇感紧绷，于是你稍微瘫坐下来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou find a familiar spot to sit in, the usual exchange between Mirrin and Herman going off without incident this time. Your [pc.belly] feels quite strained from today so you slouch a bit."

rows.original: Mirrin comes back with what appears to be two cocktails. “Just something to say how cool today was. I don’t think the public’s going to use that machine for months,” she says with some relief. You get the feeling that she’s more worn out from the test than she’s letting on.
rows.translation: 米琳拿着看似两杯鸡尾酒的东西回来。“只是为了庆祝今天有多酷。我觉得公众好几个月内都用不上那台机器，”她如释重负地说道。你感觉这次测试令她比表现出来的更加疲惫。
rows.raw: "\n\nMirrin comes back with what appears to be two cocktails. “Just something to say how cool today was. I don’t think the public’s going to use that machine for months,” she says with some relief. You get the feeling that she’s more worn out from the test than she’s letting on."

rows.original: “Hey, listen for sec, I-”
rows.translation: “嘿，听我说一下，我——”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, listen for sec, I-”"

rows.original: Her speech is interrupted by the shadow of a large figure from behind.
rows.translation: 她的话被身后一个高大身影投下的阴影打断。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer speech is interrupted by the shadow of a large figure from behind."

rows.original: “Heya, she-bull. Figured you’d be showin’ up round here,” says a vaguely threatening, familiar voice. It’s that dumbass Doug from before.
rows.translation: “嘿，母牛。我就知道你会来这附近，”一个有些威胁意味的熟悉声音说道。是之前那个蠢货道格。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Heya, she-bull. Figured you’d be showin’ up round here,” says a vaguely threatening, familiar voice. It’s that dumbass Doug from before."

rows.original: “Ahh, is just not my day...” sighs your
rows.translation: “啊，今天真不是我的幸运日...”你的
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ahh, is just not my day...” sighs your "

rows.original: qilin friend.
rows.translation: 麒麟朋友
rows.raw: "qilin friend."

rows.original: dragon trainer.
rows.translation: 龙族教练
rows.raw: "dragon trainer."

rows.original: She slowly rises to meet his eye level.
rows.translation: 叹息道。她缓缓站起身，与他平视。
rows.raw: " She slowly rises to meet his eye level."

rows.original: “So what is it uhh, Doog? Need a shoulder massage?” she sasses. “I mean, I am pretty handy after all.”
rows.translation: “所以怎么了，呃，道咯？需要按摩肩膀吗？”她挖苦道。“毕竟，我的手确实很有一套。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So what is it uhh, Doog? Need a shoulder massage?” she sasses. “I mean, I am pretty handy after all.”"

rows.original: She raises said left hand, inspecting each hooked claw in front of Doug’s full view.
rows.translation: 她举起刚才所说的左手，在道格面前逐一端详每根弯曲的利爪。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe raises said left hand, inspecting each hooked claw in front of Doug’s full view."

rows.original: “I ain’t one to back down from a challenge no matta’ how tall the order,” he boasts, grandstanding to the mostly empty restaurant. “You just playin’ hard ta get, like all them uppiteh amazawns round heeyuh! No one can resist this absolute artistry of muscle and POWAH, UNGHH!”
rows.translation: “不管挑战有多难，俺都不是会退缩的人，”他对着几乎空无一人的餐厅夸夸其谈。“你只是在装难追，就像这里那些傲慢的亚马逊娘们儿！没人能抵抗这身肌肉与力——量的绝对艺术，呃嗯！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I ain’t one to back down from a challenge no matta’ how tall the order,” he boasts, grandstanding to the mostly empty restaurant. “You just playin’ hard ta get, like all them uppiteh amazawns round heeyuh! No one can resist this absolute artistry of muscle and POWAH, UNGHH!”"

rows.original: His friends pat him on the back in agreement. “Now listen, she-bull. I can forgive ya. Lil’ bruisin on the arm ain’t nothin’ for this bronco. But,” he stops, placing his right hand on Mirrin’s shoulder.
rows.translation: 他的朋友们认同地拍了拍他的背。“现在听好了，母牛。俺可以原谅你。胳膊上一点淤青对这头烈马来说算不了什么。不过，”他说到这里停下来，把右手放到米琳肩上。
rows.raw: "\n\nHis friends pat him on the back in agreement. “Now listen, she-bull. I can forgive ya. Lil’ bruisin on the arm ain’t nothin’ for this bronco. But,” he stops, placing his right hand on Mirrin’s shoulder."

rows.original: Uh oh...
rows.raw: "\n\nUh oh..."

rows.original: She slowly turns her head to look at his hand, and then to Doug’s shit-eating grin. Her face is livid. And... that sound is there, that deep, throaty rumble that you’ve only heard in truly mammoth creatures on the verge of crushing small furry mammals.
rows.translation: 她缓缓转头，先看向他的手，再看向道格那张欠揍的笑脸。她怒不可遏。而且...那声音又出现了，那种低沉的喉间轰鸣，你只在真正的巨兽即将碾碎毛茸茸小动物时听过。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe slowly turns her head to look at his hand, and then to Doug’s shit-eating grin. Her face is livid. And... that sound is there, that deep, throaty rumble that you’ve only heard in truly mammoth creatures on the verge of crushing small furry mammals."

rows.original: Out of nowhere, she suckerpunches him right in the guts!
rows.translation: 毫无预警，她一记偷袭拳正中他的腹部！
rows.raw: "\n\nOut of nowhere, she suckerpunches him right in the guts!"

rows.original: The effect is immediate. He buckles over her fist, grasping for something to hold on to. There’s no visible damage but his buddies go paramedic on the disabled bull. Only just able to hold himself up, he tries saying something even though he’s thoroughly winded. “Lucky... shot...”
rows.translation: 效果立竿见影。他弯腰瘫在她的拳头上，四处乱抓着想找东西支撑。虽然看不见外伤，他的朋友们却已经像急救员一样围住失去行动能力的公牛。他勉强支撑身体，尽管完全喘不过气，仍试图说些什么。“侥幸...一拳...”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe effect is immediate. He buckles over her fist, grasping for something to hold on to. There’s no visible damage but his buddies go paramedic on the disabled bull. Only just able to hold himself up, he tries saying something even though he’s thoroughly winded. “Lucky... shot...”"

rows.original: The three ne’er-do-wells hightail out of the eatery with the incapacitated Doug having to slowly limp out the door.
rows.translation: 三个无赖匆忙逃出餐厅，失去行动能力的道格不得不一瘸一拐地缓慢挪出门。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe three ne’er-do-wells hightail out of the eatery with the incapacitated Doug having to slowly limp out the door."

rows.original: Mirrin’s still visibly fuming. “Fucking... fucking... fucking...” you can hear her fume under her breath. Well, you have to say something!
rows.translation: 米琳显然依旧怒火中烧。“他妈的...他妈的...他妈的...”你听见她在低声发火。好吧，你必须说点什么！
rows.raw: "\n\nMirrin’s still visibly fuming. “Fucking... fucking... fucking...” you can hear her fume under her breath. Well, you have to say something!"

rows.original: “Mirrin...? You’ve done all you need...” you meekly say, placing a hand on her hip from behind. You can feel the raw tension in her muscles.
rows.translation: “米琳...?你已经做完该做的了...”你怯生生地说道，从身后把一只手放到她髋部。你能感到她肌肉中纯粹的紧绷。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mirrin...? You’ve done all you need...” you meekly say, placing a hand on her hip from behind. You can feel the raw tension in her muscles."

rows.original: “Heeeey, big girl... time to reign it in,” you say with a light-hearted tone. You place a hand on her hip. Even in that spot, you can feel the tension.
rows.translation: “嘿——，大姑娘...该收住了，”你用轻松的语气说道，把一只手放到她髋部。即便在那个位置，你也能感到她的紧绷。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Heeeey, big girl... time to reign it in,” you say with a light-hearted tone. You place a hand on her hip. Even in that spot, you can feel the tension."

rows.original: “That’s enough. He’s not coming back,” you say sternly, conveying authority. You slowly place your hand on her hip.
rows.translation: “够了。他不会回来了，”你严厉地说道，展现出权威。你缓缓把手放到她髋部。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s enough. He’s not coming back,” you say sternly, conveying authority. You slowly place your hand on her hip."

rows.original: She turns to you, her posture relaxing when she looks at you
rows.translation: 她转向你；看到你后，她的姿态逐渐放松下来，
rows.raw: "\n\nShe turns to you, her posture relaxing when she looks at you "

rows.original: at eye level.
rows.translation: 与你平视。
rows.raw: "at eye level."

rows.original: from above.
rows.translation: 从上方。
rows.raw: "from above."

rows.original: She places a hand on your face, an affectionate look in her eyes. It only lasts for a moment. Abruptly, she starts walking to the door.
rows.translation: 她把一只手放到你脸上，眼中满是爱意。但这只持续了片刻。突然，她开始朝门口走去。
rows.raw: " She places a hand on your face, an affectionate look in her eyes. It only lasts for a moment. Abruptly, she starts walking to the door."

rows.original: “I have to go, I-I don’t want...”
rows.translation: “我必须走了，我、我不想...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I have to go, I-I don’t want...”"

rows.original: You decide that it’s best not to follow her.
rows.translation: 你认为最好不要跟上她。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou decide that it’s best not to follow her."

rows.original: MIRRIN_DISABLED
rows.raw: "MIRRIN_DISABLED"

rows.original: MIRRIN_DISABLED
rows.raw: "MIRRIN_DISABLED"

rows.original: Food it is!
rows.translation: 那就吃东西吧！
rows.raw: "Food it is!"

rows.original: You both head out towards the Barbecue Pit as per usual, discussing the day’s session and areas of improvement along the way.
rows.translation: 你们像往常一样前往烧烤坑，途中讨论着今天的训练以及可以改进的地方。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou both head out towards the Barbecue Pit as per usual, discussing the day’s session and areas of improvement along the way. "

rows.original: “You’re doing pretty great, you know! I think now you should work on keeping yourself sculpted and... yeah, just as trim and uh... you know,” she opines, getting distracted by some random thought. “That word I was thinking of, uhhh, sexy, that was it.”
rows.translation: “你做得相当不错，知道吗！我觉得现在你应该努力保持身体线条，而且...对，就这么精瘦，呃...你懂的，”她评价道，却被某个突如其来的念头分散了注意力。“我刚才想的那个词，呃，性感，对，就是这个。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re doing pretty great, you know! I think now you should work on keeping yourself sculpted and... yeah, just as trim and uh... you know,” she opines, getting distracted by some random thought. “That word I was thinking of, uhhh, sexy, that was it.”"

rows.original: what a tease!
rows.translation: 真会撩人！
rows.raw: "what a tease!"

rows.original: well, that was big a hint as any.
rows.translation: 好吧，这暗示已经够明显了。
rows.raw: "well, that was big a hint as any."

rows.original: “Not bad for today, I’d still like to see some improvement from you. It’s uuuhhh, working for you though,” she states, giving you a thumbs up.
rows.translation: “今天表现还不错，不过我仍希望看到你有所进步。但它，呃——，确实很适合你，”她竖起大拇指说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not bad for today, I’d still like to see some improvement from you. It’s uuuhhh, working for you though,” she states, giving you a thumbs up."

rows.original: Nice!
rows.translation: 不错！
rows.raw: "\n\nNice!"

rows.original: Once you’re both inside and have found a reasonably quiet place to sit, Mirrin orders up some grub and beers. Gotta regain all that energy again somehow!
rows.translation: 你们进入店内，找到一处还算安静的座位后，米琳点了些食物和啤酒。总得想办法把那些能量重新补回来！
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce you’re both inside and have found a reasonably quiet place to sit, Mirrin orders up some grub and beers. Gotta regain all that energy again somehow! "

rows.original: It comes in very little time and the sounds of eating and slurping take over the conversation. The both of you are determined to lay waste to the spread of grilled meats before you, this little routine having been driven into you enough that it’s impossible to say no.
rows.translation: 食物很快便送到，进食和吸溜的声音取代了交谈。你们都下定决心，要消灭眼前铺开的烤肉；这套小小的惯例已经深深刻进习惯，让人根本无法拒绝。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt comes in very little time and the sounds of eating and slurping take over the conversation. The both of you are determined to lay waste to the spread of grilled meats before you, this little routine having been driven into you enough that it’s impossible to say no."

rows.original: It takes a good 20 minutes for you to get through it all and once again, Mirrin takes the bigger portion. It’s just a thing you’ve accepted now.
rows.translation: 你们足足花了二十分钟才吃完，而米琳再次拿走了更大一份。现在你已经接受这件事了。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt takes a good 20 minutes for you to get through it all and once again, Mirrin takes the bigger portion. It’s just a thing you’ve accepted now."

rows.original: Once you’re both full and had a breather, you bid each other goodbye with a grub-stuffed she-dragon lazing against the couch.
rows.translation: 你们吃饱又喘过气后，彼此告别；塞满食物的雌龙懒洋洋地靠在沙发上。
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce you’re both full and had a breather, you bid each other goodbye with a grub-stuffed she-dragon lazing against the couch."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: “Well, I don’t know much about you,” you begin, leaning against a nearby pillar. “Start from the top, I guess?”
rows.translation: “嗯，我不太了解你，”你靠着附近一根柱子开口道。“我想，就从头说起吧？”
rows.raw: "“Well, I don’t know much about you,” you begin, leaning against a nearby pillar. “Start from the top, I guess?”"

rows.original: Scratching the underside of her jaw, she begins “So, the name is Mirrin Arkosduttir,” and
rows.translation: 她挠着下巴底部，开始说道：“所以，我叫米琳·阿科斯杜蒂尔，”而
rows.raw: "\n\nScratching the underside of her jaw, she begins “So, the name is Mirrin Arkosduttir,” and "

rows.original: you already need a second to process the jumble of syllables into a name you can repeat. “Arkos...duttir?” You say under your breath.
rows.translation: 你已经需要花点时间，才能把那串音节整理成一个可以重复的名字。“阿科斯...杜蒂尔？”你低声说道。
rows.raw: "you already need a second to process the jumble of syllables into a name you can repeat. “Arkos...duttir?” You say under your breath."

rows.original: you immediately blank at the deluge of unfamiliar sounds coming out. “Wha...?” You say with an open mouth.
rows.translation: 一连串陌生音节刚从她嘴里涌出，你的大脑就立刻一片空白。“什...？”你张着嘴说道。
rows.raw: "you immediately blank at the deluge of unfamiliar sounds coming out. “Wha...?” You say with an open mouth."

rows.original: She grins, stifling a laugh through her nose. “Yah, yah I know. So like, my father’s name was Arkos Arkossonne and where I grew up, you take the uhh, paternal name first and change it for gender. So, I’m Arkosduttir,” she explains, taking a second to find the right word.
rows.translation: 她咧嘴一笑，强忍着不从鼻子里笑出声。“对，对，我知道。就是，我父亲叫阿科斯·阿科斯松恩；在我长大的地方，呃，要先取父名，然后根据性别改变词尾。所以我就是阿科斯杜蒂尔，”她解释道，中途停了一下寻找正确词汇。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe grins, stifling a laugh through her nose. “Yah, yah I know. So like, my father’s name was Arkos Arkossonne and where I grew up, you take the uhh, paternal name first and change it for gender. So, I’m Arkosduttir,” she explains, taking a second to find the right word."

rows.original: “Anyway,” she continues, resting her elbows on her knees, “so technically I’m... Terran, I suppose. Born there, raised there, schooled there and also very happily left there.” She flares her nostrils and takes a swig of water from a closeby bottle.
rows.translation: “总之，”她继续说道，双肘撑在膝盖上，“所以严格来讲，我算是...泰伦人吧。出生在那里、长大在那里、在那里上学，也非常高兴地离开了那里。”她张开鼻翼，从附近的水瓶喝了一口。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anyway,” she continues, resting her elbows on her knees, “so technically I’m... Terran, I suppose. Born there, raised there, schooled there and also very happily left there.” She flares her nostrils and takes a swig of water from a closeby bottle."

rows.original: “Not quite all of it. My mother, father? Other father... no, mother,” is what she finally gets to, punctuating each title with a finger gesture. “She’s gryvain. Hence uhhh, most of this,” she grins, pointing from her top to her bottom. You follow those movements with your eyes, another opportunity to get a good look at her imposing structure up close.
rows.translation: “不完全是。我母亲、父亲？另一个父亲...不，是母亲，”她最终如此说道，每个称呼都配上一个手势。“她是格里文。所以，呃，我才有了这里的大部分东西，”她咧嘴笑着，从上到下指向自己。你的目光跟随着动作，又有机会近距离好好欣赏她那压迫感十足的体格。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not quite all of it. My mother, father? Other father... no, mother,” is what she finally gets to, punctuating each title with a finger gesture. “She’s gryvain. Hence uhhh, most of this,” she grins, pointing from her top to her bottom. You follow those movements with your eyes, another opportunity to get a good look at her imposing structure up close."

rows.original: “Childhood didn’t suck, although father was usually... not there. He was rich as hell come to think of it but apparently industrial building supplies ‘make the bread’,” she explains, that last butchered phrase making you raise an eyebrow.
rows.translation: “童年不算糟，虽然父亲通常...不在家。现在想来，他富得流油，但显然工业建筑材料能‘做出面包’，”她解释道，最后那个被说得乱七八糟的短语让你挑起眉毛。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Childhood didn’t suck, although father was usually... not there. He was rich as hell come to think of it but apparently industrial building supplies ‘make the bread’,” she explains, that last butchered phrase making you raise an eyebrow."

rows.original: “He was alright, I guess. My mother... kind of the same. Money does things, you know?” She looks at you for affirmation.
rows.translation: “我猜他还行。我母亲...也差不多。钱会改变很多事，懂吧？”她望着你，等待认同。
rows.raw: "\n\n“He was alright, I guess. My mother... kind of the same. Money does things, you know?” She looks at you for affirmation. "

rows.original: You, of course, couldn’t imagine a life without all that sweet, sweet money from daddy but you nod away in agreement.
rows.translation: 当然，你无法想象没有父亲那些甜美、甜美钞票的生活，但还是连连点头表示赞同。
rows.raw: "You, of course, couldn’t imagine a life without all that sweet, sweet money from daddy but you nod away in agreement."

rows.original: You think to the stories of your own dad gallivanting about space, getting junked up on mods and easy lays, desperately wishing that ‘special’ childhood could be conveyed in the straight faced nod you give her.
rows.translation: 你想起自己父亲在太空四处游荡、沉迷身体改造和随手可得的艳遇，拼命希望自己面无表情的点头能传达那段“特别”的童年。
rows.raw: "You think to the stories of your own dad gallivanting about space, getting junked up on mods and easy lays, desperately wishing that ‘special’ childhood could be conveyed in the straight faced nod you give her."

rows.original: “Yah, so” swig “being a Terran-mongrel in a fancy Terran school for Terrans was fun,” comes the sarcastic blurb, her arm closest to you flexing and contracting as if to work off some tension. “Were you ever 6' tall at twelve years old, covered in scales and able to rip down a fucking wall in your teens?” She seems to sincerely ask, nostrils flared. The grip from her red-scaled, clawed hand seems to be a little tighter on that water bottle.
rows.translation: “对，所以，”喝水“一个泰伦杂种，在专供泰伦人的高档泰伦学校里上学，真有意思，”她讽刺地说道，靠近你的那条手臂不断屈伸，仿佛想释放一些压力。“你十二岁时有过六英尺高、浑身鳞片，十几岁就能拆掉一面该死的墙吗？”她似乎真诚地问道，鼻翼张开。那只覆盖红鳞、带着利爪的手似乎把水瓶握得更紧了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yah, so” swig “being a Terran-mongrel in a fancy Terran school for Terrans was fun,” comes the sarcastic blurb, her arm closest to you flexing and contracting as if to work off some tension. “Were you ever 6' tall at twelve years old, covered in scales and able to rip down a fucking wall in your teens?” She seems to sincerely ask, nostrils flared. The grip from her red-scaled, clawed hand seems to be a little tighter on that water bottle."

rows.raw: "half-gryvain"

rows.original: “Mmm, something like that,” you say, pointing out features you inherited from your mother.
rows.translation: “嗯，差不多吧，”你说道，指出从母亲那里继承的特征。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mmm, something like that,” you say, pointing out features you inherited from your mother."

rows.original: “Then you know, it’s crazy how much uuuuh, arousal you get at that age! And then you have to deal with all those genes hating each other...” she finishes with a flair of anger, aghast at remembering her troublesome teens. You blush a little as your gryvain body remembers what she means.
rows.translation: “那你就懂了，那个年纪会产生那么强烈的，呃，性欲，真是疯了！然后还得应付那些彼此排斥的基因...”她带着怒意说完，回想起麻烦的青春期时满脸震惊。你的格里文身体记起她所指的感觉，令你微微脸红。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Then you know, it’s crazy how much uuuuh, arousal you get at that age! And then you have to deal with all those genes hating each other...” she finishes with a flair of anger, aghast at remembering her troublesome teens. You blush a little as your gryvain body remembers what she means."

rows.original: You shake your head and smile weakly, a confusing image flashing through your head of an angsty she-dragon punching a brick wall.
rows.translation: 你摇摇头，勉强一笑，脑海中闪过一幅令人困惑的画面：一条叛逆雌龙正在猛击砖墙。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shake your head and smile weakly, a confusing image flashing through your head of an angsty she-dragon punching a brick wall."

rows.original: “It sucked! Had to spend three weeks a year in bed getting off to boring Terran porn...” she finishes with frustration in her composure, exasperated at remembering her troublesome teens.
rows.translation: “糟透了！每年有三个星期都得躺在床上，对着无聊的泰伦色情片自慰...”她满怀挫败地说完，想起麻烦的青春期时十分恼火。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It sucked! Had to spend three weeks a year in bed getting off to boring Terran porn...” she finishes with frustration in her composure, exasperated at remembering her troublesome teens."

rows.original: It seems like a good moment to console her. You put your hand on her knee.
rows.translation: 这似乎是安慰她的好时机。你把手放到她膝盖上。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt seems like a good moment to console her. You put your hand on her knee."

rows.original: “I’m sorry it was difficult, are you alright, Mirrin?” You console with sincerity.
rows.translation: “很遗憾那段时间如此艰难。你还好吗，米琳？”你真诚地安慰道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m sorry it was difficult, are you alright, Mirrin?” You console with sincerity."

rows.original: She looks straight into your eyes, grins and pats your hand. “Nah, nah, don’t worry, just me getting worked up. It’s all uuuh, behind me,” she says calmly.
rows.translation: 她直视你的双眼，咧嘴一笑，拍了拍你的手。“没事，没事，别担心，只是我自己激动起来了。这一切都，呃，过去了，”她平静地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe looks straight into your eyes, grins and pats your hand. “Nah, nah, don’t worry, just me getting worked up. It’s all uuuh, behind me,” she says calmly."

rows.original: “Oh gods, being so horny every day, must’ve been just dreadful,” you sarcastically tease. She effeminately giggles, a bit of a turn for her.
rows.translation: “哦，天哪，每天都这么饥渴，一定惨极了吧，”你讽刺地戏弄道。她颇有女人味地咯咯笑起来，这对她而言有些反常。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh gods, being so horny every day, must’ve been just dreadful,” you sarcastically tease. She effeminately giggles, a bit of a turn for her."

rows.original: “I gueeess,” she concedes, tapping you on the shoulder. Tapping - in this case - being closer to almost shoving you off the bench.
rows.translation: “也——许吧，”她勉强同意，拍了拍你的肩膀。这里所谓的“拍”，其实更接近差点把你推下长凳。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I gueeess,” she concedes, tapping you on the shoulder. Tapping - in this case - being closer to almost shoving you off the bench."

rows.original: “Sucks,” you flatly state, accompanying it with a hard squeeze of her knee.
rows.translation: “真糟，”你平淡地说道，同时用力捏了捏她的膝盖。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sucks,” you flatly state, accompanying it with a hard squeeze of her knee."

rows.original: She shakes her head. “Is nothing, just bullshit,” Mirrin replies, taking another swig.
rows.translation: 她摇摇头。“没什么，都是些屁事，”米琳回答，又喝了一口。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe shakes her head. “Is nothing, just bullshit,” Mirrin replies, taking another swig."

rows.original: “Enough about that though, all history. So basically, school, then I didn’t really know what to do with myself. I did young person stuff. Travel everywhere, you know. Or really just Eastern Asia,” she states, placing her water bottle down and playing with her ponytail. “I just... got really into a thing one day. That became more of a uhhh, life goal. I loved the tales of ancient dragons with power and strength weaving their way through the chaotic lives of mortal folk. I guess I tried to be like that,” she finishes.
rows.translation: “不过不说那些了，都是过去的事。所以基本上，上完学以后，我其实不知道该拿自己怎么办。我做了些年轻人会做的事，到处旅行，你懂的。其实主要就是东亚，”她说道，放下水瓶，摆弄着马尾。“我只是...有一天特别迷上了某样东西。然后它逐渐变成，呃，人生目标。我喜欢那些古老巨龙的传说：它们拥有力量与威势，穿梭在凡人混乱的人生之中。我想，我试图成为那样的存在，”她说完。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Enough about that though, all history. So basically, school, then I didn’t really know what to do with myself. I did young person stuff. Travel everywhere, you know. Or really just Eastern Asia,” she states, placing her water bottle down and playing with her ponytail. “I just... got really into a thing one day. That became more of a uhhh, life goal. I loved the tales of ancient dragons with power and strength weaving their way through the chaotic lives of mortal folk. I guess I tried to be like that,” she finishes."

rows.original: You convey how ambitious that must have been.
rows.translation: 你表示，那一定是个雄心勃勃的目标。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou convey how ambitious that must have been."

rows.original: “Fuck yah! I had to make a lot of quick money... luckily, there’s always a market for ‘exotic’ modelling so some friends of friends got me a decent start in it all. Aside from the actual mods, it’s all been a blur since then. Being famous in places and being unknown in others. Everyone’s scared to talk to you but you just know they’re jackin’ it to your latest pictures,” is her disdain-fueled reply. “Still, I’ve had my share of fun. When my naked picture is on every wall around town on every nearby planet, it’s easy to get laid, get booze, forget it all. Glad I stuck to body building...”
rows.translation: “操，那当然！我得迅速赚到很多钱...好在‘异域风情’模特始终有市场，于是朋友的朋友让我在这行有了不错的开端。除了真正接受改造的过程，此后的一切都像一团模糊。在一些地方出名，在另一些地方默默无闻。所有人都害怕和你交谈，但你心里清楚，他们正对着你的最新照片打手枪，”她满怀不屑地回答。“不过，我也享受过自己的乐趣。当附近每颗星球、每座城镇的每面墙上都挂着我的裸照时，找人上床、弄到酒喝、把一切忘掉都轻而易举。幸好我坚持了健美...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fuck yah! I had to make a lot of quick money... luckily, there’s always a market for ‘exotic’ modelling so some friends of friends got me a decent start in it all. Aside from the actual mods, it’s all been a blur since then. Being famous in places and being unknown in others. Everyone’s scared to talk to you but you just know they’re jackin’ it to your latest pictures,” is her disdain-fueled reply. “Still, I’ve had my share of fun. When my naked picture is on every wall around town on every nearby planet, it’s easy to get laid, get booze, forget it all. Glad I stuck to body building...”"

rows.original: “That’s you?? I thought Steele was just a common name. But holy shit, that’s actually pretty baller,” she exclaims, inching ever so slightly closer to you. “So what, you’ve got your ship here and just do anything anywhere being the baddest ass?”

rows.raw: "\n\nMirrin just laughs. “Yah, guess I sort of stand out in crowd of horned, muscled beasts, right?” She says, briefly admiring her reflection as a horned, muscled beast. “S’alright though, I’ll try my best with this.”"

rows.original: “Yah. Well... about half, a little bit less than half terran. That whole side is screwy, trust me,” she assures you. “Human father, gryvain mother. It was kind of mutual for them, if I remember. Younger me looks very different to current me,” Mirrin recalls, re-adjusting her ponytail bindings. Her densely packed, contracted bicep flexes and twists as she does, hidden tendons and muscles seem to jump underneath her taut skin. You feel a hypnotic pull as you watch them work.
rows.translation: “对。嗯...大约一半，略少于一半是泰伦血统。相信我，整个那一半都乱七八糟，”她向你保证。“人类父亲，格里文母亲。如果我没记错，这对他们双方都一样。小时候的我和现在看起来截然不同，”米琳回忆道，重新调整马尾的绑带。动作间，她那紧密绷起的肱二头肌弯曲扭动，隐藏的肌腱和肌肉仿佛在紧绷皮肤下跃动。你看着它们运作，感到一股催眠般的吸引力。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yah. Well... about half, a little bit less than half terran. That whole side is screwy, trust me,” she assures you. “Human father, gryvain mother. It was kind of mutual for them, if I remember. Younger me looks very different to current me,” Mirrin recalls, re-adjusting her ponytail bindings. Her densely packed, contracted bicep flexes and twists as she does, hidden tendons and muscles seem to jump underneath her taut skin. You feel a hypnotic pull as you watch them work."

rows.original: “Some few problems can happen with those types of births so even before I was born, I had gene mods and expression controls fucking around with my uuuh, body,” she explains in a straight manner, some of her phrasing being a bit... Mirrin-ish.
rows.translation: “这种出生可能会遇到一些问题，所以甚至在我出生前，基因改造和表达控制就在折腾我的，呃，身体了，”她直率地解释道，有些措辞显得稍微有点...米琳风格。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Some few problems can happen with those types of births so even before I was born, I had gene mods and expression controls fucking around with my uuuh, body,” she explains in a straight manner, some of her phrasing being a bit... Mirrin-ish."

rows.original: “So I got human skin, face and lungs. Then gryvain parts. Scales, claws, height, and so on. It’s what’s on my birth certificate anyhow.”
rows.translation: “所以我得到了人类的皮肤、脸和肺，然后是格里文的部位：鳞片、爪子、身高等等。反正出生证明上是这么写的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So I got human skin, face and lungs. Then gryvain parts. Scales, claws, height, and so on. It’s what’s on my birth certificate anyhow.”"

rows.original: “And now? You’re quite far gone from either,” you ask with curiosity.
rows.translation: “那现在呢？你和两者的差别都相当大，”你好奇地问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And now? You’re quite far gone from either,” you ask with curiosity."

rows.original: “So like, in what was known as Ancient China so and so many millennia ago, a myth around a certain creature came about, yadda yadda. It was called a qilin. Said to be incredibly auspicious, ordained by the spirits to choose worthy emperors,” she recalls whimsically, her distracted eyes gazing up somewhere. “I just couldn’t get it out of my mind. Terra actually having an analogue for gryvain! Or what Terrans call gryvain, anyway,” she smirks, briefly glancing to you as she does.
rows.translation: “就是，在许多许多个千年前，被称为古代中国的地方，出现了某种生物的神话，如此这般。它被称作麒麟。据说极其吉祥，受众灵之命挑选贤明的帝王，”她异想天开地回忆着，走神的双眼望向上方某处。“我就是没办法把它从脑海里赶出去。泰拉竟然有对应格里文的生物！或者说，是泰伦人称为格里文的生物，”她坏笑道，同时短暂瞥了你一眼。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So like, in what was known as Ancient China so and so many millennia ago, a myth around a certain creature came about, yadda yadda. It was called a qilin. Said to be incredibly auspicious, ordained by the spirits to choose worthy emperors,” she recalls whimsically, her distracted eyes gazing up somewhere. “I just couldn’t get it out of my mind. Terra actually having an analogue for gryvain! Or what Terrans call gryvain, anyway,” she smirks, briefly glancing to you as she does."

rows.original: “Once I had a design, it was merely about the money. I liked the pottery of that same period of Chinese history, so... skin,” Mirrin shows you a clay-red forearm. “And the obsession with... carved jade happened too,” she continues, stroking both of her ornate dragon horns. You notice her biting her lip as she does...
rows.translation: “有了设计以后，剩下的就只是钱。我喜欢中国历史同一时期的陶器，所以...皮肤，”米琳向你展示陶红色的前臂。“后来也迷上了...雕刻玉器，”她继续说道，抚摸着两根华丽的龙角。你注意到她这样做时咬住了嘴唇...
rows.raw: "\n\n“Once I had a design, it was merely about the money. I liked the pottery of that same period of Chinese history, so... skin,” Mirrin shows you a clay-red forearm. “And the obsession with... carved jade happened too,” she continues, stroking both of her ornate dragon horns. You notice her biting her lip as she does..."

rows.original: She quickly regains her train of thought. “Horse stuff is easy, just controlled pills. So, legs, hair, tail, hooves... it did also make me a little slow in the memory, though.”
rows.translation: 她很快找回思路。“马族特征很简单，只需要受控药丸。所以就是腿、头发、尾巴、蹄子...不过这也让我的记忆稍微变慢了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe quickly regains her train of thought. “Horse stuff is easy, just controlled pills. So, legs, hair, tail, hooves... it did also make me a little slow in the memory, though.”"

rows.original: That explains why she has pauses and weird phrasing in her speech. She sticks a double jointed, equine leg forward, swiveling a jade hoof around.
rows.translation: 这解释了她说话时为何会停顿、措辞怪异。她向前伸出一条双关节马腿，转动翡翠色蹄子。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat explains why she has pauses and weird phrasing in her speech. She sticks a double jointed, equine leg forward, swiveling a jade hoof around."

rows.original: “And other things,” she adds, her knees rubbing together briefly. You note the squeeze it has on her bulge...
rows.translation: “还有别的地方，”她补充道，双膝短暂地互相摩擦。你注意到这对她的鼓包造成了挤压...
rows.raw: "\n\n“And other things,” she adds, her knees rubbing together briefly. You note the squeeze it has on her bulge..."

rows.original: “So yah, I’m Mirrin, I’m a qilin. Or at least, something like it,” finishes Mirrin, a satisfied look on her face.
rows.translation: “所以没错，我是米琳，是一名麒麟。或者至少，类似麒麟的东西，”米琳说完，脸上露出满意的神情。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So yah, I’m Mirrin, I’m a qilin. Or at least, something like it,” finishes Mirrin, a satisfied look on her face."

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: You jump off the bridge she built. “So, horse mods? What else did you use?” you inquire.
rows.translation: 你顺着她铺好的话题继续。“所以，是马族改造？你还用了什么？”你问道。
rows.raw: "You jump off the bridge she built. “So, horse mods? What else did you use?” you inquire."

rows.original: Mirrin straightens herself up, dusts herself down and clears her throat. It reminds you of a particularly proud museum curator.
rows.translation: 米琳挺直身体，掸了掸身上并清清嗓子，让你想起一位格外自豪的博物馆馆长。
rows.raw: "\n\nMirrin straightens herself up, dusts herself down and clears her throat. It reminds you of a particularly proud museum curator."

rows.original: “Right, so... Skin. And by extension, scales,” she begins, putting her right hand on her left forearm. “An offshoot of Rainbotox. A contact in pharmaceuticals narrowed it down to uuuh, a washed out color palette. Happy with red, would’ve preferred slate-blue. Hair,” she grabs a hold of her ponytail and actual pony tail with a smug grin. “Au natural. Only change is some parts are a bit green.”
rows.translation: “好，所以...皮肤，以及由此延伸的鳞片，”她开口道，把右手放在左前臂上。“这是彩虹肉毒的一种衍生品。制药行业的一位联系人把效果缩小为，呃，褪色的色调。我对红色很满意，不过原本更喜欢石板蓝。头发，”她得意地抓住头上的马尾和真正的马尾。“纯天然。唯一的变化是有些地方稍微变绿了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Right, so... Skin. And by extension, scales,” she begins, putting her right hand on her left forearm. “An offshoot of Rainbotox. A contact in pharmaceuticals narrowed it down to uuuh, a washed out color palette. Happy with red, would’ve preferred slate-blue. Hair,” she grabs a hold of her ponytail and actual pony tail with a smug grin. “Au natural. Only change is some parts are a bit green.”"

rows.original: She holds one of her legs up, bending it so it rests on the opposite knee. She points to one of her slightly over-sized hooves. “These were hard. So like... When I was describing how I wanted it to work to the pharmacy guy, he explained what he was going to use and it was such a complex chemical name. Beta-xenophylenophena-something-or-other. Worked it real good but fucking. Expensive. Same with these beauts,” she’s holding one of her horns again. “Took a while to grow but they’re just perfect.”
rows.translation: 她抬起一条腿，弯曲后架在另一侧膝盖上，指向一只稍显过大的蹄子。“这些很难搞。就是...我向药剂师描述想要的效果时，他解释了准备使用的东西，那是一个极其复杂的化学名称。β-异种菲烯酚什么什么的。效果确实很好，但他妈的，太贵了。这些美人也一样，”她又握住一根角。“长出来花了不少时间，但简直完美。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe holds one of her legs up, bending it so it rests on the opposite knee. She points to one of her slightly over-sized hooves. “These were hard. So like... Worked it real good but fucking. Expensive. Same with these beauts,” she’s holding one of her horns again. “Took a while to grow but they’re just perfect.”"

rows.translation: 仔细观察角和蹄子，其细节令人惊叹。它们几乎半透明，你可以想象特别强烈的光线会令她的角冠焕发绿色光芒。
rows.raw: "\n\nLooking at both horn and hoof properly, the detail is staggering. Almost translucent, you could imagine that a particularly strong light would irradiate her crown of horns with a green glow."

rows.original: “How about the horse, er, bits?” You say, idly fidgeting with your [pc.hair].

rows.raw: "\n\n“How about the horse, er, bits?” You say, idly fidgeting with your [pc.hair]."

rows.original: “Like I said, pills. Pricey ones, though. I had the effects tailored to what I wanted. None of that overly ticklish foot shit anymore,” she continues, shuffling her feet around a bit at the thought.
rows.translation: “就像我说的，药丸。不过是很贵的那种。我让人根据自己的需求定制了效果。再也没有那种脚部过度怕痒的破事了，”她继续说道，想到这里便稍微挪了挪双脚。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Like I said, pills. Pricey ones, though. I had the effects tailored to what I wanted. None of that overly ticklish foot shit anymore,” she continues, shuffling her feet around a bit at the thought."

I mean, things are a little colder down here,” she comments, casually tapping her tightly bound bulge like it ain’t no thing. “At least I’m not ruining yet more pants from fucking... stepping on the soft grass! Could be worse though. Could be some cow getting drowned in my own juice from sniffing a sock or some silly shit,” she finishes, chuckling away.
rows.translation: “所以没错，我也削弱了那破玩意。我的意思是，下面确实稍微冷淡了些，”她评论道，若无其事地拍了拍紧紧束缚的鼓包。“至少我不会再因为他妈的...踩到柔软草地就毁掉更多裤子！不过情况也可能更糟。总好过某头奶牛闻闻袜子之类的蠢东西，就被我自己的淫液淹死，”她笑着说道。

Could be worse though. Could be some cow getting drowned in my own juice from sniffing a sock or some silly shit,” she finishes, chuckling away."

rows.translation: 她放松下来、畅所欲言时，你露出了微笑。

rows.translation: 你和她一起笑了起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou laugh along with her."

rows.original: “Can say that again,” you add, a wry grin spreading across your face.
rows.translation: “确实如此，”你补充道，脸上浮现一抹苦笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Can say that again,” you add, a wry grin spreading across your face."

rows.original: She’s a little bit more loose towards you now...
rows.translation: 她现在对你更加放松了一些...
rows.raw: " She’s a little bit more loose towards you now..."

rows.original: One more thought crosses your brainwaves: Why does she have two dongers?
rows.translation: 你的脑海又冒出一个念头：她为什么有两根屌？
rows.raw: "\n\nOne more thought crosses your brainwaves: Why does she have two dongers?"

rows.original: She shrugs. “It just happened, really. Gryvain plus enough of the right mods all going crazy inside. I don’t really want to remove them...” she replies, shuffling about.
rows.translation: 她耸耸肩。“其实，就这么发生了。格里文血统再加上足量的正确改造，在体内一同失控。我并不想把它们移除...”她一边回答，一边挪动身体。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe shrugs. “It just happened, really. Gryvain plus enough of the right mods all going crazy inside. I don’t really want to remove them...” she replies, shuffling about."

rows.original: “Using them is still... normal, just using one sometimes sets the other off unintentionally. And I often... tend to make a mess.”
rows.translation: “使用起来依然...很正常，只是有时用一根会无意中刺激到另一根。而且我经常...容易弄得一团糟。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Using them is still... normal, just using one sometimes sets the other off unintentionally. And I often... tend to make a mess.”"

rows.original: Interesting that she’s so candid about it.
rows.translation: 她能如此坦率地谈论此事，还挺有意思。
rows.raw: "\n\nInteresting that she’s so candid about it."
