rows.translation: 你询问她对留在新德克萨斯有什么看法。
rows.raw: "You ask her about staying on New Texas and what she thinks of it."

rows.original: “Ah, fantastic beef,” she says with a joyous gasp. “I could spend a week in the local grills, gorging on all this... meat and ruining my abs forever.”
rows.translation: “啊，美味的牛肉，”她欣喜地喘道。“我可以在当地烧烤店里待上一星期，狂吃这些...肉，永远毁掉自己的腹肌。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, fantastic beef,” she says with a joyous gasp. “I could spend a week in the local grills, gorging on all this... meat and ruining my abs forever.”"

rows.original: Her face implies she’s dreaming of personal heaven, although the mention of ‘meat’ reminds you of the ever-tempting, ever-horny bulls and cows that flit and float around you in the gym.
rows.translation: 她的表情仿佛正在幻想属于自己的天堂，不过她提到“肉”，让你想起健身房里那些始终诱人、始终饥渴，在你身边来来往往的公牛和奶牛。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer face implies she’s dreaming of personal heaven, although the mention of ‘meat’ reminds you of the ever-tempting, ever-horny bulls and cows that flit and float around you in the gym."

rows.original: “Of course, they’re all cows here, so like... is it uhhh, cannibalism? Fake beef? You know, best if I don’t ask that,” she rushes, quickly downing half a bottle of water. There’s - naturally - a bit of an awkward silence.
rows.translation: “当然，这里全都是牛，所以...这算是，呃，同类相食吗？假牛肉？你知道吗，最好还是别问，”她匆匆说道，迅速喝掉半瓶水。随后自然而然地陷入一阵尴尬沉默。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course, they’re all cows here, so like... is it uhhh, cannibalism? Fake beef? You know, best if I don’t ask that,” she rushes, quickly downing half a bottle of water. There’s - naturally - a bit of an awkward silence."

rows.original: “So yah, uhm, it’s nice. Like Earth. Bit cold sometimes,” she sniffs. “Kinda handy that it looks nice, means I can do all my photoshoots here. Gym is... a big bonus. People are kind enough, perhaps too kind.”
rows.translation: “所以没错，嗯，这里挺好，像地球。有时有点冷，”她吸了吸鼻子。“这里风景不错也挺方便，意味着我能在这里完成所有摄影。健身房是...很大的加分项。人们足够友善，也许太友善了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So yah, uhm, it’s nice. Like Earth. Bit cold sometimes,” she sniffs. “Kinda handy that it looks nice, means I can do all my photoshoots here. Gym is... a big bonus. People are kind enough, perhaps too kind.”"

rows.original: Definitely something you can attest to.
rows.translation: 这一点你绝对可以作证。
rows.raw: "\n\nDefinitely something you can attest to."

rows.original: You probe her on why she doesn’t seem to talk to many people around her, finding it curious that this known fitness model seems actively shunned by locals known for their friendliness.
rows.translation: 你追问她为何似乎不怎么和周围人交流；这个知名健身模特竟被以友善著称的当地人主动躲避，令你颇感好奇。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou probe her on why she doesn’t seem to talk to many people around her, finding it curious that this known fitness model seems actively shunned by locals known for their friendliness."

rows.original: “Mmmm... they expected something different, I think. Gryvain smell it when you’re horny. These people are always horny. So they put two and two in the basket, think that I’m just as up for it as they are. Literally everyone: Bulls, cows, the big girly ones, small manly ones...”
rows.translation: “嗯...我觉得他们期待的是另一回事。格里文能闻出别人是否饥渴，而这里的人永远都很饥渴。于是他们把二加二放进篮子，以为我和他们一样随时有兴致。真的是所有人：公牛、奶牛、高大的女人味家伙、娇小的阳刚家伙...”

rows.original: “It’s not how I work though. I didn’t want to be cock hungry all the time, so I uuuh, dulled my drive with mods. I can’t really smell their pheromones either, somehow. rows.translation: “你完全有理由因此拒绝，但这是我唯一能想到的可行方式，[pc.name]...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And you’ve every reason to say no because of that but it’s the only way I see it working, [pc.name]...”"

rows.original: You wrap your arm around her middle, resting your head against her shoulder.
rows.translation: 你用手臂搂住她的腰，把头靠在她肩上。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wrap your arm around her middle, resting your head against her shoulder."

rows.original: Well...
rows.translation: 这个嘛...
rows.raw: "Well..."

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: “That’s a bit of a tall order,” you say with a heavy sigh.
rows.translation: “这个要求有点太高了，”你重重叹息道。
rows.raw: "“That’s a bit of a tall order,” you say with a heavy sigh."

rows.original: “Yeah, figured. So, mm, if, ummm... okay, the short of it: I get it, if you don’t want to ever then okay, we can keep doing our thing. If you change your mind, then...”
rows.translation: “对，我猜也是。所以，嗯，如果，嗯...好吧，简单来说：我理解；如果你永远都不愿意，那也没关系，我们可以继续保持现在这样。如果你改变主意，那么...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, figured. So, mm, if, ummm... okay, the short of it: I get it, if you don’t want to ever then okay, we can keep doing our thing. If you change your mind, then...”"

rows.original: She rubs your hand with a loose grip, a reconciliation of sorts. She still seems hopeful, you feel. You nod and rub her hand back.
rows.translation: 她松松地握住你的手揉了揉，算是一种和解。你感觉她依然抱有希望。你点点头，也揉了揉她的手。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe rubs your hand with a loose grip, a reconciliation of sorts. She still seems hopeful, you feel. You nod and rub her hand back."

rows.original: “Okay, maybe I’ll give it a little more thought,” you say with a squeeze of her forearm, “although if I don’t bring it up again, then-”
rows.translation: “好吧，也许我会再多考虑一下，”你捏着她的前臂说道，“不过如果我再也不提这件事，那么——”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Okay, maybe I’ll give it a little more thought,” you say with a squeeze of her forearm, “although if I don’t bring it up again, then-”"

rows.original: “Then yeah, it’s okay. You go on and decide, don’t let me nag,” says Mirrin as she lets go of your hand, “I won’t say anything if you won’t, so. Back to weights.”
rows.translation: “那也没关系。你自己决定，别让我纠缠你，”米琳松开你的手说道，“你不说，我也不会再提。所以，继续练负重吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Then yeah, it’s okay. You go on and decide, don’t let me nag,” says Mirrin as she lets go of your hand, “I won’t say anything if you won’t, so. Back to weights.”"

rows.original: She chuckles and lets go of your hand, her fingers stretched out for a set of handbells by her side. Yeah, wow. Really dumping all that info on you. Let her build your kids into what she wants them to be...
rows.translation: 她轻笑着放开你的手，手指伸向身旁的一组哑铃。好吧，哇哦。真是一下子把所有信息都倾倒给你。让她把你们的孩子塑造成她想要的样子...
rows.raw: "\n\nShe chuckles and lets go of your hand, her fingers stretched out for a set of handbells by her side. Yeah, wow. Really dumping all that info on you. Let her build your kids into what she wants them to be..."

rows.original: Hmm.
rows.translation: 嗯。
rows.raw: "\n\nHmm."

rows.original: You leave her be.
rows.translation: 你不再打扰她。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou leave her be."

rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.translation: 这个嘛...
rows.raw: "Well..."

rows.original: You don’t think you can take that offer, either for now or ever.
rows.translation: 你觉得自己无法接受这项提议，无论现在还是将来。
rows.raw: "You don’t think you can take that offer, either for now or ever."

rows.original: Okay
rows.translation: 好吧
rows.raw: "Okay"

rows.original: Okay
rows.translation: 好吧
rows.raw: "Okay"

rows.original: You’re okay with that arrangement, as galling as it might be. Down the line, however, you never know how much leeway she’ll give you...
rows.translation: 你能接受这种安排，尽管可能令人恼火。不过将来究竟会给你多少余地，谁也说不准...
rows.raw: "You’re okay with that arrangement, as galling as it might be. Down the line, however, you never know how much leeway she’ll give you..."

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: “Okay, yeah, chat. I thought it over and I think I’m good with what you want to do with our child. Or children. That is, as long as you hold up the other parts of it, letting me see them regularly, doing things...” you say with a squint in her direction. The qilin sighs in relief.
rows.translation: “好吧，对，谈谈。我考虑过了，觉得可以接受你想怎样养育我们的孩子。一个或多个都一样。也就是说，只要你做到其他部分，让我定期见他们、参与事情...”你眯眼看着她说道。麒麟如释重负地叹了口气。
rows.raw: "“Okay, yeah, chat. I thought it over and I think I’m good with what you want to do with our child. Or children. That is, as long as you hold up the other parts of it, letting me see them regularly, doing things...” you say with a squint in her direction. The qilin sighs in relief."

rows.original: “Absolutely. And my place, any time, wherever I am. We’ll be sharing stories, visiting... I can’t wait, elskan, I can’t.”
rows.translation: “当然。无论我在哪里，你随时都能来我的住处。我们会分享故事、互相探望...我等不及了，亲爱的，真的等不及。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Absolutely. And my place, any time, wherever I am. We’ll be sharing stories, visiting... I can’t wait, elskan, I can’t.”"

rows.translation: “如果这真是你想从中得到的东西，我理解，”你用同情的语气说道。毕竟，她的理由并没有错。
rows.raw: "“If that’s what you really want out of this, I understand,” you say in an empathetic tone. After all, she’s not wrong on her reasoning."

rows.original: Gryvain
rows.raw: "Gryvain"

rows.original: Also stands to reason that gryvain children of all dilutions would need exceptional care and attention which you might not always be there for...
rows.translation: 而且可以合理推断，各种混血程度的格里文孩子都需要格外的照料和关注，而你可能无法始终陪伴...
rows.raw: " Also stands to reason that gryvain children of all dilutions would need exceptional care and attention which you might not always be there for..."

rows.original: “So... you want this too?” she says quietly, an irregular note of optimism in her voice.
rows.translation: “所以...你也想要这个？”她轻声说道，声音中带着一丝不同寻常的乐观。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So... you want this too?” she says quietly, an irregular note of optimism in her voice."

rows.original: Of course, you wouldn’t even ask if you weren’t interested, duhhh.
rows.translation: 当然，不感兴趣的话你根本不会问，笨——蛋。
rows.raw: "\n\nOf course, you wouldn’t even ask if you weren’t interested, duhhh."

rows.original: “Aggh, I did it again,” she sighs, chuckling to herself. “Built it up inside all this time and you’re all calm and... blah, anyway.”
rows.translation: “啊，我又犯了，”她叹息着自嘲一笑。“一直把这件事憋在心里，而你却这么平静，还...算了，总之。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Aggh, I did it again,” she sighs, chuckling to herself. “Built it up inside all this time and you’re all calm and... blah, anyway.”"

rows.original: She wraps her arm loosely around your neck and kisses the top of your head.
rows.translation: 她用手臂松松搂住你的脖子，亲吻你的头顶。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe wraps her arm loosely around your neck and kisses the top of your head."

rows.original: “Hm hmm, who’s the best Steele in the world, huh? Right, so: give me a few days and then we can... breed,” she finishes, purring the last word into your ear.
rows.translation: “嗯哼，世界上最棒的斯蒂尔是谁，嗯？好，所以：给我几天时间，然后我们就能...繁育了，”她说完，把最后一个词低声咕哝进你耳边。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hm hmm, who’s the best Steele in the world, huh? Right, so: give me a few days and then we can... breed,” she finishes, purring the last word into your ear."

rows.original: But you can do better than that, Mirrin. You pull her face to yours by her jaw and give her a full, loving kiss on the lips. Now that’s how you say goodbye, ya big dumb dragon.
rows.translation: 不过你能做得比这更好，米琳。你托住她的下巴，把脸拉向自己，给了她一个充满爱意的深吻。这才是告别的方式，你这条又大又笨的龙。
rows.raw: "\n\nBut you can do better than that, Mirrin. You pull her face to yours by her jaw and give her a full, loving kiss on the lips. Now that’s how you say goodbye, ya big dumb dragon."

rows.original: Mirrin holds her pose, a little shocked by your assertive act. She quickly pulls herself back, clearing her throat in an awkwardly audible manner.
rows.translation: 米琳维持着姿势，似乎被你强势的举动惊到了。她迅速抽身，以尴尬得清晰可闻的声音清清嗓子。
rows.raw: "\n\nMirrin holds her pose, a little shocked by your assertive act. She quickly pulls herself back, clearing her throat in an awkwardly audible manner."

rows.original: “Mmmhmmm, well. That’s a good way to start,” she smiles. “But I have to prep. In fact...”
rows.translation: “嗯哼，好吧。这是个不错的开端，”她微笑道。“不过我必须准备。其实...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mmmhmmm, well. That’s a good way to start,” she smiles. “But I have to prep. In fact...”"

rows.original: She hurriedly gets up, spurred on by the prospect of fulfilling her physical desires. You can’t quite imagine what she’s got planned but you’re feeling a bit of excitement yourself. She waves you goodbye before clip-cloping to the changing rooms.
rows.translation: 实现肉体欲望的前景催促着她匆匆起身。你无法想象她究竟有什么计划，但自己也感到了一丝兴奋。她向你挥手告别，随后哒哒地走向更衣室。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe hurriedly gets up, spurred on by the prospect of fulfilling her physical desires. You can’t quite imagine what she’s got planned but you’re feeling a bit of excitement yourself. She waves you goodbye before clip-cloping to the changing rooms."

rows.original: You take your own leave, thinking to return later once she’s prepared.
rows.translation: 你也告辞离开，想着等她准备妥当后再回来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take your own leave, thinking to return later once she’s prepared."

rows.original: Mirrin seems quite agitated, most likely due to the incident at the grill earlier. She suddenly drops her barbell mid rep, the very heavy object making a booming noise as it hits the dampening material below. At the same time, she buckles over somewhat and lets out a vicious roar. Not merely a shout, but a roar! Gryvain genes...
rows.translation: 米琳显得相当焦躁，很可能是因为早些时候烧烤店里的意外。她做动作做到一半，突然扔下杠铃；极其沉重的物体撞上下面的减震材料，发出一声巨响。与此同时，她微微弯下身体，发出凶猛的咆哮。那不只是一声喊叫，而是真正的咆哮！格里文基因...

Not merely a shout, but a roar! Gryvain genes..."

rows.raw: "Your posture’s slipping, you should have one,” you say firmly, arms folded."

rows.original: She stops mid rep. She raises an eyebrow, grins and then rolls her eyes. “Sure thing, champ,” she says.
rows.translation: 她在动作中途停下，挑起眉毛，咧嘴一笑，然后翻了个白眼。“当然可以，冠军，”她说道。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe stops mid rep. She raises an eyebrow, grins and then rolls her eyes. “Sure thing, champ,” she says."

rows.original: She inhales sharply through her nose, stops mid rep and looks at your reflection. “Might be right actually,” she replies.
rows.translation: 她猛地用鼻子吸气，在动作中途停下，望向镜中的你。“其实你也许说得对，”她回答。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe inhales sharply through her nose, stops mid rep and looks at your reflection. “Might be right actually,” she replies."

rows.original: She places the barbell on the floor with a dull vumff then takes a big glug of water.
rows.translation: 她把杠铃放到地上，发出沉闷的咚声，随后大口喝水。
rows.raw: " She places the barbell on the floor with a dull vumff then takes a big glug of water."

rows.original: “Chat for a bit?” she shrugs, taking a seat on a bench press nearby, said bench press creaking a little underneath her.
rows.translation: “聊一会儿？”她耸耸肩，在附近的卧推凳上坐下；那张凳子在她身下微微吱响。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Chat for a bit?” she shrugs, taking a seat on a bench press nearby, said bench press creaking a little underneath her."

rows.original: You decide against it at the last second, hoping she’ll understand.

rows.raw: "You decide against it at the last second, hoping she’ll understand."

rows.original: “Bjáni, why bring it up if... fiiine. Ok, no matter, no worries. If and when, just talk to me about it,” she says, blowing out a huff of air at your indecision. “Back to it, I think.”
rows.translation: “蠢货，既然不想说，为什么还要提...好——吧。行，没关系，别担心。等你愿意的时候，跟我谈就好，”她说道，对你的犹豫重重呼出一口气。“我想，该继续练了。”

rows.original: “Wait, stop. I’ve given it some thought and I’m much more into the whole ‘us being friends’ thing. So, I would rather not ruin that with romantic endeavours,” you say flatly and bluntly.

rows.raw: "\n\n“Wait, stop. I’ve given it some thought and I’m much more into the whole ‘us being friends’ thing. So, I would rather not ruin that with romantic endeavours,” you say flatly and bluntly."

rows.original: The she-dragon holds her breath, then smacks her palm to her forehead with a laugh.
rows.translation: 母龙屏住呼吸，随后笑着一巴掌拍在自己额头上。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe she-dragon holds her breath, then smacks her palm to her forehead with a laugh."

rows.original: “Fucking... I did it again, huh? Kind of dragged you around doing this uhh, ‘mixed signals’ shit. Yeah, you know, I get it! I do get it. I’m sorry if it seemed that way but now, I figure that we’re both happier knowing what’s what, huh?” she thinks aloud, her muscular frame visibly relaxing before you.
rows.translation: “操...我又搞砸了，是吧？有点像是拖着你到处跑，搞这种，呃，‘信号混乱’的鬼把戏。好吧，你知道，我懂！我真的懂。要是让你产生了那种感觉，我很抱歉。不过现在嘛，我觉得我们把话说开，双方都会更开心，对吧？”她自言自语般说道，壮硕的身体在你面前明显放松下来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fucking... I did it again, huh? Kind of dragged you around doing this uhh, ‘mixed signals’ shit. Yeah, you know, I get it! I do get it. I’m sorry if it seemed that way but now, I figure that we’re both happier knowing what’s what, huh?” she thinks aloud, her muscular frame visibly relaxing before you."

rows.original: You nod with a reflexive smile on your face. Quite awkward. You got this though, it’s just a quick visit to a clinic, right? Few shots in the arm and all that. rows.original: “Ehh, I don’t know if ‘wrong’ is the right word. Is a bit like, uhhh, how do you say, um... hedged bets. I worked them out badly and now I’m nervous about asking you. Let’s just sit here, huh?” she states, setting herself down on a bench with her hands on her knees. You sit next to her then put your hand on hers to console her, to which you can see a faint flicker of a smile at the corners of her mouth.
rows.translation: “呃，我不知道该不该说是‘出了问题’。这有点像，呃——怎么说来着，嗯...两头下注。我没押好，所以现在很紧张，不知道该怎么问你。我们就坐这儿，好吗？”她说着坐到长椅上，双手搭在膝盖上。你坐在她身旁，把手放到她手上安慰她，只见她嘴角闪过一丝淡淡的笑意。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ehh, I don’t know if ‘wrong’ is the right word. Is a bit like, uhhh, how do you say, um... hedged bets. I worked them out badly and now I’m nervous about asking you. Let’s just sit here, huh?” she states, setting herself down on a bench with her hands on her knees. You sit next to her then put your hand on hers to console her, to which you can see a faint flicker of a smile at the corners of her mouth."

rows.original: So.

rows.original: We’ve been kind of open about all this, right? Having some pretty great fucking and the rest of it, no strings, no commitment. But like, I guess I’ve never been that open as a person. Not with the full history, you know. Most of it is pretty mundane,” she explains somewhat haphazardly, chuckling at her last sentence. “But I’m in a real good spot. More than enough to live off and to support anyone I chose, adoring fans all over the galaxy, someone pretty close to me...”
rows.translation: 我们对这些事一直都挺坦诚的，对吧？上过几次很爽的床，还有其他那些事；不附带条件，也不需要承诺。不过，我想我本来就不是什么特别坦率的人。至少没把自己的全部经历说出来，你懂吧。大部分其实都挺平淡的，”她颇为凌乱地解释着，说到最后一句时轻笑起来。“但我现在过得真的很好。钱多得足够自己生活，也足够供养任何我选择的人；全银河都有崇拜我的粉丝，还有一个和我很亲近的人...”
rows.raw: " We’ve been kind of open about all this, right? Having some pretty great fucking and the rest of it, no strings, no commitment. But like, I guess I’ve never been that open as a person. Not with the full history, you know. Most of it is pretty mundane,” she explains somewhat haphazardly, chuckling at her last sentence. “But I’m in a real good spot. More than enough to live off and to support anyone I chose, adoring fans all over the galaxy, someone pretty close to me...”"

rows.original: She puts her other rough-skinned palm on top of your hand, giving it a soft and warm squeeze.
rows.translation: 她把另一只皮肤粗糙的手掌覆在你手上，温柔而暖和地握了握。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe puts her other rough-skinned palm on top of your hand, giving it a soft and warm squeeze."

rows.original: “And I guess I never talked about some other things. Did you know I’m 38 next year? This kind of life breezes by when you hit a number like that. Like, I never even remembered until dad mailed me a few days ago to uhhh, say things about my birthday,” she continues, her nervousness giving way to relief as she talks.
rows.translation: “而且我想，有些事我一直没说过。你知道我明年就38岁了吗？活到这个岁数，日子一眨眼就过去了。就像，我自己都忘了，直到爸爸几天前给我发消息，呃——说了些生日的事，”她继续说道，随着话语出口，紧张逐渐化作释然。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And I guess I never talked about some other things. Did you know I’m 38 next year? This kind of life breezes by when you hit a number like that. rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: Mmm, peaceful.
rows.translation: 嗯，好安宁。
rows.raw: "Mmm, peaceful."

rows.original: Peaceful sleep.
rows.translation: 安稳的睡眠。
rows.raw: "\n\nPeaceful sleep."

rows.original: No reason to wake up. No pain, no confusion, just effortless bliss. But don’t you have a... thing... you were doing... what was it...?
rows.translation: 没有理由醒来。没有痛苦，没有困惑，只有不费吹灰之力的幸福。可你不是还有件...事情...正在做吗...是什么来着...？
rows.raw: "\n\nNo reason to wake up. No pain, no confusion, just effortless bliss. But don’t you have a... thing... you were doing... what was it...?"

rows.original: Your eyes and ears open up to the slowly to the white world around you. Beep. Beep. Beep.
rows.translation: 你的眼睛和耳朵缓缓向周围的白色世界敞开。哔。哔。哔。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour eyes and ears open up to the slowly to the white world around you. Beep. Beep. Beep."

rows.original: A pulse monitor? Gah, that light is so blinding...
rows.translation: 脉搏监测仪？呃，那盏灯太刺眼了...
rows.raw: "\n\nA pulse monitor? Gah, that light is so blinding..."

rows.original: Coming to, you realize that you are... in the Nursery.
rows.translation: 恢复意识后，你发现自己...身处育儿中心。
rows.raw: "\n\nComing to, you realize that you are... in the Nursery."

rows.original: Your body is stiff as a board, the will to move your limbs dissipating as tiredness brickwalls your mind. What’s happening, where’s the...
rows.translation: 你的身体僵硬如木板，疲倦如砖墙般封死思绪，让你失去活动四肢的意愿。发生什么了，那个...在哪？
rows.raw: "\n\nYour body is stiff as a board, the will to move your limbs dissipating as tiredness brickwalls your mind. What’s happening, where’s the..."

rows.original: Baby?
rows.translation: 宝宝？
rows.raw: "\n\nBaby?"

rows.original: The impetus comes to turn your head, first to the right and then to the left. Nothing on the right but...
rows.translation: 你产生了转头的冲动，先看右边，再看左边。右边什么也没有，可是...
rows.raw: "\n\nThe impetus comes to turn your head, first to the right and then to the left. Nothing on the right but..."

rows.original: Next to you sits a familiar figure, slouched against an ill-fitting chair with folded arms. Mirrin sits there with her head bent forward, napping away.
rows.translation: 你的身旁坐着一道熟悉的身影，双臂交叠，缩在不合身的椅子上。米琳坐在那里，脑袋低垂着打盹。
rows.raw: "\n\nNext to you sits a familiar figure, slouched against an ill-fitting chair with folded arms. Mirrin sits there with her head bent forward, napping away."

rows.original: She’s a little...different? Casual? Loose black tanktop, gray yoga pants, silvered hair unbound and left to sit loosely over her tensed-up shoulders. How long has she been there, waiting and on duty?
rows.translation: 她看起来有些...不同？随意？宽松的黑色背心、灰色瑜伽裤，银白色头发没有束起，松散地披在紧绷的肩头。她在那里等候并守了多久？
rows.raw: "\n\nShe’s a little...different? Casual? Loose black tanktop, gray yoga pants, silvered hair unbound and left to sit loosely over her tensed-up shoulders. How long has she been there, waiting and on duty?"

rows.original: You can see automated staff roaming around the corridors through the doorway, occasionally seeing the familiar face of Briget wander past.
rows.translation: 透过门口，你能看到自动工作人员在走廊里往来，偶尔还能看见布丽姬特那张熟悉的脸经过。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can see automated staff roaming around the corridors through the doorway, occasionally seeing the familiar face of Briget wander past."

rows.original: pregnancy/total day care
rows.raw: "pregnancy/total day care"

rows.original: Most likely tending to your other kids, you reckon. Seeing her do her life’s passion puts you at ease: safe, secure, familiar hands.
rows.translation: 你猜，她多半是在照料你的其他孩子。看着她从事自己毕生热爱的工作，你便放下心来：安全、稳妥，而且是熟悉的人照料。
rows.raw: "\n\nMost likely tending to your other kids, you reckon. Seeing her do her life’s passion puts you at ease: safe, secure, familiar hands."

rows.original: Oh right, now she actually has something to do... maybe you should have more kids? Mmmm, let’s not think about that right now.
rows.translation: 哦，对了，现在她确实有事可做了...或许你应该再多生几个孩子？嗯，眼下还是别想这个了。
rows.raw: "\n\nOh right, now she actually has something to do... maybe you should have more kids? Mmmm, let’s not think about that right now."

rows.original: Speaking of kids, you really, really want to know where your newborn has ended up. Like right now.
rows.translation: 说到孩子，你真的，真的很想知道自己的新生儿去了哪里。就是现在。
rows.raw: "\n\nSpeaking of kids, you really, really want to know where your newborn has ended up. Like right now."

rows.original: “Miirrrrnnn...” you slur with loose lips, your throat hoarse and dry. Exhaustion? Anaesthetic...? You try turning your head to her anyway, desperately wishing that your meek cries will awaken the sleeping dragon.
rows.translation: “米——琳——...”你嘴唇松弛，含糊地说道，喉咙沙哑而干涩。是疲惫？麻醉剂...？即便如此，你还是试着把头转向她，拼命希望自己微弱的呼唤能够唤醒沉睡的巨龙。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Miirrrrnnn...” you slur with loose lips, your throat hoarse and dry. Exhaustion? Anaesthetic...? You try turning your head to her anyway, desperately wishing that your meek cries will awaken the sleeping dragon."

rows.original: “Mirrin...!” you try calling out, still slurring.
rows.translation: “米琳...！”你再次试着呼唤，仍然含糊不清。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mirrin...!” you try calling out, still slurring."

rows.original: “Ertu... aaaalgjör... hálfviti...” she murmurs, her own voice just as slurred as yours. Dumbass dragon...
rows.translation: “你...真——是...个蠢货...”她喃喃说道，嗓音和你一样含糊。蠢货巨龙...
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ertu... aaaalgjör... hálfviti...” she murmurs, her own voice just as slurred as yours. Dumbass dragon..."

rows.original: “Oh come on,” you sigh, regaining a bit of intelligibility.
rows.translation: “哦，拜托，”你叹了口气，说话稍微清楚了一点。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh come on,” you sigh, regaining a bit of intelligibility."

rows.original: “Eh huh, what, fucking, lawyers, what,” she mumbles, jolting awake in shock from her dreams. “[pc.name]...”
rows.translation: “呃，哈，什么，他妈的，律师，什么，”她嘟囔着，从梦中惊醒，吓得猛然一颤。“[pc.name]...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Eh huh, what, fucking, lawyers, what,” she mumbles, jolting awake in shock from her dreams. “[pc.name]...”"

rows.original: She turns to you, her stony face lighting up with a wide grin you’d have thought she’d never wear.
rows.translation: 她转向你，那张岩石般的面孔绽开灿烂笑容，是你从未想过她会露出的表情。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe turns to you, her stony face lighting up with a wide grin you’d have thought she’d never wear."

rows.original: “Fuck, fuck! Uh, uhh, just hold it, stay down. Don’t move, there was some trouble with the birth and the thing an-”
rows.translation: “操，操！呃，呃呃，撑住，躺好。别动，分娩时出了点状况，而且那东-”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fuck, fuck! Uh, uhh, just hold it, stay down. Don’t move, there was some trouble with the birth and the thing an-”"

rows.original: “Where’s the baby?” you interrupt coolly, stopping her mid sentence. She inhales in an effort to stop herself from babbling.
rows.translation: “宝宝在哪？”你冷静地打断她，让她的话戛然而止。她吸了口气，努力阻止自己继续语无伦次。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Where’s the baby?” you interrupt coolly, stopping her mid sentence. She inhales in an effort to stop herself from babbling."

rows.original: “Right, right! I’ll just be uhhh, moment, moment!”
rows.translation: “对，对！我马上就，呃呃，等等，等等！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Right, right! I’ll just be uhhh, moment, moment!”"

rows.original: You’ve never seen her bolt so quickly. With large strides, the flustered qilin darts out of the room with heavy hoofsteps then turns right for some other part of the Nursery. Huh.
rows.translation: 你从未见她冲得这么快。慌乱的麒麟迈开大步，伴随沉重的蹄声飞奔出房间，随后右转前往育儿中心的其他区域。嗯。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve never seen her bolt so quickly. With large strides, the flustered qilin darts out of the room with heavy hoofsteps then turns right for some other part of the Nursery. Huh."

rows.original: Hopefully the staff don’t try to stop a bull in its tracks... or a dragon-horse in this case.
rows.translation: 希望工作人员别试图拦住一头狂奔的公牛...或者在这里，该说是龙马。
rows.raw: "\n\nHopefully the staff don’t try to stop a bull in its tracks... or a dragon-horse in this case."

rows.original: In moments, she’s back and cradling a bundle of blankets in her palms. Ohh...! Is that-
rows.translation: 片刻后，她便回来了，掌中还抱着一团襁褓。哦哦...！那是-
rows.raw: "\n\nIn moments, she’s back and cradling a bundle of blankets in her palms. Ohh...! Is that-"

rows.original: “Heeere! Say hello to little Torri,” she exclaims, delicately placing the bundle into your lap. She takes her place next to you, kneeling by the bedside with her chin rest on her palms.
rows.translation: “来——啦！快跟小托莉打个招呼，”她大声说道，小心翼翼地将襁褓放到你的腿上。她在你身旁就位，跪在床边，把下巴托在双掌上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Heeere! Say hello to little Torri,” she exclaims, delicately placing the bundle into your lap. She takes her place next to you, kneeling by the bedside with her chin rest on her palms."

rows.original: With a huge swelling of anticipation, you peel back the blanket covering the little babe’s face. What you see is a tiny face of dusky skin, the wispiest of silver-white hair and two tiny nubs on the forehead where front-facing horns would be. The adorable tot sleeps soundly in deep peace, compelling you to cradle the small thing in your arms.
rows.translation: 期待感猛然膨胀，你掀开盖住小宝宝面庞的毯子。映入眼帘的是一张暮色肌肤的小脸、几缕纤细至极的银白色头发，还有额头上两处将来会长成前向犄角的小突起。这个可爱的孩子正沉浸在宁静的酣睡中，让你忍不住将小小的她搂入怀里。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith a huge swelling of anticipation, you peel back the blanket covering the little babe’s face. What you see is a tiny face of dusky skin, the wispiest of silver-white hair and two tiny nubs on the forehead where front-facing horns would be. The adorable tot sleeps soundly in deep peace, compelling you to cradle the small thing in your arms."

rows.original: <i>“Isn’t she just... amazing?
rows.translation: <i>“她是不是简直...太棒了？
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Isn’t she just... amazing?"

rows.original: Let’s put her in the same room as Jenta, yeah? They haven’t even met yet.
rows.translation: 让她和延塔住同一个房间，好吗？她们甚至还没见过面呢。
rows.raw: " Let’s put her in the same room as Jenta, yeah? They haven’t even met yet."

rows.original: I wonder how she’ll take to you, hm?” she says sleepily, gently rubbing the back of her hand against your cheek.
rows.translation: 不知道她会不会喜欢你，嗯？”她困倦地说道，用手背轻轻蹭过你的脸颊。
rows.raw: " I wonder how she’ll take to you, hm?” she says sleepily, gently rubbing the back of her hand against your cheek."

rows.original: “Mm, my beautiful babes...”
rows.translation: “嗯，我美丽的小宝贝们...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mm, my beautiful babes...”"

rows.original: As you smile back to her, a tiny cough splutters from below. You look down and see two, tiny draconic eyes of [pc.eyeColor] look back to you.
rows.translation: 你对她回以微笑时，下方传来一声细小的呛咳。你低头看去，只见一双[pc.eyeColor]色的小小龙眸正回望着你。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you smile back to her, a tiny cough splutters from below. You look down and see two, tiny draconic eyes of [pc.eyeColor] look back to you."

rows.original: “Mahbububbubbbb...”
rows.translation: “嘛卟咘卟卟卟...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mahbububbubbbb...”"

rows.original: “Toooorri?” you say softly to the babbling babe, eliciting a smile from her and from Mirrin.
rows.translation: “托——莉？”你对牙牙学语的宝宝轻声说道，引得她和米琳一同露出笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Toooorri?” you say softly to the babbling babe, eliciting a smile from her and from Mirrin."

rows.original: “Heeey, it’s mom, yeah? Aren’t you just the sweetest!”
rows.translation: “嘿——，是妈妈哦，对吧？你怎么能这么可爱！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Heeey, it’s mom, yeah? Aren’t you just the sweetest!”"

rows.original: “Mwuhbuh...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mwuhbuh...”"

rows.original: You find it impossible to look away from your newborn daughter, nuzzling your nose to that tiny button of hers. The response is a joyful little squeal: she’s taken to you!
rows.translation: 你发现自己根本无法移开望向新生女儿的目光，用鼻子蹭着她那颗小巧的纽扣鼻。回应你的是一声欢快的细小尖叫：她喜欢上你了！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou find it impossible to look away from your newborn daughter, nuzzling your nose to that tiny button of hers. The response is a joyful little squeal: she’s taken to you!"

rows.original: With an audible shuffle from your left, Mirrin looms into view from your side, looking down at the vulnerable bundle with glassy eyes.
rows.translation: 左侧传来清晰的窸窣声，米琳的身影从你身侧探入视野，用湿润的双眼俯视着脆弱的襁褓。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith an audible shuffle from your left, Mirrin looms into view from your side, looking down at the vulnerable bundle with glassy eyes."

rows.original: “You know uh... you blacked out pretty hardcore, elskan. Nurses went ham and fist with the, uh, anesthetic. You just lying so still, I didn’t...,” she says slowly, wiping her eyes with her palm. “Knew you could do it though, not called Steele for nothing, huh?”
rows.translation: “你知道，呃...你当时昏得挺彻底的，亲爱的。护士们把那个，呃，麻醉剂，用得可猛了。看着你一动不动地躺着，我没有...”她缓缓说道，用手掌擦拭双眼。“不过我知道你能做到，不然怎么会叫斯蒂尔呢，嗯？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You know uh... you blacked out pretty hardcore, elskan. Nurses went ham and fist with the, uh, anesthetic. You just lying so still, I didn’t...,” she says slowly, wiping her eyes with her palm. “Knew you could do it though, not called Steele for nothing, huh?”"

rows.original: A heavy hand massages your left shoulder, to which you feel the urge to rest your head on it. There there, ya big lug, everything’s fine!
rows.translation: 一只沉重的手揉着你的左肩，你不由得想把脑袋靠在上面。好了好了，你这大块头，一切都没事！
rows.raw: "\n\nA heavy hand massages your left shoulder, to which you feel the urge to rest your head on it. There there, ya big lug, everything’s fine!"

rows.original: KALAS.TAVROS.NURSERYG4
rows.raw: "KALAS.TAVROS.NURSERYG4"

rows.original: Disarmed
rows.raw: "Disarmed"

rows.original: Disarmed
rows.raw: "Disarmed"

rows.original: Disarmed
rows.raw: "Disarmed"

rows.original: KALAS.TAVROS.TAVROS HANGAR
rows.raw: "KALAS.TAVROS.TAVROS HANGAR"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Done Birthing!
rows.translation: 分娩结束！
rows.raw: "Done Birthing!"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: You spend several hours together, just the three of you. You notice all of Torri’s little quirks and reactions: she’s very much drawn to your [pc.eyes], she loves it when you boop her nose in particular and, in turn, the sensation of her soft baby skin is a delight to tickle and touch.
rows.translation: 你们三人一起度过了几个小时。你留意到托莉所有的小习惯和反应：她非常容易被你的[pc.eyes]吸引，尤其喜欢你轻点她鼻子，而她柔软的婴儿肌肤反过来也让你十分享受挠弄和触摸的感觉。
rows.raw: "You spend several hours together, just the three of you. You notice all of Torri’s little quirks and reactions: she’s very much drawn to your [pc.eyes], she loves it when you boop her nose in particular and, in turn, the sensation of her soft baby skin is a delight to tickle and touch."

rows.original: A nursedroid comes by with nutrient supplements.
rows.translation: 一台护理机器人带来了营养补充剂。
rows.raw: "\n\nA nursedroid comes by with nutrient supplements. "

rows.original: As with Jenta, she
rows.translation: 和延塔一样，她
rows.raw: "As with Jenta, she"

rows.original: She
rows.translation: 她
rows.raw: "She"

rows.original: insists upon a potent ‘booster mix’ instead of natural milk for the first few days. You and Mirrin accept readily, only wishing the best for your babe.
rows.translation: 坚持最初几天要使用强效的‘强化配方’，而非天然乳汁。你和米琳欣然同意，只希望给宝宝最好的选择。
rows.raw: " insists upon a potent ‘booster mix’ instead of natural milk for the first few days. You and Mirrin accept readily, only wishing the best for your babe."

rows.original: The towering dragoness seems to hit an idea and leaves the room, returning in time with baby Jenta.
rows.translation: 高大的龙女似乎突然想到什么，离开了房间，回来时带着小宝宝延塔。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe towering dragoness seems to hit an idea and leaves the room, returning in time with baby Jenta."

rows.original: Putting yet another small bundle into your arms, you angle Jenta and Torri so that their eyelines meet. The two tiny tots stare at each other without making much movement, apparently awestruck with each others presence. After a few moments of you and Mirrin observing the two, both babies giggle at each in unison. Aww...
rows.translation: 她又把一团小襁褓放进你的臂弯，你调整延塔和托莉的位置，让她们的视线相交。两个小家伙一动不动地凝视彼此，显然都被对方迷住了。你和米琳观察片刻后，两个宝宝同时对彼此咯咯笑了起来。啊呜...
rows.raw: "\n\nPutting yet another small bundle into your arms, you angle Jenta and Torri so that their eyelines meet. The two tiny tots stare at each other without making much movement, apparently awestruck with each others presence. After a few moments of you and Mirrin observing the two, both babies giggle at each in unison. Aww..."

rows.original: “Best of friends already, huh? Little flón...”
rows.translation: “已经成了最好的朋友，是吗？小笨蛋...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Best of friends already, huh? Little flón...”"

rows.original: You’re not quite sure if that’s a pet name or something else.
rows.translation: 你不太确定那是昵称还是别的什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re not quite sure if that’s a pet name or something else."

rows.original: The two of them are swiftly asleep however: too much excitement for one day! Mirrin summons a nursedroid and the robo-matron takes them back to their shared room, audio of some unknown lullaby playing from her head unit.
rows.translation: 不过她们很快便睡着了：一天内经历的兴奋已经太多！米琳召来一台护理机器人，机器保姆把她们送回共用的房间，头部装置还播放着某首陌生的摇篮曲。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two of them are swiftly asleep however: too much excitement for one day! Mirrin summons a nursedroid and the robo-matron takes them back to their shared room, audio of some unknown lullaby playing from her head unit."

rows.original: You spend an hour or so with Mirrin and Torri but it’s not too long before Torri is fast asleep in your arms after her meal, her lit face returning to the adorable sleepy expression from before.
rows.translation: 你和米琳、托莉一起待了一个小时左右，但托莉吃完饭后没多久便在你怀里酣然入睡，明亮的小脸也重新浮现出先前那副可爱的睡颜。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou spend an hour or so with Mirrin and Torri but it’s not too long before Torri is fast asleep in your arms after her meal, her lit face returning to the adorable sleepy expression from before."

rows.original: Mirrin summons a nursedroid and the robo-matron takes tiny Torri back to their shared room with the audio of some unknown lullaby playing from her head unit.
rows.translation: 米琳召来一台护理机器人，机器保姆把小托莉送回她们共用的房间，头部装置还播放着某首陌生的摇篮曲。
rows.raw: "\n\nMirrin summons a nursedroid and the robo-matron takes tiny Torri back to their shared room with the audio of some unknown lullaby playing from her head unit."

rows.original: After saying goodbye to your
rows.translation: 向你的
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter saying goodbye to your "

rows.original: pregnancy/total day care
rows.raw: "pregnancy/total day care"

rows.original: tots
rows.translation: 小家伙们
rows.raw: "tots"

rows.original: tot
rows.translation: 小家伙
rows.raw: "tot"

rows.original: , you’re feeling ready to get out and about. Ain’t no internal bleeding gonna stop you!
rows.translation: 道别后，你已经准备好出去活动了。区区内出血可阻止不了你！
rows.raw: ", you’re feeling ready to get out and about. Ain’t no internal bleeding gonna stop you!"

rows.original: With a little guidance from Mirrin’s palm, you slip out of the bed and out of the medical gown you’ve been given. Re-applying your [pc.gear], you turn to your...hmm, what is she now? Girlfriend? Partner...?
rows.translation: 在米琳手掌的稍加引导下，你滑下床铺，脱掉身上的病号服。重新穿好[pc.gear]后，你转向自己的...嗯，她现在算是什么？女朋友？伴侣...？
rows.raw: "\n\nWith a little guidance from Mirrin’s palm, you slip out of the bed and out of the medical gown you’ve been given. Re-applying your [pc.gear], you turn to your...hmm, what is she now? Girlfriend? Partner...?"

rows.original: “Well, if you’re really feeling well, I’m going to watch over the newborn. Doc says you’ll only take a few hours to heal up properly anyhow. One last thing though,” she says,
rows.translation: “好吧，你要是真的感觉不错，我就去照看新生儿了。反正医生说你只要几个小时就能彻底恢复。不过还有最后一件事，”她说着，
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, if you’re really feeling well, I’m going to watch over the newborn. Doc says you’ll only take a few hours to heal up properly anyhow. One last thing though,” she says, "

rows.original: swiftly scooping you up by your waist.
rows.translation: 迅速搂住你的腰把你抱起。
rows.raw: "swiftly scooping you up by your waist."

rows.original: pulling you to her.
rows.translation: 将你拉向她。
rows.raw: "pulling you to her."

rows.original: With your [pc.face] now facing hers, she leans in for a deep, tongue-heavy goodbye kiss.
rows.translation: 你的[pc.face]此时正对着她，她倾身送上一记深情而缠绵的舌吻作为告别。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith your [pc.face] now facing hers, she leans in for a deep, tongue-heavy goodbye kiss."

rows.original: Oo, you... silly dragon...
rows.translation: 哦，你这只...傻龙...
rows.raw: "\n\nOo, you... silly dragon..."

rows.original: You allow her in, feeling at ease despite the body hold she has on you. But just as quickly as she goes in, she pulls out, wiping the side of her mouth with the back of her hand.
rows.translation: 你任她进入，即使身体被她牢牢抱住也依然感到安心。可她来得快，去得也快，随即抽身离开，用手背擦了擦嘴角。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou allow her in, feeling at ease despite the body hold she has on you. But just as quickly as she goes in, she pulls out, wiping the side of her mouth with the back of her hand."

rows.original: “Aight, off you go!”
rows.translation: “好啦，你走吧！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Aight, off you go!”"

joinAfter.expression:
pc.tallness < mirrin.tallness
                          ? "Unwrapping her arms from your waist"
                          : "Letting you slide to the floor"

rows.original: Unwrapping her arms from your waist
rows.translation: 她松开环住你腰间的双臂
rows.raw: "Unwrapping her arms from your waist"

rows.original: Letting you slide to the floor
rows.translation: 她任你滑落到地板上
rows.raw: "Letting you slide to the floor"

rows.original: , the winking dragoness pats you on your [pc.hip] and wanders off to the baby’s room.
rows.translation: ，然后眨着眼的龙女拍拍你的[pc.hip]，转身朝婴儿房走去。
rows.raw: ", the winking dragoness pats you on your [pc.hip] and wanders off to the baby’s room."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Mirrin Birthing!
rows.translation: 米琳分娩！
rows.raw: "Mirrin Birthing!"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: Out of nowhere, your codex begins beeping with a shrill and constant alert. You quickly scramble for the display and gasp at the words flashing back at you: Mirrin Due Date!
rows.translation: 你的法典毫无征兆地发出尖锐而持续的警报声。你迅速抓起显示器，看到闪烁的字样后倒吸一口气：米琳预产期！
rows.raw: "Out of nowhere, your codex begins beeping with a shrill and constant alert. You quickly scramble for the display and gasp at the words flashing back at you: Mirrin Due Date!"

rows.original: She’s gone into labor!
rows.translation: 她开始分娩了！
rows.raw: "\n\nShe’s gone into labor!"

rows.original: Tavros Station
rows.raw: "Tavros Station"

rows.original: Eep, she’s close by! Figuring that she’s most likely in good hands from the automated medical services of the station, you sprint freely towards the closest entrance to the Nursery.
rows.translation: 噫，她就在附近！想到空间站的自动医疗服务很可能已经让她得到妥善照料，你全速冲向离育儿中心最近的入口。
rows.raw: "\n\nEep, she’s close by! Figuring that she’s most likely in good hands from the automated medical services of the station, you sprint freely towards the closest entrance to the Nursery."

rows.original: Fuck, you’re not anywhere close!
rows.translation: 操，你离得太远了！
rows.raw: "\n\nFuck, you’re not anywhere close!"

rows.original: The world mutes around you and all you hear is your heart beating through to your throat. Going into autopilot, you practically sprint to the direction of your ship. You’re not even mindful of the business you came here for.
rows.translation: 周围的世界陷入寂静，你只能听见心跳一路撞到喉头。身体进入自动驾驶状态，几乎是朝飞船所在的方向狂奔。你甚至完全顾不上原本来这里要办的事。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe world mutes around you and all you hear is your heart beating through to your throat. Going into autopilot, you practically sprint to the direction of your ship. You’re not even mindful of the business you came here for."

rows.original: You rush to your ship, hastily clamber into the shuddering vessel and set course for Tavros!
rows.translation: 你冲向飞船，匆忙爬进颤动的船体，设定航线直奔塔弗罗斯！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou rush to your ship, hastily clamber into the shuddering vessel and set course for Tavros!"

rows.original: To Mirrin!
rows.translation: 去找米琳！
rows.raw: "To Mirrin!"

rows.original: Mirrin Birthing!
rows.translation: 米琳分娩！
rows.raw: "Mirrin Birthing!"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: The nursery brims with the hustle-and-bustle of emergency support staff. You’re not even sure if the nursery even had this many staff... is all this just for Mirrin?
rows.translation: 育儿中心里挤满了忙碌奔走的紧急支援人员。你甚至不确定这里原本有没有这么多员工...这一切都是为了米琳吗？
rows.raw: "The nursery brims with the hustle-and-bustle of emergency support staff. You’re not even sure if the nursery even had this many staff... is all this just for Mirrin?"

rows.original: There’s a heavy thundering sound from upstairs. You can’t quite say what it is, but all the busybodies in the room shudder and wince momentarily as it happens. With utmost professionalism, the staff continue on as if nothing had happened.
rows.translation: 楼上传来沉重的轰隆声。你说不清那是什么，但声音响起时，房间里所有忙碌的人都瞬间哆嗦了一下，露出痛苦的表情。员工们以最高的职业素养继续工作，仿佛什么都没发生。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s a heavy thundering sound from upstairs. You can’t quite say what it is, but all the busybodies in the room shudder and wince momentarily as it happens. With utmost professionalism, the staff continue on as if nothing had happened."

rows.original: A nursedroid takes you by the hand out of nowhere.
rows.translation: 一台护理机器人突然牵住你的手。
rows.raw: "\n\nA nursedroid takes you by the hand out of nowhere."

rows.original: Mr
rows.translation: 先生
rows.raw: "Mr"

rows.original: Miss
rows.translation: 女士
rows.raw: "Miss"

rows.original: Steele! It’s best if you wait here. Things are dicey upstairs! Miss Arkosduttir has not been cooperative even in her dilatory state and we can’t account for anyone’s personal safety at present. She’s in your room right now...”
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔！你最好在这里等候。楼上的情况很危险！阿科斯杜蒂尔女士即使在临产状态下也完全不肯配合，我们目前无法保证任何人的人身安全。她现在就在你的房间里...”
rows.raw: " Steele! It’s best if you wait here. Things are dicey upstairs! Miss Arkosduttir has not been cooperative even in her dilatory state and we can’t account for anyone’s personal safety at present. She’s in your room right now...”"

rows.original: She trails off, as if remembering some bad news that she missed out.
rows.translation: 她声音渐弱，仿佛突然想起自己漏说了一条坏消息。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe trails off, as if remembering some bad news that she missed out."

rows.original: “You might need a new door frame or even a, uhhhh, mmm, bed.”
rows.translation: “你可能需要换个新门框，甚至还要，呃呃呃，嗯，换张床。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You might need a new door frame or even a, uhhhh, mmm, bed.”"

rows.original: You’re still in autopilot; your brain takes a few fuzzy seconds to process what she’s saying and what you think you should do next.
rows.translation: 你仍处于自动驾驶状态；大脑昏沉了好几秒，才处理好她说的话，以及自己认为接下来该做什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re still in autopilot; your brain takes a few fuzzy seconds to process what she’s saying and what you think you should do next."

rows.original: “Takemethere! I have to see!” you blurt out, shaking the poor nursedroid by her scrub-covered forearms.
rows.translation: “带我过去！我必须看看！”你脱口而出，抓住可怜护理机器人被手术服包裹的前臂一阵摇晃。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Takemethere! I have to see!” you blurt out, shaking the poor nursedroid by her scrub-covered forearms."

rows.original: “Ayeee, ok! Just follow me,” she flusters back, guiding you to the next floor...
rows.translation: “呀啊，好！跟我来就行，”她慌忙回应，带你前往下一层...
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ayeee, ok! Just follow me,” she flusters back, guiding you to the next floor..."

rows.original: NURSERYE14
rows.raw: "NURSERYE14"

rows.original: Disarmed
rows.raw: "Disarmed"

rows.original: Disarmed
rows.raw: "Disarmed"

rows.original: Disarmed
rows.raw: "Disarmed"

rows.original: KALAS.TAVROS.TAVROS HANGAR
rows.raw: "KALAS.TAVROS.TAVROS HANGAR"

rows.original: Tavros Station
rows.raw: "Tavros Station"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Mirrin Birthing!
rows.translation: 米琳分娩！
rows.raw: "Mirrin Birthing!"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: As you’re led upstairs, the clamour of disgruntled voices and pained cries echoes throughout the upper floor. More and more nurses run in and out of your apartment room with various sundries. You’re pretty sure you can hear Mirrin’s voice yelling a muffled tirade of obscenities. Something about... tearing the seats of the gods asunder and something else about frozen entrails baked in brain matter.
rows.translation: 在她带你上楼时，不满的喊声与痛苦的叫声回荡在整个上层。越来越多的护士带着各种用品进出你的公寓房间。你相当确信自己能听见米琳压低声音大骂不止。内容好像是...把众神的宝座撕碎，还有什么把冰冻内脏塞进脑浆里烤。
rows.raw: "As you’re led upstairs, the clamour of disgruntled voices and pained cries echoes throughout the upper floor. More and more nurses run in and out of your apartment room with various sundries. You’re pretty sure you can hear Mirrin’s voice yelling a muffled tirade of obscenities. Something about... tearing the seats of the gods asunder and something else about frozen entrails baked in brain matter."

rows.original: Both you and the nurse gingerly press on through the corridors, getting brief welcomes from the rushing staff as you pass. You try your best to acknowledge them but only one pressing thought goes through your head: your baby.
rows.translation: 你和护士都小心翼翼地穿过走廊，沿途匆忙的工作人员纷纷简短地向你问候。你尽力回应他们，但脑海里只有一个迫切的念头：你的宝宝。
rows.raw: "\n\nBoth you and the nurse gingerly press on through the corridors, getting brief welcomes from the rushing staff as you pass. You try your best to acknowledge them but only one pressing thought goes through your head: your baby."

rows.original: “Ohhhooooo no, you’re NOT sedating me! MOTHERFOKKERS, the fuck is STEELE?!”
rows.translation: “哦哦哦哦不行，你们休想给我打镇静剂！狗娘养的，斯蒂尔他妈的在哪？！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ohhhooooo no, you’re NOT sedating me! MOTHERFOKKERS, the fuck is STEELE?!”"

rows.original: That bellow makes you stop in your tracks. Once again, the world seems to slow and focus on your heartbeat as you hear her... in danger?? You can’t be sure. Feet carry you before you can even think on it and in moments, you’re at the apartment door...
rows.translation: 那声咆哮让你的脚步骤然停下。世界似乎再度放慢，只剩心跳声占据全部注意力，因为你听见她...遇到危险了？？你无法确定。你甚至来不及思考，双脚便自行迈动，转眼间已来到公寓门口...
rows.raw: "\n\nThat bellow makes you stop in your tracks. Once again, the world seems to slow and focus on your heartbeat as you hear her... in danger?? You can’t be sure. Feet carry you before you can even think on it and in moments, you’re at the apartment door..."

rows.original: NURSERYG6
rows.raw: "NURSERYG6"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Mirrin Birthing!
rows.translation: 米琳分娩！
rows.raw: "Mirrin Birthing!"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: ...Only to find the entrance busted up and an armed security officer standing outside it.
rows.translation: ...结果却发现入口已被砸烂，外面还站着一名全副武装的安保人员。
rows.raw: "...Only to find the entrance busted up and an armed security officer standing outside it."

rows.original: Uhh..
rows.raw: "\n\nUhh.."

rows.original: The nursedroid has a few words with him but the human officer merely raises his hand up.
rows.translation: 护理机器人和他说了几句话，但那名人类警卫只是抬起手。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe nursedroid has a few words with him but the human officer merely raises his hand up."

rows.original: “Sorry ma’am, it’s in the MirrinBoss contract: unessential personnel are not allowed in until the whole thing’s over an’ done with. Not my rules, just whoever owns the boss’s contract,” is his loud reply, his face and stance unwavering.
rows.translation: “抱歉，女士，米琳Boss合同里写得很清楚：整件事结束前，非必要人员不得入内。不是我的规矩，是那位拥有老板合同的人定的，”他高声回答，表情与站姿都纹丝不动。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sorry ma’am, it’s in the MirrinBoss contract: unessential personnel are not allowed in until the whole thing’s over an’ done with. Not my rules, just whoever owns the boss’s contract,” is his loud reply, his face and stance unwavering."

rows.original: You follow up behind the droid and confront the guard, explaining in perhaps more-than-necessary detail that it’s your baby in that room and your baby momma giving birth in that room he’s guarding.
rows.translation: 你跟在机器人身后上前质问警卫，或许用了远超必要程度的细节，说明房间里的宝宝是你的，而他所守房间里正在分娩的产妇也是你孩子的妈妈。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou follow up behind the droid and confront the guard, explaining in perhaps more-than-necessary detail that it’s your baby in that room and your baby momma giving birth in that room he’s guarding."

rows.original: <i>“Uhhhh, relations aside, it still stands I’m afraid. You see dis,
rows.translation: <i>“呃呃呃，先不论你们的关系，恐怕规矩依然有效。你看这个，
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Uhhhh, relations aside, it still stands I’m afraid. You see dis, "

rows.original: sir
rows.translation: 先生
rows.raw: "sir"

rows.original: ma’am
rows.translation: 女士
rows.raw: "ma’am"

rows.original: ?” he says firmly, pointing at a busted control panel and wrenched door lock next to him.
rows.translation: ？”他语气坚定地说道，同时指向身旁被砸烂的控制面板和扭坏的门锁。
rows.raw: "?” he says firmly, pointing at a busted control panel and wrenched door lock next to him."

rows.original: “Dis ‘ere’s why security is needed for the Boss or rather... other people. Yeah, it’s fucked up but it’s in her and my contract. Don’t ask me who wrote it in either, I’m jus’ doing a job. You can wait around until the medics are all done getting that tyke outta her though.”
rows.translation: “这玩意儿就是老板需要安保的原因，或者更确切地说...是其他人需要安保的原因。对，这确实乱七八糟，但合同里就是这么写她和我的。也别问是谁写进去的，我只是在干活。不过你可以在附近等着，直到医护人员把那个小家伙从她肚子里弄出来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Dis ‘ere’s why security is needed for the Boss or rather... other people. Yeah, it’s fucked up but it’s in her and my contract. Don’t ask me who wrote it in either, I’m jus’ doing a job. You can wait around until the medics are all done getting that tyke outta her though.”"

rows.original: He flings his hands to the side and shrugs. With an ache in your chest and a heavy sigh, you return back downstairs. Nought to do but wait around for the good news, sucky as the situation is.
rows.translation: 他把双手向旁边一摊，耸了耸肩。你胸中隐隐作痛，重重叹息，随后回到楼下。尽管情况糟透了，也只能在这里等候好消息。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe flings his hands to the side and shrugs. With an ache in your chest and a heavy sigh, you return back downstairs. Nought to do but wait around for the good news, sucky as the situation is."

rows.original: So you wait...
rows.translation: 于是你开始等...
rows.raw: "\n\nSo you wait..."

rows.original: ...and wait...
rows.raw: "...and wait..."

rows.original: ...and wait!
rows.translation: ...还在等！
rows.raw: "...and wait!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: Your dreams are fanciful and confusing. You see images of what you think could be your newborn daughter... starting life full of energy, growing up, starting her first career. It all cycles around in a layer of surreality and joy: she’s either a baker, a high-profile mercenary or professional saleswoman and that’s just one thread that your mind conjures up.
rows.translation: 你的梦境天马行空又混乱不堪。你看见一些画面，似乎是刚出生的女儿...充满活力地开始人生、逐渐长大、踏上第一份事业。一切都在一层超现实感和喜悦中轮转：她时而是面包师，时而是声名显赫的佣兵，又或者是职业销售员，而这还只是你脑海编织出的一条可能性。
rows.raw: "Your dreams are fanciful and confusing. You see images of what you think could be your newborn daughter... starting life full of energy, growing up, starting her first career. It all cycles around in a layer of surreality and joy: she’s either a baker, a high-profile mercenary or professional saleswoman and that’s just one thread that your mind conjures up."

rows.original: You gently wake up to the sounds of idle chatter and a throaty breathing come from underneath you.
rows.translation: 闲聊声和从你身下传来的喉音沉重的呼吸声，让你缓缓醒来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou gently wake up to the sounds of idle chatter and a throaty breathing come from underneath you."

rows.original: You turn your tired gaze to Mirrin, exactly as you left her; still asleep. The egg lays firmly snuggled in between the dragoness’s cleavage and what a comfortable sight it seems to be.
rows.translation: 你用疲惫的目光看向米琳，她和你离开时一模一样，仍然沉睡着。那枚蛋牢牢依偎在龙女的乳沟之间，看起来是如此舒适。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou turn your tired gaze to Mirrin, exactly as you left her; still asleep. The egg lays firmly snuggled in between the dragoness’s cleavage and what a comfortable sight it seems to be."

rows.original: You consider waking her for a moment, but even if you weren’t there to experience it all, she must have had a hell of a time. The thought of all those paparazzi goons hanging around and getting free shots of your intimate moments is something you save for later. Maybe she can give you some answers when she’s up and about!
rows.translation: 你一度考虑叫醒她，但即使你没能亲历全过程，她肯定也经历了一番苦战。想到那些狗仔混蛋四处徘徊，白白拍下你们的私密时刻，你决定晚点再处理。或许等她醒来活动后，可以给你一些答案！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou consider waking her for a moment, but even if you weren’t there to experience it all, she must have had a hell of a time. The thought of all those paparazzi goons hanging around and getting free shots of your intimate moments is something you save for later. Maybe she can give you some answers when she’s up and about!"

rows.original: A nursedroid bumbles into the room.
rows.translation: 一台护理机器人跌跌撞撞地走进房间。
rows.raw: "\n\nA nursedroid bumbles into the room."

rows.original: “Ahh, [pc.Mister] Steele, good morning. You must be quite tired so if you’re willing, I’ll fill you in on everything,” she asks sweetly, hands held to where her sternum would be. You nod.
rows.translation: “啊，[pc.Mister]斯蒂尔，早上好。你一定相当疲倦，如果你愿意，我可以向你说明一切，”她甜甜地问道，双手放在本该是胸骨的位置。你点了点头。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ahh, [pc.Mister] Steele, good morning. You must be quite tired so if you’re willing, I’ll fill you in on everything,” she asks sweetly, hands held to where her sternum would be. You nod."

rows.original: “What do I have to know?” you ask through a dry mouth.
rows.translation: “我需要知道些什么？”你口干舌燥地问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What do I have to know?” you ask through a dry mouth."

rows.original: “One hundred percent natural, perfect birth. A healthy babe rests in the egg and should be expected to hatch in the next week. Ms. Arkosduttir is quite the individual. Most gryvain-related births are tumultuous affairs for the one bearing the burden. Still, smashed doors, battered nurses, scuffs against the walls: apparently it was a ‘nigh-euphoric’ experience. Thankfully a healthy dose of sedatives helped with the damage control,” she explains, smiling sweetly all the while.
rows.translation: “百分之百自然的完美分娩。健康的宝宝正在蛋中休息，预计会在下周内孵化。阿科斯杜蒂尔女士真是位不同凡响的人物。大多数与格里维恩有关的分娩，对承担生育的一方而言都是场动荡不安的经历。不过，砸烂的门、受伤的护士、墙壁上的擦痕：据说这次经历‘近乎欣快’。幸好足量的镇静剂有助于控制损失，”她解释道，全程都挂着甜美的微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“One hundred percent natural, perfect birth. A healthy babe rests in the egg and should be expected to hatch in the next week. Ms. Arkosduttir is quite the individual. Most gryvain-related births are tumultuous affairs for the one bearing the burden. Still, smashed doors, battered nurses, scuffs against the walls: apparently it was a ‘nigh-euphoric’ experience. Thankfully a healthy dose of sedatives helped with the damage control,” she explains, smiling sweetly all the while."

rows.original: There’s a sense of relief coming through her words even if not all your questions were answered. You thank her all the same.
rows.translation: 即使你的问题没有全部得到解答，她的话语中依然透出如释重负的感觉。你还是向她道了谢。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s a sense of relief coming through her words even if not all your questions were answered. You thank her all the same."

rows.original: “Most welcome. We didn’t have much space in the other parts of the nursery for someone of her particular stature so we had to make do per the head nurse’s instruction. Ah, and Ms. Arkosduttir also conveyed her wish for you to not worry about her if you awoke first. She was very intent on making sure you carried on as normal and visited her when she was awake. Expect a message when the egg hatches. That was all.”
rows.translation: “不客气。育儿中心其他区域没有足够空间容纳她那种特殊体型，所以我们只能遵照护士长的指示因地制宜。啊，阿科斯杜蒂尔女士还表达了一个愿望：如果你先醒来，请不要为她担心。她非常坚持要让你照常生活，等她醒来后再去探望。蛋孵化时，你会收到消息。以上就是全部情况。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Most welcome. We didn’t have much space in the other parts of the nursery for someone of her particular stature so we had to make do per the head nurse’s instruction. Ah, and Ms. Arkosduttir also conveyed her wish for you to not worry about her if you awoke first. She was very intent on making sure you carried on as normal and visited her when she was awake. Expect a message when the egg hatches. That was all.”"

rows.original: You sigh and nod again. It was what she wanted in a way: total responsibility for the
rows.translation: 你叹了口气，再次点头。从某种角度说，这确实是她想要的：承担照料
rows.raw: "\n\nYou sigh and nod again. It was what she wanted in a way: total responsibility for the "

rows.original: newborn
rows.translation: 新生儿
rows.raw: "newborn"

rows.original: newborns
rows.translation: 新生儿们
rows.raw: "newborns"

rows.original: . Although she did also say you could visit whenever you want... your kids after all. Guess you gotta wait for that message.
rows.translation: 的全部责任。不过她也说过，你想什么时候探望都可以...毕竟是你自己的孩子。看来你只能等待那条消息。
rows.raw: ". Although she did also say you could visit whenever you want... your kids after all. Guess you gotta wait for that message."

rows.original: You slowly get up and dust yourself down, replacing Mirrin’s drooping arm back onto the futon-bed.
rows.translation: 你慢慢起身，掸去身上的灰尘，把米琳垂下的手臂放回榻榻米床上。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou slowly get up and dust yourself down, replacing Mirrin’s drooping arm back onto the futon-bed."

rows.original: You bid her and the egg a silent goodbye and the same to the nurse then begrudgingly make your way out of the nursery.
rows.translation: 你无声地向她和那枚蛋道别，也向护士告别，随后不情不愿地离开育儿中心。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou bid her and the egg a silent goodbye and the same to the nurse then begrudgingly make your way out of the nursery."

rows.raw: "MIRRIN_DISABLED"

rows.raw: "MIRRIN_DISABLED"

rows.raw: "KALAS.TAVROS.LIFT: RESIDENTIAL DECK"

rows.original: Mirrin Birthing!
rows.translation: 米琳分娩！
rows.raw: "Mirrin Birthing!"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: You’re given some much needed leeway in the corridor and you’re at the apartment before you know it. The security guard steps aside from the doorway and as you enter the room, quite the sight is there to greet you...
rows.translation: 走廊里为你腾出了急需的空间，还没反应过来，你便已经来到公寓门前。警卫从门口让开，你一进房间，迎面便看到相当惊人的一幕...
rows.raw: "You’re given some much needed leeway in the corridor and you’re at the apartment before you know it. The security guard steps aside from the doorway and as you enter the room, quite the sight is there to greet you..."

rows.original: Sprawled on top of two joined up futons and covered in a mixture of medical scrubs and thin sheets is the reclining form of Mirrin. Her head is held up by several cushions and a small, ovaline bundle of blankets sits in her palms. You can just make out the brownish-white mottling of a shiny smooth egg...
rows.translation: 米琳斜躺在两张拼接起来的榻榻米床上，身上盖着几件医用手术服和薄床单。她的脑袋由好几个垫子支撑，掌中放着一团椭圆形的襁褓。你勉强能看清一枚光滑闪亮的蛋，上面点缀着棕白相间的斑纹...
rows.raw: "\n\nSprawled on top of two joined up futons and covered in a mixture of medical scrubs and thin sheets is the reclining form of Mirrin. Her head is held up by several cushions and a small, ovaline bundle of blankets sits in her palms. You can just make out the brownish-white mottling of a shiny smooth egg..."

rows.original: Surrounding her is an entourage of nurses and medics of all kinds. They’ve turned the main room of your apartment into a kind of emergency pitstop and it’s, uh, kind of a mess. You’re less concerned with that and more concerned with the occasional sounds of snapping cameras and shady folk. It’s doubtless that they’d have some contractual obligation to be there, sad a thought as it is. You save the thought for later to ask Mirrin about this whole ‘life in pictures’ thing she has going on but that can wait.
rows.translation: 她周围簇拥着各式各样的护士与医护人员。他们把你公寓的主房间变成了某种紧急维修站，而且，呃，现场有些混乱。你不太在意这些，反而更担心偶尔响起的相机快门声以及那些形迹可疑的人。尽管这想法令人难过，但毫无疑问，他们必然负有某种必须在场的合同义务。你把这个念头留到以后，准备询问米琳这种‘活在镜头里’的生活究竟怎么回事，不过那可以等一等。
rows.raw: "\n\nSurrounding her is an entourage of nurses and medics of all kinds. They’ve turned the main room of your apartment into a kind of emergency pitstop and it’s, uh, kind of a mess. You’re less concerned with that and more concerned with the occasional sounds of snapping cameras and shady folk. It’s doubtless that they’d have some contractual obligation to be there, sad a thought as it is. You save the thought for later to ask Mirrin about this whole ‘life in pictures’ thing she has going on but that can wait."

rows.original: You shimmy through the motley bunch of nurses and beeline right for your qilin lover. Her groggy expression turns to you as you make your ‘excuse me’s.
rows.translation: 你侧身穿过由护士组成的杂乱人群，直奔自己的麒麟爱侣而去。你一路说着‘借过’，她昏昏沉沉的目光也随之转向你。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shimmy through the motley bunch of nurses and beeline right for your qilin lover. Her groggy expression turns to you as you make your ‘excuse me’s."

rows.original: “Eheeey... it’s my best [pc.boyGirl]. I knew you’d... make it...” she murmurs. Her voice is tired and much huskier than usual; it’s likely she’s been screaming all day. You put your finger to your lips as she tries to muster more words and she nods almost immediately.
rows.translation: “嘿——...是我最棒的[pc.boyGirl]。我就知道你会...赶来的...”她喃喃说道。声音疲惫，比平时沙哑得多；她很可能已经尖叫了一整天。她试图继续开口时，你把手指放在唇边，她几乎立刻便点了点头。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Eheeey... it’s my best [pc.boyGirl]. I knew you’d... make it...” she murmurs. Her voice is tired and much huskier than usual; it’s likely she’s been screaming all day. You put your finger to your lips as she tries to muster more words and she nods almost immediately."

rows.original: You’ve never quite seen her so vulnerable or so placid and drained of energy. You swiftly set yourself by her side with your hands on her arm. The amount of body heat coming off of her is intense, as if she’d gone through a brutal full body workout. The dragoness slides her cradling palms over her front and closer to you so that the shiny, mottled egg is right under you.
rows.translation: 你从未见过她如此脆弱、平静而精疲力尽的模样。你迅速在她身旁坐下，双手扶住她的手臂。她身上散发出的热量异常强烈，仿佛刚经历一场残酷的全身锻炼。龙女将托着东西的手掌从身前滑向你，让那枚光亮斑驳的蛋正好位于你下方。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve never quite seen her so vulnerable or so placid and drained of energy. You swiftly set yourself by her side with your hands on her arm. The amount of body heat coming off of her is intense, as if she’d gone through a brutal full body workout. The dragoness slides her cradling palms over her front and closer to you so that the shiny, mottled egg is right under you."

rows.original: “Jenta...” whispers Mirrin, her drooping eyes focused on the egg. You bend down and kiss the top of the shell, almost automatically. It’s impressively warm against your [pc.lipsChaste] and in the clutches of a small furnace like Mirrin. It’s definitely in the right hands. That’s what instinct is telling you, at least.
rows.translation: “延塔...”米琳低声说道，低垂的双眼专注地望着那枚蛋。你俯身亲吻蛋壳顶部，几乎完全出于本能。它贴着你的[pc.lipsChaste]，温暖得令人惊叹，而米琳就像一座小火炉般将其护在怀中。它显然被托付给了最合适的人。至少你的本能如此告诉你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Jenta...” whispers Mirrin, her drooping eyes focused on the egg. You bend down and kiss the top of the shell, almost automatically. It’s impressively warm against your [pc.lipsChaste] and in the clutches of a small furnace like Mirrin. It’s definitely in the right hands. That’s what instinct is telling you, at least."

rows.original: “SMIIILE”
rows.raw: "\n\n“SMIIILE”"

rows.original: kzzzii-PMMMphhh
rows.translation: 咔滋——砰姆
rows.raw: "\n\nkzzzii-PMMMphhh"

rows.original: You almost jerk backwards as a camera flash gets into your eyes.
rows.translation: 相机闪光射入眼中，你差点猛然后退。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou almost jerk backwards as a camera flash gets into your eyes."

rows.original: “Fuck is...!” you blurt out.
rows.translation: “搞什么...！”你脱口而出。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fuck is...!” you blurt out."

rows.original: “Alright, we got it boys! Snap of the month! Say goodbye loooosers, aw yeah!” yells a shadowy journo from the end of the futon. You can practically feel Mirrin’s silent rage through her tensing arm muscles but knowing what she’s been through... it’s unlikely there’ll be a reaction.
rows.translation: “好了，我们拍到了，伙计们！本月最佳照片！跟失败者们说再——见，太棒了！”榻榻米床尾处的一名阴暗记者高声叫道。你几乎能从米琳绷紧的手臂肌肉中感到她无声的怒火，但考虑到她刚才经历的一切...她恐怕不会有所反应。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright, we got it boys! Snap of the month! Say goodbye loooosers, aw yeah!” yells a shadowy journo from the end of the futon. You can practically feel Mirrin’s silent rage through her tensing arm muscles but knowing what she’s been through... it’s unlikely there’ll be a reaction."

rows.original: No less than five photographers waltz out of the room. The sounds of smug chatter are far louder than the general hubbub of everything else.
rows.translation: 足足五名摄影师大摇大摆地走出房间。他们得意的谈笑声远远盖过其余人的嘈杂声。
rows.raw: "\n\nNo less than five photographers waltz out of the room. The sounds of smug chatter are far louder than the general hubbub of everything else."

rows.original: “Mm... don’t hate them. It’s just what father wants, elskan. That’s those photograph... photogra... things paychecks for a year,” slurs Mirrin. You watch as she makes a couple of obscure gestures to an observing security guard. At once, he makes an announcement.
rows.translation: “嗯...别恨他们。这只是父亲想要的，亲爱的。那些摄影...摄...东西一整年的薪水就靠这个了，”米琳含糊地说道。你看着她朝一名旁观的警卫做了几个含义不明的手势。他立刻宣布道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mm... don’t hate them. It’s just what father wants, elskan. That’s those photograph... photogra... things paychecks for a year,” slurs Mirrin. You watch as she makes a couple of obscure gestures to an observing security guard. At once, he makes an announcement."

rows.original: “Aight, all non-essentials out please, give us some space,” he loudly asserts, waving his hands in the air. A collective grumble and shuffling of feet plays out as a swathe of twenty random people exit the room. The hell did they all come from?!
rows.translation: “好了，请所有非必要人员离开，给我们腾点空间，”他高声断言，同时在空中挥手。一片抱怨与脚步挪动声中，足足二十名不知从哪来的闲杂人等离开了房间。他们到底都是从哪冒出来的？！
rows.raw: "\n\n“Aight, all non-essentials out please, give us some space,” he loudly asserts, waving his hands in the air. A collective grumble and shuffling of feet plays out as a swathe of twenty random people exit the room. The hell did they all come from?!"

rows.original: “Stay with me for the night?” whispers Mirrin, catching your attention. Her arm slumps to the side and around your [pc.hip] as an added incentive. Well of course you will but that only made things sweeter.
rows.translation: “今晚陪着我好吗？”米琳低声说道，吸引了你的注意。她的手臂垂到一旁，环住你的[pc.hip]，进一步诱惑着你。你当然会留下，但这只让一切变得更加甜蜜。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Stay with me for the night?” whispers Mirrin, catching your attention. Her arm slumps to the side and around your [pc.hip] as an added incentive. Well of course you will but that only made things sweeter."

rows.original: You nod and she wriggles along the top of her futon to accommodate you. As if predicting this, an orderly pushes another futon - from another room, no less - underneath you, allowing you to sprawl attop it or snuggle closely to your baby momma.
rows.translation: 你点了点头，她在榻榻米床上扭动着挪开，为你腾出位置。仿佛早有预料，一名勤务员又推来一张榻榻米床——甚至还是从另一个房间拿来的——垫在你身下，让你可以舒展地躺在上面，或者紧贴着孩子的妈妈依偎。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod and she wriggles along the top of her futon to accommodate you. As if predicting this, an orderly pushes another futon - from another room, no less - underneath you, allowing you to sprawl attop it or snuggle closely to your baby momma."

rows.original: With you comfortably resting in her radiating embrace and your palm resting on the egg bundle, you both slip into a wordless, seamless sleep. Damn, today’s been... oh so tiring...
rows.translation: 你舒适地躺在她散发热量的怀抱中，手掌搭在包裹着蛋的襁褓上，你们就此无言而顺畅地陷入沉睡。该死，今天真是...太累了...
rows.raw: "\n\nWith you comfortably resting in her radiating embrace and your palm resting on the egg bundle, you both slip into a wordless, seamless sleep. Damn, today’s been... oh so tiring..."

rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Mirrin Birthing!
rows.translation: 米琳分娩！
rows.raw: "Mirrin Birthing!"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: You make frequent trips to the cafeteria. Energy drinks and bars keep you awake and on the straight-and-narrow, if only just. Behind every trip is a comfortable sense of routine when you go back and forth. It’s just enough to keep your mind off of what could be happening. You wonder about how they even came to use your apartment in the first place and why Mirrin wasn’t taken to an actual medical facility. Then again, this place pretty much is a medical facility so that train of thought dies of quickly.
rows.translation: 你频繁前往餐厅。能量饮料和能量棒让你保持清醒，勉强维持正常状态。每次往返之间都有种舒适的规律感，刚好足以让你的思绪远离可能正在发生的事情。你想知道他们一开始究竟为什么会使用你的公寓，以及米琳为何没有被送去真正的医疗机构。不过话说回来，这地方本身差不多就是医疗机构，所以这条思路很快便自行消散。
rows.raw: "You make frequent trips to the cafeteria. Energy drinks and bars keep you awake and on the straight-and-narrow, if only just. Behind every trip is a comfortable sense of routine when you go back and forth. It’s just enough to keep your mind off of what could be happening. You wonder about how they even came to use your apartment in the first place and why Mirrin wasn’t taken to an actual medical facility. Then again, this place pretty much is a medical facility so that train of thought dies of quickly."

rows.original: There hasn’t been anymore outbursts in the time you’ve been here. Still an awful lot of nurses and helpers around... and more security. The security, in particular, make a habit of keeping themselves busy by patrolling the lower level. What could they even be here for? Thinking on it, this would be grade-A material for the paparazzi, and Mirrin does have the money for it... or at least someone on her side does.
rows.translation: 你在这里期间没有再发生任何爆发。不过周围依然有多得吓人的护士和帮手...还有更多警卫。尤其是警卫，他们习惯通过巡逻下层来让自己保持忙碌。他们究竟为何需要留在这里？仔细想想，这对狗仔来说可是甲级素材，而米琳确实有钱负担这些...或者至少站在她那边的某个人有钱。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere hasn’t been anymore outbursts in the time you’ve been here. Still an awful lot of nurses and helpers around... and more security. The security, in particular, make a habit of keeping themselves busy by patrolling the lower level. What could they even be here for? Thinking on it, this would be grade-A material for the paparazzi, and Mirrin does have the money for it... or at least someone on her side does."

rows.raw: " asleep even when you visit."

rows.original: Still, the thought of adding another youngling to play with fills you with parental glee. It helps take your mind off more pressing things. The waiting only causes an anxious ache on the inside...
rows.translation: 不过，一想到又有一个幼崽可以和他们一起玩，你心中便充满为人父母的喜悦。这有助于让你暂时忘记更迫切的事情。等待只会在内心激起焦虑的隐痛...
rows.raw: "\n\nStill, the thought of adding another youngling to play with fills you with parental glee. It helps take your mind off more pressing things. The waiting only causes an anxious ache on the inside..."

rows.original: Out of nowhere, almost six hours since you arrived, a small gaggle of nurses find you with their tired faces somehow brimming with delight.
rows.translation: 你抵达将近六小时后，一小群护士突然找到了你，她们疲惫的脸上不知为何洋溢着喜悦。
rows.raw: "\n\nOut of nowhere, almost six hours since you arrived, a small gaggle of nurses find you with their tired faces somehow brimming with delight."

rows.original: “[pc.Mister] Steele! It’s happened, come come! Gently now, there’s still security around and they’ve been less than helpful,” beams the leading nurse, gesturing for you to follow her.
rows.translation: “[pc.Mister]斯蒂尔！已经生下来了，快来快来！现在动作轻些，警卫还在附近，而且他们一直不怎么配合，”领头的护士满面笑容，示意你跟上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.Mister] Steele! It’s happened, come come! Gently now, there’s still security around and they’ve been less than helpful,” beams the leading nurse, gesturing for you to follow her."

rows.original: You get up immediately and follow the group of three back up to the second floor.
rows.translation: 你立刻起身，跟着三人一同返回二楼。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou get up immediately and follow the group of three back up to the second floor."

rows.original: NURSERYE14
rows.raw: "NURSERYE14"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: You’re a little surprised that she managed to both fit and get permission for these sliding doors, doubly so when you wonder how she handles security.
rows.translation: 你有些惊讶她居然既能装下这些滑门，又能获准安装；而想到她是如何应付安保问题时，你更是加倍惊讶。
rows.raw: "You’re a little surprised that she managed to both fit and get permission for these sliding doors, doubly so when you wonder how she handles security."

rows.original: Still, as you enter the spartan, pristine white apartment, a familiar sight greets you: tiled rubber mats, a few spots with weights and machines in different corners of the small space, open plan to other areas... definitely Mirrin’s place.
rows.translation: 尽管如此，当你走进这间斯巴达式、洁白无瑕的公寓时，迎面仍是一幅熟悉的景象：铺成方格的橡胶垫，几处角落放着负重器材与机器，小小空间以开放式布局通往其他区域...这里绝对是米琳的住处。
rows.raw: "\n\nStill, as you enter the spartan, pristine white apartment, a familiar sight greets you: tiled rubber mats, a few spots with weights and machines in different corners of the small space, open plan to other areas... definitely Mirrin’s place."

rows.original: “You like, Steele?” comes that familiar, smoky voice from behind. Mirrin walks up to your side, hands on her hips. She’s dressed differently than normal...
rows.translation: “喜欢吗，斯蒂尔？”身后传来那道熟悉的烟熏嗓音。米琳走到你身边，双手叉腰。她的穿着和平时不太一样...
