You get more than your fair share of envious looks, a little note of smugness creeping into your smile.
rows.translation: “好了，书呆子们，今天就练到这里！今晚我要招待客人。别担心：不收费，不计费，我会退款，诸如此类，”米琳宣布道，一只手拿着六罐装红色饮料，另一只手拿着两大袋辣味玉米片。客户们齐声叹息，抱怨自己‘正进入状态’、‘这组还没练完’，可麒麟只是用拇指指向门口。他们最终屈服，但仍然吐出大量怨气。你收获了远超应得份额的嫉妒目光，笑容中也悄然浮现一丝得意。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright, nerds, that’s enough for today! I’m entertaining tonight. Don’t worry: no charge, no fee, I’ll reimburse, yadda yadda,” announces Mirrin with a six pack of red cans in one hand and two big bags of chilli nachos in the other. Her clients all sigh in unison and complain about ‘being in the zone’ and ‘unfinished set’ but the qilin just points a thumb to the door. They give in but not without huffing a lot of hot air. You get more than your fair share of envious looks, a little note of smugness creeping into your smile."

rows.original: “Eufff, needy egoists,” dismisses Mirrin as she takes up a spot next to you. The couch sinks a little into her direction and your robed-up body rolls into her side. Without really thinking about it, she drapes her arm behind your shoulders and squeezes you all the tighter against her fluffy robe.
rows.translation: “呃呼，一群黏人的自我中心鬼，”米琳不屑地说道，在你身旁坐下。沙发向她那边略微下陷，裹着睡袍的身体也滚到她身侧。她几乎没有思考，便把手臂搭到你的肩后，将你更紧地压向蓬松睡袍。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Eufff, needy egoists,” dismisses Mirrin as she takes up a spot next to you. The couch sinks a little into her direction and your robed-up body rolls into her side. Without really thinking about it, she drapes her arm behind your shoulders and squeezes you all the tighter against her fluffy robe."

rows.original: “But don’t they pay you...?” you ask as Mirrin puts a bag of nacho chips in your lap. “It’s a bit mean.”
rows.translation: “可他们不是付钱给你了吗...？”米琳把一袋玉米片放到你腿上时，你问道。“这样有点刻薄。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But don’t they pay you...?” you ask as Mirrin puts a bag of nacho chips in your lap. “It’s a bit mean.”"

rows.original: “Ahhh they know they can’t get it anywhere else. Besides, all comfortably rich. Like, uhhh, you know, white collar, that’s it. Do it because they do it, not cuz it’s a passion,” says Mirrin with a shrug of her shoulders. She breaks out two cans from the six-pack and opens both. Through the veritable mess of soft fabrics, you get your [pc.hand] around the closest one and take a quick look at it: deep red, covered in energy drink art and with two cartoony green horns on the front; there’s no surprise to be had here. Underneath it reads ‘Super Dragon Juice’ in three different Terran alphabets.
rows.translation: “啊啊，他们知道别处享受不到这些。而且，全都相当富有。就是，呃呃，你知道的，白领，没错。他们锻炼只是因为别人也锻炼，而不是出于热爱，”米琳耸肩说道。她从六罐装中取出两罐，全部打开。你穿过乱成一团的柔软布料，用[pc.hand]抓住最近的一罐，迅速打量：深红色罐身，覆盖着能量饮料风格图案，正面还有两根卡通绿色犄角；完全没有任何惊喜。下面以三种地球字母写着‘超级龙汁’。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ahhh they know they can’t get it anywhere else. Besides, all comfortably rich. Like, uhhh, you know, white collar, that’s it. Do it because they do it, not cuz it’s a passion,” says Mirrin with a shrug of her shoulders. She breaks out two cans from the six-pack and opens both. Through the veritable mess of soft fabrics, you get your [pc.hand] around the closest one and take a quick look at it: deep red, covered in energy drink art and with two cartoony green horns on the front; there’s no surprise to be had here. Underneath it reads ‘Super Dragon Juice’ in three different Terran alphabets."

rows.original: “Is this really...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Is this really...”"

rows.original: “Mmmhmmmmm, why don’tcha try some?” giggles your dragoness as she glugs down half her can with one throw of her silvery mane.
rows.translation: “嗯哼——，何不尝尝？”龙女咯咯笑着，银色鬃发一甩，仰头便灌下半罐。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mmmhmmmmm, why don’tcha try some?” giggles your dragoness as she glugs down half her can with one throw of her silvery mane."

rows.original: Yeah, sure, whatever.
rows.translation: 好啊，随便吧。
rows.raw: "\n\nYeah, sure, whatever."

rows.original: You take a light sip and swill it around, immediately wishing you’d not done that. Despite a gentle carbonation, the
rows.translation: 你轻抿一口，让液体在嘴里打转，立刻后悔自己为什么要这么做。尽管碳酸感柔和，那股
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take a light sip and swill it around, immediately wishing you’d not done that. Despite a gentle carbonation, the "

rows.original: thicc
rows.translation: 浓稠
rows.raw: "thicc"

rows.original: thick
rows.translation: 浓稠
rows.raw: "thick"

rows.original: , almost syrupy wash of cherry and honey takes real effort to gulp down. The sweetness isn’t quite there either but the sheer mass of the fluid is worrying: just what is in this stuff??
rows.translation: 得近乎糖浆般的樱桃蜂蜜液体，仍需要真正用力才能咽下。甜度也不太足，但液体本身沉重得令人担忧：这玩意儿里到底有什么？？
rows.raw: ", almost syrupy wash of cherry and honey takes real effort to gulp down. The sweetness isn’t quite there either but the sheer mass of the fluid is worrying: just what is in this stuff??"

rows.original: “Oo, those sounds you make, mm. Just, yeah...” giggles Mirrin as she pops her bag of chips. “Slurp that drink...”
rows.translation: “哦，你发出的那些声音，嗯。就是这样...”米琳撕开玉米片袋子时咯咯笑道。“把饮料吸干净...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oo, those sounds you make, mm. Just, yeah...” giggles Mirrin as she pops her bag of chips. “Slurp that drink...”"

rows.original: You nudge her in the ribs and set your can aside. The alcoholic tang barely seems to register as you swill what little ‘juice’ remains in your mouth.
rows.translation: 你用手肘轻撞她的肋骨，把饮料罐放到一旁。你晃动嘴里仅剩的一点‘果汁’，几乎感觉不到其中的酒精刺激。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nudge her in the ribs and set your can aside. The alcoholic tang barely seems to register as you swill what little ‘juice’ remains in your mouth."

rows.original: “Alright, let’s see what uhhh, what we find in TV land...” announces the qilin as she fiddles with a holographic interface in the couches armrest. She just seems to eyeball the most random channel she can find and the big blue screen blurts into a hyper-real 3-D rendering of a TV show.
rows.translation: “好，让我们看看，呃呃，电视世界里能找到什么...”麒麟一边摆弄沙发扶手中的全息界面，一边宣布道。她似乎随便挑了个最随机的频道，巨大蓝色屏幕随即猛然播放起超写实三维渲染的电视节目。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright, let’s see what uhhh, what we find in TV land...” announces the qilin as she fiddles with a holographic interface in the couches armrest. She just seems to eyeball the most random channel she can find and the big blue screen blurts into a hyper-real 3-D rendering of a TV show."

rows.original: “Tonight on The Truth Isn’t Out There!”
rows.translation: “今晚请收看《真相并不在彼方》！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Tonight on The Truth Isn’t Out There!”"

rows.original: “Oh fuck, not this trash,” groans your lover as she rubs her chin. “Unless you want laughs, I suppose. As if some bjáni knows a thing about anything.”
rows.translation: “哦操，别放这垃圾，”你的爱侣揉着下巴抱怨。“除非你想找点乐子。我看某个笨蛋根本什么都不懂。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh fuck, not this trash,” groans your lover as she rubs her chin. “Unless you want laughs, I suppose. As if some bjáni knows a thing about anything.”"

rows.original: “What do you mean? What kind of show is this?” you ask as you squint at the overly dramatic title sequence that comes to life in 3-D models.
rows.translation: “什么意思？这是什么节目？”你眯眼看着那段过度戏剧化的片头以三维模型形式活灵活现地展开。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What do you mean? What kind of show is this?” you ask as you squint at the overly dramatic title sequence that comes to life in 3-D models."

rows.original: “Ehh, they ask some backwater mook about a thing they saw and turn an entire show into a two hour special. Then they debunk the claim. Anyone could do that with a little brain, you know? Is whatever though, at least is funny,” chuckles Mirrin with a dismissive wave of her hand.
rows.translation: “呃，他们问某个穷乡僻壤的蠢货看见了什么，然后把整档节目做成两小时特别篇。接着再驳倒他的说法。任何稍微有点脑子的人都能这么做，你知道吗？不过随便啦，至少很好笑，”米琳轻笑着，不屑地挥挥手。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ehh, they ask some backwater mook about a thing they saw and turn an entire show into a two hour special. Then they debunk the claim. Anyone could do that with a little brain, you know? Is whatever though, at least is funny,” chuckles Mirrin with a dismissive wave of her hand."

rows.original: You settle in for a ‘wild ride’ of stimulating conspiracy theory and junk science. While not entirely without intrigue, the first two ‘guest claimants’ turn out to be serial fraudsters who are swiftly arrested before the commercial breaks. It’s pretty comical, enough to get some laughs out of you both, yet it’s not quite enough for what happens next...
rows.translation: 你坐下来，准备享受由刺激阴谋论与垃圾科学组成的‘狂野旅程’。尽管并非毫无吸引力，前两名‘声称者嘉宾’最终都被揭露为惯犯骗子，并在广告前迅速遭到逮捕。场面相当滑稽，足以让你们两人笑上几声，却还远远比不上接下来发生的事情...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou settle in for a ‘wild ride’ of stimulating conspiracy theory and junk science. While not entirely without intrigue, the first two ‘guest claimants’ turn out to be serial fraudsters who are swiftly arrested before the commercial breaks. It’s pretty comical, enough to get some laughs out of you both, yet it’s not quite enough for what happens next..."

rows.original: “It’s them brain salads! Look mate, the spacey types running back in from the wastes screamin’ about some mind controlling snakey thing are onto summin’. Has to be brain salads, the kind yer need surgery for, o’ course. Ain’t no snakes, none round ‘ere an’ I can show you them brains too, look.”
rows.translation: “就是那些脑沙拉！听着伙计，那些从荒野里逃回来的太空佬，嘴里嚷嚷什么控制思想的蛇怪，他们肯定看出了点门道。一定是脑沙拉，就是那种当然得动手术处理的东西。根本没有蛇，这附近一条都没有，我还能给你们看那些脑子呢，瞧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s them brain salads! Look mate, the spacey types running back in from the wastes screamin’ about some mind controlling snakey thing are onto summin’. Has to be brain salads, the kind yer need surgery for, o’ course. Ain’t no snakes, none round ‘ere an’ I can show you them brains too, look.”"

rows.original: You both watch perplexed as the blurred out, diminutive ‘guest’ goes about his shack and shows off all manner of preserved biological ‘things’ stored in an obscured freezer. The shorter fellow barely has enough height to take the ‘things’ out but when he finally pulls free a bag full of mulched ‘stuff’, he almost spills it all over the floor. You can only look on as the rotted contents are revealed: some sort of monstrous seed or plant that looks almost fleshy, blackened and mushy to the touch.
rows.translation: 你们满脸困惑地看着经过模糊处理、身材矮小的‘嘉宾’在棚屋里忙活，展示存放在打码冰柜里的各种生物‘东西’。矮个子几乎没有足够身高把‘东西’取出来，好不容易拖出一袋捣烂的‘玩意儿’时，还差点全部洒在地板上。你只能眼看腐烂内容显露出来：某种怪异种子或植物，外观看起来近似血肉，已经发黑，摸上去软烂不堪。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou both watch perplexed as the blurred out, diminutive ‘guest’ goes about his shack and shows off all manner of preserved biological ‘things’ stored in an obscured freezer. The shorter fellow barely has enough height to take the ‘things’ out but when he finally pulls free a bag full of mulched ‘stuff’, he almost spills it all over the floor. You can only look on as the rotted contents are revealed: some sort of monstrous seed or plant that looks almost fleshy, blackened and mushy to the touch."

rows.original: “That’s a brain salad. Rare. Always find ‘em dead but they take foreva to mulch. Saw one attack a poor man from the back of ‘is ‘ead, had to have the surgery,” comments the guest as he gestures over his ‘trophy’.
rows.translation: “那就是脑沙拉。很罕见。找到它们时总是死的，可需要很——久才会烂成泥。我见过一只从某个可怜人的后脑发动袭击，他后来不得不动手术，”嘉宾指着自己的‘战利品’说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s a brain salad. Rare. Always find ‘em dead but they take foreva to mulch. Saw one attack a poor man from the back of ‘is ‘ead, had to have the surgery,” comments the guest as he gestures over his ‘trophy’."

rows.original: “A-and what’s the surgery entail...?” asks the concerned host. Without another word, the guest pulls out a Reaper-brand stun-gun and slams it on the table next to the mulched mess.
rows.translation: “那-那么，手术具体包括什么...？”忧心忡忡的主持人问道。嘉宾一言不发地取出一把收割者品牌电击枪，啪地拍在桌上那团烂泥旁边。
rows.raw: "\n\n“A-and what’s the surgery entail...?” asks the concerned host. Without another word, the guest pulls out a Reaper-brand stun-gun and slams it on the table next to the mulched mess."

rows.original: “...We’ll be back next time, dear viewers! Uhh, just... yeah... cut, cut!”
rows.translation: “...亲爱的观众们，我们下次再见！呃，就...对...停，停！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...We’ll be back next time, dear viewers! Uhh, just... yeah... cut, cut!”"

rows.original: The program then goes straight to credits without a resolution. You and Mirrin look at each other’s nacho-dusted faces with the same ‘what?’ expression before sniggling away at what you saw.
rows.translation: 节目没有给出任何结论，直接开始播放片尾字幕。你和米琳顶着沾满玉米片碎屑的脸，以相同的‘什么鬼？’表情望向彼此，随后因刚才看到的东西窃笑起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe program then goes straight to credits without a resolution. You and Mirrin look at each other’s nacho-dusted faces with the same ‘what?’ expression before sniggling away at what you saw."

rows.original: “You think ya got guts? Got what it takes, kid? Lemme see it in ya fists!”
rows.translation: “你觉得自己有种吗？你够格吗，小子？让我从你的拳头里看看本事！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You think ya got guts? Got what it takes, kid? Lemme see it in ya fists!”"

rows.original: “B-but I’m a rahn, boss! I don’t have any guts!”
rows.translation: “可-可我是拉恩啊，老板！我根本没有内脏！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“B-but I’m a rahn, boss! I don’t have any guts!”"

rows.original: “Oh I love this shit! Haven’t seen it in years!” yells Mirrin, almost flinging her chips across the floor as she jumps in her seat. “Rahney Bloboa!”
rows.translation: “哦，我超爱这玩意儿！好多年没看了！”米琳大喊着，从座位上蹦起时差点把玉米片甩满地板。“《拉恩尼·布洛波亚》！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh I love this shit! Haven’t seen it in years!” yells Mirrin, almost flinging her chips across the floor as she jumps in her seat. “Rahney Bloboa!”"

rows.original: “Wuh?” you try to ask but the next scene makes it all. While the dragoness leans forward on the couch with her hands gripping her knees, a heart-pumping montage of a white rahn punching frozen meat and running up flights of stairs segues in the worst possible way. You have to watch your [pc.legOrLegs] as Mirrin mimics the punching rhythms and hand exercises almost to perfection. Everyone’s a nerd in some way, after all...
rows.translation: “啥？”你试图发问，但下一幕已经让一切明朗。龙女在沙发上前倾，双手紧抓膝盖；一段激动人心的蒙太奇却以最糟糕的方式衔接出现，画面里一名白色拉恩猛击冻肉、沿楼梯飞奔。米琳近乎完美地模仿起拳击节奏和手部练习，你不得不留意自己的[pc.legOrLegs]。毕竟每个人都在某方面是书呆子...
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wuh?” you try to ask but the next scene makes it all. While the dragoness leans forward on the couch with her hands gripping her knees, a heart-pumping montage of a white rahn punching frozen meat and running up flights of stairs segues in the worst possible way. You have to watch your [pc.legOrLegs] as Mirrin mimics the punching rhythms and hand exercises almost to perfection. Everyone’s a nerd in some way, after all..."

rows.original: The film’s pretty decent for pure entertainment purposes and yet it’s Mirrin who’s the most into it. Every line of dialogue is matched by her gestures and imitations, especially the poor rahn who is clearly unable to reach the level needed to punch things professionally. Each punch just sort of bounces with the kinect force of an industrial water balloon.
rows.translation: 单纯从娱乐角度来说，这部电影相当不错，不过真正全情投入的是米琳。每句台词都会得到她的动作和模仿配合，尤其是那名可怜的拉恩，显然始终达不到职业拳击所需的水平。每一拳都只会带着工业水球般的动能力道弹开。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe film’s pretty decent for pure entertainment purposes and yet it’s Mirrin who’s the most into it. Every line of dialogue is matched by her gestures and imitations, especially the poor rahn who is clearly unable to reach the level needed to punch things professionally. Each punch just sort of bounces with the kinect force of an industrial water balloon."

rows.original: You sit with your head in your hands at the leaps in gusto and ludicrous plot developments. When the ‘sad scene’ before the climax hits, Mirrin is clutching her fist in tears.
rows.translation: 面对热情迸发和荒谬情节发展，你双手抱头坐在那里。高潮前的‘悲情场面’到来时，米琳已经热泪盈眶地紧握拳头。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou sit with your head in your hands at the leaps in gusto and ludicrous plot developments. When the ‘sad scene’ before the climax hits, Mirrin is clutching her fist in tears."

rows.original: “I never wanted to fight, only to try!”
rows.translation: “我从没想过要战斗，只想努力尝试！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I never wanted to fight, only to try!”"

rows.original: “I never wanted to fight, only to try!”
rows.translation: “我从没想过要战斗，只想努力尝试！”
rows.raw: "\n“I never wanted to fight, only to try!”"

rows.original: “Ya did good kid, ya did real good...”
rows.translation: “你做得很好，孩子，你真的做得很好...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ya did good kid, ya did real good...”"

rows.original: “Ya did good kid, ya did real good...”
rows.translation: “你做得很好，孩子，你真的做得很好...”
rows.raw: "\n“Ya did good kid, ya did real good...”"

rows.original: “Boss, no! Don’t leave me! I love yoooou!”
rows.translation: “老板，不！别离开我！我爱——你！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Boss, no! Don’t leave me! I love yoooou!”"

rows.original: “Boss, no! Don’t leave me! I love yoooou!”
rows.translation: “老板，不！别离开我！我爱——你！”
rows.raw: "\n“Boss, no! Don’t leave me! I love yoooou!”"

rows.original: Even as she ‘acts’ along with each line, the sheer cheesiness of the delivery from every party just makes you sink into the chair further and further. The scene - and film - ends with a circular fade-out.
rows.translation: 即使她会配合每句台词进行‘表演’，所有演员过分做作的念白还是让你在椅子里越缩越深。这个场景——以及整部电影——以圆形淡出结束。
rows.raw: "\n\nEven as she ‘acts’ along with each line, the sheer cheesiness of the delivery from every party just makes you sink into the chair further and further. The scene - and film - ends with a circular fade-out."

rows.original: You both sigh together: you in relief and her in catharsis.
rows.translation: 你们一同叹息：你是如释重负，她则得到了情感宣泄。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou both sigh together: you in relief and her in catharsis."

rows.original: “Oof, makes Rahney 2 all the sweeter... eee, elskan, sori, I got a little emotional there,” sniffs the red giantess. You pat her on the shoulder and tell her it’s all okay. Despite her naked emotional display though, the goodwill well on cheesy and bad films is getting pretty low for today.
rows.translation: “呼，这让《拉恩尼2》显得更甜美了...呃，亲爱的，抱歉，我刚才有点激动，”红色女巨人抽着鼻子说道。你拍拍她的肩膀，告诉她一切都好。不过尽管她毫不掩饰地流露情感，今天留给俗套烂片的耐心已经所剩无几。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oof, makes Rahney 2 all the sweeter... eee, elskan, sori, I got a little emotional there,” sniffs the red giantess. You pat her on the shoulder and tell her it’s all okay. Despite her naked emotional display though, the goodwill well on cheesy and bad films is getting pretty low for today."

rows.original: “Supa Duraguno Jyusuuu! Oishiiiii-desu!”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Supa Duraguno Jyusuuu! Oishiiiii-desu!”"

rows.original: Your eyes widen as a long advert showing a chibified Mirrin jumps onto the screen. She starts off on her knees, cursing the sun for tiring her out on track day and stealing the source of her ‘inner powers’. A slender red dragon breaks through the clouds from on high decked in sunglasses and two red-and-green cans in his claws. Cans that look a lot like..
rows.translation: 一段漫长广告跳上屏幕，展示着Q版米琳，你的双眼顿时睁大。开始时，她跪在地上，诅咒太阳在赛道日耗尽自己的体力，夺走了‘内在力量’的源泉。一条身材纤细的红龙佩戴墨镜，从云端高处破云而下，爪中拿着两罐红绿饮料。那两罐东西看起来非常像..
rows.raw: "\n\nYour eyes widen as a long advert showing a chibified Mirrin jumps onto the screen. She starts off on her knees, cursing the sun for tiring her out on track day and stealing the source of her ‘inner powers’. A slender red dragon breaks through the clouds from on high decked in sunglasses and two red-and-green cans in his claws. Cans that look a lot like.."

rows.original: “Mirrin-sama wa tsuyoi-desu! Anata wa kono Supa Duraguno Jyusu wa o nomu hitsuyou ga arimasu!”
rows.translation: “米琳大人很强！你必须喝下这款超级龙汁！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mirrin-sama wa tsuyoi-desu! Anata wa kono Supa Duraguno Jyusu wa o nomu hitsuyou ga arimasu!”"

rows.original: As the dragon gives his speech, he turns to both the camera and back to chibi-Mirrin. He chucks the can, and it flies in slow-mo into her undersized, animated hands. With hearts in her eyes, she wastes no time in popping it open and chugging the entire thing. As she does, beams of green and red light pour out of her eyes, and an energized theme song plays behind. With a powerful roar, the chibi-Mirrin crushes the can, throws it aside and poses; every single muscle - and other forward bulgy parts - powers up with ‘jyusu’.
rows.translation: 红龙发表演说时，视线在镜头与Q版米琳之间来回转动。他扔出饮料罐，罐子以慢动作飞进她过小的动画双手。她双眼冒出爱心，立刻拉开罐子，把整罐饮料一口喝光。饮用过程中，红绿光束从她眼中倾泻而出，激昂的主题曲也在背后响起。Q版米琳发出有力咆哮，把罐子捏扁扔到一旁，摆出姿势；每一块肌肉——以及其他向前凸起的部位——都在‘果汁’作用下充满力量。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs the dragon gives his speech, he turns to both the camera and back to chibi-Mirrin. He chucks the can, and it flies in slow-mo into her undersized, animated hands. With hearts in her eyes, she wastes no time in popping it open and chugging the entire thing. As she does, beams of green and red light pour out of her eyes, and an energized theme song plays behind. With a powerful roar, the chibi-Mirrin crushes the can, throws it aside and poses; every single muscle - and other forward bulgy parts - powers up with ‘jyusu’."

rows.original: The tagline plays again while chibi-Mirrin gives the audience a thumbs up.
rows.translation: 广告标语再次播放，同时Q版米琳朝观众竖起拇指。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe tagline plays again while chibi-Mirrin gives the audience a thumbs up."

rows.original: “Sooo... that was for...” you begin, quickly losing focus as you realize what you’re holding in your hands.
rows.translation: “那么...那是为了...”你刚一开口，意识到自己手中拿着什么后，很快便失去专注。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sooo... that was for...” you begin, quickly losing focus as you realize what you’re holding in your hands."

rows.original: “Whaaat? It’s just fun. I didn’t make it anyway, blame dad and the marketing people,” shrugs Mirrin as she takes a swig of her own drink. “Don’t give me that look, I’m just the face of the thing.”
rows.translation: “什——么？只是好玩而已。反正又不是我制作的，要怪就怪父亲和营销人员，”米琳耸耸肩，喝了一大口自己的饮料。“别用那种眼神看我，我只是这东西的代言人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Whaaat? It’s just fun. I didn’t make it anyway, blame dad and the marketing people,” shrugs Mirrin as she takes a swig of her own drink. “Don’t give me that look, I’m just the face of the thing.”"

rows.original: You give her ‘the eye’ as you consider again that... spectacle you just saw. She turns her head away with a soft blush in her cheeks and a hand in her bag of chips. Yeah, you know what you did, you big greedy girl...
rows.translation: 你再次回想刚才看见的那场...奇观，用‘那种眼神’盯着她。她脸颊微微发红，把头转开，一只手伸进玉米片袋子。没错，你知道自己做了什么，你这个贪婪的大姑娘...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give her ‘the eye’ as you consider again that... spectacle you just saw. She turns her head away with a soft blush in her cheeks and a hand in her bag of chips. Yeah, you know what you did, you big greedy girl..."

rows.original: Next, a panel show on ‘sex politics’ - The Dirty Truth - flips on screen and is actually just a debate format for the convoluted mess of political ideas for eight different parties... but all the contestants are buxom femme’s in oddly conservative suits. While they speak the political language, the topics mostly range from the ethics of hair removal mods in the face of a hypothetical genetic diversity problem and if laboratory-made leather is still ethically pure even though it is an entirely victimless, creative process. Something tells you that it’s much more vapid than it appears and yet it’s just so... sexy.
rows.translation: 接下来，一档讨论‘性政治’的座谈节目——《肮脏真相》——出现在屏幕上，实际上只是八个不同党派复杂政治理念的辩论形式...可所有参赛者都是胸部丰满、身穿奇怪保守套装的女性。她们虽然满口政治语言，话题却主要围绕两件事：面对假设中的遗传多样性问题，脱毛改造是否符合伦理；以及实验室制造的皮革虽然是完全无受害者的创造过程，是否仍在道德上纯洁。某种感觉告诉你，它远比表面看起来更加空洞，却又实在如此...性感。
rows.raw: "\n\nNext, a panel show on ‘sex politics’ - The Dirty Truth - flips on screen and is actually just a debate format for the convoluted mess of political ideas for eight different parties... but all the contestants are buxom femme’s in oddly conservative suits. While they speak the political language, the topics mostly range from the ethics of hair removal mods in the face of a hypothetical genetic diversity problem and if laboratory-made leather is still ethically pure even though it is an entirely victimless, creative process. Something tells you that it’s much more vapid than it appears and yet it’s just so... sexy."

rows.original: And you both keep watching the dryness of it all just hoping for a wardrobe malfunction or a little lean forward, but none of the contestants move more than their arms or necks.
rows.translation: 你们两人继续观看这场枯燥节目，只希望发生服装故障，或者有人稍稍前倾，可所有参赛者除了手臂或脖子以外，其他部位根本一动不动。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd you both keep watching the dryness of it all just hoping for a wardrobe malfunction or a little lean forward, but none of the contestants move more than their arms or necks."

rows.original: And you keep watching.
rows.translation: 而你继续看着。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd you keep watching."

rows.original: And watching.
rows.translation: 继续看。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd watching."

rows.original: That redhead almost bent over.
rows.translation: 那个红发女人差点就弯下腰了。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat redhead almost bent over."

rows.original: Two hours of engaging in silly back and forth later and you’re still holding out for something there. The drinks are all gone, the chips have been devoured; Mirrin takes action, ends both of your disappointments and turns off the TV.
rows.translation: 两个小时的愚蠢唇枪舌剑过去，你仍然期待着发生些什么。饮料已经全部喝光，玉米片也被一扫而空；米琳终于采取行动，结束你们两人的失望，关掉了电视。
rows.raw: "\n\nTwo hours of engaging in silly back and forth later and you’re still holding out for something there. The drinks are all gone, the chips have been devoured; Mirrin takes action, ends both of your disappointments and turns off the TV."

rows.original: “Smashing! A feast for the ears! The conductor, of course, a master in his field and able to wrangle the notes in just the right way. I found the violin solo particularly enchanting, pulling just enough on the edges of the original, what do you say...”
rows.translation: “精彩！真是一场听觉盛宴！指挥当然是其领域的大师，能够以恰到好处的方式驾驭音符。我觉得小提琴独奏尤其迷人，在原作的边缘做了恰到好处的延伸，你觉得呢...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Smashing! A feast for the ears! The conductor, of course, a master in his field and able to wrangle the notes in just the right way. I found the violin solo particularly enchanting, pulling just enough on the edges of the original, what do you say...”"

rows.original: “Ooooh, it’s an orchestra thing. It’s the Terran-Rosha Crystal Choir and Philharmonic, how about that? What do you think?” asks Mirrin as she relaxes in her chair.
rows.translation: “哦哦哦，是交响乐之类的东西。地球-罗莎水晶合唱团与爱乐乐团，怎么样？你觉得如何？”米琳靠在椅子上放松身体，开口问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ooooh, it’s an orchestra thing. It’s the Terran-Rosha Crystal Choir and Philharmonic, how about that? What do you think?” asks Mirrin as she relaxes in her chair."

rows.original: “Sounds lovely,” you say softly as you slide yourself into her lap, your head coming to rest on the closest thigh. “Something reeeeeally nice.”
rows.translation: “听起来很美，”你轻声说道，身体滑入她的腿上，脑袋枕在最近的大腿处。“真——的非常美好。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sounds lovely,” you say softly as you slide yourself into her lap, your head coming to rest on the closest thigh. “Something reeeeeally nice.”"

rows.original: The performance is beautiful: a mixture of Renaissance-era opera and kaithrit mourning pieces, played by an 80 piece orchestra and 40 piece choir. It doesn’t take long for the trembling violins and sultry bassoons to lull you into a peaceful state. All seems so calm, warm and thoughtless: just you and the music.
rows.translation: 演出十分优美：文艺复兴时期的歌剧与凯斯瑞特哀悼曲目相互交融，由八十人组成的管弦乐队和四十人组成的合唱团共同演绎。颤动的小提琴与柔美的巴松管很快便令你陷入平静状态。一切如此安宁、温暖，无需思考：只有你和音乐。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe performance is beautiful: a mixture of Renaissance-era opera and kaithrit mourning pieces, played by an 80 piece orchestra and 40 piece choir. It doesn’t take long for the trembling violins and sultry bassoons to lull you into a peaceful state. All seems so calm, warm and thoughtless: just you and the music."

rows.original: That turns into a nap. Even so, you can even remember the melodies, themes, the mimetic qualities of genius music passed down through the millennia...
rows.translation: 这份平静变成了一场小睡。即便如此，你甚至仍能记得旋律、主题，以及流传数千年的天才音乐中那些拟态特质...
rows.raw: "\n\nThat turns into a nap. Even so, you can even remember the melodies, themes, the mimetic qualities of genius music passed down through the millennia..."

rows.original: What wakes you up is Mirrin’s chest-shaking yawn.
rows.translation: 将你惊醒的是米琳震动胸膛的哈欠。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat wakes you up is Mirrin’s chest-shaking yawn."

rows.original: “Sandra, that’s just ridiculous! There’s no way we’re halting the party because of one errant flame of yours from 20 years ago! It’s old news! We are done with it!”
rows.translation: “桑德拉，这也太荒谬了！我们绝不可能因为你二十年前的一段错误情缘就中止派对！那都是旧闻！我们已经结束了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sandra, that’s just ridiculous! There’s no way we’re halting the party because of one errant flame of yours from 20 years ago! It’s old news! We are done with it!”"

rows.original: “But Frank, I love him!”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But Frank, I love him!”"

rows.original: Ah, she appears to have found a ‘classic’ romance film. Despite the contemporary setting and mostly non-human cast, the feel is noir as all hell, all the way down to the monochromatic color scheme. It’s easily the cheesiest thing you could’ve found but hell, why not. Neither of you recognize the actors on screen, but then...
rows.translation: 啊，她似乎找到了一部‘经典’爱情电影。尽管背景设定在当代，演员大多也不是人类，整体感觉却黑色电影到了极点，甚至采用单色配色方案。这显然是你能找到的最俗套作品，不过管他的，为什么不看呢。你们都认不出屏幕上的演员，但随后...
rows.raw: "\n\nAh, she appears to have found a ‘classic’ romance film. Despite the contemporary setting and mostly non-human cast, the feel is noir as all hell, all the way down to the monochromatic color scheme. It’s easily the cheesiest thing you could’ve found but hell, why not. Neither of you recognize the actors on screen, but then..."

rows.original: “Frank, no! Don’t leave me!”
rows.translation: “弗兰克，不！别离开我！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Frank, no! Don’t leave me!”"

rows.original: <i>“<b>Forget it Sandra, Frank is dead, killed by
rows.translation: <i>“<b>忘了他吧，桑德拉，弗兰克已经死了，被
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“<b>Forget it Sandra, Frank is dead, killed by "

isSillyModeEnabled()
                            ? "the salt of the Riya-fiasco tears"

rows.original: the salt of the Riya-fiasco tears
rows.translation: 里娅惨剧的泪水之盐
rows.raw: "the salt of the Riya-fiasco tears"

rows.original: his own vices
rows.translation: 他自己的恶习
rows.raw: "his own vices"

rows.original: . It’s you and me now, doll!”
rows.translation: 杀死了。现在只有你和我，宝贝！”
rows.raw: ". It’s you and me now, doll!”"

rows.original: That voice is so distinctive and integral to your memory that you can’t help but stare at the actor.
rows.translation: 那道声音如此独特，又与你的记忆密不可分，让你忍不住死死盯着那名演员。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat voice is so distinctive and integral to your memory that you can’t help but stare at the actor."

rows.original: ...dad?

You sit there dumbfounded, perplexed as to how you couldn’t tell it was him from his face alone. Well, he does have much more of a neck mane than you remember... even though he didn’t have a neck mane when he was alive. You say nothing about it, just astounded and static as Mirrin crunches on handfuls of chips at a time.
rows.translation: 你目瞪口呆地坐在那里，不明白自己为什么光看脸竟没能认出他。好吧，他颈部的鬃毛确实比记忆中浓密得多...尽管他活着时根本没有颈鬃。你没有对此说些什么，只是惊讶得僵在原地，而米琳则每次抓起一大把玉米片大嚼。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou sit there dumbfounded, perplexed as to how you couldn’t tell it was him from his face alone. Well, he does have much more of a neck mane than you remember... even though he didn’t have a neck mane when he was alive. You say nothing about it, just astounded and static as Mirrin crunches on handfuls of chips at a time."

rows.original: “Thakks kott innninit,” garbles the nacho-stuffed qilin as her eyes are lazily locked to the screen. She only just about manages to swallow her mouthful before continuing. “Real cute. Shame about the Frank guy. I like this other guy more though.”
rows.translation: “这里真有趣，”麒麟嘴里塞满玉米片，含糊不清地说道，双眼懒洋洋地锁定屏幕。她勉强把嘴里的东西咽下，才继续开口。“非常可爱。可惜那个叫弗兰克的家伙。我倒是更喜欢另一个人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thakks kott innninit,” garbles the nacho-stuffed qilin as her eyes are lazily locked to the screen. She only just about manages to swallow her mouthful before continuing. “Real cute. Shame about the Frank guy. I like this other guy more though.”"

rows.original: That’s dad. You’d know that voice anywhere. The more you look, the more you remember his mannerisms. It all shines even through this brief cameo. Not nary two scenes later and he’s gone from the film forever.
rows.translation: 那是父亲。无论在哪里，你都能认出这道声音。看得越久，你便越能回想起他的举止习惯。哪怕只是短暂客串，这一切仍清晰地展现出来。没过两个场景，他便永远从电影中消失。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s dad. You’d know that voice anywhere. The more you look, the more you remember his mannerisms. It all shines even through this brief cameo. Not nary two scenes later and he’s gone from the film forever."

rows.original: You put a palm to your chest in effort to calm your heart. It’s a small thing but an unsettling one. Guess dad really did get around, didn’t he...
rows.translation: 你将手掌按在胸口，努力平复心跳。虽然只是件小事，却令人心神不宁。看来父亲当年真的四处留下过足迹，对吧...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou put a palm to your chest in effort to calm your heart. It’s a small thing but an unsettling one. Guess dad really did get around, didn’t he..."

rows.original: You slide against your qilin lover and fall limply into her lap, intent on just waiting the rest of the reel out.
rows.translation: 你贴着麒麟爱侣滑下身体，无力地倒在她腿上，只打算等待剩余影片播放完毕。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou slide against your qilin lover and fall limply into her lap, intent on just waiting the rest of the reel out."

rows.original: “Mmm, sleepy, huh?” whispers Mirrin as she massages your shoulders with her palms. You just murmur as if half-awake and let yourself drift off...
rows.translation: “嗯，困了，对吧？”米琳一边用手掌按摩你的肩膀，一边低声说道。你只是像半睡半醒般嘟囔着，任自己逐渐进入梦乡...
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mmm, sleepy, huh?” whispers Mirrin as she massages your shoulders with her palms. You just murmur as if half-awake and let yourself drift off..."

rows.original: What wakes you up is Mirrin’s chest-shaking yawn.
rows.translation: 将你惊醒的是米琳震动胸膛的哈欠。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat wakes you up is Mirrin’s chest-shaking yawn."

rows.original: “Mwwohh, fjandinn, tired. That was... quite the thing. Also shit, that took forever! I gotta call dad...” announces Mirrin. “Mm, loved today babe, let’s hang more later, yah?”
rows.translation: “呣哦，见鬼，好累。那真是...相当特别。而且妈的，也太久了！我得给父亲打电话...”米琳宣布道。“嗯，宝贝，今天过得很开心，改天再多聚聚，好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mwwohh, fjandinn, tired. That was... quite the thing. Also shit, that took forever! I gotta call dad...” announces Mirrin. “Mm, loved today babe, let’s hang more later, yah?”"

rows.original: She plants a kiss on your forehead and stands up with a stretch, the holoscreen blinking out of existence to leave an amber void where the big wall of blue once was. You shake yourself down, clear away the mess of the chip bags and empty cans - somehow you managed several of the things on your own - from your lap and do the best you can to get rid of the nacho dust from everything.
rows.translation: 她在你额头落下一吻，伸展身体站起身来；全息屏幕随之闪烁消失，原本巨大蓝色墙面的地方只剩琥珀色空白。你抖擞精神，清理腿上的玉米片袋与空罐——不知怎的，你独自喝掉了好几罐——并尽力把到处都是的玉米片碎屑清理干净。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe plants a kiss on your forehead and stands up with a stretch, the holoscreen blinking out of existence to leave an amber void where the big wall of blue once was. You shake yourself down, clear away the mess of the chip bags and empty cans - somehow you managed several of the things on your own - from your lap and do the best you can to get rid of the nacho dust from everything."

rows.original: The two of you take a few minutes to get changed from today’s adventures, and Mirrin gives you a full bodied goodbye hug as you’re about to leave through the automatic doors. With a wave and a nice bit of time passed, you set off back into the Steele routine.
rows.translation: 你们用了几分钟换下今天冒险期间穿的衣服；就在你准备从自动门离开时，米琳给了你一个全身拥抱作为告别。你挥手离开，在度过一段美好时光后，重新踏上斯蒂尔的日常轨道。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two of you take a few minutes to get changed from today’s adventures, and Mirrin gives you a full bodied goodbye hug as you’re about to leave through the automatic doors. With a wave and a nice bit of time passed, you set off back into the Steele routine."

rows.translation: “那——就干我的屁股，”你咬紧牙关说道，仿佛那东西属于自己一样，粗暴地用手掌揉弄她的隆起。她长满老茧的手掌把你拉向温暖身体，遮住健身房投来的视线，而你继续按摩爱抚她的隆起。

rows.raw: "\n\n“Mmmm love it when you’re ambitious,” murmurs Mirrin as she tugs at your outfit, her motherly mammaries beating against you with an elevated heartbeat. “Bedroom?”"

rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod with glee and slip out from under her arms, [pc.walking] with a jump in your step down the corridor to the love nest."

rows.translation: 米琳的人类父亲。他是男人，他是爸爸，他是男爸爸，嘟嘟嘟。
rows.raw: "Mirrin’s human dad. He’s a man, he’s a dad, he’s mandad, doodoodoo."

rows.original: Him
rows.translation: 他
rows.raw: "Him"

rows.original: Him
rows.translation: 他
rows.raw: "Him"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: “Mirrin doesn’t talk about her personal life too much. She’s told me you exist and that’s mostly it,” you begin with a sheepish look on your face. Sounds almost rude when you put it like that. Arkos simply laughs.
rows.translation: “米琳不怎么谈自己的私生活。她告诉过我你确实存在，基本就这些，”你露出腼腆神情开口道。这样说出来几乎显得有些无礼。阿尔科斯只是大笑。
rows.raw: "“Mirrin doesn’t talk about her personal life too much. She’s told me you exist and that’s mostly it,” you begin with a sheepish look on your face. Sounds almost rude when you put it like that. Arkos simply laughs."

rows.original: “Aheheh! That’s her alright. I’m a bit too much of a dad, asking her how she is all the time, a call every day, that sort of thing. I manage a third of her little ‘empire’ as we call it back home, mostly the manufacturing and uhhh, whatsitcalled, the uhhh, advertising. You ever see that advert for her new drink?” he asks, a knowing and all-too-cheeky grin on his face.
rows.translation: “啊哈哈！她就是这样。我可能太像个父亲了，总是问她过得怎样，每天打一次电话之类的。我管理她那个小‘帝国’的三分之一，我们老家都这么叫；主要负责生产和呃，那个叫什么，呃，广告。你见过她新饮料的广告吗？”他问道，脸上露出心知肚明且过分顽皮的笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Aheheh! That’s her alright. I’m a bit too much of a dad, asking her how she is all the time, a call every day, that sort of thing. I manage a third of her little ‘empire’ as we call it back home, mostly the manufacturing and uhhh, whatsitcalled, the uhhh, advertising. You ever see that advert for her new drink?” he asks, a knowing and all-too-cheeky grin on his face."

rows.original: “Oh, yep, yeah, I’ve seen it alright,” you admit, trying to hold back your laughter as you visualize it. Suuupa jyusuuuuu...
rows.translation: “哦，对，当然，我看过了，”你承认道，想象那则广告时竭力忍住笑。超——级果汁——...
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, yep, yeah, I’ve seen it alright,” you admit, trying to hold back your laughter as you visualize it. Suuupa jyusuuuuu..."

rows.original: “Heheh, all my work. It’s a very, very old callback to Terran adverts but it seems to have worked. We might have to double production for the next two solar years because of it,” he muses as he looks into space with his hand on his chin.
rows.translation: “嘿嘿，全是我的杰作。这是对非常古老的泰伦广告的致敬，不过看起来确实奏效了。接下来两个太阳年里，我们恐怕得把产量翻倍，”他手托下巴，望着虚空沉思。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Heheh, all my work. It’s a very, very old callback to Terran adverts but it seems to have worked. We might have to double production for the next two solar years because of it,” he muses as he looks into space with his hand on his chin."

rows.original: “Nnnooo I don’t think so? What should I expect?” you ask slyly, wondering what he’s implying.
rows.translation: “嗯——没有吧？我该期待什么？”你狡黠地问，猜测他在暗示什么。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nnnooo I don’t think so? What should I expect?” you ask slyly, wondering what he’s implying."

rows.original: “Oho, you’ll see, it’s quite a thing,” he says with a wink.
rows.translation: “哦吼，你会看到的，那可相当不得了，”他眨眼说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oho, you’ll see, it’s quite a thing,” he says with a wink."

rows.original: You tsk and tut at his playful way but it’s still his turn to speak.
rows.translation: 你对他顽皮的作风啧了一声，但现在仍轮到他说话。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tsk and tut at his playful way but it’s still his turn to speak."

rows.original: “Anyway, uhh. Yeah, so I’m a bit of a self-made man. Say a century ago, Terra had economic troubles back home. When you grow up there, it’s hard to break out of ehhh, deadlocks like that. I had it in my head to just do anything I could, any bit of hard, physical work. Landed a welding job, then a qualification, then management, onto the board of directors. Lots of grit and sweat in between,” he says as he rubs his shoulder.
rows.translation: “总之，呃。对，我算是白手起家。大概一个世纪前，泰拉老家有经济困难。你在那里长大，就很难摆脱呃，那种僵局。我当时只想着做任何能做的事，什么艰苦体力活都行。先找到焊工工作，然后取得资质，再进入管理层，最后加入董事会。这期间少不了毅力和汗水，”他一边揉肩一边说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anyway, uhh. Yeah, so I’m a bit of a self-made man. Say a century ago, Terra had economic troubles back home. When you grow up there, it’s hard to break out of ehhh, deadlocks like that. I had it in my head to just do anything I could, any bit of hard, physical work. Landed a welding job, then a qualification, then management, onto the board of directors. Lots of grit and sweat in between,” he says as he rubs his shoulder."

rows.original: “Got very tired of it. A ship would come in for repairs and I’d have to spend weeks navigating the thing for any inch-sized hole. Management just meant more paperwork. Board of Directors meant only paperwork. So I took my rough knowledge, a few friends from the firm and a healthy savings account... started building things. It became exponential when we had an in-house consultant picking our battles for us. Contract after contract, hiring after hiring. Had to move it closer into U.G.C territory or risk a slow bleed of travel costs. Was lucky enough to land a ship contract, as in you know, make a ship. Prototype, unique hull design. That’s where I met uhhh... yeah, my first wife, aheh.”
rows.translation: “后来实在厌倦了。船进来维修时，我得花几个星期在里面穿行，只为找一个一英寸大的破洞。管理层只意味着更多文书工作。董事会则意味着只有文书工作。所以我凭粗浅知识、公司里的几个朋友和一笔可观存款...开始制造东西。有了内部顾问替我们选择项目后，业务便呈指数增长。一份又一份合同，一批又一批招聘。我们不得不搬到更靠近银河联合政府辖区的地方，否则交通成本会缓慢放血。幸运的是，我们接到一份造船合同，真的是制造一艘船。原型船，独特船体设计。也就是在那里，我遇到了呃...对，我的第一任妻子，啊嘿。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Got very tired of it. A ship would come in for repairs and I’d have to spend weeks navigating the thing for any inch-sized hole. Management just meant more paperwork. Board of Directors meant only paperwork. So I took my rough knowledge, a few friends from the firm and a healthy savings account... started building things. It became exponential when we had an in-house consultant picking our battles for us. Contract after contract, hiring after hiring. Had to move it closer into U.G.C territory or risk a slow bleed of travel costs. Was lucky enough to land a ship contract, as in you know, make a ship. Prototype, unique hull design. That’s where I met uhhh... yeah, my first wife, aheh.”"

rows.original: First wife...? You cock your head and squint in his direction.
rows.translation: 第一任妻子...？你歪着脑袋，眯眼看向他。
rows.raw: "\n\nFirst wife...? You cock your head and squint in his direction."

rows.original: “Mirrin’s mother, of course! Eyy, what a woman. Tall, mysterious, flowing blue hair just... catching in the wind all the time. Gryvain, as you might have thought. We met when she and her team from... Pyrite, I think it was, yeah. They came down to fit their engine parts and she was a lead engineer. The brains on that woman, helvitis. Made my bumpkin mind spin,” says Arkos. He quickly gets lost in this moment of nostalgia and you think it only fair for him to continue. After all, he makes her sound like a real bombshell...
rows.translation: “当然是米琳的母亲！哎呀，她可真是个女人。高挑、神秘，飘逸蓝发总是...在风中飞舞。格莱温人，跟你想的一样。我们相遇时，她和她的团队来自...黄铁工业，我记得是，对。他们来安装引擎部件，而她是首席工程师。那个女人的脑子，天啊，让我这乡巴佬头晕目眩，”阿尔科斯说道。他很快沉浸在怀旧之中，你觉得让他继续才公平。毕竟，他把她说得像个真正的大美人...
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mirrin’s mother, of course! Eyy, what a woman. Tall, mysterious, flowing blue hair just... catching in the wind all the time. Gryvain, as you might have thought. We met when she and her team from... Pyrite, I think it was, yeah. They came down to fit their engine parts and she was a lead engineer. The brains on that woman, helvitis. Made my bumpkin mind spin,” says Arkos. He quickly gets lost in this moment of nostalgia and you think it only fair for him to continue. After all, he makes her sound like a real bombshell..."

rows.original: “We hit it off a little quick, aheh. Three months of working together in a tightly cramped hull will do that to people. At that point, I’d never slept with a non-Terran before but ohh, the things I could say... good thing skrimli isn’t here to hear it, aheh,” he winks. That’s all well and good but he could actually say that stuff, the tease.
rows.translation: “我们很快就看对眼了，啊嘿。在狭窄船体里一起工作三个月，总会让人如此。那之前我从未和非泰伦人睡过，不过哦，我能讲的东西可多了...幸好小怪兽不在这里听，啊嘿，”他眨眨眼。话虽如此，他倒是真可以把那些事情说出来啊，真会吊人胃口。
rows.raw: "\n\n“We hit it off a little quick, aheh. Three months of working together in a tightly cramped hull will do that to people. At that point, I’d never slept with a non-Terran before but ohh, the things I could say... good thing skrimli isn’t here to hear it, aheh,” he winks. That’s all well and good but he could actually say that stuff, the tease."

rows.original: “Damn, almost 40 years now... am I that old? Hah! You know, the de-aging stuff may make you live longer but you still feel things speed up a bit each couple of years. And being a dad for the first time was already pretty jarring back then, now I’m a grandfather? Eee, even my papa would’ve been knocked off his feet. But yeah, damn... Onsula is her name. Eh... was her name,” he says with a sigh.
rows.translation: “该死，已经快40年了...我真有那么老吗？哈！你知道，逆龄技术或许能让人活得更久，可每隔几年，你仍会感觉时间又快了一点。那时候第一次当父亲就已经很震撼，现在我成祖父了？咿，连我父亲都会惊得站不稳。不过对，该死...她叫昂苏拉。呃...那是她曾经的名字，”他叹息道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Damn, almost 40 years now... am I that old? Hah! You know, the de-aging stuff may make you live longer but you still feel things speed up a bit each couple of years. And being a dad for the first time was already pretty jarring back then, now I’m a grandfather? Eee, even my papa would’ve been knocked off his feet. But yeah, damn... Onsula is her name. Eh... was her name,” he says with a sigh."

rows.original: “Ohh, I didn’t know, did she...?” you ask softly as his voice lowers.
rows.translation: “哦，我不知道，她是不是...？”他的声音低下去，你也轻声问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ohh, I didn’t know, did she...?” you ask softly as his voice lowers."

rows.original: “Oh no, not dead, no. I think, at least. Let’s just say that once Mirrin hit a certain age, the feisty-minded engineer I fell in love with vanished with nothing but a note on the table. ‘I’m not good enough’ it said. She’d left most of her things behind, taken her money, ID’s...”
rows.translation: “哦不，不是死了，不。至少我觉得没有。只不过米琳到了某个年纪后，我爱上的那个性格泼辣的工程师消失了，桌上只留下一张字条。上面写着‘我不够好’。她留下了大部分东西，带走钱和身份证件...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh no, not dead, no. I think, at least. Let’s just say that once Mirrin hit a certain age, the feisty-minded engineer I fell in love with vanished with nothing but a note on the table. ‘I’m not good enough’ it said. She’d left most of her things behind, taken her money, ID’s...”"

rows.original: He pauses before rubbing his brow.
rows.translation: 他停下来揉了揉眉心。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe pauses before rubbing his brow."

rows.original: “All save one. It was a Heartland Republic I.D and it simply had Dr. Mairis on it. All her details were on there but no surname, no photo frame. A fake. For 30 years, I’ve never known what to make of it. I hid away for months, just torn up, making sure my daughter was alright, trying not to lose it. Business peaked. I didn’t care. We just got stronger through it. Ehhh, the dark stuff. You deserve to know though,” he says, huffing air through his teeth as he finishes.
rows.translation: “除了一张。那是张腹地共和国身份证，上面只写着迈里斯博士。所有资料都在，却没有姓氏，也没有照片框。是假的。30年来，我始终不知道该如何理解。我躲了几个月，整个人都崩溃了；一边确认女儿没事，一边竭力不让自己失控。生意达到巅峰，我却毫不在乎。我们只是因此变得更坚强。呃，那些阴暗往事。不过你有权知道，”他说完，从齿间呼出一口气。
rows.raw: "\n\n“All save one. It was a Heartland Republic I.D and it simply had Dr. Mairis on it. All her details were on there but no surname, no photo frame. A fake. For 30 years, I’ve never known what to make of it. I hid away for months, just torn up, making sure my daughter was alright, trying not to lose it. Business peaked. I didn’t care. We just got stronger through it. Ehhh, the dark stuff. You deserve to know though,” he says, huffing air through his teeth as he finishes."

rows.original: “I’m so sorry,” you say calmly. “Perhaps I shouldn’t have pried.”
rows.translation: “真的很抱歉，”你平静地说道。“或许我不该追问。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m so sorry,” you say calmly. “Perhaps I shouldn’t have pried.”"

rows.original: “Oh no no, is ancient news. We all moved on. Besides, now that you’re here, helping her out, giving her what she needs, sharing a life, it’s... just better,” he says with a smile and a shrug.
rows.translation: “哦不不，都是陈年旧事了。我们都已经继续生活。再说现在你来了，帮助她，给予她所需，与她分享生活，这就...好多了，”他微笑耸肩。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh no no, is ancient news. We all moved on. Besides, now that you’re here, helping her out, giving her what she needs, sharing a life, it’s... just better,” he says with a smile and a shrug."

rows.original: You chat a little more with him for a time, oddly absorbed in his casual approach to his life. You get the impression that he never quite left Terra behind. He gets up rather abruptly and excuses himself when his coffee runs out. “Business never sleeps,” are his parting words.
rows.translation: 你又和他聊了一会儿，莫名被他对待人生的随和态度吸引。你感觉他从未真正把泰拉抛在身后。咖啡喝完后，他相当突然地起身告辞。“生意永不休息，”这是他的临别赠言。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou chat a little more with him for a time, oddly absorbed in his casual approach to his life. You get the impression that he never quite left Terra behind. He gets up rather abruptly and excuses himself when his coffee runs out. “Business never sleeps,” are his parting words."

rows.original: Somewhat satisfied, you swing back to the play area and find your
rows.translation: 你颇为满足地回到游乐区，发现你的
rows.raw: "\n\nSomewhat satisfied, you swing back to the play area and find your "

rows.original: prodigies
rows.translation: 天才孩子们
rows.raw: "prodigies"

rows.original: prodigy
rows.translation: 天才孩子
rows.raw: "prodigy"

rows.original: in the arms of a big red momma dragoness.
rows.translation: 正被红色巨龙妈妈抱在怀里。
rows.raw: " in the arms of a big red momma dragoness."

rows.original: Aww...
rows.raw: "\n\nAww..."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Him
rows.translation: 他
rows.raw: "Him"

rows.original: Mirrin only mentions him, get the lowdown from the man himself.
rows.translation: 米琳只是提到过他，详情还是去问本人吧。
rows.raw: "Mirrin only mentions him, get the lowdown from the man himself."

rows.original: Mirrin
rows.translation: 米琳
rows.raw: "Mirrin"

rows.original: Mirrin
rows.translation: 米琳
rows.raw: "Mirrin"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: “So I have to ask a bit about Mirrin. Iunno, I’ve never had the chance to let her open up,” you ask, pondering on the times you tried.
rows.translation: “所以我想问问米琳的事。说不上来，我一直没机会让她敞开心扉，”你问道，回想起自己过去的种种尝试。
rows.raw: "“So I have to ask a bit about Mirrin. Iunno, I’ve never had the chance to let her open up,” you ask, pondering on the times you tried."

rows.original: “Aheh, yah, I imagine so. Mirrin, ohooo, Mirrin, what a child. My little skrimli. She’s my only daughter so I’m not sure how to frame it, really. Sleepless nights, noisy mornings, broken toys by the afternoon. Laughing all the way, all three of us, aheh. Yeah, I suppose it was normal, except, mmm... she was always strong for a baby, unusually so. No wings, didn’t need to take the Heartland gene therapy for breathing oxygen, we always just penned it on hybrid births. But anyway: I let the company go to some trusted friends - they’re still ploughing away at it - and me and Onsula... uhhh, we settled into domestic life,” he begins, pausing after mentioning that name.
rows.translation: “啊嘿，是啊，我想也是。米琳，哦嚯，米琳，那孩子可真是。我的小怪兽。她是我唯一的女儿，所以我真不知道该怎么讲。彻夜难眠，清晨吵闹，到了下午玩具又坏了。我们三个一路笑个不停，啊嘿。对，我想这算正常吧，只不过，嗯...她从婴儿时就一直很强壮，强壮得异乎寻常。她没有翅膀，也不需要接受用来呼吸氧气的腹地基因疗法，我们总把这归因于混血儿。不过说回来，我把公司交给了几个信得过的朋友，他们现在还在埋头经营，而我和昂苏拉...呃，我们安顿下来，过起了居家生活，”他开始讲述，却在提到那个名字后顿了一下。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Aheh, yah, I imagine so. Mirrin, ohooo, Mirrin, what a child. My little skrimli. She’s my only daughter so I’m not sure how to frame it, really. Sleepless nights, noisy mornings, broken toys by the afternoon. Laughing all the way, all three of us, aheh. Yeah, I suppose it was normal, except, mmm... she was always strong for a baby, unusually so. No wings, didn’t need to take the Heartland gene therapy for breathing oxygen, we always just penned it on hybrid births. But anyway: I let the company go to some trusted friends - they’re still ploughing away at it - and me and Onsula... uhhh, we settled into domestic life,” he begins, pausing after mentioning that name. "

rows.original: Understandable, if curious. Might have to ponder on that...
rows.translation: 可以理解，不过也令人好奇。或许得好好琢磨一下...
rows.raw: "Understandable, if curious. Might have to ponder on that..."

rows.original: Odd, perhaps a former lover or wife. Mirrin’s mom?
rows.translation: 有点奇怪，也许是以前的爱人或妻子。米琳的母亲？
rows.raw: "Odd, perhaps a former lover or wife. Mirrin’s mom?"

rows.original: “First ten years were heavenly. A breeze. I had two beautiful girls in my life, I could nurture one during the day, spend all my time with the other during the night. Mirrin was a good kid, you know. Everything she learned, she wanted more. No time for paperwork though, it all had to be physical activity. We hired teachers for music lessons, artistry, made sure she went to an athletes school when she showed her genes. I guess all my years of uhhh, handiwork seeped in somehow, aheh...”
rows.translation: “最初十年简直像在天堂。轻松得很。我的生命里有两个美丽的姑娘，白天可以照顾一个，夜里则把全部时间留给另一个。米琳是个好孩子，你知道的。无论学会什么，她都还想学得更多。不过她没耐心做书面功课，一切都得是身体活动。我们请老师教她音乐和艺术；她表现出遗传天赋后，我们还确保她进了运动员学校。我猜我这么多年，呃，亲手干活的本事不知怎么也渗进她身上了，啊嘿...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“First ten years were heavenly. A breeze. I had two beautiful girls in my life, I could nurture one during the day, spend all my time with the other during the night. Mirrin was a good kid, you know. Everything she learned, she wanted more. No time for paperwork though, it all had to be physical activity. We hired teachers for music lessons, artistry, made sure she went to an athletes school when she showed her genes. I guess all my years of uhhh, handiwork seeped in somehow, aheh...”"

rows.original: As he continues, you get the feeling that the last sentiment was riddled with doubt. Seems logical though: a strong dad makes a strong daughter through genes, it happens.
rows.translation: 随着他继续讲述，你感觉最后那句话里充满了怀疑。不过这似乎也合乎逻辑：父亲强壮，女儿便通过遗传变得强壮，这种事确实会发生。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs he continues, you get the feeling that the last sentiment was riddled with doubt. Seems logical though: a strong dad makes a strong daughter through genes, it happens."

rows.original: “She never really liked singing much. Had the chords for it, so I was told. I’m fairly certain she still has perfect pitch... can’t be sure. Art, wasn’t her thing. She wasn’t patient enough. She’d spend all her time after school, in the gym. The adults gym, I should say. It was amazing, she could lift her own body weight by age 9 and then squat the same a year later. That’s when I knew she was a certain kind of special. Then uhh, then Onsula... yeah, well, that part is personal,” he sighs, a note tinged with regret.
rows.translation: “她从来都不怎么喜欢唱歌。听说她有那副嗓子。我相当确定她现在仍有绝对音感...但也说不准。艺术也不对她胃口，她没有足够的耐心。放学后，她会把所有时间都花在健身房里。准确说，是成年人的健身房。那真是惊人，她九岁时就能举起等同自己体重的重量，一年后还能用同样重量做深蹲。那时我就知道，她是某种特别的孩子。后来，呃，后来昂苏拉...对，那个部分属于私事，”他叹了口气，声音里染着一丝悔意。
rows.raw: "\n\n“She never really liked singing much. Had the chords for it, so I was told. I’m fairly certain she still has perfect pitch... can’t be sure. Art, wasn’t her thing. She wasn’t patient enough. She’d spend all her time after school, in the gym. The adults gym, I should say. It was amazing, she could lift her own body weight by age 9 and then squat the same a year later. That’s when I knew she was a certain kind of special. Then uhh, then Onsula... yeah, well, that part is personal,” he sighs, a note tinged with regret. "

rows.original: You nod in understanding, remembering the tale he told before.
rows.translation: 你理解地点点头，想起他之前讲过的故事。
rows.raw: "You nod in understanding, remembering the tale he told before."

rows.original: That name again... you simply nod and let him continue.
rows.translation: 又是那个名字...你只是点点头，让他继续说下去。
rows.raw: "That name again... you simply nod and let him continue."

rows.original: “It hit my girl pretty hard. And so did puberty, oh yoy, I’ve never seen someone change so quickly in the space of three years. She hit my height by age 12, beat me in all my weight records, spent 5 hours a day working out and the rest trying to ‘understand’ herself. She’d bring home boys - and girls - and they’d be around for a few days but uhhh, they couldn’t really handle her. Always mad all the time, stern, rough around the edges. It was far harder for her, having to deal with her mother’s genes coming out of nowhere. She was stronger than any of her training partners, probably than any of her idols but she couldn’t enter tournaments because of age. So when she was 16 I built her a private gym, with my own tools and such. Custom made weights, welded by hand. Nothing less for my daughter. I’d never seen her so happy.”
rows.translation: “那件事对我的姑娘打击很大。青春期同样来势汹汹，哦哟，我从没见过谁能在三年间变化得这么快。她十二岁时就长到跟我一样高，打破了我所有的负重纪录，每天锻炼五小时，其余时间则试图‘理解’自己。她会把男孩，还有女孩带回家，他们会待上几天，但呃，他们实在招架不住她。她总在生气，严厉又粗犷。母亲的遗传特征不知从哪儿突然冒出来，她要应付这些，日子就更难过了。她比所有训练搭档都强壮，可能也比自己的任何偶像强壮，但因为年龄不够，她无法参加锦标赛。所以她十六岁时，我用自己的工具之类的东西给她建了一间私人健身房。订制的负重器械，全由我亲手焊接。给我女儿的东西，绝不能差。我从未见她那么开心。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It hit my girl pretty hard. And so did puberty, oh yoy, I’ve never seen someone change so quickly in the space of three years. She hit my height by age 12, beat me in all my weight records, spent 5 hours a day working out and the rest trying to ‘understand’ herself. She’d bring home boys - and girls - and they’d be around for a few days but uhhh, they couldn’t really handle her. Always mad all the time, stern, rough around the edges. It was far harder for her, having to deal with her mother’s genes coming out of nowhere. She was stronger than any of her training partners, probably than any of her idols but she couldn’t enter tournaments because of age. So when she was 16 I built her a private gym, with my own tools and such. Custom made weights, welded by hand. Nothing less for my daughter. I’d never seen her so happy.”"

rows.original: He bites back a tear and sniffs right before rubbing his face with his sleeve.
rows.translation: 他强忍住眼泪，吸了吸鼻子，随后用袖子擦脸。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe bites back a tear and sniffs right before rubbing his face with his sleeve."

rows.original: “It’s okay if-” you begin.
rows.translation: “如果不方便也没关系-”你开口说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s okay if-” you begin."

rows.original: “Ohhh nono, I’m just a softy. It was a great time, all the same. We trained together every day, spotting each other. She’d learned so much about it that she started teaching me, it was crazy. Then... well, I’m not sure how to put it. Second puberty? No, nothing that drastic. When she hit 20, she just... grew. Shot well past my height, massive muscle and skeletal growth. I just, well, I’ll show you,” he says, reaching for something in his pocket. He pulls out a thick and well-used wallet then proceeds to rummage through the business cards and pieces of plastic for a photo.
rows.translation: “哦，不不，我只是容易感伤。总的来说，那是一段很棒的时光。我们每天一起训练，互相保护。她学会了那么多，甚至开始教我，真是不可思议。然后...唉，我不知道该怎么形容。第二次青春期？不，没那么剧烈。她满二十岁时，就只是...长大了。身高猛蹿，远远超过我，肌肉和骨骼也大幅生长。我还是直接给你看吧，”他说着，伸手去掏口袋里的东西。他取出一只厚实而用旧了的钱包，在名片和塑料卡片间翻找一张照片。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ohhh nono, I’m just a softy. It was a great time, all the same. We trained together every day, spotting each other. She’d learned so much about it that she started teaching me, it was crazy. Then... well, I’m not sure how to put it. Second puberty? No, nothing that drastic. When she hit 20, she just... grew. Shot well past my height, massive muscle and skeletal growth. I just, well, I’ll show you,” he says, reaching for something in his pocket. He pulls out a thick and well-used wallet then proceeds to rummage through the business cards and pieces of plastic for a photo."

rows.original: He lays it out in his hand and encourages you to look. You lean in, a little taken aback by it. That’s clearly Mirrin and her dad, the latter of which is unchanged from the man before you save his dark suit.
rows.translation: 他把照片摊在手里，示意你看。你凑近过去，不免有些吃惊。照片上显然是米琳和她父亲；后者除了身穿深色西装，与眼前的男人并无变化。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe lays it out in his hand and encourages you to look. You lean in, a little taken aback by it. That’s clearly Mirrin and her dad, the latter of which is unchanged from the man before you save his dark suit."

rows.original: But Mirrin... she’s making a peace sign with her fingers, a big ol’ grin across both of their faces. She’s leaning on his shoulder with an oversized, golden medal hanging from her neck. That’s the side stuff: what takes you in is that she’s blue. Not entirely blue, just... wow. That’s her face alright with the proud nose and skeptical look but that light blue hair, that pale skin... those yellow eyes. Young Mirrin stands shoulder to shoulder with her pa, looking closer to a seasoned personal fitness trainer rather than the behemoth sitting in the other room. Her one piece gymsuit - taut and skintight as it might be - is still more modest than the accentuating outfits she wears now.
rows.translation: 可是米琳...她用手指比着胜利手势，两人脸上都挂着灿烂笑容。她靠在父亲肩上，脖子上挂着一枚硕大的金牌。这些都只是陪衬：真正吸引你的是，她是蓝色的。并非全身蓝色，只是...哇。那确实是她的脸，有着骄傲的鼻子和怀疑的神情，可那浅蓝色头发、苍白皮肤...还有那双黄色眼睛。年轻的米琳与父亲并肩站立，看起来更像经验丰富的私人健身教练，而非坐在隔壁房间里的庞然大物。她身上的连体健身服虽然绷紧贴身，却仍比她如今穿的那些凸显身材的服装端庄得多。
rows.raw: "\n\nBut Mirrin... she’s making a peace sign with her fingers, a big ol’ grin across both of their faces. She’s leaning on his shoulder with an oversized, golden medal hanging from her neck. That’s the side stuff: what takes you in is that she’s blue. Not entirely blue, just... wow. That’s her face alright with the proud nose and skeptical look but that light blue hair, that pale skin... those yellow eyes. Young Mirrin stands shoulder to shoulder with her pa, looking closer to a seasoned personal fitness trainer rather than the behemoth sitting in the other room. Her one piece gymsuit - taut and skintight as it might be - is still more modest than the accentuating outfits she wears now."

rows.raw: "MirrinYoung"

rows.original: “So you see, that was a few months before the big changes. When they happened, it was nuts. She’d be out all day, bringing home new friends all the time, training, training, training. There was so little I could do to help aside cover costs and just be a dad. Sometimes she wouldn’t be back for a month, having taken a trip to some pleasure planet or something, eugh. A dad doesn’t want to think about what his daughter does to have fun, sorry. That aggression was there, always. She’d never sit still for long. Bought new clothes every week because she outgrew them too fast and never found something that worked. I couldn’t explain it, doctors couldn’t explain it. It’s like a freak gene that went crazy. All that aside, that’s when...”
rows.translation: “所以你看，那是在巨变发生前几个月。变化真正到来时，一切都疯了。她整天不在家，不断带新朋友回来，不停地训练、训练、再训练。除了支付开销、尽到一个父亲的责任，我几乎帮不上什么忙。有时她跑去某个欢愉星球之类的地方，一整个月都不回来，呃。父亲可不想去想女儿平时怎么寻开心，抱歉。那种攻击性始终存在。她从来安分不了多久。她长得太快，每周都得买新衣服，却一直找不到合适的。我解释不了，医生也解释不了。就像某个异常基因突然发了疯。先不说这些，就是在那时候...”
rows.raw: "“So you see, that was a few months before the big changes. When they happened, it was nuts. She’d be out all day, bringing home new friends all the time, training, training, training. There was so little I could do to help aside cover costs and just be a dad. Sometimes she wouldn’t be back for a month, having taken a trip to some pleasure planet or something, eugh. A dad doesn’t want to think about what his daughter does to have fun, sorry. That aggression was there, always. She’d never sit still for long. Bought new clothes every week because she outgrew them too fast and never found something that worked. I couldn’t explain it, doctors couldn’t explain it. It’s like a freak gene that went crazy. All that aside, that’s when...”"

rows.original: “Oh is that when she did the modelling thing?” you chime in, picking up on where the thread was going.
rows.translation: “哦，就是那时她开始当模特的吗？”你插话道，听出了话题的走向。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh is that when she did the modelling thing?” you chime in, picking up on where the thread was going."

rows.original: “Exactly, yes. You don’t go around being that big without turning heads so I guess it would’ve only made sense. She got her first contract work within the week. That then blew up in the fitness circuit. The new ‘it’ girl, unmodded and all natural, putting everyone in her size and weight class to shame with a body to match. My little skrimli became... well, big skrimli. Then the actual modding came a long,” he says with a huff. With his wallet still in hand, he pulls out a small list on a piece of cut card and shows it to you.
rows.translation: “没错，是的。长到那么大的块头，不引人注目才怪，所以这大概也是顺理成章。不到一周，她就接到了第一份合约工作。接着，她在健身圈一炮而红。没有改造、纯天然的当红新秀，凭着那副身体，让所有同体型和同重量级的人都相形见绌。我的小怪兽变成了...嗯，大怪兽。然后才开始真正的身体改造，”他呼了口气说道。他手里仍拿着钱包，从中抽出一张裁切卡片，上面写着一份短短的清单，随后递给你看。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Exactly, yes. You don’t go around being that big without turning heads so I guess it would’ve only made sense. She got her first contract work within the week. That then blew up in the fitness circuit. The new ‘it’ girl, unmodded and all natural, putting everyone in her size and weight class to shame with a body to match. My little skrimli became... well, big skrimli. Then the actual modding came a long,” he says with a huff. With his wallet still in hand, he pulls out a small list on a piece of cut card and shows it to you."

rows.original: “So yes, this was the list. ‘That’ list. Very expensive. Horns, hooves, pigments, scale cultures, tail growth, uhhh, genitals... took months for the finished effect. Yet I think it needed to happen. Her little forays into zen and all that, just to calm her inner dragon. And because of all these things, she’s more successful than I was, aheh. I’m more than happy to help her. But I’m also happy that she, uhhh, she found herself. And now you. I have to thank you,” he says with a blush, “she smiles more now.”
rows.translation: “所以没错，这就是那份清单。‘那份’清单。非常昂贵。角、蹄子、色素、鳞片培养、尾巴生长，呃，还有生殖器...花了几个月才达到最终效果。不过我觉得这件事必须发生。她短暂接触过禅修之类的东西，只为了平息内心的巨龙。也正因为这一切，她如今比我还成功，啊嘿。我非常乐意帮助她。但我也很高兴她，呃，她找到了真正的自己。而现在她又找到了你。我必须谢谢你，”他红着脸说道，“她现在笑得更多了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So yes, this was the list. ‘That’ list. Very expensive. Horns, hooves, pigments, scale cultures, tail growth, uhhh, genitals... took months for the finished effect. Yet I think it needed to happen. Her little forays into zen and all that, just to calm her inner dragon. And because of all these things, she’s more successful than I was, aheh. I’m more than happy to help her. But I’m also happy that she, uhhh, she found herself. And now you. I have to thank you,” he says with a blush, “she smiles more now.”"

rows.original: Oh... well he didn’t have to drop all those feelings on you all at once. Not really knowing what to say or do, you simply laugh and pat him on the arm. It’s then that a device beeps.

rows.original: “Ahhh, helvitis, more advertising nonsense. Hate to cut it short but, ehhh... anyway. Appreciate it, also I hope uh, I helped too,” he says in a fluster as he gets up to leave. You hang around for a few minutes to think about what he says before heading back to the play area.
rows.translation: “啊，该死，又是广告废话。真不想这么快结束，不过，呃...总之，谢谢你，而且我希望，呃，我也帮上了忙，”他慌乱地说道，站起身准备离开。你又停留了几分钟，思考他说过的话，随后回到游乐区。

rows.original: A bright green world comes into view ahead: a planet of small, scattered oceans, rolling plains, and clear weather. At first glance, New Texas looks like a male paradise world, peaceful and idyllic. The space lanes around the planet are mostly clear, letting you punch in the auto-lander and sit back as your ship’s computers guide you down to the surface. The clouds roll past you as your ship cruises down toward the largest continent.
rows.translation: 前方出现一个翠绿世界：一颗散布着小片海洋、遍布起伏平原且天气晴朗的行星。乍看之下，新得克萨斯就像男性的天堂，宁静而田园诗般美好。星球周围的航道大多畅通，你得以启动自动着陆程序，靠回座椅，让飞船电脑引导你降向地表。飞船朝最大的一块大陆下降，云层从舷外滚滚掠过。

The clouds roll past you as your ship cruises down toward the largest continent."

rows.original: Your auto-nav guides you down toward the most popular tourist spot on the planet, a particularly large ranch owned by the planetary governor. You bring up a few articles on the place: the extranet is full of holo-pics of busty, bovine-like human girls milling about the ranch, as well as reviews of an amazing barbeque joint and a something simply called the Treatment, which has all but made the planet what it is today. A whole planetary society based on gene mods... interesting.
rows.translation: 自动导航系统引导你降向星球上最受欢迎的旅游地点，一座归行星总督所有的特大型牧场。你调出几篇介绍文章：外网上到处都是胸部丰满、外形近似牛族的人类女孩在牧场活动的全息照片，还有一家绝佳烧烤店的评价，以及一种只被称作“改造疗程”的东西。正是后者几乎塑造了这颗星球如今的模样。一个以基因改造为基础的行星社会...真有意思。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour auto-nav guides you down toward the most popular tourist spot on the planet, a particularly large ranch owned by the planetary governor. You bring up a few articles on the place: the extranet is full of holo-pics of busty, bovine-like human girls milling about the ranch, as well as reviews of an amazing barbeque joint and a something simply called the Treatment, which has all but made the planet what it is today. A whole planetary society based on gene mods... interesting."

rows.original: The computer alerts you to imminent landing. You cast a glance out your viewscreen just in time to see a monolithic barn coming into view, easily the size of two city blocks back to back on each side. As you approach, the roof of the barn shudders and begins to split, separated by two massive hydraulic arms that create an opening wide enough for a frigate to pass through. Your ship slows, guided in by the automatic docking protocols as it passes between the raised slates of the barn-dock’s roof. Inside, you can see a handful of smaller cargo haulers and touristy passenger ships docked below, each pulled into an oversized, self-contained “stall.” You feel a slight shudder in the deck as your ship lands on the hay-covered floor, quickly surrounded by several buff, burly dock workers, each with a pair of bull horns growing from his head.
rows.translation: 电脑提醒你即将着陆。你及时瞥向视窗，正好看到一座宏伟的谷仓映入眼帘，它的每一边都足有两个相连街区那么长。随着飞船靠近，谷仓屋顶震颤起来，继而从中间分开；两条巨大的液压臂将其撑开，形成一道足以让护卫舰通过的入口。飞船减速，在自动对接程序引导下，从谷仓船坞抬起的屋顶板之间穿过。内部下方停着几艘较小的货运船和观光客船，每艘都被拖入一个超大的独立“畜栏”。飞船落在铺满干草的地面上时，你感觉甲板微微一震；几名强壮魁梧的码头工人迅速围了上来，每人头上都长着一对牛角。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe computer alerts you to imminent landing. rows.original: The Customs and Visitor Check-in office dominates the only passage between the spaceport and the ranch proper, ensuring anybody coming or going gets a proper screening. Two desks are set up, facing each other across the thoroughfare: one is labeled “Customs and Weapons Check,” the other, “Visitor Check-in.” Very straightforward.
rows.translation: 海关与访客登记处占据了太空港与牧场主体之间的唯一通道，确保所有进出人员都接受适当检查。两张桌子隔着通道相对摆放：一张标着“海关与武器检查”，另一张则标着“访客登记”。非常直白。
rows.raw: "The Customs and Visitor Check-in office dominates the only passage between the spaceport and the ranch proper, ensuring anybody coming or going gets a proper screening. Two desks are set up, facing each other across the thoroughfare: one is labeled “Customs and Weapons Check,” the other, “Visitor Check-in.” Very straightforward. "

rows.original: A broad-chested, muscular bull-man is sitting lazily behind the Customs desk, leaning back in his chair and staring off into space. When he sees you, he sits up a little straighter, though in so doing he gasps a bit. Something seems to be distracting him, though you can’t see what... “Ah. Sorry, slow day. Come on over, let’s get you checked out.”
rows.translation: 一名胸膛宽阔、肌肉发达的公牛男懒散地坐在海关柜台后，靠着椅背，茫然望向远处。他看见你后稍微坐直了一点，却因此轻喘了一声。似乎有什么让他分心，但你看不出是什么...“啊，抱歉，今天挺清闲的。过来吧，我来给你检查。”

rows.original: You approach the bull-man behind the desk. He looks human enough at first glance, if abnormally tall, muscular, and broad-chested. Up close, though, you can get a good look at the massive pair of bull horns sticking up on either side of his blue cap, and the mat of thick, dark hair poking out from his long sleeves and over the hem of his undershirt. He’s dressed in old-school corporate security getup: blue pants and shirt, with a ballistic vest strapped tight to his barrel chest, barely hanging in there thanks to his size. Pinned to his vest is a tag reading, “Hello, my name is Ogram.”
rows.translation: 你走向柜台后的公牛男。乍看之下，他很像人类，只是异常高大、肌肉发达且胸膛宽阔。不过走近后，你能清楚看到蓝色帽子两侧伸出的硕大牛角，以及从长袖和汗衫下摆钻出的浓密深色体毛。他穿着老派企业安保制服：蓝色长裤和衬衫，粗壮胸膛上紧紧绑着防弹背心；以他的体型，背心几乎快撑不住了。背心上别着一块名牌，写着“你好，我叫奥格拉姆。”
rows.raw: "You approach the bull-man behind the desk. He looks human enough at first glance, if abnormally tall, muscular, and broad-chested. Up close, though, you can get a good look at the massive pair of bull horns sticking up on either side of his blue cap, and the mat of thick, dark hair poking out from his long sleeves and over the hem of his undershirt. He’s dressed in old-school corporate security getup: blue pants and shirt, with a ballistic vest strapped tight to his barrel chest, barely hanging in there thanks to his size. Pinned to his vest is a tag reading, “Hello, my name is Ogram.”"

rows.original: Seeing you looking, he chuckles and sits up straighter behind his desk. “What? Never seen a Texan before, or do I have something on my shirt?”
rows.translation: 见你盯着看，他轻笑一声，在柜台后坐直。“怎么？以前没见过得州人，还是我脸上沾了什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nSeeing you looking, he chuckles and sits up straighter behind his desk. “What? Never seen a Texan before, or do I have something on my shirt?”"

rows.original: You apologize as he picks up a stack of forms, sticks them on a clipboard, and hands them to you. “Basic stuff, here: just check to say that you don’t have any contagious diseases, you’re not bringing foreign foodstuffs in, and that you’re generally not going to be a dick on my planet. Oh, and there’s a weapons check. No firearms, bladed weapons, or other means of murder and mayhem beyond this point. Don’t worry, we’ll tag ‘em and hand ‘em back to you as soon as you’re ready to leave.”
rows.translation: 你道了歉。他拿起一叠表格，夹在写字板上递给你。“只是些基本资料。姓名、飞船登记号、访问目的。还有，进入牧场前得把武器交给我保管。”

Oh, and there’s a weapons check. No firearms, bladed weapons, or other means of murder and mayhem beyond this point. Don’t worry, we’ll tag ‘em and hand ‘em back to you as soon as you’re ready to leave.”"

[thirdCheck |You put up as strong a guard as you can, holding fast against the rapid impact of her punches. |Your footwork kicks into high gear as you duck and move away from her, dodging as well as you can. |You keep your guard up and look for the right chance, then lash out with a well-aimed counterattack as soon as she leaves herself open. |You use what you’ve learned of her fighting style to keep her hits from landing, and wait for an opening that you know is coming. |You keep your guard up and endure, focusing on staying steady until you have a chance to fight back. ] The two of you seem almost evenly matched, her training and your life experience balancing each other out, and you separate again, both sweaty and breathing hard. [thirdWin |You move in before she can recover, and land a solid jab that sends her reeling back. A quick right hook staggers her, and your follow-through cross sends her stumbling back into the ropes. Tara sags against them, then holds up one gloved hand, breathing hard. She’s tapped out – you won. You step back, giving her a moment to recover, and she pulls herself together quickly. Tara blinks a few times, and mutters something as she rubs at her jaw. “Damn, Steele,” she says, steadying herself as she leans against the ropes. “That was a hell of a last shot.” |Tara moves in fast at you again before you can recover, and lands a few solid jabs that send you reeling back. Your head spins from the impact, and that means you don’t even see her follow-up attack, but you feel the uppercut slam into your jaw. You stumble back into the ropes, and push through the dizziness to hold up one gloved hand. That’s a tap out – she’s won. You lean against the ropes for a moment, waiting for the spinning in your head to pass. When it does, you see Tara standing there with a smug grin on her face. “Not bad, Steele,” she says. “You’ve got some moves, but don’t feel too bad. I’ve been at this since I was a kid, y’know, and it’s kind of my job.” ] The two of you step out of the ring, and Tara hands you a towel with the Ten Ton Gym’s logo on it. Both of you wipe away some of the sweat, though there’s only so much a quick toweling-off can do. Once she’s done, Tara slings the towel over her shoulders, then grabs a water bottle from the side of the ring and chugs it down, pouring some of it over her head. “Nothing like a good little bout,” Tara says, then grins at you. “Couldn’t pull out my best moves here at the gym, but y’know, you still did pretty damn good.” [thirdWin |Pretty damn good? You got her to tap out. That’s a lot better than just pretty good, especially against someone who’s trained for this. |It’s not the kind of fighting you’re used to, but you can always learn plenty from going up against someone who knows their stuff. ] Tara just keeps grinning. “Hey, this is what I’m here for. You want to go another round, or just get in some training, you let me know, yeah?” After today’s fight, you definitely will. "
