rows.original: You tell Tara that you’re here to do some training. She gives you a look like she’s genuinely happy to hear that, and claps you on the shoulder with one gloved hand. “Hell yeah, Steele,” she says, grinning. “Always good to help someone get better with their hands.” She smirks, the double meaning clear even if she’s talking about boxing. “Pull on some gloves and get in the ring, and we’ll get started.” You head to the rack of boxing gloves on the wall, and pull on a pair that fits you, then climb into the boxing ring. Tara meets you at the middle, already bouncing a little on her feet, [taraChest |clearly ready to go |her chest bouncing along with the rest of her |her huge boobs bouncing like they’re trying to bust out of her sports bra ]. There’s some kind of determination on her face, but it’s different than when she’s usually in the ring. “So, we always start with the basics,” Tara begins. “[flags.TARA_TRAINING |Remind me how much of this kind of thing you’ve done before? |How much of this kind of thing you done before? ]” [pc.cl mercenary |You’ve been fully trained in hand-to-hand combat, though most of it was so you could fight off something that was trying to kill you. |You’ve had your share of fights, both up close and at a distance, but you haven’t really focused on hand-to-hand combat. ] [pc.cl mercenary |Tara’s eyebrows rise, but she doesn’t comment on you having a much more brutal kind of experience than she does. ]”Okay, we can work with that,” Tara says. “Let’s start with the basics, stance and guard, then we’ll work through some punching before hitting footwork.” Tara helps you get into the right position for boxing, a simple guard with your dominant hand up in front, your weight evenly distributed. [pc.isTaur |It takes her a moment to get all four of your legs positioned right, but she figures it out, and looks proud of herself for doing it. |[pc.isGoo |It takes her a moment to figure out how your legless lower body will affect your stance, but she finds a way to make it work, and looks proud of herself. |[pc.isNaga |It takes her a moment to figure out how your legless lower body will affect your stance, but she finds a way to make it work, and looks proud of herself. ] ] ]Once you’re set, she explains the key parts of the guard. “Head down, shoulders up, good,” she says, stepping around you and nudging your arms into place. “Make sure you can see over your gloves, you’re not gonna do a damn thing if you can’t see past your own hands.” She grins, then steps up in front of you. “Now focus on me,” Tara says.[taraChest | | The way her tits are sticking out in front of her, it’s hard to focus on anything else. | The way her enormous rack is swaying right in front of you, it’s hard to focus on anything else. ] “[firstCheck |Think about putting as much power behind your punches as you can. |Think about putting some real speed into your strikes. |Think about making your fists land exactly where you want them. |Think about getting your technique exactly right, and all of this will work better. |Think about being able to stay in the fight as long as you need to. ]” You focus like Tara told you to, and she walks around you and adjusts your stance again, then nods. “Not bad, not bad. Now, I want you to swap in and out of that stance a bunch, get you used to dropping into it.” 6y [flags.TARA_TRAINING |You’ve been through this before, but it helps to get a refresher, and you can feel the exercise working for you already. |You can tell it could change how you fight, and you can feel yourself slowly getting better at it as you go. ] “Nice,” Tara says, and steps up in front of you again. “Now, we’re gonna work on your guard. Keep your arms up, but loose, so you’re ready to block what’s coming in, no matter who or where it’s coming from.” She snickers as New Texan sex humor strikes again, but gets serious real quick as she raises her gloved hands. You keep your arms up, and Tara starts throwing some slow, light punches at you. With your combat experience, it’s no trouble to keep her from hitting you, and she calls out corrections and suggestions the whole time. After a few rounds of half a dozen jabs, you feel like you can do that a little bit better. It might not help in a fight for your life, but having the fundamentals down will keep you safer no matter what. “Okay.” Tara steps back, and wipes sweat from her forehead. “Now, let’s work on some punching.” Tara guides you back into position, and checks your stance, nodding as she walks a circle around you. “So, basic punching rules are don’t tense up, exhale as you throw a punch, and tighten yourself up on impact.” She comes to stand in front of you again, and tilts her head a little as she looks at you. “I know that’s a lot to think about when it’s just hitting someone, but trust me, it’ll help. And once you get it down, you’ll see a difference.” She moves in to stand next to you, and walks you through the process of a basic jab, showing you how she starts off relaxed but tenses herself right before the moment of impact, to get more power into the punch. [taraChest | |It’s impossible not to notice how much her chest shakes as she punches, but you do your best to pay attention to the lesson. |It’s kind of amazing that she can keep up her technique with so much boob sticking out in front of her, but she did say she’d had to adapt to work with her new tits. ]Once she’s demonstrated it enough for you to understand, she turns to face you again. “Okay, let’s go through the basic jab,” she says. “This is the heart of boxing, so getting it right is where everything else starts. Try to focus on [secondCheck |getting some real power into it |the motion of tensing and relasing |putting your fist exactly where you want it |getting the technique right |making all the steps work together ], and let’s see how you do.” You check your stance to make sure it’s right, then focus and throw a few jabs, just like Tara said. She walks around you as you punch, checking your technique, making a few adjustments as she goes. Like she said, you focus on [secondCheck |putting as much strength behind your strikes as you can |the quick tensing at the end of the punch, followed by relaxing after impact |making sure you strike right where you intend to |the methods behind everything she’s teaching you |putting together everything she’s taught you ]. There’s something about focusing just on a simple punch that feels real good, even if it’s very different from what you usually use in a fight. Tara keeps on checking your technique, then nods, an approving smile on her face. “Looks good, Steele. I know this seems like super basic shit, but trust me, everything about boxing starts with getting good at jabs. Most every combo you could think of starts with a jab, and if you know how to throw that quick, reliable punch, you can use it for most anything in the ring.” She shrugs one shoulder, and puts a hand on her hip. “I know everyone’s big on the flashier stuff, uppercuts and hooks and whatever, but it’s the jab that makes a good boxer.” You can see what she means. Even though [pc.cl mercenary |you’ve learned hand-to-hand combat |it’s not something you’ve learned much ] before coming here, you can tell how helpful landing a simple good punch would be in a fight. “Damn right,” Tara says. “Now let’s get to some footwork. If you can’t move in the ring, you’re gonna get stomped on, and I’m not letting that happen to anyone I’ve trained.” Tara walks you through some basic footwork instructions, [pc.isTaur |though she has to take a moment to figure out how to adapt them for your four feet |[pc.isNaga |though she seems confused at first about how she’s supposed to teach you to step when you don’t have any legs |[pc.isGoo |though she seems confused at first about how she’s supposed to teach you to step when you don’t have any legs |adjusting your [pc.legs] as she gets you into the right position ] ] ]. Most of it is about a few basic steps, keeping your weight grounded and making sure you don’t cross your feet when you’re in the ring. [pc.isNaga |Not that you have to worry about that. |[pc.isGoo |Not that you have to worry about that. ] ] “Step and drag, step and drag,” Tara says, working her way across the ring a step ahead of you so you can see her feet. “Don’t get flashy with me, or start jumping around – that’s bullshit from movies or whatever else. Last thing you want to do is launch yourself into the air where you can’t change which way you’re going.” She walks you through a pivot step, and after you’ve circled around the ring a few times, she wipes sweat from her face and gives you a considering look. “Okay, Steele, let’s put this all together.” Tara runs you through a drill of everything she’s taught you, calling out punches and steps and guards one after another, making sure you can do everything the two of you have gone over. [secondCheck |You make sure to put plenty of power behind your punches, just like she said. |You focus on the quick tense-and-relax she taught you for punching, and make sure your footwork goes just like she said. |You focus on making sure every jab you throw goes right where you want it to, striking out quick at an imaginary opponent. |You focus on perfect execution of the techniques she’s taught you, weaving them all together for an impressive result. |You focus on your breathing as she calls out, keeping your body moving and making sure you don’t run out of energy before you’re done. ] Finally, Tara claps her gloved hands together, then steps in and gives you a gentle punch on one shoulder. “Nice work! You catch onto this stuff pretty damn quick.” [pc.nmh |It’s not too different from some of the fighting you’ve had to do before, but having a good teacher helps. |Yeah, you’re the best. Pretty soon you’ll be able to take her out, yeah? Maybe? Maybe not. |It’s a damn rough galaxy out there, and you’ve had to keep yourself safe no matter what, so of course you’re good at fighting. ] Tara nods, grinning, then steps out of the ring and grabs two towels. She throws you one, and says, “I dunno if you’re ready for more advanced stuff, but we can work that out another time. You let me know if you want to go for another session, yeah?” You towel yourself off, taking off the worst of the sweat. As for another training session, you’ll definitely let her know when you’re ready for that.
rows.translation: 你告诉塔拉，你是来接受训练的。她看起来发自内心地为此感到高兴，还用戴着拳套的一只手拍了拍你的肩膀。“太棒了，斯蒂尔，”她咧嘴笑着说。“能帮别人把手上功夫练得更好，总是件好事。”她露出坏笑；虽然她谈的是拳击，但双关意味再明显不过。“戴好拳套，上拳台，我们马上开始。” 你走到墙边的拳套架前，戴上一副合适的拳套，随后爬上拳台。塔拉在中央与你会合，脚下已经开始微微弹跳，[taraChest |显然已经准备就绪 |胸部随着身体的其余部分一起弹动 |硕大的奶子上下弹动，仿佛想要挣破运动胸罩 ]。她脸上带着某种坚定神情，却与平常比赛时有所不同。 “那么，我们总是从基础开始，”塔拉说道。“[flags.TARA_TRAINING |提醒我一下，你以前做过多少类似的训练？ |你以前做过多少类似的训练？ ]” [pc.cl mercenary |你接受过完整的徒手格斗训练，不过大多是为了击退那些想杀死你的东西。 |远近距离的战斗你都经历过不少，但并没有真正专注于徒手格斗。 ] [pc.cl mercenary |塔拉扬起眉毛，却没有评论你那远比她残酷的战斗经历。 ]”好，这样也没问题，”塔拉说道。“先从基础开始，练站姿和防御，然后练习出拳，最后再练步法。” 塔拉帮你摆出正确的拳击姿势：惯用手举在身前，体重均匀分配，构成简单的防御架势。[pc.isTaur |她花了一会儿才把你的四条腿全部调整到正确位置，不过最终还是弄明白了，而且为自己的成果颇感自豪。 |[pc.isGoo |她花了一会儿才弄明白你没有腿的下半身会怎样影响站姿，不过最终还是找到了可行的办法，而且显得颇为自豪。 |[pc.isNaga |她花了一会儿才弄明白你没有腿的下半身会怎样影响站姿，不过最终还是找到了可行的办法，而且显得颇为自豪。 ] ] ]等你摆好姿势后，她开始解释防御架势的关键之处。 “低头，耸肩，很好，”她一边说，一边绕着你走动，将你的手臂推到正确位置。“确保自己能从拳套上方看出去。要是连自己的手都看不过去，你他妈什么也做不了。”她咧嘴一笑，随后走到你面前。 “现在，专心看着我，”塔拉说。[taraChest | |她的奶子就这样挺在身前，让人很难把注意力放到别处。 |她硕大的胸脯就在你面前摇晃，让人很难把注意力放到别处。 ]“[firstCheck |想办法让每一拳都带上尽可能强大的力量。 |想办法让攻击拥有真正的速度。 |想办法让拳头准确落在你希望的位置。 |想办法把技巧做到完全正确，这样所有动作都会更有效。 |想办法让自己能在比赛中坚持到任何必要的时候。 ]” 你按照塔拉的指示集中精神。她绕着你走了一圈，再次调整你的架势，随后点点头。“不赖，不赖。现在，我要你反复进出这个架势，让你习惯迅速摆好姿势。” 6y [flags.TARA_TRAINING |你以前练过这些，不过重新温习一下仍有帮助，而且已经能感觉到这次训练正在发挥作用。 |你能看出它会改变你的战斗方式，也能感觉到自己在练习过程中慢慢进步。 ] “很好，”塔拉说着，再次走到你面前。“现在，我们要练习防御。双臂抬起，但要保持放松，这样无论攻击来自谁、来自哪里，你都能随时格挡。”新德克萨斯式的性暗示再次冒了出来，她窃笑一声，却在举起戴着拳套的双手时立刻恢复严肃。 你举起双臂，塔拉开始朝你挥出缓慢而轻柔的拳头。凭借你的战斗经验，要让她打不中你毫不费力，而她则全程不断喊出纠正意见和建议。经过几轮、每轮约六记刺拳后，你觉得自己的防守确实进步了一点。它或许无法在生死搏斗中派上大用场，但无论遇到什么情况，扎实的基本功都能让你更加安全。 “好了。”塔拉后退一步，擦去额头上的汗水。“现在来练练出拳。” 塔拉引导你回到正确位置，检查你的架势，一边绕着你走了一圈，一边点头。“出拳的基本规则是不要绷紧身体，挥拳时呼气，在命中时才收紧全身。”她再次站到你面前，微微偏着头打量你。“我知道，不过是打个人，却要同时考虑这么多事，但相信我，这些会有帮助。等你掌握之后，就会看出区别。” 她走到你身旁，引导你完成一记基础刺拳的全过程，展示自己如何在起初保持放松，却在命中的前一刻绷紧身体，为拳头注入更多力量。[taraChest | |她出拳时胸部晃动得十分厉害，根本不可能不去注意，但你仍尽力专心听课。 |她身前挺着这么多乳肉，居然还能保持动作技巧，实在令人惊叹，不过她确实说过，为了适应新长出的奶子，她不得不调整自己的打法。 ]等她示范到足以让你理解之后，她再次转身面对你。 “好，我们来练基础刺拳，”她说。“这是拳击的核心，所有其他技巧都始于正确的刺拳。试着专注于[secondCheck |真正把力量灌注进去 |绷紧和放松的动作 |让拳头准确落在你希望的位置 |把技巧做正确 |让所有步骤协调运作 ]，看看你练得怎么样。” 你检查自己的架势是否正确，随后集中精神，按照塔拉所说挥出几记刺拳。你出拳时，她绕着你走动，检查你的技巧，并随时进行一些调整。正如她所说，你专注于[secondCheck |让攻击带上尽可能强大的力量 |在拳头末端迅速绷紧身体，并在命中后放松 |确保准确击中自己瞄准的位置 |她所教授的一切背后的方法 |把她教给你的一切结合起来 ]。仅仅专心打好一记简单的拳头，感觉出奇地好，尽管这和你平时在战斗中采用的方式截然不同。 塔拉继续检查你的技巧，随后点点头，脸上露出赞许的笑容。“看起来不错，斯蒂尔。我知道这些像是最他妈基础的东西，但相信我，拳击的一切都始于练好刺拳。你能想到的绝大多数组合拳都以刺拳起手；只要掌握这种迅速可靠的拳法，拳台上的几乎任何情况都能用得上。”她耸起一边肩膀，一只手叉在腰间。“我知道人人都喜欢更花哨的招式，什么上勾拳、勾拳之类的，但真正造就优秀拳击手的是刺拳。” 你明白她的意思。尽管来到这里之前，[pc.cl mercenary |你已经学过徒手格斗 |你并没有学过多少这方面的东西 ]，但你仍看得出，在战斗中稳稳打出一记简单的好拳会多么有用。 “这才对，”塔拉说。“现在来练步法。要是你不能在拳台上移动，就会被人踩扁，而我绝不会让自己训练过的人落得这种下场。” 塔拉带你练习一些基础步法，[pc.isTaur |不过她得先花一点时间，弄清楚该如何让这些技巧适应你的四只脚 |[pc.isNaga |不过她起初似乎很困惑，不知道你连腿都没有，她该怎样教你迈步 |[pc.isGoo |不过她起初似乎很困惑，不知道你连腿都没有，她该怎样教你迈步 |她一边把你摆进正确姿势，一边调整你的[pc.legs] ] ] ]。其中大部分都围绕几种基本步伐展开：重心保持稳定，而且在拳台上绝不能让双脚交叉。[pc.isNaga |当然，你不必担心这一点。 |[pc.isGoo |当然，你不必担心这一点。 ] ] “迈步，再拖步，迈步，再拖步，”塔拉说道。她始终领先你一步横穿拳台，让你能看清她的双脚。“别在我面前耍花招，也别开始蹦来蹦去 – 那都是电影或其他东西里的胡扯。你最不该做的，就是把自己送到半空中，再也没法改变前进方向。” 她带你练习旋转步；等你绕着拳台转过几圈后，她擦去脸上的汗水，若有所思地看着你。“好了，斯蒂尔，现在把这些全都结合起来。” 塔拉让你进行一套涵盖所有所学内容的训练，接连喊出拳法、步法和防御动作，确保你能完成两人练过的每一样东西。[secondCheck |你按照她的指示，确保每一拳都带上充足的力量。 |你专注于她教你的出拳时迅速绷紧再放松，并确保步法也完全符合她的要求。 |你专注于确保挥出的每一记刺拳都准确落在希望的位置，迅速击向想象中的对手。 |你专注于完美执行她教给你的技巧，将它们融为一体，取得令人赞叹的效果。 |你在她喊出动作时专注于呼吸，让身体持续移动，并确保自己不会在结束前耗尽体力。 ] 最后，塔拉拍了拍戴着拳套的双手，随后上前轻轻打了你的肩膀一拳。“干得漂亮！你他妈学这些东西真快。” [pc.nmh |这和你以前不得不经历的一些战斗相差不大，不过有位好老师确实很有帮助。 |没错，你是最棒的。很快你就能打败她了，对吧？也许？也许不能。 |这片银河他妈危险得很，而你无论如何都得保护自己，所以你当然很擅长战斗。 ] 塔拉咧嘴笑着点点头，随后走下拳台，拿来两条毛巾。她朝你扔来一条，说道：“我不知道你是否已经准备好学习更高阶的内容，不过我们可以下次再研究。你要是想再练一节课，就告诉我，好吗？” rows.raw: " You tell Tara that you’re here to do some training. She gives you a look like she’s genuinely happy to hear that, and claps you on the shoulder with one gloved hand. “Hell yeah, Steele,” she says, grinning. “Always good to help someone get better with their hands.” She smirks, the double meaning clear even if she’s talking about boxing. “Pull on some gloves and get in the ring, and we’ll get started.” You head to the rack of boxing gloves on the wall, and pull on a pair that fits you, then climb into the boxing ring. Tara meets you at the middle, already bouncing a little on her feet, [taraChest |clearly ready to go |her chest bouncing along with the rest of her |her huge boobs bouncing like they’re trying to bust out of her sports bra ]. There’s some kind of determination on her face, but it’s different than when she’s usually in the ring. “So, we always start with the basics,” Tara begins. “[flags.TARA_TRAINING |Remind me how much of this kind of thing you’ve done before? |How much of this kind of thing you done before? ]” [pc.cl mercenary |You’ve been fully trained in hand-to-hand combat, though most of it was so you could fight off something that was trying to kill you. |You’ve had your share of fights, both up close and at a distance, but you haven’t really focused on hand-to-hand combat. ] [pc.cl mercenary |Tara’s eyebrows rise, but she doesn’t comment on you having a much more brutal kind of experience than she does. ]”Okay, we can work with that,” Tara says. “Let’s start with the basics, stance and guard, then we’ll work through some punching before hitting footwork.” Tara helps you get into the right position for boxing, a simple guard with your dominant hand up in front, your weight evenly distributed. [pc.isTaur |It takes her a moment to get all four of your legs positioned right, but she figures it out, and looks proud of herself for doing it. |[pc.isGoo |It takes her a moment to figure out how your legless lower body will affect your stance, but she finds a way to make it work, and looks proud of herself. |[pc.isNaga |It takes her a moment to figure out how your legless lower body will affect your stance, but she finds a way to make it work, and looks proud of herself. ] ] ]Once you’re set, she explains the key parts of the guard. “Head down, shoulders up, good,” she says, stepping around you and nudging your arms into place. “Make sure you can see over your gloves, you’re not gonna do a damn thing if you can’t see past your own hands.” She grins, then steps up in front of you. “Now focus on me,” Tara says.[taraChest | | The way her tits are sticking out in front of her, it’s hard to focus on anything else. | The way her enormous rack is swaying right in front of you, it’s hard to focus on anything else. ] “[firstCheck |Think about putting as much power behind your punches as you can. |Think about putting some real speed into your strikes. |Think about making your fists land exactly where you want them. |Think about getting your technique exactly right, and all of this will work better. |Think about being able to stay in the fight as long as you need to. ]” You focus like Tara told you to, and she walks around you and adjusts your stance again, then nods. “Not bad, not bad. Now, I want you to swap in and out of that stance a bunch, get you used to dropping into it.” 6y [flags.TARA_TRAINING |You’ve been through this before, but it helps to get a refresher, and you can feel the exercise working for you already. |You can tell it could change how you fight, and you can feel yourself slowly getting better at it as you go. ] “Nice,” Tara says, and steps up in front of you again. “Now, we’re gonna work on your guard. Keep your arms up, but loose, so you’re ready to block what’s coming in, no matter who or where it’s coming from.” She snickers as New Texan sex humor strikes again, but gets serious real quick as she raises her gloved hands. You keep your arms up, and Tara starts throwing some slow, light punches at you. With your combat experience, it’s no trouble to keep her from hitting you, and she calls out corrections and suggestions the whole time. After a few rounds of half a dozen jabs, you feel like you can do that a little bit better. It might not help in a fight for your life, but having the fundamentals down will keep you safer no matter what. “Okay.” Tara steps back, and wipes sweat from her forehead. “Now, let’s work on some punching.” Tara guides you back into position, and checks your stance, nodding as she walks a circle around you. “So, basic punching rules are don’t tense up, exhale as you throw a punch, and tighten yourself up on impact.” She comes to stand in front of you again, and tilts her head a little as she looks at you. “I know that’s a lot to think about when it’s just hitting someone, but trust me, it’ll help. And once you get it down, you’ll see a difference.” She moves in to stand next to you, and walks you through the process of a basic jab, showing you how she starts off relaxed but tenses herself right before the moment of impact, to get more power into the punch. [taraChest | |It’s impossible not to notice how much her chest shakes as she punches, but you do your best to pay attention to the lesson. |It’s kind of amazing that she can keep up her technique with so much boob sticking out in front of her, but she did say she’d had to adapt to work with her new tits. ]Once she’s demonstrated it enough for you to understand, she turns to face you again. “Okay, let’s go through the basic jab,” she says. “This is the heart of boxing, so getting it right is where everything else starts. Try to focus on [secondCheck |getting some real power into it |the motion of tensing and relasing |putting your fist exactly where you want it |getting the technique right |making all the steps work together ], and let’s see how you do.” You check your stance to make sure it’s right, then focus and throw a few jabs, just like Tara said. She walks around you as you punch, checking your technique, making a few adjustments as she goes. Like she said, you focus on [secondCheck |putting as much strength behind your strikes as you can |the quick tensing at the end of the punch, followed by relaxing after impact |making sure you strike right where you intend to |the methods behind everything she’s teaching you |putting together everything she’s taught you ]. There’s something about focusing just on a simple punch that feels real good, even if it’s very different from what you usually use in a fight. Tara keeps on checking your technique, then nods, an approving smile on her face. “Looks good, Steele. I know this seems like super basic shit, but trust me, everything about boxing starts with getting good at jabs. Most every combo you could think of starts with a jab, and if you know how to throw that quick, reliable punch, you can use it for most anything in the ring.” She shrugs one shoulder, and puts a hand on her hip. “I know everyone’s big on the flashier stuff, uppercuts and hooks and whatever, but it’s the jab that makes a good boxer.” You can see what she means. Even though [pc.cl mercenary |you’ve learned hand-to-hand combat |it’s not something you’ve learned much ] before coming here, you can tell how helpful landing a simple good punch would be in a fight. “Damn right,” Tara says. “Now let’s get to some footwork. If you can’t move in the ring, you’re gonna get stomped on, and I’m not letting that happen to anyone I’ve trained.” Tara walks you through some basic footwork instructions, [pc.isTaur |though she has to take a moment to figure out how to adapt them for your four feet |[pc.isNaga |though she seems confused at first about how she’s supposed to teach you to step when you don’t have any legs |[pc.isGoo |though she seems confused at first about how she’s supposed to teach you to step when you don’t have any legs |adjusting your [pc.legs] as she gets you into the right position ] ] ]. Most of it is about a few basic steps, keeping your weight grounded and making sure you don’t cross your feet when you’re in the ring. [pc.isNaga |Not that you have to worry about that. |[pc.isGoo |Not that you have to worry about that. ] ] “Step and drag, step and drag,” Tara says, working her way across the ring a step ahead of you so you can see her feet. “Don’t get flashy with me, or start jumping around – that’s bullshit from movies or whatever else. Last thing you want to do is launch yourself into the air where you can’t change which way you’re going.” She walks you through a pivot step, and after you’ve circled around the ring a few times, she wipes sweat from her face and gives you a considering look. “Okay, Steele, let’s put this all together.” Tara runs you through a drill of everything she’s taught you, calling out punches and steps and guards one after another, making sure you can do everything the two of you have gone over. [secondCheck |You make sure to put plenty of power behind your punches, just like she said. |You focus on the quick tense-and-relax she taught you for punching, and make sure your footwork goes just like she said. |You focus on making sure every jab you throw goes right where you want it to, striking out quick at an imaginary opponent. |You focus on perfect execution of the techniques she’s taught you, weaving them all together for an impressive result. |You focus on your breathing as she calls out, keeping your body moving and making sure you don’t run out of energy before you’re done. ] Finally, Tara claps her gloved hands together, then steps in and gives you a gentle punch on one shoulder. “Nice work! You catch onto this stuff pretty damn quick.” [pc.nmh |It’s not too different from some of the fighting you’ve had to do before, but having a good teacher helps. |Yeah, you’re the best. Pretty soon you’ll be able to take her out, yeah? Maybe? Maybe not. |It’s a damn rough galaxy out there, and you’ve had to keep yourself safe no matter what, so of course you’re good at fighting. ] Tara nods, grinning, then steps out of the ring and grabs two towels. She throws you one, and says, “I dunno if you’re ready for more advanced stuff, but we can work that out another time. You let me know if you want to go for another session, yeah?” You towel yourself off, taking off the worst of the sweat. As for another training session, you’ll definitely let her know when you’re ready for that. "

rows.original: You ask Tara if she’s up to talk about herself, and she gives you a surprisingly stern look, like you said something wrong. “My master always said you don’t really know someone until you fight them, so what, are you saying you don’t know me?” She keeps up the grim look for a second or two, then gives you a friendly punch on the shoulder and grins. “I’m just fucking with you, Steele. I don’t have a master, I had a trainer, and I maybe watched way too many old movies with people fighting each other.” Is that what got her into boxing? She might be the first New Texan you’ve met who wanted to fight instead of fucking. “Okay, first off, the fighting before fucking rule is because I work here,” Tara says, gesturing at the gym. “Wasn’t for that, I’d be down for just about anything. Second, [pc.isTreated |I get that you’re kind of going native or whatever, but ]you didn’t grow up here. There’s a shitload more of NT that you tourists never see.” She blows her bangs out of her eyes, and leans back on the boxing ring’s ropes. “I’m from one of the biggest cities here,” she says, looking off toward the room’s high windows. “I know it’s not shit compared to the core worlds, but it’s big for us. The place isn’t where people landed here first, but it got big for... I dunno, whatever reasons. Haven’t studied history since I was a kid and I forgot most of it.” She shrugs. “Not like I need it now, y’know?” Maybe not. But you haven’t heard much about any cities on New Texas. You’ve heard it’s mostly pastoral, and most people from offworld never see much beyond the spaceport and resort here. “I’d say you’re not missing much, but nah, home’s a good place,” Tara says. “I’ve seen vids of a bunch of other cities, on different worlds and all that, and they just feel kind of lifeless compared to where I grew up. You look around and see nothing but buildings, shit like that. We like things green and growing here.” Tara pauses, and glances down at her chest. [taraChest |There’s not much to see there, and you get the feeling that she’s not happy about it, if the frown that twists her lips is any sign. |Her lips curl up in a smirk, and she slaps a hand on one of her boobs, clearly happy with their growth. |A grin spreads across her face as she stares at her massive tits, and it’s clear she’s thrilled with how big they’ve grown. ] She looks back at you, then shrugs again. “So, yeah, I’m a city girl that ended up out here. But a job’s a job, and I don’t miss it too much, and I get home when I can. It’s been more interesting out here than I thought, though.” She gestures toward the windows, toward the resort town and spaceport outside. “I’ve seen more different kinds of people since I moved here than I ever saw back home.” She pauses. “I figured you’re on the Planet Rush, yeah? You must have seen some crazy shit.” [probesFound |You are, and you’ve been on the Rush a long time and seen some absolutely crazy stuff. |You are, and while you’ve got a few worlds under your belt, you’ve still got plenty to see ahead of you. |You are, but you’re just getting started. You’ve still got a lot of worlds to see and a long way to go. ]- Tara’s eyes widen as you tell her a few stories about your journeys, and she pushes herself off the ropes and rocks from foot to foot, grinning at your tales. “See, that’s so cool,” Tara says, and shakes her shoulders up and down as she moves[taraChest | | making her boobs bounce and making you wonder how long that sports bra can hold them in place | making her boobs bounce and making you wonder how long that sports bra can hold them in place ]. “I’ve got no idea if I could handle the Rush, but it sounds like a hell of a time. What’s the strangest piece of ass you’ve gotten so far?” [pcIsVirgin |You tell her that you haven’t gotten laid on your journey, or really, at all. Tara stops moving and just stares at you, her head tilted to one side, her mouth hanging open. “What the fuck? Seriously?” It’s hard to say the last time you saw someone look so bewildered. “I don’t get you, Steele. Whole damn galaxy out there to fuck your way through, and you’re not getting any. You make me want to join the Rush just so I can fuck the aliens.” She shakes her head. “Shit, I’m surprised you even walked through the gym without getting laid. Off-worlders, I swear.” |You tell her about some of the places you’ve seen, on some of the new people you’ve met, and some of how it was, because you’ve definitely found some entirely new kinds of people to fuck. She grins at your tales, and gives you another friendly punch, on the arm this time. “Good to know you’re getting laid out there, Steele. Can’t go out and explore the galaxy if you’re not gonna fuck the aliens, yeah? It’s a rough job, but someone’s gotta do it.” ] Tara steps into the middle of the ring and throws a few quick jabs at the air, like she’s stood still for too long and now she has to move. Then, she pulls one arm over her head and starts to stretch, exposing some of the untanned skin beneath her sports bra. “But yeah, I’ve heard stories about what’s out there, seen some vids and watched some new porn, all of that,” she says. “When I was a kid, I thought about getting out there and hitting up some new planets, or doing something that’d get me off NT for a while.” Lots of people think about that, but not everyone gets to do it. What kept her from finding her way off-world? “Mostly money.” Tara snorts. “My parents do fine, but they’re not rich, and it’s not like I was gonna join a merc company or sell my ass to some sex corp just to get off world,” she says. Tara glances down at her chest again [taraChest |, and mutters, “They’d have to want my ass, cause they’re damn sure not getting anything else.” | and smirks. “I’d do better with a sex corp now, so thanks, but it’s still not something I’m gonna do.” | and smirks. “I’d do better with a sex corp now, so thanks, but it’s still not something I’m gonna do.” ] Working at a local gym’s probably a lot friendlier than working for any corp, even a sexy one. At least here, she’s around people she knows and doesn’t have to worry about losing her job because someone who doesn’t even know she works there fired her to cut costs. Tara chuckles. “Sounds like you know what you’re talking about,” she says. “But yeah, corpo bullshit, I know the deal. Anyway, back when I was a kid, I liked the idea of heading out and seeing the worlds, but now it feels like just one of those old dreams, like the time I wanted to be a zookeeper. Besides, after I got Treated, it was kind of like, why? I like things here, and I’ve got stuff I want to do. The whole thing looks very sturdy, like it’s made to handle people with the heavy muscle growth that sometimes comes with the Treatment. A rack of boxing gloves is attached to one wall, with various sizes of gloves lined up on it, along with a stand below it that holds towels and spray cleaner. One corner holds several punching bags of different sizes, all with the Ten Ton Gym’s logo on them, hanging from the ceiling on heavy chains. The wall opposite the door is mirrored, making the room look larger than it is, and windows up high on the walls let in light from outside. There’s a lone cowgirl at one of the punching bags, gloved hands held up in front of herself, jabbing at the bag with thin, toned arms. She has short black hair and horns to match, and her ears and tail are a classic mix of black and white. She’s clad in a white sports bra and black shorts, like she’s trying to match her own colors, but she’s also got the kind of tan that comes from spending a lot of time outside. Her arms, legs, and back look fit and toned, so it’s clear she’s no stranger to[silly | love, or ] this kind of exercise. The cowgirl strikes the punching bag a few more times, then turns around and wipes the sweat from her face. Now that she’s facing you, you can see she’s an utter rarity among the New Texas locals – she’s almost completely flat. Her boobs are barely palm-sized, like the Treatment skipped her chest entirely. She flicks her sweaty bangs out of her dark brown eyes, and looks at you, like she’s just realized you’re there. “Oh, hey,” the cowgirl says, her voice utterly casual. “Thought I saw someone come in.” She gives you a grin, and it’s easy and friendly, though there’s a fierce glint in her eyes. “Name’s Tara. I’m the boxing instructor here, just got hired.” You introduce yourself, and tell her you’re [var0 |a regular here |just checking out the gym for the day ]. “Good to meet you,” Tara says. “You here to box? Because I’m here to box. Or to teach you, if you don’t box. Either way, we box.” She cackles, then gives you a quick look up and down. It’s hard to tell if she likes what she sees or if she just wants to fight you. “You look like you can handle yourself, but trust me, I’ve dropped plenty of people who thought they knew what they were doing.” [pc.cl mercenary |It’s been a while since you did hand-to-hand regularly, since most of what you deal with is too dangerous to just punch it and hope for the best. |Combat training wasn’t necessarily part of what you trained for, though you’ve had more than your share of scraps. ] But you can hold your own in a fight, no problem. “Oh, really?” Tara jerks her head toward the ring. “Love to see if you can back that up, Steele. But I get it, not everyone’s here to punch people.” She holds up her hands, then slaps her gloves together. “You want to go a few rounds, we can do that. But I also do training, if you’re not ready for the ring.”

rows.original: “So what kind of fighting do you do?” you ask her. Wanting to get to know her livelihood better. “Mixed martial arts, with Terran rules to be specific. Terra isn’t the only place in the galaxy where we beat each other up for fun, and the rules vary by planet. Kui-tans, for example, don’t allow any attacks to the legs since they have those giant balls of theirs to worry about. Or Galotians; they have an entirely different world of combat sports. They’re actually not even allowed to attend most circuits since they’re amorphous. But most species are allowed to participate in the Terran circuits, and they also bring their own style of fighting with them. That’s what I love about it, seeing how a kaithrit differs in their style from a thraggen, or how someone short takes on someone almost three times their size.” She lets out an excited exhale, her arms quivering and lips pulled into a wide grin. “Just thinking about it is getting my heart going. I remember seeing this one match of a 5' 6" kaithrit girl going against a big mountain of muscle thraggen. He must have been like seven feet tall, but she was quick and wiry. As soon as the match started, she dove for his legs and tripped him up, making him land face-first into the arena. Before he could recover, she got him in a submission hold, and he tapped out. It was one of the most amazing matches I’ve seen, even if it was over before it started. It was a beautiful example of when skill beats size.” “Any other memorable matches you could enlighten me with,” you ask, fondly listening to her describe something she’s so passionate about. “Ooh, absolutely. One time there was a fight between two thraggen. Both of them were big and strong. But once the fight started, neither of the two threw even a single punch or kick. I’ve seen thraggen fight before, and the thraggen style is to focus on waiting for an opening to deliver a single, powerful blow, which makes perfect sense since they’re so strong. Instead of fighting like that, they both decided to just grapple each other and try to take down their opponent with pure strength. It was impressive; both of them were strong enough to take down five trained fighters at the same time. But they both were the worst opponent for their one style.” “Sounds like the opposite of the match with the small kaithrit girl,” you muse. “All power, no skill.” “It’d be a disservice to them if I were to say they had no skill. It takes a good deal of know-how to fight like that, how to put the pressure on your opponent’s body correctly, and how to protect yourself from retaliation while you’re holding onto them.” She pauses and takes a swig of water before continuing. “But it certainly was a feat of strength, first and foremost.” She’s quiet for a moment as she rubs her chin. “There was one fight; it was quite controversial in the end. It was between a kui-tan and a gryvain. At first, it seemed like it’d be an even match, but the gryvain had learned how to use her wings in a fight. She didn’t use them to strike, since they’re incapable of doing that particularly well, but she obscured herself behind them.” “Did she win?” you ask, wondering if it is against the rules. “She did, which is why it was so controversial. The judges ended up deciding that if the kui-tan had a problem with it, the gryvain would be disqualified, but surprisingly she was alright with it. She said that if she wasn’t good enough to overcome the handicap, she didn’t deserve to win. Didn’t stop people from complaining, though. Some of them were probably fans of her, while others thought it went against the spirit of the rules. And I’m sure there were a few that had put money down on her.” “But that’s enough of me raving about other fighters,” she finishes, rolling her head around to limber up her neck. “Did you have anything else to ask?” she asks you.

But most species are allowed to participate in the Terran circuits, and they also bring their own style of fighting with them. I remember seeing this one match of a 5\' 6\" kaithrit girl going against a big mountain of muscle thraggen. He must have been like seven feet tall, but she was quick and wiry. As soon as the match started, she dove for his legs and tripped him up, making him land face-first into the arena. Before he could recover, she got him in a submission hold, and he tapped out. It was a beautiful example of when skill beats size.” “Any other memorable matches you could enlighten me with,” you ask, fondly listening to her describe something she’s so passionate about. “Ooh, absolutely. One time there was a fight between two thraggen. Both of them were big and strong. But once the fight started, neither of the two threw even a single punch or kick. rows.translation: 强壮公牛们在两场锻炼之间互相碰拳，其中一头还拍了一下路过牛仔女郎摇晃的屁股。她尖叫着转过身，双手用力抓住他的屁股，令他惊讶得跳起并低哼。
rows.raw: "\n\nBuff bulls fist-bump each other on their way between workouts, and one gives a passing cowgirl a smack on her jiggling rear. She squeals, then spins around and grabs his ass hard with both hands, making him jump and grunt in surprise."

rows.original: A couple makes out in one corner. She’s pressed against the wall while he holds her up by gripping her ass, and her legs are wrapped around him. This being New Texas, the locals offer encouragement and grope one or both of the lovers as they pass by.
rows.translation: 一对情侣在角落里热吻。她被压在墙上，他抓住她的屁股将其托起，而她的双腿则环着他。这里毕竟是新德克萨斯；当地人路过时会出言鼓励，并揉摸其中一人或两人。
rows.raw: "\n\nA couple makes out in one corner. She’s pressed against the wall while he holds her up by gripping her ass, and her legs are wrapped around him. This being New Texas, the locals offer encouragement and grope one or both of the lovers as they pass by."

rows.original: A group of bulls heads from the pool to the showers, naked and dripping, horsecocks swinging freely. One snaps a towel at another’s ass and gets a punch to the shoulder for it.
rows.translation: 一群公牛从泳池走向淋浴间，全身赤裸、滴着水，马鸡巴自由摇摆。其中一头用毛巾抽打另一头的屁股，结果肩膀挨了一拳。
rows.raw: "\n\nA group of bulls heads from the pool to the showers, naked and dripping, horsecocks swinging freely. One snaps a towel at another’s ass and gets a punch to the shoulder for it."

rows.original: A group of cows jogs from the track to the showers, boobs and butts bouncing along the whole way. Their bubbly laughter and chatter echoes through the hall.
rows.translation: 一群母牛从跑道慢跑到淋浴间，奶子与屁股一路弹动。她们活泼的笑声与闲聊在走廊里回荡。
rows.raw: "\n\nA group of cows jogs from the track to the showers, boobs and butts bouncing along the whole way. Their bubbly laughter and chatter echoes through the hall."

rows.original: Two bulls in nothing but workout pants head down the hall, arms around each others’ shoulders, both bragging they can lift more than the other. From their conversation, the prize in this competition seems to be a blowjob from the loser.
rows.translation: 两头只穿运动裤的公牛勾肩搭背地沿走廊前行，都吹嘘自己比对方举得更重。从交谈来看，这场比赛的奖品似乎是输家提供的一次口交。
rows.raw: "\n\nTwo bulls in nothing but workout pants head down the hall, arms around each others’ shoulders, both bragging they can lift more than the other. From their conversation, the prize in this competition seems to be a blowjob from the loser."

rows.original: A cowgirl jogs in from the track and meets another cow waiting by the door, fresh out of the pool. They share a quick kiss and head into the showers. As the door closes, you see one reach for the others’ breasts.
rows.translation: 一位牛仔女郎从跑道慢跑进来，与在门边等候、刚离开泳池的另一位母牛会合。她们迅速亲吻，随后走进淋浴间。门关上时，你看见其中一人伸手摸向另一人的乳房。
rows.raw: "\n\nA cowgirl jogs in from the track and meets another cow waiting by the door, fresh out of the pool. They share a quick kiss and head into the showers. As the door closes, you see one reach for the others’ breasts."

rows.original: Open doorways lead to the track and the swimming pool, while closed double doors at the hall’s end have a sign above them reading ‘Locker Room and Showers’.
rows.translation: 敞开的门通往跑道与泳池；走廊尽头的封闭双开门上方，则挂着“更衣室与淋浴间”的标志。
rows.raw: "\n\nOpen doorways lead to the track and the swimming pool, while closed double doors at the hall’s end have a sign above them reading ‘Locker Room and Showers’."

rows.original: Slab Bulkhead
rows.raw: "Slab Bulkhead"

rows.original: The sounds of grunts and clanking metal greet you as you walk into the weight room. Half the room is taken up with machines for working every possible muscle, all of them with stacks of heavy plates over a meter high, to account for the brute strength the Treatment bestows upon some of its users. The room’s other half is filled with various types of weight benches and racks of free weights, for those who want to pump iron without mechanical assistance. The gym’s front windows make up most of one wall, and the opposite wall is all mirrors.
rows.translation: 你走进举重室，迎面而来的是低吼与金属碰撞声。房间一半摆满锻炼各种肌肉的器械，每台都配有超过一米高的沉重配重片，以适应改造赋予某些使用者的蛮力。另一半则摆放各种举重凳与自由重量架，供那些不借助机械便想举铁的人使用。健身房前窗占据一整面墙的大部分，而对面则完全由镜子构成。
rows.raw: "The sounds of grunts and clanking metal greet you as you walk into the weight room. Half the room is taken up with machines for working every possible muscle, all of them with stacks of heavy plates over a meter high, to account for the brute strength the Treatment bestows upon some of its users. The room’s other half is filled with various types of weight benches and racks of free weights, for those who want to pump iron without mechanical assistance. The gym’s front windows make up most of one wall, and the opposite wall is all mirrors."

rows.original: Most of the room’s occupants are bulls, focusing largely on their chests and arms, with a few of them pressing hard on the leg machines. A few cows are scattered around the room, working on their arms and legs or doing ab exercises on mats. Bulls and cows both ogle and catcall each other as they work, often stopping in the middle of a set to do so. A dark-skinned cowgirl is lifting heavier weights on a machine, and offers a challenging smirk to anyone who approaches her.
rows.translation: 房间里大多是公牛，主要锻炼胸膛与手臂，其中几头正用力蹬腿部器械。少数母牛散落各处，锻炼手臂、双腿，或在垫子上练习腹肌。公牛与母牛锻炼时都互相色眯眯打量、吹口哨，经常做到一半便停下来如此调情。一位深色皮肤牛仔女郎正在器械上举起更重的配重，对每个接近她的人露出挑衅坏笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nMost of the room’s occupants are bulls, focusing largely on their chests and arms, with a few of them pressing hard on the leg machines. A few cows are scattered around the room, working on their arms and legs or doing ab exercises on mats. Bulls and cows both ogle and catcall each other as they work, often stopping in the middle of a set to do so. A dark-skinned cowgirl is lifting heavier weights on a machine, and offers a challenging smirk to anyone who approaches her."

rows.original: You see another familiar face, Busky, hidden under a bench press. Whenever he takes a break, he stares dreamily at the bulging crotches of other bulls. He seems to be in the middle of an extensive workout, lifting around 300 imperial pounds. It’s a rather low amount compared to the other bulls lifting twice, some thrice that much weight. However his endurance is astonishing, doing longer reps than any other bull. Compensating for weight, he’s doing a much harder workout, and his body is showing it. His heaving chest is sweating profusely, being soaked up by his sodden undershirt and gym shorts.
rows.translation: 你又看见一张熟悉面孔：巴斯基，他正藏在卧推凳下。每逢休息，他都会痴迷地盯着其他公牛隆起的胯间。他似乎正在进行漫长锻炼，举起约三百英制磅；与其他公牛动辄举起两倍甚至三倍相比，这相当轻。不过，他的耐力惊人，重复次数比任何公牛都多。他用更加艰苦的训练弥补重量，身体也清楚展示成果。剧烈起伏的胸膛汗流不止，湿透背心和运动短裤。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou see another familiar face, Busky, hidden under a bench press. Whenever he takes a break, he stares dreamily at the bulging crotches of other bulls. He seems to be in the middle of an extensive workout, lifting around 300 imperial pounds. It’s a rather low amount compared to the other bulls lifting twice, some thrice that much weight. However his endurance is astonishing, doing longer reps than any other bull. Compensating for weight, he’s doing a much harder workout, and his body is showing it. His heaving chest is sweating profusely, being soaked up by his sodden undershirt and gym shorts."

rows.original: A doorway sits between two racks of free weights, labeled "Boxing Room". Through the door, you can see one side of a boxing ring, along with a punching bag hanging in one corner.
rows.translation: 两座自由重量架之间有一扇门，上面写着“拳击室”。透过门口，你能看见拳台的一侧，以及悬挂在角落里的沙袋。
rows.raw: 'A doorway sits between two racks of free weights, labeled "Boxing Room". Through the door, you can see one side of a boxing ring, along with a punching bag hanging in one corner.'

rows.original: A closed door sits between two racks of free weights, labeled “Boxing Room”. A sign on the door says: “Our trainer’s out for a few days. She’ll be back soon. Thanks for your patience. –Management”.
rows.translation: 两座自由重量架之间有一扇关闭的门，上面写着“拳击室”。门上的告示写道：“我们的教练要离开几天，很快回来。感谢您的耐心。–管理层”。
rows.raw: "A closed door sits between two racks of free weights, labeled “Boxing Room”. A sign on the door says: “Our trainer’s out for a few days. She’ll be back soon. Thanks for your patience. –Management”."

rows.translation: 你正准备在一位友善的当地保护者协助下，再稍微增加一点重量。
rows.raw: "You’re just about to try a little more with a friendly, local spotter."

rows.original: There’s something oddly relaxing about putting yourself through the simple motions, and the burn sets in after a while, leaving your muscles feeling tired and springy.
rows.translation: 单纯重复这些动作，竟有种奇妙的放松感。过了一会儿，灼热感逐渐出现，让肌肉疲惫而富有弹性。
rows.raw: "There’s something oddly relaxing about putting yourself through the simple motions, and the burn sets in after a while, leaving your muscles feeling tired and springy."

rows.original: You step away from the machines when done, wipe sweat from your forehead, and smile. Not a bad workout, but not too exhausting either. Let the bulls sweat and grunt until they can barely lift their arms; you’re just here to make sure you stay in good shape.
rows.translation: 结束后，你离开器械，擦去额头上的汗水，露出微笑。锻炼效果不错，却也没有过度消耗。让那些公牛流汗低吼，练到几乎抬不起手臂吧；你来这里只是为了确保自己保持良好体型。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou step away from the machines when done, wipe sweat from your forehead, and smile. Not a bad workout, but not too exhausting either. Let the bulls sweat and grunt until they can barely lift their arms; you’re just here to make sure you stay in good shape."

rows.original: Your muscles have become slightly more toned.
rows.translation: 你的肌肉线条略微变得更加清晰。

rows.original: Time to pump iron. You slam some weights on the bars and start hefting. The gym regulars clearly appreciate seeing you put in as much work as they do, and volunteer to spot you, so long as you can spot them in return.
rows.translation: 该举铁了。你把配重片猛装到横杆上，开始用力举起。健身房常客显然很欣赏你像他们一样投入，主动提出为你保护，只要你也愿意回报他们。

rows.original: One of the bulls starts lifting at the bar next to you, and an impromptu contest begins, both of you lifting heavier and heavier weights as the other does. You grit your teeth and push through it, determined to show the locals you’ve got what it takes.
rows.translation: 一头公牛在旁边的横杆开始举重，一场即兴比赛就此展开。你们看到对方增加重量，便也举起越来越重的配重。你咬紧牙关坚持，决心让当地人看看自己确实有真本事。
rows.raw: "\n\nOne of the bulls starts lifting at the bar next to you, and an impromptu contest begins, both of you lifting heavier and heavier weights as the other does. You grit your teeth and push through it, determined to show the locals you’ve got what it takes."

rows.original: The contest comes to an abrupt end when a cowgirl walks by and tickles the bull’s crotch, nearly making him drop the bar. He struggles to right his weight, and you do the same. It’s a strain to even sit up after that, but you nod to your worthy opponent, then head off to stretch out the soreness.
rows.translation: 一位牛仔女郎路过并挠了挠公牛的胯间，差点让他把横杆砸下来，比赛也戛然而止。他竭力稳住重量，你也同样如此。之后甚至连坐起都十分吃力，不过你仍朝这位值得尊敬的对手点头，随后离开，去伸展酸痛肌肉。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe contest comes to an abrupt end when a cowgirl walks by and tickles the bull’s crotch, nearly making him drop the bar. He struggles to right his weight, and you do the same. It’s a strain to even sit up after that, but you nod to your worthy opponent, then head off to stretch out the soreness."

rows.raw: "compete"

rows.original: You tell Simone you’ll take her on, and lie down on the other chest press machine. You set the stack to four weights, as per her instructions, then take hold of the bar. She says, “Ready? Go!” and you start lifting.
rows.translation: 你告诉西蒙娜，自己接受挑战，随后躺到另一台卧推器械上。你按照她的指示，将配重设为四片，再握住横杆。她说道：“准备好了吗？开始！”于是你开始举起。
rows.raw: "You tell Simone you’ll take her on, and lie down on the other chest press machine. You set the stack to four weights, as per her instructions, then take hold of the bar. She says, “Ready? Go!” and you start lifting."

rows.original: You push your way through your first set, then add more weight and start your second, lifting slow and steady. Simone matches your pace, clearly handling this without a problem. It doesn’t start to get difficult until you add the sixth weight, but you keep going.
rows.translation: 你坚持完成第一组，随后增加重量，开始第二组，以缓慢稳定的节奏举起。西蒙娜与你保持相同速度，显然应付得毫无问题。直到增加第六片配重，动作才开始变得困难，但你仍继续坚持。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou push your way through your first set, then add more weight and start your second, lifting slow and steady. Simone matches your pace, clearly handling this without a problem. It doesn’t start to get difficult until you add the sixth weight, but you keep going."

rows.original: By the time you get to the ninth weight, you and Simone have both slowed down a little, but she shows no signs of stopping. You take a deep breath and move up to the tenth weight. One... two... three... four... five. There’s an aching in your chest now, but you force yourself to keep lifting.
rows.translation: 增加到第九片配重时，你和西蒙娜都稍稍放慢，却没有任何停下迹象。你深吸一口气，增加到第十片。一...二...三...四...五。胸膛已经开始酸痛，但你强迫自己继续举起。
rows.raw: "\n\nBy the time you get to the ninth weight, you and Simone have both slowed down a little, but she shows no signs of stopping. You take a deep breath and move up to the tenth weight. One... two... three... four... five. There’s an aching in your chest now, but you force yourself to keep lifting."

rows.original: The movements become mechanical: lift five, add weight, lift five more, add weight. You plow through the eleventh stack with only a little trouble, and a quick glance over at Simone shows that she’s starting to struggle. You both add the twelfth weight at the same time, and she pauses to take a deep breath.
rows.translation: 动作变得机械：举五次、加重量，再举五次、再加重量。你只遇到一点困难便完成第十一组，迅速瞥向西蒙娜，发现她已经开始吃力。你们同时加上第十二片配重，而她停下来深吸一口气。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe movements become mechanical: lift five, add weight, lift five more, add weight. You plow through the eleventh stack with only a little trouble, and a quick glance over at Simone shows that she’s starting to struggle. You both add the twelfth weight at the same time, and she pauses to take a deep breath."

rows.original: You shove the bar up with a grunt, pushing through your set, then lower the weights and add another to the stack. A loud slam comes from Simone’s machine, and you look over to see her laying there, arms dangling off both sides of the bench, her heavy tits trying to flop to either side as her sports bra strains to hold them in place. She looks at you, and you push the bar up once, twice, three times, so she knows that you won.
rows.translation: 你低哼着把横杆推起，坚持完成这一组，随后放下重量，再向配重堆增加一片。西蒙娜的器械传来响亮撞击；你望过去，看见她躺在那里，双臂垂在卧推凳两侧，沉重奶子试图向两边摊开，运动胸罩则竭力将其固定。她看向你，而你把横杆推起一次、两次、三次，让她明白自己输了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shove the bar up with a grunt, pushing through your set, then lower the weights and add another to the stack. A loud slam comes from Simone’s machine, and you look over to see her laying there, arms dangling off both sides of the bench, her heavy tits trying to flop to either side as her sports bra strains to hold them in place. She looks at you, and you push the bar up once, twice, three times, so she knows that you won."

rows.original: Victory is yours, and you let the bar drop.
rows.translation: 胜利属于你；你让横杆落下。
rows.raw: "\n\nVictory is yours, and you let the bar drop."

rows.original: Simone rises and walks over to you, her arms hanging limp at her sides. “Damn, [pc.name],” she says. “I didn’t think you had it in you.”
rows.translation: 西蒙娜站起身走向你，双臂无力垂在身体两侧。“妈的，[pc.name]，”她说道。“没想到你真有这个本事。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSimone rises and walks over to you, her arms hanging limp at her sides. “Damn, [pc.name],” she says. “I didn’t think you had it in you.”"

rows.original: You sit up and flex your arms and chest, trying not to show any strain from the workout. It looks like you win, you tell her, and she laughs.
rows.translation: 你坐起身，绷紧手臂与胸膛，努力不显露锻炼造成的疲惫。看来是你赢了，你如此告诉她，而她则笑了起来。

rows.original: You hit the track at a moderate pace, working your way up to a swift walk, then a gentle jog. After about half a lap, you catch up with the group of cows, and fall in with them. It seems like they’re here to chat just as much as they’re here to work out, and most of the conversation revolves around the local bulls and who’s best in the sack, though there’s mention of some curious people working at the nearby barn.
rows.translation: 你以适中的速度踏上跑道，逐渐加速，从快走转为轻松慢跑。大约跑过半圈后，你追上了那群母牛，加入她们的队伍。看来她们来这里聊天的兴致并不亚于锻炼，谈话大多围绕着当地的公牛，以及谁在床上表现最好，不过她们也提到了附近谷仓里几个行事古怪的人。
rows.raw: "You hit the track at a moderate pace, working your way up to a swift walk, then a gentle jog. After about half a lap, you catch up with the group of cows, and fall in with them. It seems like they’re here to chat just as much as they’re here to work out, and most of the conversation revolves around the local bulls and who’s best in the sack, though there’s mention of some curious people working at the nearby barn."

rows.original: You do a few more laps with the locals, then excuse yourself, slowing to a walk and heading off the track. It’s an easy workout, but it leaves you with a healthy glow and a light sweat once you’re done.
rows.translation: 你又和当地人跑了几圈，然后告辞离开，放慢脚步改为步行，走出跑道。这次锻炼并不费力，但结束时仍让你容光焕发、微微出汗。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou do a few more laps with the locals, then excuse yourself, slowing to a walk and heading off the track. It’s an easy workout, but it leaves you with a healthy glow and a light sweat once you’re done."

rows.original: You feel slightly trimmer after your workout.
rows.translation: 锻炼过后，你觉得身材略微精瘦了一些。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou feel slightly trimmer after your workout."

rows.original: Time to move, and there’s no better place for it. You hit the track and run a quick warmup lap, then decide it’s time to push yourself. The sound of chanting comes from behind you, and you glance back to see the group of young bulls running in cadence.
rows.translation: 该活动起来了，而这里正是最合适的地方。你踏上跑道，快速跑完一圈热身，随后决定逼自己一把。身后传来整齐的口号声，你回头一看，只见那群年轻公牛正踩着节奏跑来。
rows.raw: "Time to move, and there’s no better place for it. You hit the track and run a quick warmup lap, then decide it’s time to push yourself. The sound of chanting comes from behind you, and you glance back to see the group of young bulls running in cadence."

rows.original: You move over to the side to let them pass, then speed up to match their pace, running in time along with them. A few of them grunt a greeting, but every one of them is breathing hard, sweat flowing freely down their chests. They set a grueling pace, but you match it and keep up with them for at least a few miles.
rows.translation: 你移到一旁让他们先过，随后加速跟上他们的步伐，与他们保持同样的节奏奔跑。几个人哼声向你打了招呼，但所有人都在大口喘气，汗水肆意流过胸膛。他们的速度极其折磨人，但你仍与他们保持一致，跟着跑了至少几英里。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou move over to the side to let them pass, then speed up to match their pace, running in time along with them. A few of them grunt a greeting, but every one of them is breathing hard, sweat flowing freely down their chests. They set a grueling pace, but you match it and keep up with them for at least a few miles."

rows.original: Soon, you’re dripping sweat and have to cool off. One of the bulls razzes you about not being able to keep up, but running with them until you collapse doesn’t sound like the best idea. You head off the track, then grab a gym towel and wipe yourself off.
rows.translation: 没过多久，你已经汗流浃背，不得不放慢速度冷却身体。一头公牛嘲笑你跟不上他们，但陪他们跑到自己累垮听起来可不是什么好主意。你离开跑道，拿起一条健身房毛巾擦干身体。
rows.raw: "\n\nSoon, you’re dripping sweat and have to cool off. One of the bulls razzes you about not being able to keep up, but running with them until you collapse doesn’t sound like the best idea. You head off the track, then grab a gym towel and wipe yourself off."

rows.original: You feel like you’ve shed a few pounds from that workout.
rows.translation: 这次锻炼让你觉得自己减掉了几磅。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou feel like you’ve shed a few pounds from that workout."

rows.original: A quick word buys you enough freedom to take a hasty rinse and the showers and the opportunity to don your gear once more before being ousted from the gym.
rows.translation: 你匆忙解释几句，争取到足够时间快速冲洗一番，并在被赶出健身房前重新穿好装备。
rows.raw: "\n\nA quick word buys you enough freedom to take a hasty rinse and the showers and the opportunity to don your gear once more before being ousted from the gym."

rows.original: Tile covers the floor in this long room, and the whole place has a pleasant yet unfamiliar smell. A pool stretches nearly the entire length of the room, with black lines crossing its floor to designate swimming lanes. A sloping ramp leads down into the shallow end.
rows.translation: 这间狭长房间铺着瓷砖，整片区域弥漫着宜人却陌生的气味。一座泳池几乎贯穿房间全长，池底有几道黑线划分泳道。一条倾斜坡道通向浅水区。
rows.raw: "Tile covers the floor in this long room, and the whole place has a pleasant yet unfamiliar smell. A pool stretches nearly the entire length of the room, with black lines crossing its floor to designate swimming lanes. A sloping ramp leads down into the shallow end."

rows.original: This place seems more popular with the local cows than the other rooms, as there are groups of them swimming together. Many are clad in holstein-print swimsuits, while others – cow and bull alike – go naked. One naked cowgirl floats on her back, pink nipples pointing toward the ceiling, pushing herself along in a lazy backstroke.
rows.translation: 这里似乎比其他房间更受当地母牛欢迎，成群结队的母牛正一起游泳。许多母牛穿着荷斯坦奶牛花纹的泳衣，而其他人 – 无论母牛还是公牛 – 都一丝不挂。一名裸体牛女仰面漂浮，粉色乳头朝向天花板，悠闲地仰泳前进。
rows.raw: "\n\nThis place seems more popular with the local cows than the other rooms, as there are groups of them swimming together. Many are clad in holstein-print swimsuits, while others – cow and bull alike – go naked. One naked cowgirl floats on her back, pink nipples pointing toward the ceiling, pushing herself along in a lazy backstroke."

rows.original: You wonder why it doesn’t smell like chlorine; surely they can’t go without something to keep the pool clean, with this many people in it. You dip two fingers into the pool water to test it, and find it smooth, almost slippery, the sign of a synthetic decontaminant. That explains the unfamiliar smell, and it’s probably a safer choice here, as you’re sure more than a few people have had sex in this pool.
rows.translation: 你很疑惑这里为何没有氯气味；这么多人泡在池里，他们肯定不能完全不使用保持泳池洁净的东西。你把两根手指浸入池水试了试，发现水质顺滑，近乎滑腻，这是使用合成净化剂的迹象。这解释了那股陌生气味，而且在这里或许也是更安全的选择，毕竟你敢肯定有不少人曾在这座泳池里做过爱。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wonder why it doesn’t smell like chlorine; surely they can’t go without something to keep the pool clean, with this many people in it. You dip two fingers into the pool water to test it, and find it smooth, almost slippery, the sign of a synthetic decontaminant. That explains the unfamiliar smell, and it’s probably a safer choice here, as you’re sure more than a few people have had sex in this pool."

rows.original: A bubbling spa sits in one corner, big enough to hold fifteen to twenty people. It looks to be very popular; about a dozen cows and bulls sit in it, some on each others’ laps. You’re not sure if the motion in the water is entirely from the jets, or if there’s something going on beneath the bubbles. Probably both.
rows.translation: 角落里有一座冒着气泡的水疗池，足以容纳十五到二十人。那里似乎非常受欢迎；大约十几头公牛和母牛正泡在其中，有些还坐在彼此腿上。你无法确定水中的动静是否全都来自喷嘴，抑或气泡下还发生着什么。多半两者皆有。
rows.raw: "\n\nA bubbling spa sits in one corner, big enough to hold fifteen to twenty people. It looks to be very popular; about a dozen cows and bulls sit in it, some on each others’ laps. You’re not sure if the motion in the water is entirely from the jets, or if there’s something going on beneath the bubbles. Probably both."

rows.original: You step into the pool, taking a few minutes to get used to the water. The unusual smoothness feels good against your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun], almost sensual. The temperature is pretty much perfect, a little bit cold but nothing you can’t handle.
rows.translation: 你走进泳池，花了几分钟适应水温。那种不同寻常的顺滑感擦过你的[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]，感觉很舒服，几乎称得上色情。水温几乎完美，略微偏凉，却不至于让你承受不住。
rows.raw: "You step into the pool, taking a few minutes to get used to the water. The unusual smoothness feels good against your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun], almost sensual. The temperature is pretty much perfect, a little bit cold but nothing you can’t handle."

rows.original: Once the water’s past your waist, you plunge in and swim a few laps. It’s amazingly refreshing, and you turn on your back and float, letting your worries wash away with the water.
rows.translation: 水位没过腰部后，你一头扎进去游了几圈。感觉无比清爽，于是你翻身仰面漂浮，让烦恼随水流逝。
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce the water’s past your waist, you plunge in and swim a few laps. It’s amazingly refreshing, and you turn on your back and float, letting your worries wash away with the water."

rows.original: After a few moments, you remind yourself that you’re here to work out, not drift away, and you push yourself a little through a few more laps. It’s a good workout, and leaves you feeling tired but energized.
rows.translation: 片刻后，你提醒自己是来锻炼的，不是来随波漂流的，于是逼自己又多游了几圈。这是一次不错的锻炼，结束后你虽感疲倦，却也精力充沛。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a few moments, you remind yourself that you’re here to work out, not drift away, and you push yourself a little through a few more laps. It’s a good workout, and leaves you feeling tired but energized."

rows.original: You feel a little stronger and fitter after your swim.
rows.translation: 游完泳后，你觉得自己更强壮、更健美了一些。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou feel a little stronger and fitter after your swim."

rows.original: You plunge into the cool water headfirst, coming up with a spurting breath. You head for one of the lanes, and get right into swimming laps. It takes a few strokes for you to find your rhythm, but soon you’re coasting through the water with ease.
rows.translation: 你头朝下一头扎进凉爽的水中，浮出水面时猛地吐出一口气。你游向其中一条泳道，立刻开始来回游泳。划过几下后，你才找到节奏，但很快便能轻松地在水中穿行。
rows.raw: "You plunge into the cool water headfirst, coming up with a spurting breath. You head for one of the lanes, and get right into swimming laps. It takes a few strokes for you to find your rhythm, but soon you’re coasting through the water with ease."

rows.original: After a few laps, you swim up alongside the local cows who are also doing laps, and nod a quick greeting to them, then match their pace. They clearly do this a lot, and it’s a struggle at first, but you manage to stay with them for a while.
rows.translation: 游过几圈后，你来到同样在进行游泳训练的当地母牛身旁，点头匆匆打了声招呼，随后跟上她们的速度。她们显然经常这么做，一开始要跟上相当吃力，但你还是设法与她们并行了一阵。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a few laps, you swim up alongside the local cows who are also doing laps, and nod a quick greeting to them, then match their pace. They clearly do this a lot, and it’s a struggle at first, but you manage to stay with them for a while."

rows.original: Soon enough, your limbs start feeling heavy, and your once-smooth strokes start to stutter. You swim for the edge and pull yourself out, sore but satisfied.
rows.translation: 很快，你的四肢开始变得沉重，原本流畅的划水动作也开始断断续续。你游到池边，撑着身体爬出泳池，虽然浑身酸痛，却十分满足。
rows.raw: "\n\nSoon enough, your limbs start feeling heavy, and your once-smooth strokes start to stutter. You swim for the edge and pull yourself out, sore but satisfied."

rows.original: You feel stronger and fitter after your swim.
rows.translation: 游完泳后，你觉得自己变得更强壮、更健美了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou feel stronger and fitter after your swim."

rows.raw: "The spa is a welcome sight. You ready yourself and climb in."

rows.original: The smooth water is just barely beneath too hot, but once you get used to it, you let out a deep sigh of relief. You find a place to relax among the bubbling jets, and let the warm water soothe away your aches and pains.
rows.translation: 平静的池水只比烫手稍凉一点，但习惯温度后，你深深舒了口气。你在冒泡的喷流间找了个地方放松，让温水舒缓身上的酸痛。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe smooth water is just barely beneath too hot, but once you get used to it, you let out a deep sigh of relief. You find a place to relax among the bubbling jets, and let the warm water soothe away your aches and pains."

rows.original: As you suspected before, not all the water’s motion is from the jets. There are several couples enjoying both the spa and each other, thrusting together in slow, lazy strokes. Pretty much what you’d expect for New Texas. Must be a great way to come down from a workout.
rows.translation: 正如你先前所料，水中的动静并非全都来自喷流。好几对伴侣一边享受水疗池，一边享受彼此，以缓慢慵懒的节奏交合。对新德克萨斯来说，差不多正合预期。这一定是锻炼后放松的好办法。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you suspected before, not all the water’s motion is from the jets. There are several couples enjoying both the spa and each other, thrusting together in slow, lazy strokes. Pretty much what you’d expect for New Texas. Must be a great way to come down from a workout."

rows.original: After a while, you feel yourself starting to get too warm, and climb out. The air feels suddenly cold, a bit bracing but not uncomfortable. Time to find a towel.

rows.original: The cute little varmint twists its head 180 degrees at you and makes an owl-like hoot. When you don’t attack it, though, the creature’s spikes flex back out, and it makes a great big huff in your face, blasting you with a horribly cinnamon-like breath that burns your eyes and nose. You make yourself giggle in spite of the burning breath and slowly reach out to stroke the critter’s big blue head-plate. It’s armored skin feels like ultra-smooth latex, glossy and brilliantly colored, getting rougher around the base of its spines. The varmint recoils a bit when you touch it, but after a few minutes of you searching out the equivalent of behind its ears to scratch (ear-holes, you guess?); it ends up making a purring hooting sound and wagging its big, spiky tail around like an oversized puppy.
rows.translation: 这只可爱的小害兽把脑袋朝你扭转180度，发出猫头鹰般的叫声。不过你没有攻击它，于是生物的尖刺又向外舒展；它朝你脸上重重呼出一口气，喷出极其类似肉桂、令你眼鼻灼痛的气息。尽管遭受灼热吐息，你还是强迫自己咯咯轻笑，缓缓伸手抚摸小动物硕大的蓝色头甲。它的铠甲皮肤像极其光滑的乳胶，色泽明亮鲜艳，靠近尖刺根部则变得更加粗糙。你触碰时，害兽稍稍畏缩；但在你寻找相当于耳后的部位挠了几分钟后（你猜是耳孔？），它最终发出呼噜般的咕咕声，又像一只超大号小狗般摇起硕大的尖刺尾巴。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe cute little varmint twists its head 180 degrees at you and makes an owl-like hoot. When you don’t attack it, though, the creature’s spikes flex back out, and it makes a great big huff in your face, blasting you with a horribly cinnamon-like breath that burns your eyes and nose. You make yourself giggle in spite of the burning breath and slowly reach out to stroke the critter’s big blue head-plate. It’s armored skin feels like ultra-smooth latex, glossy and brilliantly colored, getting rougher around the base of its spines. The varmint recoils a bit when you touch it, but after a few minutes of you searching out the equivalent of behind its ears to scratch (ear-holes, you guess?); it ends up making a purring hooting sound and wagging its big, spiky tail around like an oversized puppy."

rows.original: “Aww, you’re not so bad!” you tease, scritching its snout until the varmint’s putty in your hands. Like, totally cute!
rows.translation: “啊，你也没那么坏嘛！”你逗弄道，轻挠它的鼻口，直到害兽彻底任你摆布。真是超级可爱！
rows.raw: "\n\n“Aww, you’re not so bad!” you tease, scritching its snout until the varmint’s putty in your hands. Like, totally cute!"

rows.original: It hoots again, but with a little coaxing, you get it to stretch out its neck and let you collar it. Ah, it’s soooo adorable! And the colors look so good together! rows.original: Sitting by the gate to the field is a New Texan dressed in overalls and a wide-brimmed straw hat. For a moment, you think you’ve found the mythic flat-chested cow-girl by the figure’s extremely feminine face, nub-like horns, tiny cloven hooves, and slight figure - until your eyes wander down and see the very blatant bulge in his pants, holding what must be a pretty sizable member at bay. He seems to be in something of a huff, kicking at a fence post and thumbing the handle of a slug gun on his belt.
rows.translation: 田野大门旁坐着一名穿背带裤、戴宽边草帽的新德州人。看着极其女性化的脸庞、凸点般的角、小巧偶蹄与纤细身材，有那么一刻，你以为自己找到了传说中的平胸牛女——直到视线下移，看见他裤子上极其明显的鼓包，显然正压制着相当可观的家伙。他似乎十分恼火，一边踢篱笆柱，一边用拇指拨弄腰带上弹头枪的握柄。
rows.raw: "\n\nSitting by the gate to the field is a New Texan dressed in overalls and a wide-brimmed straw hat. For a moment, you think you’ve found the mythic flat-chested cow-girl by the figure’s extremely feminine face, nub-like horns, tiny cloven hooves, and slight figure - until your eyes wander down and see the very blatant bulge in his pants, holding what must be a pretty sizable member at bay. He seems to be in something of a huff, kicking at a fence post and thumbing the handle of a slug gun on his belt."

rows.original: He huffs at the question. “I wish! This here used to be my daddy’s job, and he tasked me to clear the little bastards out, but... agh, look at me! Damn Treatment backfired on me! Was supposed to turn me into a big, buff hunk who could wrestle these varmints like that Steph Irson chick tackled that naleen on the TV! But noooo, I can’t even use the damn gun my dad gave me. Kicks so hard I damn near broke my nose, and you know what the little blue critter did? Just made this hissy little laughing noise and shat right on my boot while I bled everywhere.”
rows.translation: 他因这个问题气呼呼地说道：“我倒希望可以！这原本是我老爸的工作，他叫我清理这些小混蛋，可是... 啊，看看我！该死的改造疗程在我身上适得其反！本来应该把我变成高大强壮的猛男，能像电视里斯蒂芬·厄森那姑娘扑倒纳林一样制服这些害兽！可是不——，我甚至没法使用老爸给的破枪。后坐力大得差点打断我的鼻子；你知道那只蓝色小动物做了什么吗？就在我血流满地时，发出嘶嘶的轻笑声，还直接拉在我的靴子上。”

rows.original: As you make your way through the field, you spot something... digging? Yeah, digging into the earth, trying to root up some of the crop. You pull the light lasso off your belt and step towards the strange, blue shape in the dirt.
rows.translation: 穿过田野时，你发现有什么东西...在挖掘？没错，它正在刨土，想把一些庄稼连根翻出来。你从腰带上取下光索，走向泥土中那道陌生的蓝色身影。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you make your way through the field, you spot something... digging? Yeah, digging into the earth, trying to root up some of the crop. You pull the light lasso off your belt and step towards the strange, blue shape in the dirt."

rows.original: Sure enough, as you approach, the creature pokes its head up, revealing a jaw of razor-sharp teeth and large, thin spikes poking up from its flat head. The varmint growls at you and lunges!
rows.translation: 果然，当你靠近时，那只生物抬起脑袋，露出一张长满剃刀般尖牙的大嘴和一双黑色小眼睛。一排蓝色尖刺沿着背部竖起，末端是一条带刺的尾巴。尽管模样怪异，它看起来倒有点可爱，就像长满尖刺、胖乎乎的蓝色太空小狗！
rows.raw: "\n\nSure enough, as you approach, the creature pokes its head up, revealing a jaw of razor-sharp teeth and large, thin spikes poking up from its flat head. The varmint growls at you and lunges!"

rows.original: Your relaxed journey between systems is interrupted by a sudden crash from somewhere aboard your ship

rows.raw: "Your relaxed journey between systems is interrupted by a sudden crash from somewhere aboard your ship"

rows.original: , and a shriek of alarm

rows.original: . You curse and grab your gear, running out of your cabin and down the corridor to the common room. A moment later, though, you’re skidding to a stop and backpedaling out of your ship’s galley as a huge, snarling blue creature stomps out with a mouthful of protein cubes drooling out of its mouth.
rows.translation: 。你咒骂一声，抓起装备，冲出舱室，沿走廊跑向公共休息室。然而片刻之后，你却猛地刹住脚步，从飞船厨房里倒退出来；一只巨大的蓝色生物咆哮着走出，嘴里塞满蛋白质方块，口水不断滴落。
rows.raw: ". You curse and grab your gear, running out of your cabin and down the corridor to the common room. A moment later, though, you’re skidding to a stop and backpedaling out of your ship’s galley as a huge, snarling blue creature stomps out with a mouthful of protein cubes drooling out of its mouth."

rows.original: Your pudgy little cowgirl is up on the kitchen counter, wrapping her arms around herself and screeching. “What’s it doing on the ship!?” she yelps as soon as she sees you, flailing at the person-sized New Texan critter. “[pc.name] do somethiiing!”
rows.translation: 你那圆润娇小的牛娘正站在厨房柜台上，双臂紧抱着自己，尖叫不止。“它为什么会在船上！？”她一看见你就喊道，慌乱地指着那只与人等高的新德克萨斯生物。“[pc.name]，快做点什么嘛啊啊！”
rows.raw: "\n\nYour pudgy little cowgirl is up on the kitchen counter, wrapping her arms around herself and screeching. “What’s it doing on the ship!?” she yelps as soon as she sees you, flailing at the person-sized New Texan critter. “[pc.name] do somethiiing!”"

rows.original: Suddenly, you remember that you somehow managed to walk right off New Texas with the big blue bastard wrapped up and slung over your shoulder. How did you forget to turn this one in?
rows.translation: 你突然想起，自己不知怎么竟把这个蓝色大混蛋捆得严严实实、扛在肩上，直接带离了新德克萨斯。你怎么会忘了把这只交出去？
rows.raw: "\n\nSuddenly, you remember that you somehow managed to walk right off New Texas with the big blue bastard wrapped up and slung over your shoulder. How did you forget to turn this one in?"

rows.original: The creature hisses at you, pacing around you, its huge claws clattering on the metal bulkheads under your [pc.feet]. The varmint gives you a wide berth, chomping its needle-like teeth on your food supply, staring at you with its beady little black eyes. Its long, sinuous tail smacks against a shelf on the far wall, sending some of your foodstuff crashing to the ground. The sudden sound spooks the creature, and it lunges away, leaping through a hatch and into another room. Shit.
rows.translation: 那只生物冲你嘶叫，在你身边踱步，巨爪在你[pc.feet]下方的金属舱壁上咔哒作响。害兽远远绕着你走，一边用针状尖牙嚼食你的储备粮，一边用黑色小眼睛盯着你。它细长蜿蜒的尾巴抽中远墙上的架子，震得一些食物坠落在地。突如其来的声响吓到了它，它猛地躲开，跃过舱门冲进另一个房间。该死。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe creature hisses at you, pacing around you, its huge claws clattering on the metal bulkheads under your [pc.feet]. The varmint gives you a wide berth, chomping its needle-like teeth on your food supply, staring at you with its beady little black eyes. Its long, sinuous tail smacks against a shelf on the far wall, sending some of your foodstuff crashing to the ground. The sudden sound spooks the creature, and it lunges away, leaping through a hatch and into another room. Shit."

rows.original: “[pc.name], kill it! Kill it!” Reaha squeals, hiding behind you.
rows.translation: “[pc.name]，杀了它！杀了它！”蕾娅尖叫着躲到你身后。
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name], kill it! Kill it!” Reaha squeals, hiding behind you."

rows.original: Varmint
rows.translation: 害兽

rows.original: Steeling yourself, you [pc.readyWeapon] and cautiously advance towards the hatch. The critters back on New Texas might have been relatively easy to wrangle in a wide open field where you could use your light-lasso, but things are a little too cramped in your living quarters to do anything other than either kill it or try and wrestle it down if the varmint attacks you.
rows.translation: 你鼓起勇气，[pc.readyWeapon]，小心翼翼地走向舱门。新德克萨斯的那些生物在开阔田野中或许比较容易用光索制服，但你的生活区实在太狭窄；如果害兽向你发动攻击，你除了杀死它或设法把它摔倒，几乎别无选择。
rows.raw: "Steeling yourself, you [pc.readyWeapon] and cautiously advance towards the hatch. The critters back on New Texas might have been relatively easy to wrangle in a wide open field where you could use your light-lasso, but things are a little too cramped in your living quarters to do anything other than either kill it or try and wrestle it down if the varmint attacks you."

rows.original: Instead, when you step through the hatch, you find the giant critter curled up on a tattered mess of your clothes ripped down from the laundry hatch, munching quietly on the sack of protein cubes that it stole. You blink in surprise at the creature’s sudden change in attitude, and slowly step forward. The varmint looks up and glowers at you, its blue spikes rising like hackles when you get too close. Doesn’t look like it wants to be friends...
rows.translation: 然而，穿过舱门后，你发现那只巨大生物蜷缩在一堆破烂衣物上；那些衣服是它从洗衣口扯下来的，它正安静地嚼着偷走的那袋蛋白质方块。你惊讶地眨眨眼，对它态度的骤变感到意外，随后缓缓上前。害兽抬头怒视你；你一靠得太近，它的蓝色尖刺便像炸毛一样竖起。看来它并不想交朋友...
rows.raw: "\n\nInstead, when you step through the hatch, you find the giant critter curled up on a tattered mess of your clothes ripped down from the laundry hatch, munching quietly on the sack of protein cubes that it stole. You blink in surprise at the creature’s sudden change in attitude, and slowly step forward. The varmint looks up and glowers at you, its blue spikes rising like hackles when you get too close. Doesn’t look like it wants to be friends..."

rows.original: Aww, what a pretty space-puppy! You get down on the ground with your big blue cutie and give it a scritch under the chin, earning an adorable hoot and a tail-wiggle from it. “Good boy!” you cheer, moving your fingers a little faster and moving them all over its shiny smooth head-plate.
rows.translation: 嗷，多漂亮的太空小狗！你在这只蓝色大可爱身边蹲到地上，挠了挠它的下巴，换来一声可爱的咕叫和一阵摇尾巴。“好孩子！”你欢呼着，加快手指的动作，摸遍它光滑闪亮的头甲。
rows.raw: "Aww, what a pretty space-puppy! rows.original: It doesn’t take long for the happy space-puppy to roll into its back, paws in the air and spikes splaying out all around it, showing its spiny-plated belly. You scoop the critter down and give it a big hug, starting to scratch all over. It gurgles and hoots and paws at the air, wriggling like a big ol’ noodle while you play with it.
rows.translation: 这只开心的太空小狗很快便翻身躺下，四爪朝天，尖刺向四周摊开，露出覆满刺甲的腹部。你把它抱进怀里，用力搂住，开始到处抓挠。它咕噜叫着、咕咕叫着，爪子在空中乱挥；你陪它玩耍时，它像一根大面条似的扭来扭去。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt doesn’t take long for the happy space-puppy to roll into its back, paws in the air and spikes splaying out all around it, showing its spiny-plated belly. You scoop the critter down and give it a big hug, starting to scratch all over. It gurgles and hoots and paws at the air, wriggling like a big ol’ noodle while you play with it."

rows.translation: 那对，呃，带刺耳孔之间亲昵地挠了挠。它巨大的尾巴沉重地扫过舱壁，像一袋石头般不断捶打，并发出柔和的咕叫声。你猜这表示它喜欢？
