rows.original: After a couple moments, the huge beast flops onto its side, yawning and pawing at you, the deck, and its own curling tail. Taking the hint, you reach down and start scratching its... very rough, plated, spiky belly. It’s not exactly comfortable to pet, but your blue buddy seems to like it until your hand gets too sore to keep going. When you stop, it gives a defeated huff and curls up to take a nap.
rows.translation: 片刻之后，巨兽倒向一侧，打着哈欠，用爪子扒拉你、甲板和自己卷曲的尾巴。你领会了暗示，伸手开始抓挠它...极其粗糙、覆甲而带刺的腹部。摸起来并不舒服，但你的蓝色伙伴似乎很享受，直到你的手酸得再也挠不动。你一停下，它便失望地哼了一声，蜷起身体开始打盹。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a couple moments, the huge beast flops onto its side, yawning and pawing at you, the deck, and its own curling tail. Taking the hint, you reach down and start scratching its... very rough, plated, spiky belly. It’s not exactly comfortable to pet, but your blue buddy seems to like it until your hand gets too sore to keep going. When you stop, it gives a defeated huff and curls up to take a nap."

The great big beasty takes a big, huffing breath as you activate its leash and stands up, sauntering over to stand at your side. Looks like it’s ready to go!
rows.translation: 坐在那里，巨大尾巴砰砰拍打着甲板。你靠近时，它低声咕叫，尾巴摆动得更快了些。你把项圈和牵引绳套上它树干般粗的脖子时，它没有阻止你，不过锁定项圈时，它的尖刺略微竖起。你启动牵引绳后，大块头猛兽呼哧着深吸一口气，站起身，缓步走到你身边。看来它已经准备好出发了！

rows.original: The landing zone on T.’s Ranch in New Texas is as rustic as you could realistically make it: from the outside, the building looks like a monstrously large barn, complete with shingled roof and bright red paint job. From the inside, though, you can see it’s clearly been designed as a landing zone for private starships: the roof retracts on a pair of powerful metal arms, opening and closing to allow access. The stalls where stallions or cows might be kept have been dramatically sized up like the rest of the barn, large enough to snugly house most commercial freighters and pleasure yachts. To the west, you can see several bull-men hefting crates and moving cargo from visiting ships.
rows.translation: 新德克萨斯大T牧场的着陆区已经尽可能建得质朴：从外面看，这栋建筑像一座大得吓人的谷仓，有木瓦屋顶，还漆成鲜红色。但从内部看，它显然是专为私人星舰设计的着陆区：屋顶安装在一对强力金属臂上，可以伸缩开合供飞船进出。原本用于安置种马或母牛的隔间也与谷仓其他部分一样被大幅放大，足以贴合容纳大多数商用货船与娱乐游艇。西边可以看见几个公牛人搬动板条箱，将货物从到访的飞船上运走。

rows.original: Just walking along this pockmarked road has you wishing that the locals would do a better job maintaining their infrastructure. They don’t seem to mind, though. All too often, you see guys walking by, escorting curvy, wiggly cow-girls with a well-placed, squeezing palm or casually groping fingers. Their vehicles, boxy-looking hovertrucks, occasionally zip by, undoubtedly on some errand. Wooden steps to the north lead up onto a white porch that makes up the facade of an impressive looking ranch house. Plenty of foot traffic is going in and out, and you’re pretty sure you can make out a doormat with “Welcome, Y’all” spelled out on it.
rows.translation: 仅仅走在这条坑坑洼洼的道路上，你便希望当地人能更认真维护基础设施。不过他们似乎并不介意。你频繁看见男人们经过，用放在恰当位置、不断揉捏的手掌或随意摸索的手指，陪伴曲线玲珑、摇曳生姿的牛姑娘。他们外观方正的悬浮卡车偶尔飞驰而过，毫无疑问是在执行某项差事。北边的木阶通向一座白色门廊，构成气派牧场宅邸的正面。大量行人来来往往，你很确定能辨认出一张写着“欢迎你们”的门垫。

rows.original: Little puffs of dust kick up with each step you take on this east-west thoroughfare. The roadway is a simple affair of cleared dirt that’s been weatherworn into what feels more like a series of ruts than a transportation hub. A gleaming white post protrudes from the waving grasses to the north, anchoring the easternmost side of an expansive porch. Behind it sits a large farmhouse; many of the passersby look to be heading towards its entrance - just to the west.
rows.translation: 你每踏一步，这条东西向大道上都会扬起一小团尘土。路面不过是被清理出来的泥土，饱经风雨后，感觉更像一连串车辙，而非交通枢纽。北边摇曳的草丛中立着一根闪亮白柱，固定着宽阔门廊最东侧。后方是一栋大型农舍；许多路人似乎都朝西边不远处的入口走去。

rows.original: Wooden fence posts line the roadside, polished to such a gleaming sheen that you can see your face reflected across patterned grain. They’re at least eight feet tall and connected by slats inches thick. New Texans either have immense livestock or value size more than the rest of the galaxy. The result is a barrier tall enough to give even the largest beasts pause and strong enough to arrest a speeding hovertruck. Behind the posts, there are acres of rolling fields; you get the impression that wandering off the beaten paths might run you afoul of the locals. It’s best to stay on the road for now. A gap to the southeast reveals a colorful structure.
rows.translation: 木制栅栏柱沿路排列，被打磨得光可鉴人，你能从花纹木纹上看见自己的脸。它们至少八英尺高，由数英寸厚的横板相连。新德克萨斯人要么饲养着巨型牲畜，要么比银河其他地方更看重尺寸。最终形成的屏障高得足以令最大型野兽却步，也结实得足以拦停高速悬浮卡车。围栏后是绵延数英亩的起伏田野；你感觉偏离常走路线或许会惹恼当地人。现在最好留在道路上。东南方的缺口露出一栋色彩鲜艳的建筑。

rows.original:
Despite the rumblings of the occasional, passing hovertruck, this straight and narrow thoroughfare is quite peaceful. The pitted, unkept earth of the roadway has just enough give beneath your [pc.feet] to make your passage one of relative peace so long as you keep from tripping in the rare deep divot. Immense fences protect you on either side, guarding over fields of waving grasses to the north and the south. A decent-sized barn isn’t far to the northeast, and an impressive ranch house stands off the road to the northwest.

A one-story building with smooth tan walls sits to the north of the road, with a bright neon holographic sign across the front proclaiming it to be the “Ten Ton Gym”. The sign shows a cartoonish, overmuscled bull hefting a barbell the size of a small freighter over his head with one hand. Plate glass windows across the front give you a glimpse into a weight room filled with denizens of New Texas, cows and bulls alike lifting weights of varying sizes.

As you watch, the giant barbell on the sign changes to an actual cow, its eyes wide in surprise, then to a fit cowgirl with breasts the size of her head, raising two weights with her toned arms. The hard-bodied bull winks at you between the changes.
rows.translation:
尽管偶尔经过的悬浮卡车发出隆隆声，这条笔直狭窄的大道仍相当宁静。路面凹凸失修的泥土在[pc.feet]下略微下陷，只要别被罕见的深坑绊倒，走起来还算平和。道路两侧都有巨大围栏保护，守护着南北两边随风摇摆的草地。东北方不远处有一座规模不小的谷仓，西北方路边则矗立着一栋气派的牧场宅邸。

道路北侧坐落着一栋光滑棕褐色墙壁的单层建筑，正面横跨着明亮的霓虹全息招牌，宣称这里是“十吨健身房”。招牌描绘着一头肌肉夸张的卡通公牛，单手将一根小型货船大小的杠铃举过头顶。正面的平板玻璃窗让你得以窥见里面的力量训练室，新德克萨斯居民挤满其中，母牛和公牛都在举起大小不一的重量。

你注视时，招牌上的巨型杠铃变成了一头真正的母牛，双眼惊讶地大睁，随后又变成胸部和脑袋一样大的健美牛姑娘，用线条分明的双臂举起两只哑铃。画面切换之间，身体结实的公牛朝你眨了眨眼。

rows.original: A prairie breeze hits you as you walk, carrying the smell of straw and milk on an eastern breeze. Just to the northeast, you can see what is likely the source of the farmland scents: a red and white barn. You can vaguely hear the sound of mooing from within. The whole place has a fresh, wholesome air that’s entirely at odds with the message you received and the attitudes of the customs agents. Off to the southwest is a colorful-looking structure. A sweet dairy scent emanates from within.
rows.translation: 行走时，一阵草原微风从东方吹来，带着稻草与牛奶的气息。东北方不远处，你能看见农田气味可能的来源：一座红白相间的谷仓。里面隐约传出哞叫声。整片地方洋溢着清新健康的气息，与收到的信息和海关人员的态度完全相悖。西南方有一栋色彩鲜艳的建筑，里面飘出香甜乳制品气息。

The whole place has a fresh, wholesome air that’s entirely at odds with the message you received and the attitudes of the customs agents. Off to the southwest is a colorful-looking structure. A sweet dairy scent emanates from within."

rows.original: This close to the barn, you’re able to appreciate the work that went into its construction. Every beam is perfectly straight. The paint is smooth as if freshly washed. It’s even been patterned after the cows that undoubtedly lie within, with white spots interrupting its more normal, crimson exterior. Rather than having the typical cow-print shape, the spots’ edges follow the joints and braces of the wood, making the structure vaguely resemble some kind of blocky, strawberry cow. The doors in aren’t far to the east. You can also follow the road west towards the ranch house and landing barn.
rows.translation: 距离谷仓如此之近，你得以欣赏建造时投入的工艺。每根横梁都笔直无瑕。油漆光滑得像刚刚洗过。建筑甚至仿照里面无疑存在的母牛设计，较为正常的深红外墙上点缀着白色斑块。斑点边缘并非典型奶牛花纹，而是沿着木材接缝与支撑延伸，让整栋建筑隐约像一头方方正正的草莓奶牛。入口就在东边不远处。你也可以沿道路向西，前往牧场宅邸与着陆谷仓。

It’s even been patterned after the cows that undoubtedly lie within, with white spots interrupting its more normal, crimson exterior. Rather than having the typical cow-print shape, the spots’ edges follow the joints and braces of the wood, making the structure vaguely resemble some kind of blocky, strawberry cow. rows.original: A hand painted piece of what looks like oak hangs above the barn’s single sliding door, declaring it to be the “Milk Barn”. Even stranger, the door is transparent. You can see right down the barn’s central path, covered as it is by a bed of straw. You can only assume that the stalls along either side are equally carpeted with the stuff. You hear pleased-sounding moos and moans in equal proportion, and the air is heady with the scent of milk. The roadway leads west, back towards the farmhouse, and is blocked by a checkpoint to the east. The guards working it inform you that visitors aren’t permitted past without a visa.
rows.translation: 一块看似橡木的手绘木板悬在谷仓唯一的滑门上方，宣布这里是“挤奶谷仓”。更奇怪的是，门居然透明。你能一路看清谷仓中央铺满稻草的通道。只能猜测两侧隔间里也铺着同样材料。悦耳的哞叫与呻吟同样频繁，空气中充满浓郁奶香。道路向西通回农舍，东边则被检查站阻断。值守警卫告诉你，没有签证的访客不得通过。

rows.original: The inside of the barn assaults your senses with two things above all else: indecent moans and the scent of milk. A not-so-subtle undercurrent of sexual musk runs beneath them, tickling at your nose and making it impossible to ignore the sexual pleasure surrounding you. Despite the lurid scents and smells, the floor of the barn is clean. It’s covered with a fine layer of hay that will undoubtedly keep things dry in case of an accident, not that you’ve seen one yet. A massive sliding door is positioned on the southern wall, leading back out to the road. Empty stalls sit east and west of here, and more of them line the passageway to the north.
rows.translation: 谷仓内部首先以两样东西袭击你的感官：淫荡呻吟与牛奶气息。其下还流淌着毫不含蓄的性欲麝香，撩拨鼻腔，令你无法忽视周围的性爱快感。尽管气味淫靡，谷仓地面却十分干净。上面覆盖着一层细薄干草，一旦发生意外，无疑能保持干燥，虽然你暂时还没看到事故。南墙设有一扇巨型滑门，通回道路。这里东西两侧是空隔间，更多隔间沿通道向北排列。

rows.original: A thickly-spread layer of hay makes every step you take a rustling, shuffling affair. The walls are surprisingly modern, covered in liquid and stain resistant tile. A large, industrial-sized milking device is built into the wall to the west, but it is currently powered down and retracted. There’s a padded table that a potential milkee could sit or recline upon during the process. An activation button labeled “Moo” is recessed next to the machinery. Its purpose seems obvious. You can leave out the door to the east.
rows.translation: 厚厚铺开的干草让你每一步都伴随沙沙摩擦声。墙壁现代得出人意料，铺有抗液体、抗污渍瓷砖。西墙内嵌着一台工业规模的大型挤奶设备，不过目前已经关闭并收起。旁边有张软垫桌，可能接受挤奶的人可在过程中坐下或躺卧。机械旁嵌有一个标着“哞”的启动按钮，用途似乎显而易见。你可以从东门离开。

A large, industrial-sized milking device is built into the wall to the west, but it is currently powered down and retracted. There’s a padded table that a potential milkee could sit or recline upon during the process. An activation button labeled “Moo” is recessed next to the machinery. Its purpose seems obvious. You can leave out the door to the east."

rows.original: Hay covers every square inch of the floor, there to catch any stray fluids and be quickly cleaned away. A gleaming machine of metal and plastic has been built into the wall. It appears to be built to pop out into the stall in order to more readily service any available cows. It only has a single button that you can see - a simple green circle with a picture of a cow on its face. You don’t push it, yet, but it seems the only option available to you besides leaving. At least there’s a comfortable-looking table for the prospective cow to sit or lie upon.
rows.translation: 干草覆盖地板每一平方英寸，用来吸收任何溅出的液体，并能迅速清理。一台闪亮的金属塑料机器嵌在墙内。它似乎会弹出进入隔间，以便更直接地服务任何可用母牛。你只看见一个按钮 - 一个简单的绿色圆圈，表面画着母牛。你暂时没有按下，但除了离开，这似乎是唯一选项。至少还有一张看起来舒适的桌子，供未来的母牛坐下或躺卧。

rows.original: Big T.’s ranch house is like a super-sized version of an old Texas one, complete with a longhorn skull hanging over the door and a pair of rocking chairs on the front porch. An electric mosquito net hangs around the doorframe, the only sign of advanced technology around. Several cow-girls, bull-boys, and more human tourists are making their way in and out, many with black-and-white-splotched bags from the gift shop.
rows.translation: 大T的牧场宅邸像一栋超大号的古老德州住宅，门上挂着长角牛头骨，前门廊摆着一对摇椅。门框四周悬有电击防蚊网，是附近唯一的先进科技迹象。几个牛姑娘、公牛男孩和更加接近人类的游客来来往往，许多人手里提着礼品店出品的黑白斑点袋。
rows.raw: "Big T.’s ranch house is like a super-sized version of an old Texas one, complete with a longhorn skull hanging over the door and a pair of rocking chairs on the front porch. Several cow-girls, bull-boys, and more human tourists are making their way in and out, many with black-and-white-splotched bags from the gift shop."

rows.original: The central room of the ranch house is a huge, wood-paneled affair, with old-school lever guns, tribal totems, and stuffed animals adorning the walls in between advertisements for the Treatment and for Texan Milk. A huge staircase in front of you leads upwards to the second floor, helpfully labeled “Manager’s Office.” A door to the west leads to the gift shop, which seems to be pretty busy; to the east is a wide open set of double doors leading into what looks like a steakhouse, complete with a longhorn skull and horseshoes nailed to the barn-like door.
rows.translation: 牧场宅邸中央房间是一处巨大的木镶板空间，墙上在“改造”和德州牛奶广告之间装饰着老式杠杆枪、部族图腾与动物标本。面前一座巨大楼梯通向二楼，贴心地标着“经理办公室”。西门通往似乎相当繁忙的礼品店；东边敞开的宽阔双开门则通向一间牛排馆，谷仓风格的门上还钉着长角牛头骨和马蹄铁。

rows.original: You can’t go more than a few steps without hitting a divot or deeply sunken pothole in the road. The hovertrucks that trundle by don’t seem to have issue with the imperfect surface in the slightest, though they do kick up sizeable clouds of dust on their way. Thrumming ship engines sometimes emanate from the barn-turned-hangar to the southeast. The entrance is just a ways down the road. To the west, the road leads towards a field so big that it almost looks endless.
rows.translation: 走不了几步，你就会踩进道路上的凹陷或深坑。隆隆驶过的悬浮卡车似乎丝毫不受不平整路面影响，不过途中确实会扬起大片尘云。东南方那座谷仓改成的机库里，有时会传出飞船引擎的轰鸣。入口就在道路前方不远处。向西，道路通往一片大得仿佛无边无际的田野。
rows.raw: "You can’t go more than a few steps without hitting a divot or deeply sunken pothole in the road. The hovertrucks that trundle by don’t seem to have issue with the imperfect surface in the slightest, though they do kick up sizeable clouds of dust on their way. Thrumming ship engines sometimes emanate from the barn-turned-hangar to the southeast. The entrance is just a ways down the road. To the west, the road leads towards a field so big that it almost looks endless."

rows.original: The Road
rows.raw: "The Road"

rows.original: Fences tall enough to hold back an elephant block off the swaying grasses to the south, but the north side of the road is completely unguarded, perhaps thanks to some attempt at groundskeeping. The growth is kept to a well-trimmed patch. The bumpy surface of the road travels east and west away from here, leading back towards the buildings to the east or out into the fields to the west.
rows.translation: 足以挡住大象的高大围栏隔开南方摇曳的草地，道路北侧却完全没有防护，也许是某种园地维护措施所致。那里的植被被修剪成整齐草坪。颠簸路面从这里向东西延伸，向东通回建筑群，向西进入田野。
rows.raw: "Fences tall enough to hold back an elephant block off the swaying grasses to the south, but the north side of the road is completely unguarded, perhaps thanks to some attempt at groundskeeping. The growth is kept to a well-trimmed patch. The bumpy surface of the road travels east and west away from here, leading back towards the buildings to the east or out into the fields to the west."

rows.original: The Road
rows.raw: "The Road"

rows.original: Coming to an abrupt end, the road terminates in a circular well-trod cul-de-sac. Fences are all too apparent in the area around you, preventing travel into the wild grasses to the south and surrounding the expansive field to the west. A small, close-cut field of grass sits empty to the north save for a broken-down tractor that’s grounded to the far north.
rows.translation: 道路突然走到尽头，终止于一处被反复踏过的圆形死胡同。四周围栏十分显眼，阻止你进入南方野草地，并包围西侧辽阔田野。北边是一片修剪整齐的小草场，除了最北端趴窝的一辆破旧拖拉机外空无一物。
rows.raw: "Coming to an abrupt end, the road terminates in a circular well-trod cul-de-sac. Fences are all too apparent in the area around you, preventing travel into the wild grasses to the south and surrounding the expansive field to the west. A small, close-cut field of grass sits empty to the north save for a broken-down tractor that’s grounded to the far north."

rows.original: Short Grass
rows.raw: "Short Grass"

rows.original: Here in this small, protected field, you can see how New Texas can bill itself as a something of a rustic resort. Lovely green grass blows softly in the breeze. The scents of wild flowers and nature mix into a titillatingly heady bouquet. Still, you aren’t so far from civilization to have escaped the deep, bass hum of passing hovertrucks. There’s a road just to the south, if you wanted to get back to civilization. This lovely field stretches away to the west. To the north, the going is rocky, and there doesn’t look to be anything worthwhile in that direction.
rows.translation: 置身这片受到保护的小田野，你能明白新德克萨斯为何把自己宣传成质朴度假胜地。可爱的青草在微风中轻柔摇摆。野花与自然的气味混成令人陶醉兴奋的芬芳。不过，你还没有远离文明到听不见悬浮卡车经过时低沉的嗡鸣。南边有条道路，可以让你回归文明。这片可爱的田野向西延伸。北方道路崎岖，看起来也没有任何值得前往的地方。
rows.raw: "Here in this small, protected field, you can see how New Texas can bill itself as a something of a rustic resort. Lovely green grass blows softly in the breeze. The scents of wild flowers and nature mix into a titillatingly heady bouquet. Still, you aren’t so far from civilization to have escaped the deep, bass hum of passing hovertrucks. There’s a road just to the south, if you wanted to get back to civilization. This lovely field stretches away to the west. To the north, the going is rocky, and there doesn’t look to be anything worthwhile in that direction."

rows.original: Short Grass
rows.raw: "Short Grass"

rows.original: You nearly trample a small, purple bloom as you move, but catch yourself just in time. The flower is barely two inches across and perfectly circular in shape. The center has a trio of divots. As you watch, a terran bee alights on its petals, only to be sucked into one of the divots by what resembles a lightning fast-tongue. New Texas might look a lot like Terra, but the natives must have missed the memo.
rows.translation: 行走时，你差点踩烂一朵紫色小花，幸好及时收脚。花朵直径不足两英寸，形状完美浑圆，中央有三个凹坑。你注视时，一只地球蜜蜂落上花瓣，却被类似闪电般迅疾的舌头吸进其中一个凹坑。新德克萨斯或许长得很像地球，但本地物种显然没收到通知。
rows.raw: "You nearly trample a small, purple bloom as you move, but catch yourself just in time. The flower is barely two inches across and perfectly circular in shape. The center has a trio of divots. As you watch, a terran bee alights on its petals, only to be sucked into one of the divots by what resembles a lightning fast-tongue. New Texas might look a lot like Terra, but the natives must have missed the memo."

rows.original: Busted Hovertractor
rows.raw: "Busted Hovertractor"

rows.original: A wounded hovertractor lies askew, embedded in the ground. Judging by the angle it’s sitting at as well as the ruts it scored in the grass, its driver lost control of it and crashed it into the dirt, nearly tipping it over until it caught on a white-washed fence that stands almost as high as it. Viscous fluids have puddled in places around it, and many access hatches are popped open as if someone was trying to repair it. Nothing of interest lies to the north or east, but the road is a short ways south.
rows.translation: 一辆受损的悬浮拖拉机歪斜嵌进地面。从停放角度和草地上留下的车辙判断，驾驶员失去控制撞进泥土，差点侧翻，最终被一面几乎同样高的刷白围栏卡住。四周几处积着黏稠液体，许多检修舱门敞开，像是有人试图维修。北方和东方都没有有趣的东西，道路就在南边不远处。
rows.raw: "A wounded hovertractor lies askew, embedded in the ground. Judging by the angle it’s sitting at as well as the ruts it scored in the grass, its driver lost control of it and crashed it into the dirt, nearly tipping it over until it caught on a white-washed fence that stands almost as high as it. Viscous fluids have puddled in places around it, and many access hatches are popped open as if someone was trying to repair it. Nothing of interest lies to the north or east, but the road is a short ways south."

rows.original: The Fields
rows.raw: "The Fields"

rows.original: Waist-high grass ripples outward from you. Some peculiarity in the biology of the flora translates the motion from one plant to the next. Every motion you make fans outward from you, running ahead of you through the field of this particular crop. High fences to the east do their best to keep out the wilds, but it wouldn’t be hard for a man-sized creature to slip through.
rows.translation: 齐腰深的草丛从你身旁向外荡开。植物生物学中的某种特殊性质令动作从一株传向下一株。你的每个动作都会向外扩散，在这片特殊作物田里跑到你前方。东边的高大围栏竭力阻挡野外生物，但人类大小的生物想钻过并不困难。
rows.raw: "Waist-high grass ripples outward from you. Some peculiarity in the biology of the flora translates the motion from one plant to the next. Every motion you make fans outward from you, running ahead of you through the field of this particular crop. High fences to the east do their best to keep out the wilds, but it wouldn’t be hard for a man-sized creature to slip through."

rows.original: The Fields
rows.raw: "The Fields"

rows.original: The shorter grass between rows of corn crunches under your feet. It seems a bit drier here, with the short plant life only reaching up to your [pc.legOrLegs] and only in patches. The rest of the area is yellowed and parched, creating a mottled green-yellow landscape of corn and wilted grass. A high, white fence bars passage to the north and east.
rows.translation: 你脚下，玉米行间的矮草发出嘎吱声。这里似乎较为干燥，低矮植物只零星长到[pc.legOrLegs]，其余地区则枯黄干旱，形成玉米与萎蔫青草交错的黄绿色景观。北方和东方都有白色高围栏阻挡去路。
rows.raw: "The shorter grass between rows of corn crunches under your feet. It seems a bit drier here, with the short plant life only reaching up to your [pc.legOrLegs] and only in patches. The rest of the area is yellowed and parched, creating a mottled green-yellow landscape of corn and wilted grass. A high, white fence bars passage to the north and east."

rows.original: The Fields
rows.raw: "The Fields"

rows.original: You walk over a low fence, to face an army of scarecrows. Spaced regularly amidst the lines of heavy grain, you observe dozens and dozens of scarecrows. The local animals must love these crops... or someone just really, really likes scarecrows. You eye them suspiciously before moving on.
rows.translation: 你跨过一道低矮围栏，迎面看见一支稻草人大军。几十个稻草人以固定间距分布在沉甸甸的谷物行列中。当地动物肯定很爱这些作物...要不就是有人真的、真的很喜欢稻草人。你怀疑地打量它们，随后继续前进。
rows.raw: "You walk over a low fence, to face an army of scarecrows. Spaced regularly amidst the lines of heavy grain, you observe dozens and dozens of scarecrows. The local animals must love these crops... or someone just really, really likes scarecrows. You eye them suspiciously before moving on."

rows.original: The Fields
rows.raw: "The Fields"

rows.original: You pass an odd orchard in your wanderings. Each thick-trunked tree seems to have three distinct stages. One meter up, and branches spread out, heavy with ripe, purple fruit. Another meter up, and an umbrella of waxy-looking leaves shades the fruit below. At the very top of the trees are bright crowns of feathery-yellow blossoms, waving gently in a breeze that isn’t there.
rows.translation: 游荡期间，你经过一片奇怪果园。每棵粗壮树干似乎都有三个鲜明阶段。一米高处伸展出结满成熟紫色果实的枝条。再往上一米，蜡质外观的伞形叶片为下方果实遮阴。树木最顶端则戴着羽毛般亮黄色花朵组成的鲜艳冠冕，在不存在的微风中轻柔摇摆。
rows.raw: "You pass an odd orchard in your wanderings. Each thick-trunked tree seems to have three distinct stages. One meter up, and branches spread out, heavy with ripe, purple fruit. Another meter up, and an umbrella of waxy-looking leaves shades the fruit below. At the very top of the trees are bright crowns of feathery-yellow blossoms, waving gently in a breeze that isn’t there."

rows.original: The Fields
rows.raw: "The Fields"

rows.original: You walk through an empty field that appears to be lying fallow for some reason. Some local version of clover has spread rapidly over the churned land, carpeting it with tiny, green and blue leaves. Here and there, small arthropods leap up through the leaves, dancing some incomprehensible ballet.
rows.translation: 你穿过一片不知为何休耕的空田。当地某种苜蓿迅速覆盖翻动过的土地，用细小绿蓝叶片铺成地毯。各处都有小型节肢动物从叶间跃起，跳着某种无法理解的芭蕾。
rows.raw: "You walk through an empty field that appears to be lying fallow for some reason. Some local version of clover has spread rapidly over the churned land, carpeting it with tiny, green and blue leaves. Here and there, small arthropods leap up through the leaves, dancing some incomprehensible ballet."

rows.original: The Fields
rows.raw: "The Fields"

rows.original: Rows of low, wooden terraces criss-cross this field, hanging with thin, green vines. Stubby pods hang from those vines, open and revealing orange spheres. At your approach, the pods snap shut with a peculiar “PLAP,” hiding their amber troves.
rows.translation: 一排排低矮木架纵横交错地覆盖田野，挂着细长绿藤。藤上垂着粗短豆荚，敞开后露出橙色圆球。你走近时，豆荚伴随奇特的“啪”声猛然闭合，藏起琥珀色宝藏。
rows.raw: "Rows of low, wooden terraces criss-cross this field, hanging with thin, green vines. Stubby pods hang from those vines, open and revealing orange spheres. At your approach, the pods snap shut with a peculiar “PLAP,” hiding their amber troves."

rows.original: The Fields
rows.raw: "The Fields"

rows.original: You spy an odd figure amidst a field of arrowroot. You wave, but feel foolish as you walk closer to it. It’s a scarecrow, albeit an odd one. A barrel has been propped up on a sawhorse and topped with a dried gourd, forming the rough semblance of a four legged man. It looks like the two, hollow gourds, nailed to the front of the barrel were added later, meant to suggest breasts. Now why would someone do that?
rows.translation: 你在一片竹芋田里发现奇怪身影。你挥手致意，但走近后觉得自己很傻。那是个稻草人，不过样式十分奇怪。一个木桶架在锯木架上，顶着干葫芦，粗略构成四足人形。桶身前方后来又钉上两个空心葫芦，似乎用来表示乳房。可为什么有人要这么做？
rows.raw: "You spy an odd figure amidst a field of arrowroot. You wave, but feel foolish as you walk closer to it. It’s a scarecrow, albeit an odd one. A barrel has been propped up on a sawhorse and topped with a dried gourd, forming the rough semblance of a four legged man. It looks like the two, hollow gourds, nailed to the front of the barrel were added later, meant to suggest breasts. Now why would someone do that?"

rows.original: The Fields
rows.raw: "The Fields"

rows.original: You walk alongside a field of low, red fruits, glancing curiously at what appears to be an out of place section of bent, wooden fence. As you near it, the posts pull themselves out of the ground, rising up into a crude horse-like shape. It trains knothole eyes on you, then dashes away down the path at a surprising speed. You blink in surprise and continue on your way.
rows.translation: 你沿一片低矮红色果实田前行，好奇地看向一截显得格格不入、弯曲的木栅栏。靠近时，木柱自行从地面拔出，站成粗糙马形。它用树结孔眼睛盯住你，随后以惊人速度沿小径飞奔离去。你惊讶地眨眨眼，继续上路。
rows.raw: "You walk alongside a field of low, red fruits, glancing curiously at what appears to be an out of place section of bent, wooden fence. As you near it, the posts pull themselves out of the ground, rising up into a crude horse-like shape. It trains knothole eyes on you, then dashes away down the path at a surprising speed. You blink in surprise and continue on your way."

rows.original: The Fields
rows.raw: "The Fields"

rows.original: You walk between rows of waist-high, sticky-petaled flowers until you hear a small crunch beneath your [pc.foot]. Looking down, you see that you’ve crushed the bleached skull of a small animal. Your eyes widen as you realize that the earth here is littered with tiny bones. You eye the sticky flowers warily, and continue along your way at a slightly faster pace.
rows.translation: 你在齐腰高、花瓣黏腻的花丛行列间行走，直到[pc.foot]下传来轻微碎裂声。低头一看，你踩碎了一只小动物漂白的头骨。意识到这里的土地散落着细小骨骼，你睁大双眼，警惕地看向黏性花朵，加快脚步继续前进。
rows.raw: "You walk between rows of waist-high, sticky-petaled flowers until you hear a small crunch beneath your [pc.foot]. Looking down, you see that you’ve crushed the bleached skull of a small animal. Your eyes widen as you realize that the earth here is littered with tiny bones. You eye the sticky flowers warily, and continue along your way at a slightly faster pace."

rows.original: The Fields
rows.raw: "The Fields"

rows.original: The crops here are odd; tall, grass-like stalks end in bright red, slightly swollen tips. The wind blows and you pick up a faint, sweet scent of strawberries from the plants The hybrid crop must be some attempt to grow a hardier variant of strawberries. The aroma makes the walk significantly more pleasant - you wish it could go on forever.
rows.translation: 这里的作物很奇怪；高高的草状茎秆末端带着鲜红而略微肿胀的尖端。风吹过，你从植物间闻到淡淡草莓甜香。这种杂交作物必定是培育更顽强草莓品种的尝试。香气令旅途愉快许多 - 你希望它能永远持续。
rows.raw: "The crops here are odd; tall, grass-like stalks end in bright red, slightly swollen tips. The wind blows and you pick up a faint, sweet scent of strawberries from the plants The hybrid crop must be some attempt to grow a hardier variant of strawberries. The aroma makes the walk significantly more pleasant - you wish it could go on forever."

rows.original: The Fields
rows.raw: "The Fields"

rows.original: In the center of a stretch of fallow fields, you spy what looks like the skeleton of a burned-down barn in the dark, freshly-churned dirt. Massive support beams rise from the ground, leaning against each other in a half-hazard way. You decide to investigate, but as you near it, the entire structure groans, the beams rising up and unfolding into 20 meters of towering creature. Spindly and vaguely horse-like, but with a massively elongated neck, the wooden creature regards you with empty knothole eyes before striding off. Though its weather-worn legs move deceptively slowly, each footfall spans several meters, and it’s soon out of sight.
rows.translation: 在一片休耕田中央，你看见新近翻动的黑土里似乎立着一座烧毁谷仓的骨架。巨大的支撑梁从地面升起，以杂乱方式相互倚靠。你决定调查，但靠近时，整个结构发出呻吟，梁柱升起展开，变成一头高达二十米的庞然巨兽。木制生物四肢细长，隐约像马，脖颈却极度拉长；它用空洞树结孔眼睛端详你，随后大步离开。虽然饱经风雨的腿移动得看似缓慢，每一步却跨越数米，很快便消失在视野外。
rows.raw: "In the center of a stretch of fallow fields, you spy what looks like the skeleton of a burned-down barn in the dark, freshly-churned dirt. Massive support beams rise from the ground, leaning against each other in a half-hazard way. You decide to investigate, but as you near it, the entire structure groans, the beams rising up and unfolding into 20 meters of towering creature. Spindly and vaguely horse-like, but with a massively elongated neck, the wooden creature regards you with empty knothole eyes before striding off. Though its weather-worn legs move deceptively slowly, each footfall spans several meters, and it’s soon out of sight."

rows.original: The Fields
rows.raw: "The Fields"

rows.original: Rows of pink flowers span a relatively small, fenced-in area, cushioned amidst green-stemmed plants. The smell is pleasant enough, but soon becomes cloying. The bees enjoy it well enough, as they comb lazy spirals in the air around you.
rows.translation: 一排排粉色花朵分布在一片相对较小、有围栏围住的区域，簇拥在绿茎植物间。气味起初相当宜人，很快却甜腻得令人厌烦。蜜蜂倒很享受，围绕你在空中画出慵懒螺旋。
rows.raw: "Rows of pink flowers span a relatively small, fenced-in area, cushioned amidst green-stemmed plants. The smell is pleasant enough, but soon becomes cloying. The bees enjoy it well enough, as they comb lazy spirals in the air around you."

rows.original: The Fields
rows.raw: "The Fields"

rows.original: You walk through a freshly-harvested field, the cropped remains of wheat at your feet. Oddly, this field also hosts a small collection of what look like broken benches. As you approach the loose pile of wood, the benches unfold into small horse-like shapes, and gallop swiftly away.
rows.translation: 你穿过一片刚收割的田野，脚边是被割短的小麦残茬。奇怪的是，这片田里还有一小堆看似破损的长凳。你走近松散木堆时，长凳展开成小型马状物，迅速飞奔离开。
rows.raw: "You walk through a freshly-harvested field, the cropped remains of wheat at your feet. Oddly, this field also hosts a small collection of what look like broken benches. As you approach the loose pile of wood, the benches unfold into small horse-like shapes, and gallop swiftly away."

rows.original: The Fields
rows.raw: "The Fields"

rows.original: You stop and stare at the rows of trees here. It’s some sort of orchard, and small blue fruits do hang from the branches, but that’s not what catches your attention. Each trunk resembles the frozen form of a female humanoid. Covered in bark, they’re not carved, but, you guess, grow that way on their own. After a few minutes of marvelling, you continue on your way.
rows.translation: 你停下脚步，凝视这里的一排排树木。这是某种果园，树枝上确实挂着蓝色小果实，但真正吸引注意的不是它们。每根树干都像一名冻结的女性人形。它们覆盖树皮，并非雕刻而成；你猜它们天生就长成这样。惊叹几分钟后，你继续上路。
rows.raw: "You stop and stare at the rows of trees here. It’s some sort of orchard, and small blue fruits do hang from the branches, but that’s not what catches your attention. Each trunk resembles the frozen form of a female humanoid. Covered in bark, they’re not carved, but, you guess, grow that way on their own. After a few minutes of marvelling, you continue on your way."

rows.original: The Fields
rows.raw: "The Fields"

rows.original: A sharp smell announces a wide field of onions. The short, green stalks rise up from the loamy earth. On their own, you doubt they’d be strong enough to water your eyes, but the thousands of them here stand a fair chance. You hurry along your way.
rows.translation: 刺鼻气味预告着一大片洋葱田。矮短绿茎从肥沃泥土中长出。单独一株恐怕不足以让你流泪，但这里成千上万株合在一起颇有机会。你加快脚步。
rows.raw: "A sharp smell announces a wide field of onions. The short, green stalks rise up from the loamy earth. On their own, you doubt they’d be strong enough to water your eyes, but the thousands of them here stand a fair chance. You hurry along your way."

rows.original: The Fields
rows.raw: "The Fields"

rows.original: Tiny, yellow-blossomed plants cover the ground here. Waist-high white birds on meter-high legs mince delicately among them. You blink, realizing that each bird has two heads, each one dipping down amongst the plants in turn. You wonder why there are so many, and why they’re allowed to flourish on the farm until you spot one with a small insect in its beak, hungrily gobbling it up. You nod in comprehension and continue on your way.
rows.translation: 开着黄色小花的矮小植物覆盖地面。长着一米高双腿、身体齐腰高的白色鸟类在其中优雅碎步行走。你眨眨眼，发现每只鸟都有两个脑袋，轮流低头探入植物间。你正疑惑为何数量如此之多，又为何被允许在农场繁衍，直到看见一只嘴里叼着小昆虫，饥饿地一口吞下。你恍然点头，继续上路。
rows.raw: "Tiny, yellow-blossomed plants cover the ground here. Waist-high white birds on meter-high legs mince delicately among them. You blink, realizing that each bird has two heads, each one dipping down amongst the plants in turn. You wonder why there are so many, and why they’re allowed to flourish on the farm until you spot one with a small insect in its beak, hungrily gobbling it up. You nod in comprehension and continue on your way."

rows.original: The Fields
rows.raw: "The Fields"

rows.original: Easily five meters high and a meter around, the cane plants in this section of the farm are clearly biologically tweaked. You can’t think of a reason for growing such thick stems, until it occurs to you that these might be sugar-cane. If that’s the case, someone on this planet has an awfully sweet tooth. You continue on your way.
rows.translation: 农场这一区域的甘蔗显然经过生物调整，轻易便高达五米、周长一米。你想不出种植如此粗壮茎秆的理由，直到意识到这些也许是糖蔗。若真如此，这颗星球上有人格外嗜甜。你继续前进。
rows.raw: "Easily five meters high and a meter around, the cane plants in this section of the farm are clearly biologically tweaked. You can’t think of a reason for growing such thick stems, until it occurs to you that these might be sugar-cane. If that’s the case, someone on this planet has an awfully sweet tooth. You continue on your way."

rows.original: The Fields
rows.raw: "The Fields"

rows.original: A broad expanse of wheat greets your eyes, rippling outwards for several miles. The sun dances across the shimmering gold of the heavy wheat, and you shade your eyes as you take it in before continuing on your way.
rows.translation: 一望无际的小麦映入眼帘，向外绵延数英里。阳光在沉甸甸小麦闪耀的金色表面跳动；你遮住双眼欣赏片刻，随后继续上路。
rows.raw: "A broad expanse of wheat greets your eyes, rippling outwards for several miles. The sun dances across the shimmering gold of the heavy wheat, and you shade your eyes as you take it in before continuing on your way."

rows.original: The Fields
rows.raw: "The Fields"

rows.original: You hear a buzzing noise and wave a hand by your ear. A small insect flies off, and you recognize it as some kind of wasp. A glance at the trees here reveals a surprising number of the buzzing insects. It seems a bit odd until you squint up at the branches of the trees and recognize the small shapes of figs amidst them. Impressed by your own zoological acumen, you continue along your way.
rows.translation: 你听见嗡嗡声，在耳边挥手。一只小昆虫飞开，你认出那是某种黄蜂。看向这里的树木，能发现数量惊人的嗡鸣昆虫。起初有些奇怪，但当你眯眼望向枝条，认出其中小小的无花果轮廓，便明白过来。你为自己的动物学才华感到佩服，继续前进。
rows.raw: "You hear a buzzing noise and wave a hand by your ear. A small insect flies off, and you recognize it as some kind of wasp. A glance at the trees here reveals a surprising number of the buzzing insects. It seems a bit odd until you squint up at the branches of the trees and recognize the small shapes of figs amidst them. Impressed by your own zoological acumen, you continue along your way."

rows.original: The Fields
rows.raw: "The Fields"

rows.original: Now this is a surprisingly familiar crop. Broad, yellow-petaled flowers on tall, thick stalks fill this next field. However, as you walk past them, each sunflower turns the ebony center of its bloom towards you, following your progress past the field. Maybe they’re not as familiar as you thought. You shiver and continue on your way.
rows.translation: 这倒是一种熟悉得出人意料的作物。下一片田里长满高大粗茎和宽阔黄色花瓣的花朵。不过，当你从旁走过，每株向日葵都会把乌黑花心转向你，目送你经过田野。也许它们并不像想象中那样熟悉。你打了个哆嗦，继续赶路。
rows.raw: "Now this is a surprisingly familiar crop. Broad, yellow-petaled flowers on tall, thick stalks fill this next field. However, as you walk past them, each sunflower turns the ebony center of its bloom towards you, following your progress past the field. Maybe they’re not as familiar as you thought. You shiver and continue on your way."

rows.original: The Fields
rows.raw: "The Fields"

rows.original: Brown-green plants lie arrayed for some distance here, heavy with brittle-looking pods. Several lie open across the path, and, curious, you pick one up. Soybeans! Densely-packed with protein, these little guys actually make up the majority of cheap rations across most of the galaxy. You’re actually surprised that you haven’t seen more of these. You toss the pod aside and continue walking.
rows.translation: 棕绿色植物在这里铺展相当远，挂满看似脆弱的豆荚。几只敞开的豆荚散落在小径上，你好奇地捡起一个。大豆！这些小家伙蛋白质含量密集，实际上构成银河大多数地区廉价口粮的主体。你反倒惊讶自己没有见到更多。你扔开豆荚，继续行走。
rows.raw: "Brown-green plants lie arrayed for some distance here, heavy with brittle-looking pods. Several lie open across the path, and, curious, you pick one up. Soybeans! Densely-packed with protein, these little guys actually make up the majority of cheap rations across most of the galaxy. You’re actually surprised that you haven’t seen more of these. You toss the pod aside and continue walking."

rows.original: The Fields
rows.raw: "The Fields"

rows.original: What the hell is that? Looming over a field of grain is a grotesque parody of a humanoid. Sackcloth drapes a rusted-metal frame, while a face of splintered wood leers across the field. The wind blows, catching the scarecrow’s tatters, and with a terrifying shriek of metal, it turns slowly on its base. You shudder, severely creeped out by the thing, but as you leave it behind, reflect on the fact that you didn’t see any birds for miles around it.
rows.translation: 那他妈是什么？一片谷物田上方耸立着对人形生物的怪诞拙劣模仿。粗麻布披在生锈金属骨架上，碎木拼成的面孔狞笑着俯视田野。风吹动稻草人的破布，它伴随骇人的金属尖叫，在底座上缓缓转动。你浑身发抖，被这东西吓得厉害；但将它抛在身后时，又想到方圆数英里内确实没看见任何鸟。
rows.raw: "What the hell is that? Looming over a field of grain is a grotesque parody of a humanoid. Sackcloth drapes a rusted-metal frame, while a face of splintered wood leers across the field. The wind blows, catching the scarecrow’s tatters, and with a terrifying shriek of metal, it turns slowly on its base. You shudder, severely creeped out by the thing, but as you leave it behind, reflect on the fact that you didn’t see any birds for miles around it."

rows.original: The Fields
rows.raw: "The Fields"

rows.original: No more than five massive trees stand in the center of this field, seemingly alone amidst the sandy dirt. You can see though, even from a distance, that gigantic, glittering peaches hang from the branches of these house-sized trees. You take a step closer, and jump back as the sandy soil gives way far too easily. Ants swarm in the deep divot left by the brief touch of your [pc.foot]. To your horror, you realize the ground here is saturated with living ants. Are these some kind of terrible guard system? Who would want peaches that badly?
rows.translation: 这片田中央最多只有五棵巨树，孤零零立在沙质泥土中。即使隔着很远，你也能看见房屋大小的树木枝头挂着巨大闪亮的桃子。你走近一步，却因沙土轻易塌陷得过分而猛然后跳。仅仅被[pc.foot]短暂触碰留下的深坑里，蚂蚁蜂拥而出。你惊恐地意识到这里的地面充斥着活蚂蚁。难道这是某种可怕的防卫系统？谁会如此渴望桃子？
rows.raw: "No more than five massive trees stand in the center of this field, seemingly alone amidst the sandy dirt. You can see though, even from a distance, that gigantic, glittering peaches hang from the branches of these house-sized trees. You take a step closer, and jump back as the sandy soil gives way far too easily. Ants swarm in the deep divot left by the brief touch of your [pc.foot]. To your horror, you realize the ground here is saturated with living ants. Are these some kind of terrible guard system? Who would want peaches that badly?"

rows.original: The Fields
rows.raw: "The Fields"

rows.original: You walk past a thick field of wheat, pausing only as you spot a patch of darkness in the wall of grassy plants. Before your eyes, a hole opens in the plants, and a large, mouse-like head peers out of it. Before you can say a word, it sees you and ducks back in with a squeak. A door made of wheat slams shut and disappears completely. You push your arms through the wheat, finding no evidence of the creature or the door. Did you just hallucinate that?
rows.translation: 你经过一片茂密麦田，只因在草本植物墙上发现一块黑暗而停步。眼前，植物间打开一个洞，一颗硕大的鼠形脑袋从中探出。你还来不及开口，它便看见你，吱叫着缩了回去。一扇小麦组成的门猛然关闭，彻底消失。你伸手拨开小麦，却找不到那生物或门存在的任何证据。刚才只是幻觉吗？
rows.raw: "You walk past a thick field of wheat, pausing only as you spot a patch of darkness in the wall of grassy plants. Before your eyes, a hole opens in the plants, and a large, mouse-like head peers out of it. Before you can say a word, it sees you and ducks back in with a squeak. A door made of wheat slams shut and disappears completely. You push your arms through the wheat, finding no evidence of the creature or the door. Did you just hallucinate that?"

rows.original: The Fields
rows.raw: "The Fields"

rows.original: The green plants in this field cling low to the ground, no more than an inch high in places. In fact, many of the stems seem to bend directly back into the ground. You wonder what kind of crop this could be, until a small, six-legged rodent runs across the path, carrying a dirt-covered peanut in its mouth. Mystery solved!
rows.translation: 这片田里的绿色植物紧贴地面，有些地方不足一英寸高。事实上，许多茎似乎直接弯回土中。你正猜想这是什么作物，一只六足小啮齿动物便叼着沾满泥土的花生跑过小径。谜题解决了！
rows.raw: "The green plants in this field cling low to the ground, no more than an inch high in places. In fact, many of the stems seem to bend directly back into the ground. You wonder what kind of crop this could be, until a small, six-legged rodent runs across the path, carrying a dirt-covered peanut in its mouth. Mystery solved!"

rows.original: The Fields
rows.raw: "The Fields"

rows.original: Dark green gourds sit, nestled in the dirt of this field amidst creeping green vines. Here and there, two-headed white birds stride among them. Some small pest has chewed a hole through one, revealing yellow-orange tenderness beneath. A small, six-legged rodent scurries out of the hole in the pumpkin, only to be speared on the beak of one of the white birds. You blink at the speed of the avian and count yourself lucky that you’re not a varmint.
rows.translation: 深绿色葫芦躺在田野泥土中，被蔓延的绿藤包围。各处都有双头白鸟在其间迈步。某种小害兽在其中一只上咬出洞，露出下方黄橙色的柔嫩果肉。一只六足小啮齿动物从南瓜洞里窜出，却被一只白鸟的喙刺穿。你为鸟类的速度眨眨眼，庆幸自己不是害兽。
rows.raw: "Dark green gourds sit, nestled in the dirt of this field amidst creeping green vines. Here and there, two-headed white birds stride among them. Some small pest has chewed a hole through one, revealing yellow-orange tenderness beneath. A small, six-legged rodent scurries out of the hole in the pumpkin, only to be speared on the beak of one of the white birds. You blink at the speed of the avian and count yourself lucky that you’re not a varmint."

rows.original: The Fields
rows.raw: "The Fields"

rows.original: Orderly rows of tall palm trees cover this field, thick bunches of orange-brown fruits hanging from their tops. Here and there hairy, many-legged insects scurry among the fruit, though you’re not sure if they’re pest control, or the pests themselves. You decide not to look into it and instead continue on your way.
rows.translation: 一排排整齐的高大棕榈树覆盖田野，顶部挂着一串串橙棕色果实。各处都有多毛多足昆虫在果实间奔窜，但你不确定它们是在控制害虫，还是本身就是害虫。你决定不去深究，继续前进。
rows.raw: "Orderly rows of tall palm trees cover this field, thick bunches of orange-brown fruits hanging from their tops. Here and there hairy, many-legged insects scurry among the fruit, though you’re not sure if they’re pest control, or the pests themselves. You decide not to look into it and instead continue on your way."

rows.original: The Fields
rows.raw: "The Fields"

rows.original: As you walk down the rows of waist-high plants in this field, you feel your progress begin to slow. The sticky tendrils of these plants cling to your [pc.legOrLegs] and leave red, bristly pods on you. You curse, and upon leaving the field, spend several minutes removing the pods.
rows.translation: 沿着田里齐腰高的植物行列前进时，你感觉速度开始减缓。这些植物的黏性卷须缠住[pc.legOrLegs]，并把红色刺毛豆荚留在你身上。你咒骂一句，离开田野后花了几分钟摘掉豆荚。
rows.raw: "As you walk down the rows of waist-high plants in this field, you feel your progress begin to slow. The sticky tendrils of these plants cling to your [pc.legOrLegs] and leave red, bristly pods on you. You curse, and upon leaving the field, spend several minutes removing the pods."

rows.original: The Fields
rows.raw: "The Fields"

rows.original: As you walk through a field of blue-black berries, you hear a distant galloping sound, and glimpse on the horizon the silhouettes of horse-like shapes. You wonder, briefly, who would let horses run free on a farm like this, but shrug and continue along your way.
rows.translation: 穿过一片蓝黑色浆果田时，你听见远处的疾驰声，并瞥见地平线上马形轮廓。你短暂思考谁会在这样的农场放任马匹自由奔跑，随后耸耸肩继续上路。
rows.raw: "As you walk through a field of blue-black berries, you hear a distant galloping sound, and glimpse on the horizon the silhouettes of horse-like shapes. You wonder, briefly, who would let horses run free on a farm like this, but shrug and continue along your way."

rows.original: The Fields
rows.raw: "The Fields"

rows.original: You walk alongside a field of corn, and the air is suddenly split by a cacophony of cawing. Dark birds, each sporting two heads, mob a scarecrow. You watch in amusement as the scarecrow refuses to fall beneath their attacks. After a few moments of fruitless warfare, the murder of crows flies off, leaving the cornfield untouched.
rows.translation: 你沿着一片玉米田行走，空气突然被嘈杂鸦叫撕裂。长着两个脑袋的黑鸟成群围攻一个稻草人。你饶有兴致地看着稻草人在攻击下屹立不倒。徒劳交战片刻后，鸦群飞走，留下毫发无伤的玉米田。
rows.raw: "You walk alongside a field of corn, and the air is suddenly split by a cacophony of cawing. Dark birds, each sporting two heads, mob a scarecrow. You watch in amusement as the scarecrow refuses to fall beneath their attacks. After a few moments of fruitless warfare, the murder of crows flies off, leaving the cornfield untouched."
